1844524972.title: Log Extender
1844524972.description:
Adds more logs to the Logs directory the Project Zomboid game.

[h1]Description[/h1]
The Log Extender mod designed for Project Zomboid servers and adds log entries that helps administering the server. The mod allows you to save information about the levels of perk character, time of his survival, number of killed zombies and other information about the character. Log Extender also adds more building and action logs such as build campfire, light and extinguish campfires, toggle ovens and more actions with vehicles.

[h1]How to Use[/h1]
This mod does not work in single player mode. Therefore, it must be installed on a dedicated Project Zomboid server. You can see logs in Zomboid/Logs directory. See examples on [url=https://github.com/openzomboid/log-extender]github repository[/url].

[h1]Warning[/h1]
Mod Log Extender is under development and is being tested on the server [url=https://last-day.wargm.ru]Last Day[/url]. You can join our server or use the mod on your own server. If you think you have found a bug, write about it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1844524972/1638668751263547005/]bug reporting topic[/url] the Steam workshop or create issue in [url=https://github.com/openzomboid/log-extender]github repository[/url].

Workshop ID: 1844524972
Mod ID: LogExtender

2392676812.title: Antibodies (v1.97) [B41 + B42]
2392676812.description:
The Antibodies mod enhances the vanilla zombification mechanic by introducing an antibodies curve inspired by real-life immune system responses. If the antibodies successfully counteract the infection, the character will experience a gradual recovery over time.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]How it Works[/h2]

As you get infected, the Knox Virus in your body spreads. Alongside, your body slowly mounts an immunological response.

The antibodies output rate is tied to infection progression (peaks at 50% infection), your condition, wounds, infections and hygiene.

Your job is to sustain all positive effects, and reduce all negative effects (see diagnose panel) - so that antibodies can overtake the infection and eradicate the virus.

Playing as character with medical background actually makes sense now, since it allows you to diagnose yourself and others, and also provide significant bonuses while treating wounds.

By default, sandbox settings are rather forgiving. The easiest way to tweak that is by changing "Base Antibodies Growth" property in General section.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]FAQ:[/h1]

[b]Will this mod work if I install it after my character got infected?[/b]
Yes, unless you are past certain point. Infection length is randomized, but it takes between 2-3 days to resolve (either way).

[b]I've been nursing my character back to health for several days now, and he hasn't died, but it still says he's bitten. Should it be taking this long?[/b]

Most likely you are confusing a wound and the infection. Wound will stay with you for a while, even if you survive the virus - but it will eventually heal.

[b]Does this mod work in multiplayer mode?[/b]
Yes, including local co-op.

[b]Susceptible Mod compatibility?[/b]
Yes. Investigated by @The Animeville Horror. Thanks again.

[b]Does antibiotics pill found in the game help at all?[/b]
In real life antibiotics don't do anything against viruses. It will help by healing bacterial infections, however it won't do anything against Knox Virus.

[b]How can I make sure this mod works?[/b]
Create a character with medical background (with +2 First Aid) - this will add diagnose button in your health panel.
This is also the best way to tailor sandbox settings to your needs.

[b]How can I make this mod harder or adjust the difficulty?[/b]
The key setting is [i]Base Antibodies Growth[/i], which controls how quickly your character develops immunity. Here's what different values mean (assuming no other effects):
[list]
    [*][b]180 (default)[/b] - You overcome the infection at [b]40% progression[/b].
    [*][b]140[/b] - You overcome it at [b]66% progression[/b].
    [*][b]138[/b] - You overcome it at [b]70% progression[/b].
    [*][b]135[/b] - [b]You die[/b]. The infection progresses faster than your body can fight it.
[/list]

Every in-game effect modifies this baseline. You can adjust difficulty by:
[list]
    [*]Lowering [i]Base Antibodies Growth[/i] to shrink your margin for error.
    [*]Adding harsher penalties (e.g., from injuries, exhaustion, etc.).
    [*]Combining both for a tougher experience.
[/list]

[b]Personal note:[/b]
I think the vanilla Knox Infection kind of sidesteps some (even core) mechanics in the game. For example:
[list]
    [*][i]First Aid[/i] feels almost irrelevant without human enemies like bandits or raiders.
    [*][i]Tailoring[/i] also doesn't offer enough incentive to grind it to meaningful levels.
    [*][i]Hygiene/Washing[/i] completely meaningless, even though you can plumb your washing machine, after water gets shut off.
[/list]

Personally, I find [b]managing the infection[/b] more engaging than just hiding in a base for a few days - especially in multiplayer.
Don't worry, you will get cocky at some point, and you will get stranded without necessary supplies to survive the infection. It's just a matter of time.
But hey, don't let me tell you how to play your game.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Special Thanks:[/h1]

[b]MrTerreII[/b] for providing ES (Spanish) translation.
[b]VVentos[/b] for providing TR (Turkish) translation.
[b]llerafel[/b] for providing RU (Russian) translation.
[b]Rookavite[/b] for providing DE (German) translation.
[b]geuks[/b] for providing FR (French) translation.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Translations:[/h1]

I’m always happy to include more translations.
You can contribute here - and if you don’t know how to use Git, just drop me a message:
https://github.com/lonegamedev/pz_mod_antibodies

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Want to say thanks?[/h1]

If you enjoy the mod and want to support future updates, you can do so here:
[url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/lonegamedev]Buy Me a Coffee[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Known conflicts:[/h1]

[b]zRe Vaccine ReMod by kERHUS[/b] - this mod packs older version of Antibodies, and will break the current version. If you want new features please ask author of that mod to update theirs. You shouldn't try to run both.

The same goes for any other mod that includes previous version of Antibodies.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Update Schedule:[/h1]

I have constrained myself to update only Tue-Thu. All potential problems with the update should be resolved in this time window.

I do however reserve a right to fix critical issues ASAP (for example when game update breaks the mod).

2553809727.title: KillCount
2553809727.description:
Details kills by weapon category and by weapon in a new dedicated tab of character window.
[Solo]Adds to the genuine character panel the number of Z that died of other things than player weapon.

[h1]B42.12 Limitations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Car kills are now partially counted by vanilla. This can create counters discrepencies.
[*]Ask your questions on [url=https://discord.gg/theindiestone]Discord mod_support channel[/url].
[/list]

[h1]Technical details[/h1]
[list]
[*]Total number of kills can be exported (if selected in sandbox options) to %username%/Zomboid/lua/killcount.txt (windows path)
[*][Solo only] Counts fire kills in addition to vanilla weapon kills on the genuine character sheet.
[*][Solo & Multiplayer] Details kills by weapon category and by weapon in a new dedicated tab of character window.
[*][Multiplayer] You can visualise the kills of other players, with a delay (configurable in sandbox options).
[*][Multiplayer] You can visualise the total number of kills on the server (same delay).
[*][Multiplayer] You can deactivate the sharing of dead characters from sandbox options (to reduce GlobalModData size on never-wiping servers).
[*][Multiplayer] You can deactivate the sharing of kill count from sandbox options (to remove GlobalModData use).
[*]Visible at death time in the PostDeathUI text (can be removed in sandbox options).
[*]Handles character specific counters (saved with mod data, so server must be stopped properly for the values to be saved).
[*]Works only for one local player. i.e. not for multiscreen.
[*]Ask your questions on [url=https://discord.gg/theindiestone]Discord mod_support channel[/url].
[/list]

2699828474.title: Rebalanced Prop Moving
2699828474.description:
Do I really need a hammer to move a couch?
I wish I could move this desk, but I haven't taken any carpentry classes!

This mod removes the nails holding your furniture and appliances to the floor!

Details:
- Furniture and appliances require no skill/tool to move.
- Fixtures like cabinets and shelves still require skills/tools.
- Break chance for props requiring skills/tools has been reduced to 30% at skill level 0, 20% at 1, 10% at 2, and 0% for >=3.
- Break chance for props not requiring skills/tools is now 0%.
- Sinks in vanilla have no associated skill and receive a 25% break chance default. Changed to 0% since apparently no skill is required!
- All the above only applies to "pickup" and "place" actions. Disassembly should not be affected by this mod.

The mod works by "whitelisting" props if their name matches certain patterns. This implies that the patterns may catch too much or too little, so feel free to provide feedback if you think some props should or should not require a skill/tool.

Note: Not compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2685057281]Safer Prop Moving[/url]

Disclaimer: There could be big bugs in this mod! The vanilla lua code has numerous edge cases, please comment if you discover issues.

Should be compatible with 42.0 - 42.16


Workshop ID: 2699828474
Mod ID: RebalancedPropMoving

2769706949.title: Tidy Up Meister
2769706949.description:
[h2][b]The vanilla game added automatic item return behavior in Build 42.8.0. However, some actions are still not covered by the vanilla implementation, including certain firearm operations and restoring items to their original placement on the ground. Tidy Up Meister complements the vanilla behavior and is designed to work alongside it rather than disable or replace it.[/b][/h2]

[h1]Overview :[/h1]
Automatically restores your equipment and returns temporarily moved items after an action is completed.
[b][i]Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable and in MP.[/i][/b]

[h1]Features :[/h1]
[list]
[*]After an action temporarily changes your equipment, the items in your hands and worn equipment are restored to their previous state.
[*]Items temporarily moved out of a bag or other container are returned to their original container.
[*]Items taken from the ground are returned to their original square, position, and rotation.
[*]Replacement items, such as food left after opening or partially consuming an item, can also be returned to the original location.
[*]You can toggle automatic re-equipping from the context menu. This setting is stored separately for each character, making it useful when you want to perform several actions continuously without restoring your equipment each time.
[*]For a visual demonstration, please check the introduction video above.
[/list]

[h1]Build 42 V2 :[/h1]
The Build 42.20 implementation has been completely redesigned. Instead of individually modifying every supported action, V2 observes the Timed Action queue and identifies sequences in which equipment or items are temporarily moved for another operation.

This allows V2 to support a much wider range of vanilla and modded actions without requiring a separate patch for every action. Explicit player actions, such as manually equipping, unequipping, or placing an item, are distinguished from temporary equipment changes and are not automatically reverted.

Because actions from other mods may use unusual queue behavior, compatibility with every modded action cannot be guaranteed. Please report any action that is not detected correctly.

[h1]Options :[/h1]
Build 42 options are available from the built-in Mod Options screen.
Build 41 uses [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2169435993]Mod Options[/url], and the available legacy options may differ.
[list]
[*]Show Re-Equip Toggle in Context Menu : Adds an option to the context menu that enables or disables automatic re-equipping after actions.
[*]Re-Equip Held Items After Interruptions : By default, interrupted actions do not restore your equipment. Enable this option to restore only the items that were in your hands before the interrupted action.
[*]Return Materials from Dismantling : Returns materials obtained by dismantling an item to the container the dismantled item came from.
[*]Diagnostic Output : Outputs troubleshooting information to the game log. Detailed logging may affect performance, so enable it only while reproducing an issue.
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility :[/h1]
[list]
[*]V2 is designed to work alongside the automatic return behavior included in the vanilla game.
[*]Because V2 observes general Timed Action sequences instead of modifying individual actions, many modded actions can work without dedicated compatibility code.
[*]Inventory placement information is preserved where the current game APIs provide it.
[*]Compatibility with unusual or custom Timed Actions cannot be guaranteed. Please report any action that does not restore correctly or is reverted when it should not be.
[/list]

[h1]For Modders :[/h1]
Most Timed Actions do not require any special integration with Tidy Up Meister. However, compatibility registration may be necessary if your action intentionally changes equipment, clothing, or an item's container as its final result. Without registration, Tidy Up Meister may interpret those changes as temporary preparation and restore the previous state. Please consider implementing the compatibility enhancements based on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2769706949/585056462065257022/]For Modders: Compatibility API[/url]
 thread.

[h1]Known Issues :[/h1]
[list]
[*]No known critical issues.
[*]Some modded actions may use queue or cancellation behavior that V2 cannot identify correctly.
[*][h3][b]If you encounter a problem, please report it in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2769706949/4638240084912525660/]Bug & Issue Reports[/url].[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Use the character context menu to disable re-equipping, reproduce the problem again, and state whether this changes the behavior.
[*]If the issue occurs only when this mod is enabled, please follow the steps below to gather and report detailed information.
[list]
[*]Enable "Diagnostic Output" and select "Log only" or "Log + overhead text."
[*]Reproduce the problem.
[*]Open the "console.txt" file in your Zomboid user folder.
[*]Include the lines containing "[P4TidyUpMeister]" in your report.
[*]Describe the action you were performing and the exact steps that caused the problem.
[*]List any mods that may be related.
[*]State whether the problem occurred in SP or MP.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Future plans :[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bug fixes and compatibility improvements as needed.
[/list]

[h1]Remarks :[/h1]
[list]
[*]You may include this mod in a mod pack without requesting permission or providing credit. However, please use it at your own risk.
[*]The mod has been tested in both SP and MP, but behavior may differ depending on the game version, server configuration, and other installed mods.
[/list]

[h1]Release Notes :[/h1]
[list]
[*]v2.0 - Completely redesigned for Build 42.20.
[*]v1.37 - Hotfix for Build 42.15.
[*]v1.36 - Hotfix for Build 42.13.
[*]v1.35 - Fixed an error in Build 42.11.0.
[*]v1.34 - Added restoration of X/Y rotation in Build 42.
[*]v1.33 - Added support for Bath Towels Overhaul.
Please refer to "Change Notes" for older release history.
[/list]

2776874515.title: M-13's Reading Tweaks
2776874515.description:
[h1]Mod is up to date for B42.20.
Multiplayer should work from 42.15 Onwards.[/h1]


[h1]Mod Information:[/h1]
[b]Workshop ID: 2776874515
Mod ID: M13ReadingTweaks[/b]

[h1]Mod Description:[/h1]

[b][u]What does this mod do?[/u][/b]
Simply put this mod allows you to read faster (or slower) and allows you to even read a book while you walk.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1911232111872208012/A47BDE834A5BA16FBC094B96CBD453C70E8E0A6A/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=#000000&letterbox=false[/img]
The mod also has it's own Sandbox options you can use to configure if you want to be able to read while walking, how fast or slow you read AND if you want to read faster when sitting down!

[b][u]How does it work?[/u][/b]
Either start a new game and adjust the settings under [b][Custom Sandbox][/b]
OR install a mod that allows you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=108600&searchtext=change+sandbox+options][b][Change Sandbox Options][/b][/url] for a game you've already started.

You can find all the settings under [b][M-13's Reading Tweaks][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1GyB0A9.jpg[/img]

[b]Minutes per page (Build 41 only)[/b]
This value determines how fast or slow you read books while standing or walking.
The default for SOLO is 2.0, The default for Servers is 1.0
The lower this value, the faster you read.
(For example: setting this to 0.1 will make you read really fast)
[b]B42 Users can find this setting under "Character", it's called "Minutes Per Skill Book Page"[/b]

[b]Sitting Multiplier[/b]
This value multiplies the reading speed, but only applies to when you are sitting.
The Higher this value, the faster you read.
Pre 42.15 this only applied to ground and furniture, from 42.15 onwards, this applies to sitting in Vehicles as well.

[b]Read while walking[/b]
Enable this to read a book while walking.

[b][u]Does this mod work with other mods?[/u][/b]
Yes, I've tested a few mods and it worked with all the books they included.

[b][u]Does this mod work with Multiplayer?[/u][/b]
Yes, B41 works, but B42 only works from 42.15 Onwards.

[b][u][h1]After an update my character is reading slower/faster then they used to, why?[/h1][/u][/b]
Sometimes i am forced to change stuff in the mod that forces the game to reset certain values back to default
The first good example of this was when B42 introduced [b]Minutes per Skill Book Page[/b] as a vanilla sandbox setting, which made this mod's [b]Minutes per page[/b] setting absolete.
There is nothing i can do about this but you won't have to start a new game because the fix is pretty simple:

[quote]
Use [b]DEBUG[/b] mode (or a mod) to change your savegame's sandbox settings.
(Starting a new game also works, but that would be overkill right?)
[/quote]

How do i enable debug mode?
[quote]
To enable debug mode:
- Rightclick on Project Zomboid in your Steam Library
- Click on Properties
- In the box under [b]Launch Options[/b] type:  [b]-debug[/b]

- Launch Project Zomboid and load your save.
- Click on the WASP looking icon on the left side of the screen, this is the [b]DEBUG MENU[/b].
- Click on [b]Sandbox Settings[/b]

If you want ALL reading to go faster:
- Click on the [b]Character[/b] tab and look for [b]Minutes per skill book page[/b]
- Lower it's value to make reading go faster.

If you only want reading to go faster when sitting:
- Click on the [b]M-13's Reading Tweaks[/b] tab and look for [b]Sitting Multiplier[/b]
- The higher this number, the faster you read when sitting on the ground or on furniture.

After you are done changing values click [b]Apply Changes[/b]
If you want to disable DEBUG MODE, close your game and remove -debug from the launch options.
[b]The settings you changed will only take effect AFTER you reloaded your save game.[/b]
[/quote]

[b][u]What if i do not want to use this mod anymore?[/u][/b]
This mod can be removed from your game without consequences.

[b][u]Does this work for Multiplayer?[/u][/b]
For B41: Yes it does, but it overwrites the "MinutesPerPage" value in your server's sandbox settings.
When Multiplayer for B42 releases, i expect no issues regarding this either.

It [i]should[/i] also work in Co-op, but i have not tested this.

[/list]

[list]
[*]Dropping casings when firing regular firearms

[*]Randomly returning old casings to simulate wear
[*]Collect old casings with custom search focus in foraging mode

[*]Added definitions dynamically adjust all relevant systems
[*]Templates with full description in: [i]…\AmmoMaker\api\ammomaker_apiTables.lua[/i]
[/list]

2815966702.title: Rabbit Hash, KY [B42+ Update]
2815966702.description:
[h1]EARLY RELEASE - Build 42 Support: [/h1]
We have released a preliminary version of the map compatible with Build 42 to get it out there for people to enjoy. It is worth noting that there are several issues we have not worked out:
[list]
    [*]Zombie spawn density has changed - Comment how you feel about the current values, if they are too low or too high, or if a particular area needs love
    [*]Some archways inside houses render improperly
    [*]Marine Petrol Station sign renders improperly when under the roof
    [*]Tree leaves render inside of houses in some areas
[/list]

[h1]About the Map: [/h1]
A generally quiet river town, Rabbit Hash is known for its iconic General Store. Here, you will find all manner of goodies to help you out on your journey along the rural route to Louisville.

Rabbit Hash is a real-world location in KY, although it has been displaced a bit geographically and now finds itself a fair ways down the river from its former home.

[h1]Map Features: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]🗺️ Lootable in-game map
    [*]🔍 Foraging Zones
    [*]🚙 Modded 'military' vehicle spawn zones
    [*]🥾 Lots of 4-wheeler trails to sneak between various POIs
    [*]🌽 A big fancy farm with several facilities to explore
    [*]🏪 A really cool general store with custom tiles for the sign
    [*]⛵ A variety of docks & other infrastructure to support your boating habits
    [*]👮‍♀️ A Police Station
[/list]

[h1]Technical Stuff:[/h1]
Rabbit Hash and its particular geometry and layout seemed to fit well into the chosen cells & surrounding road system. The map does a good job of filling in some dead space between Riverside & West Point.

This is our first map & as such it only uses the vanilla tiles (aside from the awesome sign). The map may have some errors, feel free to comment and I'll do my best to fix anything. You may also feel that the loot is too heavy or light as I built a majority of the buildings as I went, so feel free to voice any bugs/loot/etc issues as well. Expect semi-frequent updates, but have some patience with us as we wrap our heads around the idiosyncracies of Build 42 mapping.

[h1]Compatibility:[/h1]
[strike]So far, the only map I've found that Rabbit Hash conflicts with is North Peak. The cell is included in that map, but isn't used. Simply load Rabbit Hash before North Peak and both maps should work fine.[/strike]
No promises on compatibility as of Build 42. The change in cell size from 300x300 tiles to 256x256 tiles expanded the map's footprint slightly, and maps that previously occupied adjacent cells but otherwise played nicely prior to B42 may be incompatible.
Drop a comment if you find any maps that conflict with cells used by RH. YMMV.


[b]Like the map? Please show your support, it helps a lot![/b]

2907834593.title: Calorie Fix
2907834593.description:
42 compatible! This mod fixes the abnormally high calorie burn rate from simply walking that was introduced in version 41.78, that causes walking to consume more calories than running. Currently in 41.78 (and it appears on 42) walking will consume 110% of the calories as running the same distance. This mod changes that so walking consumes 40% the calories as running the same distance. Thumbs up if you like it.

NOTE: You have to load this mod from the load game screen, not the main menu UI, if you want it to work on an existing save game.

Eternal thanks to Chuckleberry Finn for developing the original code for this mod and allowing me to use it.

[b]THIS MOD IS INCOMPATIBLE with Chuckleberry's "Rebalanced Calorie Burning" mod.[/b] My mod here is basically the scaled down version of his that just does one simple thing, adjusts the calorie burn on walking, while his allows you to tweak and adjust a ton of other features with calories. But they WILL NOT work together.

If any feedback or bugs please let me know.

***
BACKGROUND

With the 41.78 update to PZ the game adjusted the walking calorie burn rate so that it's more than just standing still doing nothing which is fine, but the problem is they over corrected and increased it so much that walking now takes MORE calories than running the same distance. So you actually save calories and get fatter by running versus walking everywhere which is counter intuitive and makes no sense.

If you wondered why on 41.78 your character was going into starvation even though you are playing the same way you always have eating a balanced diet this is why. This abnormally high change to walking calories burn rate also meant that foraging for food had become obsolete since you now use more calories than you gain from foraging, and doing things like resting at your safehouse and moving around organizing things will burn as much calories as running a marathon outside all day. This mod fixes that.

***

FAQ

Q. What does this mod actually do?
A. It changes the per second walking calorie burn rate scaling from .6 to .22 now, which when factoring in running speed vs walking speed over a fixed distance means that walking now takes approximately 40% of the calories as running the same distance. This ratio will shrink as your sprinting skill increases and will be affected by any run modifying clothes.

Q. How do I know if this mod is actually working?
A. I've tested it quite thoroughly so it appears to be doing its job (pending any big game updates). If you want to verify though download Minimal Display Bars mod then pick a fixed distance to move back and forth from. Walking that fixed distance should only use 40% of the calories as running the same distance if the mod is working correctly. Keep in mind this burn rate will be affected if you are wearing clothes that modify run rate and/or have a high sprint skill.

Q. I just enabled the mod on my existing save game but it’s not working?
A. You have to enable it in the load game screen section to apply it to an existing save game, not the main menu.

Q. Will this mod work with other mods?
A. It should since not many other mods affect calorie burn rate.

Q. Will this mod work on multiplayer servers?
A. I don’t know. I think so? I’m still learning modding so if you discover that it does or doesn’t let me know.

Q. I just peeked under the hood of this mod and it seems unnecessarily complicated for changing a single calorie scaling number.
A. That is because you can’t actually change a single calorie scaling number. The genius behind the code on this mod, Chuckleberry Finn, instead found a workaround and recreated the entire vanilla calculations for calorie burn rate while moving. So when this mod is enabled what happens is that there are actually two calorie burn calculations occurring simultaneously, the vanilla one and this modified one. This mod then adjusts the final calorie burn rate by the difference. Hence why it appears so complicated.

***

If you enjoy this fix please consider thanking [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2840487215&tscn=1769588222]Chuckleberry Finn[/url] who did the coding work on it by enjoying some of his other mods or supporting him from the links found on his mod descriptions.

2948824747.title: Inspect Weapon
2948824747.description:
[h1] About [/h1]
Tired of scrolling to your equipped section of the inventory to check your weapon's status and attachments?

This mod allows you to inspect your currently equipped weapon on your primary hand at anytime, by:

- Hold down the reload button and choose "Inspect Weapon"
- Right click on any weapon in your inventory or a world container and choose "Inspect Weapon"  will automatically try to equip it in your primary hand slot and inspect it
- Pressing [b];[/b] button to inspect current weapon. You can rebind this button through PZ's default option menu

This mod comes with a simple UI and a terrible animation that took an hour to make :)

[h1] Stats & Navigating UI [/h1]
Unlike the exact stats that are shown within the weapon's tooltip, the "condition" and "number of repair" stat are shown in estimation text (yes, I took this out of the DayZ book). I personally think that this will give players a better immersion on how their characters physically see the condition of the weapon, rather than numbers on a datasheet.

[b] Condition [/b]
- Pristine: This weapon has a perfect 100% condition, and on top of that, it was never repaired
- Used: This weapon has a condition between 50%, all the way to 100%. Weapons that are 100% but were repaired even once will get knocked down from "Pristine", to this category
- Damaged: This weapon has a condition between 30% to 50%
- Badly Damaged: This weapon has its condition less than 30%

[b] Number of repair [/b]
- No sign of repair: Pretty self-explanatory, this weapon hasn't been repaired even once
- Slightly repaired: This weapon has been repaired, but less than 3 times
- Heavily repaired: This weapon has been repaired at least 3 times

It is sort of hard to determine what's the good number for "Number of repair" stat. Realistically, I think 3 times duct taping or replacing some parts of a firearm would look noticeable enough to be deemed "Heavily repaired"

[b] Repair [/b]
If weapon is damaged, an "information" button will be shown next to "Number of repair" stat. You can press on it and directly fix your weapon from the pop-up context menu, just like how you usually do it within the inventory pane

[b] Attachments [/b]
This section is only shown for ranged weapon. I am not too sure if the melee weapons can use attachments (or any mods out there that allows it), prove me wrong :)

Attachments can be equipped by clicking on a blank attachment slot, and a list should show options for compatible attachments for that slot. To un-equip it, double clicking on a currently equipped slot.

For "Magazine" slot specifically, ammo will be shown for each one, and you can choose to load or unload them by right clicking on them.

[b] For controller [/b]
You can navigate the UI using D-Pad buttons, with [i]A (South) Button[/i] as accept, [i]B (East) Button[/i] as Back/Close, and [i]X (West) Button[/i] as Context/Sub menu

Also please be advised, I am aware of the issue that the radial menu entry not showing. This has to do with other gun mods overwriting all the radial menu entries. For VFE specifically, I am working with the devs to figure out a solution to that.

[h1] To-do list [/h1]
[b] High priority [/b]
- [strike]Repair weapon[/strike]
- [strike]Indication for screwdriver in inventory[/strike]
- [strike]Potential fits into attachment slot[/strike]
- [strike]Magazine display (if applicable)[/strike]
- [strike]Working with multiplayer[/strike]
- [strike]Custom keybind to inspect current weapon[/strike]
- [strike]Window position save[/strike]

[b] Low priority [/b]
- [strike]Controller support for all my Steam Deck homies out there[/strike]
- [strike]Splitscreen coop support[/strike]
- Add ability to move window for controller
- Skill check to enable potential fits into attachment slot

[h1] Frequently asked questions [/h1]
[b] Is this compatible with VFE? [/b]
- Some adjustments to the mod has been made for VFE for attachments of several firearms to show up. There might be other undiscovered issues, so if you have found any, let me know how to recreate it.

[b] Is this compatible with other weapon mods? [/b]
- So far several of them were confirmed to be working, but some might have some issues, if they introduce new mechanics to how vanilla weapon should work. I can't test it all myself, so do try it for yourself. My goal for this mod is to keep it as compatible with the vanilla as possible, so any changes in the future by IndieStone wouldn't affect it too much.

[b] Why don't those melee weapons have inspect animation? [/b]
- I actually do not know how to make the animation for this to look interesting enough...? I'm open for suggestion on this one.

[b] Does it work with B42? [/b]
- Currently, yes!

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
This is my first ever published mod. It took about a week of work to make. Any feedback from the end-user experience, to code improvement is appreciated.

Massive thanks to:

2951270166.title: Trees Have Loot [B41 &  B42]
2951270166.description:
[h2]Build Support: B41.78 and B42.12 to B42.20[/h2]
[i]B42.20 compatibility reviewed. SP / MP Host tested on recent builds. Dedicated server feedback is welcome.[/i]

[h1][b]Trees Have Loot[/b][/h1]

[b]Trees Have Loot[/b] adds contextual interactions to trees, letting you [b]search them for small foraging loot[/b] or [b]cut branches from large trees[/b] with the right tool.

You may find twigs, branches, bugs, fruit, pine cones, wild eggs, dead critters and other small surprises depending on the tree, season, temperature, tree size and your character’s skills.

This version keeps PepperCat’s original gameplay idea while updating the mod for recent Project Zomboid versions, including Build 41 support, Build 42 multibuild support and multiplayer handling.

[h2][b]Difference vs the original Trees Have Loot[/b][/h2]
This version is based on PepperCat’s original [b]Trees Have Loot[/b] and adds:
[list]
[*][b]Build 42 multibuild support[/b], from [b]B42.12[/b] to [b]B42.20[/b].
[*][b]Legacy B41.78 support[/b] for older saves and setups.
[*][b]Multiplayer support for B42.13+[/b].
[*]Server-side handling for tree search and branch cutting results in MP.
[*]Updated B42 item, tool and tag compatibility.
[*]Improved pathing to trees using a vanilla gardening-style approach.
[*]Updated translation support, including B42.15+ JSON translations.
[*]Updated B42.20 tree definitions, including new larger [b]JUMBOXL[/b] and [b]JUMBOXXL[/b] tree variants where relevant.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[h2][b][u]Search in tree[/u][/b][/h2]
Search a tree for small loot.

Your character will walk to the tree, turn toward it and search inside it. When the action finishes, the mod rolls for possible loot.

The result depends on several factors:
[list]
[*]Tree size.
[*]Foraging skill.
[*]Season and world temperature.
[*]Tree type.
[*]Whether the tree has already been searched recently.
[/list]

Possible finds include:
[list]
[*]Twigs and branches.
[*]Bugs and small foraging finds.
[*]Fruit from fruit trees when conditions are right.
[*]Pine cones from pine trees.
[*]Wild eggs in warmer seasons, especially from larger trees.
[*]Rare dead critters.
[/list]

[h3][b]Seasonal behavior[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Winter:[/b] mostly twigs and branches.
[*][b]Autumn:[/b] twigs, branches and a few bugs.
[*][b]Spring:[/b] twigs, branches and more bugs. Large trees can also have wild eggs.
[*][b]Summer:[/b] twigs, branches and many bugs. Large trees have better chances for wild eggs.
[/list]

[h3][b]Extra search details[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The [b]Foraging[/b] skill improves the search chance.
[*]Pine trees can drop pine cones, with chances affected by tree size and player Strength.
[*]Fruit trees can provide fruit when the season and temperature allow it.
[*]Searching large trees without hand protection can scratch the player’s hands.
[*]Pulling twigs or branches from a tree can slightly reduce Endurance.
[*]Searched trees become available again after about [b]1 in-game day[/b].
[/list]

[h2][b][u]Cut branch from tree[/u][/b][/h2]
Equip a suitable sharp tool and cut branches from large trees.

Supported tools include knives and axes, with behavior depending on the tool type:
[list]
[*][b]Knives:[/b] the cut branch is added to the player’s inventory.
[*][b]Axes:[/b] the cut branch falls to the ground.
[/list]

The result can be a tree branch or sapling, depending on the current build and available items.

[h3][b]Extra branch-cutting details[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Only large enough trees can be used for cutting branches.
[*]Cutting branches can reduce the tool’s condition.
[*]The action slightly tires the player.
[*]Pine trees can also drop pine cones.
[*]Dead squirrels or birds may fall from the tree.
[*]Trees can run out of available branches for a while, preventing infinite branch farming from the same tree.
[*]Branch cutting has a longer cooldown: branches regrow after about [b]30 in-game days[/b].
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Builds / Multiplayer[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Build 41 support:[/b] compatible with [b]B41.78[/b].
[*][b]Build 42 multibuild support:[/b] compatible from [b]B42.12[/b] to [b]B42.20[/b].
[*][b]B42.20 compatibility:[/b] reviewed against the current vanilla files.
[*][b]B42.20 tree update:[/b] new larger tree sprite variants are covered where relevant for pine-tree and fruit-tree checks.
[*][b]MP support for B42.13+:[/b] search and cut results are handled server-side to reduce desync.
[*][b]Priority support:[/b] focused on the latest tested Build 42 version.
[/list]

[h1][b]Compatibility Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]This mod adds context-menu interactions to trees and should be compatible with most mods that do not heavily replace tree or world-object behavior.
[*]Mods that change tree objects, foraging loot, item definitions or tool categories may affect results.
[*]If testing on a server, please verify item spawning and inventory sync before using it on a live save.
[*]Dedicated server reports are especially useful.
[*]Existing saves should work, but testing on a copy of your save is recommended.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Credits[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Original mod, concept and design by [b]PepperCat[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/alexaltez95/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop[/url]
[*]Build 42 compatibility update and maintenance by [b]Afyrmo[/b], with PepperCat’s permission: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop[/url]
[/list]

Special thanks to everyone reporting issues, testing multiplayer behavior and helping keep PepperCat’s mods updated for newer Project Zomboid builds.

[h2]PepperCat's mods :)[/h2]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2459400130]Dynamic Traits and Expanded Moodles[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3675868751]Expanded Moodles[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2951270166]Trees Have Loot[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2971021306]Surviving The Storm[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3428146910]Wash Or Rot[/url][/b]
[/list]

2951816996.title: Server Tweaker
2951816996.description:
Server Tweaker contains careful edits that do not affect significant game mechanics and fixes some annoying bugs. First of all, the mod will be interesting for the owners of their servers, since all the changes are intended to improve the quality of life in multiplayer mode. Server Tweaker is developed for the need of [url=https://last-day.wargm.ru]Last Day[/url] server.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed some game bugs.
    [*] Many quality of life improvements that increase the convenience of the gameplay and administration.
    [*] All improvements can be turned off in the sandbox settings. Don't require a server restart, and most of them don't require a client restart either.
    [*] Provided libraries for use as API in other mods. The utilities located in the shared/openutils, client/clientutils and server/serverutils directories are designed in such a way that they can be easily used in other mods. There is no need to copy pieces of code, just call the functions themselves from shared libraries.
[/list]

[h1]Configuration[/h1]
For details see [url=https://github.com/openzomboid/server-tweaker]GitHub repository[/url]. In the sandbox settings there is a "Server Tweaker" tab where you can change the following settings:

[h2]Server Sandbox Options[/h2]
[list]
    [*] HighlightSafehouse (default=true) - Shows color highlight of area of players Safehouse to members. If the HighlightSafehouse option is enabled in the server sandbox settings, then the same setting becomes available to the player in the client settings. Each player will be able to choose for himself whether to highlight the territory or not.
    [*] ShowCoordinates (default=true) - Adds coordinates to the character view interface (J). The player must have any watch that displays the date.
    [*] EnableSuicideCommand (default=true)` - Adds suicide command to chat with confirmation window. The character will immediately die after entering this command and confirmation.
    [*] AdminSafehouseExtension (default=true) - Turns on several changes at once in the interface for creating a custom Safezone.
    [list]
        [*] Removes the restriction on the minimum size of an arbitrary Safezone - it becomes possible to create a Safezone with a size of 1x1 tiles.
        [*] The Savezone creation interface now allows you to specify all Safezone members. A comma is used as a separator.
        [*] Added the ability to create a Savezone for a player who is not online on the server.
    [/list]
    [*] SafehouseVehicleProtection (default=false) - Protects vehicles wholly or partly in a safehouse. Hidden the radial menu of these vehicles for a non-Hideout character and disabled the ability to enter the vehicle and open the mechanics menu. Also, such cars cannot be towed by another car. In the original game, such cars are often stolen or parts are twisted from them, which causes discomfort on PVE servers. Enabling this setting will improve this user experience.
    [*] ElevatedStaffPermissions (default=false) - Currently, this only enables the context menu on the global map for roles with the "SeeWorldMap" permission. Roles with the "TeleportToCoordinates" permission now have the ability to freely teleport on the global map.
    [*] BrushToolFix (default=false) - Fixes synchronization issues with objects placed using the Brush Tool. Objects are now synchronized between players and are not deleted when rejoining the server. Special thanks to James "J" Kelly and his Astaroth server for their assistance in development.
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
Game version: Build 42.20+ (Multiplayer)
There is practically no rough patching in the mod with a complete replacement of the vanilla functions code, so good compatibility with all mods from the workshop is assumed. Also, the mod is compatible with existing saves and safe for remove.

[h1]Translations[/h1]
This mod has full translations to following languages:
[list]
    [*]English (EN)
    [*]Russian (RU)
[/list]
If you'd like to translate this mod, post your translations to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2951816996/3824159062924268441]translations topic[/url] and I will add it with credits in-place.

[h1]Warning[/h1]
If you think you have found a bug, write about it in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2951816996/3824159062917518549/]bug reporting topic[/url]
the Steam workshop or create issue in [url=https://github.com/openzomboid/server-tweaker]GitHub repository[/url]

[b]Server Tweaker is under development and can be updated frequently.[/b]

[h1]Thanks[/h1]
Thanks to everyone for the help and interest in this mod. You make this mod better.
[list]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198090202334]@Di-Crash[/url] - For helping with coding
    [*]Last Day server moderators and GMs  - For helping with testing
[/list]

2956146279.title: Rain Cleans Blood [B42.20 + MP]
2956146279.description:
Tired of zombies splattering their brains all over your pretty lawn? Well no more! Just wait for some rain or snow and watch it all fade away.

[h1]What gets cleaned?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Blood on the ground, walls, and floors
[*]Ash left behind by burned corpses
[*]Animal droppings (dung) on the ground (B42+)
[*]Blood and dirt on your worn clothing (B42+)
[*]Blood on nearby vehicles (B42+)
[/list]

Everything fades gradually, only while it's raining or snowing (unless you turn that off), and every part of it is configurable.

[h1]Does it work in multiplayer?[/h1]
Yes, fully server-authoritative.

[h1]Can I add this to my current game?[/h1]
Yes, you can add or remove this mod at any time. It contains no save-breaking features.

[h1]How does it work?[/h1]
Every game minute the mod checks the weather intensity against a configurable threshold. If it's raining or snowing hard enough, it randomly selects a number of nearby tiles and cleans them. Clothing and vehicles are cleaned incrementally on the same tick.

[h1]Why not always?[/h1]
Immersion — watching blood fade in the rain just feels right. The gradual approach also keeps the performance impact minimal. That said, there's a sandbox option to always clean regardless of weather if you prefer.

[h1]Sandbox options[/h1]
Everything is configurable: cleaning speed, weather threshold, tiles per minute, and toggles for ash, animal droppings, indoor cleaning, vehicles, and clothing.

2990322197.title: Point Blank
2990322197.description:
Works with B42 MP update

While shooting a firearm, if you are within extreme proximity of the target zombie, the target will instantly die. (Or take a lot of damage, if you configure it in sandbox options)

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Recent Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where one shot could kill a zombie that wasn't in your line of fire. Point Blank now resolves its kill before the engine decides what the bullet hits, so the shot can't go on to put down a second zombie. Controlled by the new [i]PointBlankExperimentalHitLimitations[/i] option (on by default) — turn it off to restore the old behaviour.
[*]Fixed the sandbox options showing raw/garbled text instead of readable labels.
[*]Point blank now has a cooldown between kills — .5s by default, dropping to .1s as your Aiming skill levels up. You'll barely notice it with pistols/revolvers; automatics will feel it more. Want point blank more restricted for balance? Bump [i]PointBlankCooldownDuration[/i] up to 1-2 seconds — [i]PointBlankCooldownDurationMin[/i] can be adjusted too, and it'll still scale correctly with your Aiming skill.
[*]Two-handed weapons (rifles, shotguns) now get a larger point blank range than one-handed ones (pistols, revolvers), since the muzzle sits further from your body.
[*]Added rough translations for the remaining languages.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Preview[/h2]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bnbjy8FDgCo

[hr][/hr]
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer? Yes.
[*]Can this be added/removed mid-save? Yes.
[*]Works with Advanced Trajectory / Brita's / Arsenal / Realistic Guns? Yes.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Other Mods[/h1]

Ever find another vehicle with a dead battery and be like "where the fk are my [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3044422476]jumper cables[/url]?" ... i found them in this 90's infomercial: https://youtu.be/OwuG9AleQS4

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3044422476][img]https://i.imgur.com/IEY7g9J.gif[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Sandbox Options[/h1]

[h3]Point Blank - Aiming Xp Multiplier[/h3]
Any xp gains from killing a zombie will be multiplied by this value.
[code]Default = .05[/code]

[h3]Point Blank - Effective Range[/h3]
Zombies shot at a distance below this value will take point blank damage. Applies to one-handed weapons (pistols, revolvers).
[code]Default = 1.85[/code]

[h3]Point Blank - Effective Range (Two-Handed Weapons)[/h3]
Same as above, but for two-handed weapons (rifles, shotguns). Set higher than the one-handed value, since the muzzle sits further from the player's body.
[code]Default = 2.3[/code]

[h3]Point Blank - Cooldown Between Point Blank Kills at Min Aiming Skill (seconds)[/h3]
Real-world seconds required between point blank triggers at Aiming skill level 0, regardless of game speed or framerate. This is the longest the cooldown gets — it scales down toward the value below as your Aiming skill increases.
[code]Default = .5[/code]

[h3]Point Blank - Cooldown Between Point Blank Kills at Max Aiming Skill (seconds)[/h3]
The cooldown used once you've reached Aiming skill level 10 — the shortest the cooldown gets. Scales linearly between this and the value above based on your current Aiming skill level.
[code]Default = .1[/code]

[h3]Point Blank - Experimental Hit Limitations[/h3]
Limits one trigger pull to a single point blank victim. Point Blank picks the closest zombie in range and resolves the kill before the engine chooses what the bullet hits, so the shot can no longer put down a second zombie out of your line of fire. Note that this means a point blank kill consumes the shot — a zombie further down range won't also be hit. Turn this off to restore the previous behaviour.
[code]Default = true[/code]

[h3]Point Blank - Min Ticks Between Point Blank Kills[/h3]
Set this higher to enforce a "cooldown" between point blank kills. By default, this ensures point blank can't trigger multiple times in a single tick.
[code]Default = 1[/code]

[i]Point Blank - Disable Multiplayer Command Updates[/i]
[i]For debugging purposes — you shouldn't need to change this. If you're having server/client/networking issues, this disables synchronous server/client updates. Without it, there can be a delay before a point-blank-killed zombie appears dead to other players.[/i]
[code]Default = false[/code]

[h3]Point Blank - Instant Kill[/h3]
If TRUE, when shooting a zombie within point blank range, they die instantly. If FALSE, the bonus damage options below apply instead.
[code]Default = true[/code]

[i]Only relevant if Instant Kill (above) is disabled:[/i]

[i]Point Blank - Minimum Bonus Damage[/i]
[i]The minimum amount of bonus damage applied. E.g. if your base damage is .0001, this raises the effective bonus damage to at least this value.[/i]
[code]Default = .15[/code]

[i]Point Blank - Bonus Damage Multiplier[/i]
[i]This multiplier is applied to your bonus damage from above. Does NOT affect BASE damage, ONLY bonus damage.[/i]
[code]Default = .4[/code]

[i]Damage Equation[/i]
[code]TotalDamage = BaseDamage + PointBlankDamage
PointBlankDamage = Max(BaseDamage, PointBlankMinimumBonusDamage) * PointBlankBonusDamageMultiplier[/code]
[i](BaseDamage is your weapon's own damage stat — the "MaxDamage" value from its item definition)[/i]

Hidden from sandbox options, for debugging, punch this into lua console:
[code]HF_PointBlank.Debug()[/code]

If ARTO is enabled, Point Blank is disabled for shotguns.

[hr][/hr]

2996978365.title: Dynamic Backpack Upgrades [ B41-B42.20 ]
2996978365.description:
[h2] 42.20 update [/h2]
Once again thank Lenniitsch for updating the mod to 42.20! without him the original mod probably wouldn't have been fixed. He's another mod creator in the community so go check out his stuff :)
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3660382016

Are you tired of backpacks being too small?
Have you ever spent 3 hours digging around looking for a decent bag only to get stuck with the school bag?
Do you want a backpack upgrade mod that works with all modded backpacks?

This is the mod for you!

Introducing Dynamic Backpack Upgrades!
The only backpack upgrade mod that can upgrade EVERY inventory container item in the game!

[h2] Upgrade Mechanics Explanation [/h2]

Each container item will now have 1 or 2 Upgrade Slots. Containers that can be worn on your back get 2 slots. all other containers get 1.

To add an upgrade you will need the upgrade item you want to add, a sewing needle, and at least 1 unit of thread.
To remove upgrades you will need a pair of scissors.

At level 10 tailoring, you can add an additional upgrade to any bag.
Upgraded bags retain their upgrades until the item is destroyed or the upgrade is removed. This means you can add an additional upgrade to other people's bags if you have level 10 tailoring.

[h2] Obtaining/Crafting Upgrade Items [/h2]

All upgrade items can be looted in the world, and all but the best ones can be crafted.

The stats for each upgrade and spawn rates for each tier of item can be changed in the Sandbox settings.
These stats are always displayed as part of the Upgrade Items tooltip and changes dynamically based on the sandbox settings of the world.

Military upgrades cannot be crafted, but you can convert Military upgrades into their opposite type if you have level 10 tailoring. (Meaning you can turn a Military Capacity upgrade into a Military Weight Reduction upgrade)

[h3] Capacity Upgrades [/h3]

Bag capacity upgrades have 2 components to them. Flat Bonuses and Multipliers.
The Bonus will add a flat amount of capacity regardless of what kind of bag its attached to.
The Multiplier will add a percentage bonus to the bags existing size, rounding to the nearest whole number.

Example; a 10% bonus for the duffel bag would increase its capacity from 18 to 20. the bonus from the multiplier is +1.8, rounded up to to a +2.

Formula; Capacity = math.ceil((BaseCapacity*(1+SumMultiplierBonus))+SumFlatBonus)

Container Capacity is still affected by the Organized and Disoragnized traits. This leads to some pretty insane bag capacities with modded backpacks. (Brita's)

Default values for Capacity upgrades;
[table]
[tr]
[th]Type[/th]
[th]Multiplier [/th]
[th]Bonus [/th]
[th]Crafting Requirements[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Cloth[/td]
[td]+10%[/td]
[td]+1[/td]
[td]Tailoring 3[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Denim[/td]
[td]+20%[/td]
[td]+1[/td]
[td]Tailoring 5[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Leather[/td]
[td]+25%[/td]
[td]+2[/td]
[td]Tailoring 7[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Military[/td]
[td]+35%[/td]
[td]+2[/td]
[td]Loot Only[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h3] Weight Reduction Upgrades [/h3]

Weight reduction upgrades only have 1 component, their Weight Reduction Efficiency bonus.
This value is not a flat bonus to the weight reduction of an item, and the math is fairly complicated compared to the capacity bonus.
The weight reduction increase is a bonus based on the difference between its current value and 100%.
Simply put, increasing a bags weight reduction efficiency by 50% will cause the items in the bag to weigh half as much as they did before. Increasing the efficiency by 25% will make the items in the bag weigh 25% less than they did before. and so on.

Example 1: the Big Hiking Bag has an 80% weight reduction value. giving it a 50% bonus adds an even 10% bonus (20*0.5) bringing it up to a 90% reduction.
Example 2: the Duffel bag has a 65% weight reduction, giving it a 35% bonus results in a bonus of 12.25, rounded to 12% totaling a 77% reduction
Example 3: the Military Backpack has a 87% weight reduction, giving it a 20% bonus would add  2.6 (13*0.2), rounded up to 3%, totaling 90%

Formula; Weight Reduction = 100-( (100-BaseWR)*ProductEfficiencyBonus )

[th]Type[/th]
[th]EffiencyBonus[/th]
[th]Crafting Requirements[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Cloth[/td]
[td]+15%[/td]
[td]Tailoring 3[/td]
[/tr]

[/tr]

[/tr]

[td]Military[/td]

[/tr]
[/table]

[h2] Is this mod compatible with Inventory Tetris? [/h2]
Yes and no, I've never used inventory tetris so i don't know how it works. I've been told in the vanilla game it segments the bags into various compartments. and that does break with modified inventory size values. turning it into quote "one big box" but otherwise I've been told it does work functionally.

[h2] I can't pick up my backpack / My backpack is stuck in a container [/h2]
Yeah.. this is an issue caused by the 50 weight hard limit on every character. Weight reduction doesn't apply until you have the bag equipped, which means you need to put the full weight of the bag in your normal inventory before you can equipo it
But, when dealing with upgraded or modded bags, its possible to fill a bag so much that picking it up would put you over that 50 weight hard limit before you can equip it, which prevents you from picking it up in the first place.

To fix the problem, move the bag to the floor if its not already there. Then you can access its inventory and move things out of the bag to make it lighter, then equip it and put the stuff back in.

[h2] Crafting Upgraded Items Warning [/h2]
When you upgrade an item with this mod, that upgrade info is saved as part of the items Mod Data. If you use the upgraded item to craft another item, it will be deleted and the upgrades will be lost.
This isn't too likely, as very few mods use backpacks as crafting ingredients, but it's worth a warning anyway.

[h2] Known Issues [/h2]
This mod has text clipping issues with pretty much any other mod that adds custom Tooltips.

Sometimes items have their stats reset.
Upgraded items will not automatically fix their stats by default. This was done to hopefully avoid conflicts with other mods that change item stats. If an item has unexpected stats then an option to Fix Upgrades will appear in the context menu for that item.

2998737588.title: Comfy Sleeping [B41 & B42.19+]
2998737588.description:
Check out my other mod, [b][u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007922923]Proper Vehicle Injuries[/url][/u][/b]!


[h1][u]Purpose & How It Works[/u][/h1]
This mod was created from an idea I saw on Reddit (thanks to user Garrett-Wilhelm) in the Zomboid subreddit.

Comfy Sleeping takes into account your characters clothing, mental condition, and cleanliness to determine your sleep quality. Bulky clothing and backpacks leads to your character sleeping restlessly, often waking up after a few hours of sleep, while getting into lighter clothing before bed leads to better quality sleep!

The player's comfort level is displayed in the same tooltip as the bed comfort.

Comfort has 6 different levels:
[list]
[*] Snug as a bug: Your character sleeps exceedingly well, waking up once fully rested.

[*] OK: Your character feels comfortable and has no negative effects.

[*] Tolerable: Your character won't feel fully recharged when waking up, meaning their exertion/stamina doesn't go to 100% while sleeping

[*] Bad: Your character feels more tired in the morning than usual, with a small amount of fatigue and exertion/stamina not fully regenerating.

[*] Poor: Your character doesn't recharge a sizeable portion of their fatigue and exertion. They will also wake up after several hours, and may have neck pain.

[*] Very Poor: Your character doesn't recharge a significant amount of their fatigue and exertion. They will wake up after only a few hours, and may have neck pain.
[/list]


[h1][u]Features[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3175484316&searchtext=standing+items]Standing Items[/url] support: Pillows standing up via Standing Items are recognised as pillows for the comfort bonus while sleeping.

[*] Multiplayer Support: Now everyone can be restless and uncomfortable together!

[*] Moodles & Clothing: Both can now affect your characters comfort, meaning you have to go the extra mile to make them feel right at home.

[*] Poor comfort causes pain: Makes pain from sleeping a bit more frequent to be more in line with the mod.

[*] Restlessness: Being too uncomfortable will eventually wake your character up.

[*] Customizability: Not a fan of how much pain your character wakes up in sometimes? Or wish to disable very poor comfort waking your character up at night? Then disable it!

[*] PILLOWS! (They now contribute to your comfort)
[/list]


[h1][u]Planned Features[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Body temp/warmth bonus while sleeping. Will help for perma-winter/extreme winter scenarios.
[*] Look into compatibility for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3028528478]Beds Have Blankets[/url].
[*] Look into compatibility for Take A Shower And Bath (grime system).
[*] Adjust method for penalizing fatigue and endurance while sleeping. Comfort could instead limit the amount recovered per tick, fixing the issues caused by simply incrementing either stat until it hits a threshold.
[/list]

If you have any other ideas that you think would be in line with the mod, feel free to add them to the "Ideas & Suggestions" discussion. Please note however that this is a passion project of mine, and suggestions may or may not be implemented!


[h1][u]SANDBOX OPTIONS[/u][/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2998737588/3803903008590586667/]Click here to see the sandbox options and their description/examples![/url]

If the above link isn't working, keep scrolling and look for the pinned "Sandbox Options" discussion board.


[h1][u]FAQ (READ BEFORE COMMENTING)[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*][b][u]Is Comfy Sleeping compatible with BB42.20?[/u][/b]
[/list]
Yes! Comfy Sleeping officially supports the latest versions of B42 and B41.

[list]
[*][b][u]Does this mod have any incompatibilities?[/u][/b]
[/list]
Generally, it shouldn't. Please see the below 'Known Issues' section for reported issues.

[list]
[*][b][u]Does this mod work in SP/Coop/Dedicated MP?[/u][/b]
[/list]
Yes, it works in all 3!

[list]
[*][b][u]Is this safe to add to a current save?[/u][/b]
[/list]
Yes!

[list]
[*][b][u]I'm adding this to an existing SP save, how do I change the sandbox options mid save?[/u][/b]
[/list]
Use a mod such as [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2670674997#:~:text=You%20can%20change%20the%20Sandbox,some%20time%20or%20restart%20game.]Change Sandbox Options[/url] to modify them.

[h1][u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Comfort not showing in Sleep context option:[/b] There seems to be an issue potentially related to Act 1 & 2 of True Actions, lying down on beds or other furniture causes the Sleep UI to no longer report the players comfort level. Hovering over the Sleep option of a bed/couch/chair and not sitting on it still works as normal.

[*][b]Comfort calculation bug[/b]: Some users have reported their comfort being stuck at 'very poor' after sleeping with exercise fatigue. Need to find out reproduce-able steps, game version, and, if needed, investigate comfort calculations.

3042138819.title: Functional Appliances 2
3042138819.description:
All new upgrade into 42.20+ Not everything has been brought over yet. This page now will reflect 42+

[h3]New Extractor Hoods:[/h3]
Build them in a square where you place your generator to extract the fumes from it out of the building. All automatically, but the hood will not start until power is there and will not extract unless a running generator is under the hood in the same square.

[h3]Popcorn Machines:[/h3] They now have function and will convert instant popcorn packets into edible popcorn without the pain of burning the food. Popcorn buckets are also added and you can butter the popcorn when in a bucket. Popcorn can now rot in buckets too. Added ambient lighting to it as well.

[h3]Hotdog Machines:[/h3] They also have function and will keep from burning those priceless sausages. It uses the base sausages and hotdogs with sliced bread or hotdog rolls in the game to make hotdogs. Can also cook the hotdogs and sausages without fear of burning. Added ambient lighting to it as well.

[h3]Soda Fountains:[/h3] Are now plumbed objects and will dispense water for all the uses. It also dispenses soda to fountain cups and refills soda/water bottles for preserved use. They use soda syrups and CO2 tanks to operate. Just drop them into the counter the table top unit is on or put them inside the Slurp 'n Burp stand alone unit. These can now pull materials from any static container in the square or the square behind them. If water is a problem, try using water jugs or plumb it like a sink.  Added ambient lighting to it as well. *** fixed vanilla water issue only with the soda fountains, should plumb as usual ***

[h3]Bar Taps and Kegs:[/h3] Setup the kegs in furniture containers with the taps connected. Kegs pulled from any static container in the square with the bar taps.

[h3]Food Display Counters, Buffet Islands, Rounded Glass Display Counters and Vending Machines:[/h3] These are now temperature settable appliances for food storage. Some have Hot, Warm, or Cold others just Warm and Cold. Each segment has it's own settings. Now automatically spawn on when they can and switch to cold in ice cream parlors, cafes, bakeries, etc. Pizza parlors and other restaurants will default to warm. Soda Machines automatically default to cold. *** working on getting them to actually cool and freeze food like fridges but not working yet.***

[h3]Paper Towel and Napkin Dispensers:[/h3] They show up as small containers and come standard with a few loose napkins. *** working on the actions to allow them to wash and dry again. ***

[h3]Bulletin Boards:[/h3] Both large and small corkboards, you can now add things into it's container and the random notices appear as overlays.

[h3]Peg Boards:[/h3] Containers that spawn with tools and have an overlay. Updated these to work in all directions now.

[h3]Pool Cue Stands:[/h3] Containers that spawn with pool cues and have an overlay.

[h3]Industrial Deep Fryers:[/h3] *** Coming Soon! ***

[h3]Coffee X-Press and Espresso Machines:[/h3] *** Coming Soon! ***

[h3]Green Oven Silo Generators:[/h3] *** May return... ***

If you see any bugs let me know. I tried to make the functions and items as unique as possible to keep from any conflicts. A big thank you to everyone that has helped with identifying the bugs and Lazarus for his support and time fighting them on our server to try and make things right.

Thank you and enjoy!

Squeezes maximum performance out of all textures while preserving their quality as much as technically possible. It also improves some of the original textures.
Must-have if you have a lot of junk or zombies in your location and many more.

[H3]Future Plans:[/H3]
[B]•[/B] [URL=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3119788162]HD Textures[/URL] – Improves the detail of vanilla textures without losing performance.
[B]•[/B] [URL=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3119788162]Project Optimized[/URL] – Optimization of Vanilla+ textures from other mod authors.
[strike][B]•[/B] [URL=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3119788162]Absolutely Lossless[/URL] – Here, every pixel is identical to the original, all the magic lies in the resource-intensive optimization by my side.[/strike]

3171167894.title: that DAMN Library - Mangled animated parts are a base game issue.
3171167894.description:
[b]What is this?[/b]
This is a framework that fuels all KI5 mods, one centralized place to fine tune and expand all mods and make them ready for game changes and new features. 

You can find more about it here for B41: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3262959206]that DAMN Library - Crafting, Fixing and Recycling explained[/url], B42 guide is coming soon.

[b]Why are the comments closed?[/b]
There is no need for them here, all mod related stuff can be discussed on mod pages of those mods. That way i know what mod could be impacted.

[b]Can I use this for my mods?[/b]
Not yet, the contents of this library will be changing in the next weeks without any warnings so it's better to wait while we fine tune the things and give a green light for wide use.

[b]I found a bug and/or have issues, what now?[/b]
Please note, that DAMN Library was tested with all KI5 mods enabled in SP and MP environment (42.19 included). Crafting, fixing and recycling works for all mods that are b42 MP compatible (check bottom of mod descriptions or look for KI5's temp B42.13+ MP collection on steam), if you are having issues, make sure you have the required skills, materials and items uninstalled in case of vehicle parts, make sure you are not having 3rd party mod conflicts, remove any damnlib fixes or reuploads, and if problem still persists, report the errors in bug report discussions of affected mods. Cheers!

[b]I found some warnings in my logs, what now?[/b]
Console warnings like "no such mesh" or "template not found B" can be ignored, they are caused by game trying to access assets that it has not yet loaded, all of those parts and ground objects work fine in game after the load.

3268487204.title: [B42] Bandits NPC
3268487204.description:
[h1]Bandits[/h1]
[h3]During the zombie apocalypse, It's not the zombies you should be afraid of; it's the people...[/h3]

[quote][b]This mod works for: [u]B42 ONLY (B42.20+) both single and multiplayer.[/u][/b]
[/quote]

This mod introduces hostile (NPC) bandits into the game. Enemies in this mod can be extremely dangerous, and provide a new set of challenges to those accustomed to the walking dead. Treat them as actual players when it comes to combat. Initial waves of NPC’s will be armed with melee weapons, and over time larger groups with firearms will begin to spawn.

Bandits, besides killing you, can steal items from your base, sabotage generators, vehicles or crops. They can destroy obstacles and furniture blocking their way, including doors and windows. There are friendly NPC’s but with the base mod, but they aren’t complex companions.

Bandits mod is also the base NPC mod for a number of different mods, including [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3707475814]The Ark[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3403180543]Week One[/url], and more.

[h2]Donations[/h2]
Mod development and support is driven by donations:
[url=/ko-fi.com/M4M7SGR4P][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/brandasset/kofi_bg_tag_dark.png[/img][/url]

[h3]We have a [url=https://discord.gg/YzYXCn3HuJ]Discord[/url][/h3]

[h2]Bandit Spawning - How does it work?[/h2]
Initially, small groups of armed bandits with melee weapons will appear after 24 hours in the world around ~55 tiles away from the player. Over time, larger groups and ones more frequently with firearms will start to arrive to make your life hell. Always be prepared that bandits could strike when you least expect them.

Other groups act as wanderers. They will travel between important places on the map and their path may cross with player's. 

[h2]Bandit Customization[/h2]
General behaviour and loadouts of Bandits can be customized in the Custom Sandbox/Sandbox Settings, including changing the chances of bandits to spawn. For greater customization, including loadout, appearance, AI settings and more, use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3469292499]Bandit Creator.[/url]

[h2]Bandits can…[/h2]
[list]
[*]Steal items from your base, sabotage your generators, vehicles or crops.
[*]Destroy things such as doors and furniture that block their path.
[*]Assigned additional traits which determine their skills.
[*]Customized in bandit creator to have custom loadouts.
[*]Resupply from corpses or containers.
[*]Use all weapons, including melee and firearms.
[*]They can know how to hunt you, and can track you to your location.
[*]Be spawned in using debug mode to test your creations.
[/list]

[h2]Troubleshooting / Bugs / FAQ [/h2]
[h3]There are no bandits[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Wait for at least 48 hours, avoid wilderness all the time. 
[*]Is Bandits installed correctly? For Single Player you just have to ensure that the mod is selected in your save. For Multiplayer Hosting, you need to make sure the Bandits mod (and also Bandit Creator if you want) is enabled in three distinct areas: The Mod Selection page for your server, the Mods tab and the Steam Workshop tab.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/NM5kPcZ5/20260802095459-1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d1LjSYgD/20260802095514-1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0Qb0Hshk/20260802095520-1.jpg[/img]
[*] Ensure there are no conflicting mods
[*] If you have been using Bandit Creator, ensure each clan configuration is valid. Delete Zomboid/Lua/bandits folder and resub the mod to restore original bandits.
[*] Ensure zombies are not disabled completely.
[/olist]
[h3]There is too many bandits[/h3]
Use Bandit Creator mod to tune the right amount for you.
[h3]They spawned inside my base[/h3]
There is no way to easily check if the area is enclosed. So the spawn is purely distance based.
[h3]Can I spawn in bandits?[/h3]
You can spawn in bandits by using debug both in single and multiplayer by right clicking and selecting the clan you wish to spawn. These bandits will not function as well as normal bandits that spawn in natively, but can be a good way to test out if the mod works.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/B6VS0dpr/20260802102834-1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nzPFJ62N/20260802102837-1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Can I add this mod to an existing save?[/h3]
Bandits can be added and removed without issue to any existing save, both single and multiplayer. Adding bandits to an old will make later and harder bandits spawn which may be a shock to you.

3281755175.title: Vanilla vehicles animated
3281755175.description:
[h2]!!! ATTENTION !!![/h2]
Since build 41 is now moved into a legacy branch rather than being the default version, I am planning to remove Build 41 support from this workshop item. If you are planning to play build 41 and not lose access to the mod, please use
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3774077235]Build 41 legacy fork of the mod[/url] instead of this one.

[h1](VVA) Vanilla Vehicles Animated[/h1]
[h2]What this mod does?[/h2]
There are many cool mods that add vehicles with openable doors, meaning the game can handle such animations.
But vanilla vehicles remain as solid bricks.
This mod fixes that. Vehicle models are reworked - split into multiple objects, and code added to display vanilla vehicles. As a free bonus of it - if a part is removed (or torn off) it would become visually missing, rather than tinted grey.

[h2]Why are Dash Roamer, Drive90s and other modded cars no longer animated?[/h2]
Trying to keep the mod more focused so since they are not based on vanilla models and not all of them were transitioned to build 42 - that created a bunch of issues making sure stuff got updated correctly. So I made a hard decision to drop them from this mod.
I am repackaging all the animated model patches for those vehicles and will publish them as a couple of separate workshop items - for build 41 and 42 separately. But at this moment they are just remived as a hotfix to them getting broken by latest code rafactoring.

[h2]B41 or B42?[/h2]
Both. for now, but in near future I am planning to make this mod 42 only. Please see special notice at the top of description for a link to 41 legacy fork.

[h2]Multiplayer?[/h2]
By itself only the local player would see animations in action. Remote players would only ubdate parts state when they moved far enough from vehicle and then returned to it so server sends current state for all parts.
To fix this issue you need to use a mod that patches in server signals to update parts state when they change
For build 42 use https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3685499657
For build 41 use https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2959512313


[h2]Existing save - safe?[/h2]
Yes. This mod only changes the way vehicles are displayed and does not interfere with save data in any way. It is safe to add or remove this mod on existing saves/servers.

[h2]There are many mods in this item. Which ones I should enable?[/h2]
[h3]Vanilla Vehicles Animated[/h3] - Main mod. Nothing works without it.
[h3]disable passenger rendering (VVA_cullseats)[/h3] - (optional) - The main mod enables rendering character model in the interior. But animations for characters switching seats, exiting vehicle or aiming a weapon if a window is rolled down, are not set up, so defailts ones (for character standing on ground) are used, resulting in character clipping through vehicle roof. If this bothers you - enable this mod. It will prohibit my mod adding passenger rendering. But if some other mod also enables interior character rendering it might not work.
[h3]Standard Vehicle Upgrades Patch (VanillaVehiclesAnimated_SVU)[/h3] - (optional) - If you wand to MadMax your vehicles using armor from Standard Vehicle Upgrades, by default the armor would be rendered static. So an open door would clip through armor plate. Enabling this optional mod patches armor definition scripts to make armor animated too.
[h3]ApocalypticallySlowDoors (VVA_slowdoors)[/h3] - depricated - In Build 41 version using Fancy Handwork together with this mod could cause a bug with door close animation being unable to play properly because it was running too fast. This mod slowed all animations down to avoid this bug.
[h3]Pikamy's Delighter[/h3] - depricated - Build 42 specific. A little mod created for Pickamy_ (follow her on Twitch!). Changes models and textures for seats of Lady Delighter specialty van to be pink with some embroidery.
[h3]Snappy Doors[/h3] Removes animated transitions between opened and closed states so doors/hoods/trunks snap open/closed. Requested for consistency with how building doors are not actually animated in B41, or mods that synchronize animations between different clients actually just synchronize end states.

[h2]Just Vanilla Vehicles?[/h2]
No. Some mods that add reskins of vehicles based on vanilla models (i.e. Donny's Company Cars) are also supported. And if you know such a mod that is not supported - please let me know and I would gladly cover it in an update. Also Vanilla Vehicle Enhancer (both 41 and 42 versions) are supported, including custom models for all vehicles that match enhanced textures with geometry.

[h2]Can a vanilla-model based vehicle mod hook into animations without requiring update to this mod?[/h2]
At this point - I feel the code is settled enough, so yes. If you are making a mod that adds more vehicles that are reskins of vanilla models - they can be easily added as long as you don't change shape of windows and headlights.
Also if your mod is not based on vanilla models, I am eager to help you set up the models and scripts to have animations on their own.

[h2]How many people are working on this mod?[/h2]
One. Just me in my free time. If you want to support me - the best way would be to show up to [url=www.twitch.tv/hilvon1984]my Twitch[/url] streams 8am till 1pm GMT on saturdays and sundays. I mostly work on another huge mod adding animations to PZK Vanilla Like Cars pack...
You can also support me on [url=https://boosty.to/hilvon1984]Boosty[/url].
