3360392628.title: Map Mod Manager (41 and 42)
3360392628.description:
[b] Map Mod Manager [/b] is a tool for managing and organizing your map mods. With a cell grid display, you can visually identify conflicts between maps, regardless of if you're subscribed to them or picked from the huge database of over 800 maps. Whether you're curating a fine collection of maps, checking your current subscriptions for conflicts or expanding your map collection, Map Mod Manager is the tool to help you do it.

[h2] Now reads subscribed mod cells! [/h2]
[i] The latest update enables Map Mod Manager to read your map files directly, so you don't need to wait for the database to update when a new map is released. As long as you're subscribed, it will know exactly where on the map it belongs. [b] Currently available for Build 42 only. [/b][/i]

[h2] Features: [/h2]
[h3]Interactive Cell Display:[/h3]
View maps on a detailed grid that highlights selected mods to instantly spot conflicts - either with other mods or with vanilla map areas.
[h3]Toggle Mods:[/h3]
Quickly enable or disable your subscribed mods and their dependencies directly in Map Mod Manager, you don't have to go back to mods to manage them.
[h3]Quick Select and Filter:[/h3]
Quickly select map mods that don't conflict with your current selection or filter by specific cells to find compatible mods.
[h3]Steam Links:[/h3]
Open any map or dependency workshop page directly from Map Mod Manager - if a map works with your current collection, you can update it in a few clicks and a refresh of the game.
[h3]Dependency Checker:[/h3]
See required mods for every selected or enabled map. Hover over a dependency to see which maps are relying on it, so you don't miss anything essential - preventing in-game issues.
[h3]Read Subscribed Maps (Build 42):[/h3]
Automatically reads the cells of any subscribed map, ensuring that even the newest maps are checked for conflicts with your collection.
[h3]Export Data:[/h3]
The export function generates a list of selected maps, including their URL's, dependencies and multiplayer data, enabling you to quickly set up a server or share it with a mate.
[h3]Re-Order Mods and MapFolders:[/h3]
Easily reorder both ModIDs and MapFolders.

[h2]How do I use it?[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Enable Map Mod Manager in the mods menu, save and go back to the main menu. A button called 'Map Mod Manager' will appear under the Quit button.
    [*]Select maps to show them on the cell grid, conflicting maps appear red, if they conflict with a vanilla map they appear yellow.
    [*]Purple cells are map mods without conflicts, green and blue cells are vanilla maps.
    [*]Hover your mouse over any cell in the grid to show what map/s are occupying that cell.
    [*]If you're subscribed to a map, it will appear in the Subscribed Map Mods list, green maps are enabled.
    [*]Dependencies will populate for both active mods and selected mods, active mods are green, required dependencies that aren't enabled are white, dependencies you aren't subscribed to are red.
    [*]Hover over a dependency to see what map enabled it.
    [*]Use the steam link next to any map or dependency to navigate to the workshop page, if you subscribe to a new mod, you'll need to quit and re-open the game for it to show up in your Subscribed Map Mods list.
    [*]Buttons have tooltips, so you know exactly what they are doing.
    [*]Mod changes are saved by closing the UI.
[/list]

Note, if you have increased your font size, you will have issues displaying the UI. Reduce your font size to default while using this mod.

[b] Important disclaimers about maps that aren't in the database: [/b]
[list]
    [*][b] Uninstalled Dependencies: [/b] If a required dependency isn’t installed and isn’t already in the database, it won’t be listed as required. Always check the map Workshop page for any dependencies when subscribing to new maps.
    [*][b] Mod Packs: [/b] Map Mod Manager will detect “mod packs” (workshop items that contain multiple mods). This can cause issues if you’re subscribed to both a mod pack and one of its individual mods. It’s best to avoid subscribing to both at the same time.
[/list]

[b]Translations:[/b]
[list]
    [*]French, thanks to Aatheom.
    [*]Korean, thanks to Teray.
[/list]

If you'd like to translate it for me, please reach out!

3370707195.title: organizedCategories
3370707195.description:
[h1]Inventory, organized.[/h1]
[hr]
organizedCategories is a mod which adds features to a much beleagured part of Project Zomboid: the inventory panes, specifically their display categories. In vanilla, display categories are terse and often unhelpful. In organizedCategories, they are detailed and explicit. For example:
[list]
[*]Firearms now display by caliber
[*]Food, not only into perishable or nonperishable, calls out spices, fruits, meats, vegetables and more
[*]Tools state which craft they are primarily used with
[*]Clothes are sorted into which body part, including space for accessories
[*]And many, many more...
[/list]

[h2]Other Features[/h2]
[h3]Liquid Autosort[/h3]
Liquid containers update in real time according to which liquid is their majority content regardless of the bearing item. For example, a bottle of gasoline becomes Mechanics - Fuel when full and reverts to Container - Liquid when emptied.

[h3]Full Customization[/h3]
While organizedCategories ships with an extensive catalogue of handsort definitions for vanilla and modded content, tastes differ across sorting solutions as to what item should belong to what, how those categories order, what they should be called and their appearance. Well, now you may make your own refinements graphically without the need for any restarts, persisting across saves by default.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9MbVWfs7/Screenshot-20260827-075403-steam.png[/img]

[h3]Mod Support[/h3]
organizedCategories works with CleanUI, which is itself recommended to use with this mod though also works with vanilla display panes and Better Containers.

Over 100 mods have handsort definitions, and more are always being added. This is in tandem with an autosort for mods which lack manual definitions, making best effort attempts at categorization before any manual intervention.

Always load organizedCategories to the BOTTOM of your mod list, since its primary purpose is overriding other mods.

[h3][EN] Item Name Overrides[/h3]
Tired of every mod naming its items differently than the standard Type - Permutation (Status) format set by vanilla? Tired of vanilla naming items differently than its own standard? Optionally, English clients include an override to bring item names into more consistent form.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/jdQ1m90L/Screenshot-20260827-080238-steam.png[/img]

[h3]Localizations[/h3]
organizedCategories packs community localizations for many languages, please see the pinned thread and feel free to contribute your own.

- You can change the keybind from:
   Options > Mods section.
-  To disable the right-click context menu option or to turn off the advanced options, uncheck the corresponding setting under the Sandbox Options category in the Sandbox Options.
   > ⚠️After unchecking, exit to the main menu and reload your save for the change to take effect.

---

[h2]👥Multiplayer Instructions[/h2]

❕You don’t need this mod in multiplayer, as you can access the Sandbox Options directly through the Admin Panel.

If you want to use this mod in multiplayer, you must be an admin to make changes in Sandbox Options.

To become an admin, type in the chat:
/setaccesslevel "playerName" admin

If you want to revert to a normal player, type:
/setaccesslevel "playerName" user

⚠️Keep in mind that even in singleplayer, after making changes, you need to exit and re-enter your save for the changes to work properly. In multiplayer, doing this could disrupt your gameplay, so be aware.

---

[h2]💡 If the mod does not work on an existing save[/h2]
Follow these steps:
[olist]
[*]From the main menu, click *Load*
[*]Select the save you want to use the mod with
[*]Click *More* (bottom-right corner)
[*]Choose *Mods* (top-left corner)
[*]Enable this mod from the mod list
[*]Enter the save where you have activated the mod.
[/olist]

Once enabled, right-click anywhere in-game and you’ll see Sandbox Options will be among the options that appear.

[H3]Mod Overview[/h3]
MDE aims to re-write vanilla descriptions to be less vague and provide players with more informational negative or positive status effects caused by in game Moodles by introducing the appropriate +/-% and qualitative ratings to indicate severity of status effects.

This mod is by no means related to any other previous Moodle description mods - This mod is purely based on my own interpretations and of the translators who have contributed to the mod.

All descriptions should be represented accurately according to [url=https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Moodle]PZWiki Moodles[/url].

The idea stems from older Moodle description mods, such as "Verbose Moodles" or "Clear Moodle Descriptions"

[h3]Compatability[/h3]
• Compatible with everything that does not change Moodle descriptions.
• For the best possible compatability, just to be sure. Enable the mod after any moodle mod. The mod is so simple, it shouldn't be the culprit behind crashes.
• Ongoing save compatible.

3389606570.title: Jump
3389606570.description:
You can jump.
Up to 4 tiles.


[h1]How to jump[/h1]
[list]
[*]You must be running or sprinting.
[*]You must be in good health condition*.
[*]Press the Jump key, 'F' by default, configurable.
[/list]


[h1]Health condition*[/h1]
[list]
[*]Each of the following points apply to the lower torso, groin, legs and feets body parts.
[*]Health must be above 50 percents.
[*]Exercise fatigue (stiffness) must be below 50 percents.
[*]No fracture.
[*]No deep wound.
[/list]


[h1]Endurance consumtion[/h1]
[list]
[*]Run jump: 1.56% endurance.
[*]Sprint jump: 3.64% endurance.
[/list]


[h1]Jump distance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Base Distance (Run): 1m. (1m = 1tile)
[*]Sprinting adds 1.25m (at best +1.25m).
[*]Each point in Strength and Fitness adds 0.1m (at best +2m).
[*]Each level of Endurance removes 0.5m (at worse -2m)
[*]Each level of HeavyLoad removes 0.8m (at worse -3.2m)
[*]Obese trait removes 1.25m (at worse -1.25m)
[*]Overweight trait removes 0.75m
[*]Minimum jump distance is saturated to 1m (impossible to jump 1 tile)
[*]Maximum jump distance is 4.25m (possible to jump 4 tiles).
[/list]


[h1]Warnings[/h1]
[list]
[*]No chance of failure.
[*]Animation end is clunky.
[*]You may feel like a Duke.
[*]You cannot jump from stairs.
[*]You cannot jump over fences with this animation.
[*]You cannot jump over water coast.
[*]But you still can fall in water from height like in vanilla. To get out, use [url=https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Debug_mode]debug mode and teleport[/url].
[*]This makes the game easier by allowing to isolate your base from zombies.
[*]Play it safe: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/108600/discussions/0/2265817650395740986/?l=latam]Back Up Your Save[/url].

3392699932.title: Auto Loot
3392699932.description:
With this mod looting is done automatically.
With this mod store your loot in one click.

So you are here ?
Ah.. you're bored of spending your life looting dead corpses and searching through furnitures..
You've come to the right place.

[h1]How to access your loot selection[/h1]
You can (and should) change your configuration.
You can access the [url=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2057630803899466981/643E966783EB19E0E92DF422ACA94F3A41838119/]configuration page[/url]:
[list]
[*]By pressing the key selected under OPTIONS >> MODS >> Auto Loot >> Change Configuration (default key is NONE).
[/list]


[h1]How to modify your loot selection[/h1]
On the configuration page, you have tools to help you change your configuration quickly:
[list]
[*]Filter on unique ID.
[*]Filter on displayed name.
[*]Filter on category through a combo box.
[*]Filter on display category through a combo box.
[*]Green and red buttons apply on current filter.
[*]Double click on an item for individual selection.
[/list]
See [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sO-X6tShfdo]this video[/url] for a full exemple of the configuration interface.
Alternatively -I do not recommend but- you can [url=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2057630803899449564/ACAB1C7FCBBC227CABC949AFDDBB8DBBD5E8A482/]add/remove an item type through contextual menu[/url].


[h1]Toggle ON / OFF[/h1]
[list]
[*]Toggle Auto Loot ON / OFF by pressing [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13985282339957860016/AA86AC69D736C6CE02C0372E2191594AD90BDD70/]the text button[/url] on vanilla inventory window, next to vanilla "Transfer All" button.
[*]Toggle Auto Loot ON / OFF by pressing the key selected OPTIONS >> MODS >> Auto Loot >> Toggle On / Off (default key is NONE).
[/list]


[h1]How to store your loot ?[/h1]
This functionnality is an evolution of the great mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=966221273]SmartStack[/url].
By clicking on [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13985282339957860016/AA86AC69D736C6CE02C0372E2191594AD90BDD70/]Store All[/url] icon/button (next to "Auto Loot ON / OFF" button), all items that are not equipped or favorite will be spread onto any reachable container that already has an instance of the same item.


[h1]Annex functions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sandbox option Loot Mode allows select one single mode for the whole server.
[*]Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag priority option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu).
[*]Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag filter option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu).
[*]Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag activation/inhibition option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu).
[*]Sandbox options allows to deactivate item type add/remove option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu).
[*]Activating [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3783387236]Responsive Context Menu[/url], contextual filter menus will persist on click, allowing smooth multi selection!
[*]You can permanently inhibit Auto Loot on a furniture or vehicle [url=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1862815243314627821/F12AE1045C574D45A30720F4CC0E43EEFB369C20/]through a contextual "Inhibit/Activate" toggle[/url].
[*]Inventory icon of modded item is corrected in the Item List (for the Autoloot configuration).
[*]Inventory weight overlap is corrected.
[/list]


[h1]You have questions ?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Works in solo and multiplayer.
[*]Can be added / removed mid game.
[*]The mod still works, it will be tagged obsolete otherwise.
[*]Check the [url=https://youtu.be/sO-X6tShfdo]tutorial video[/url].
[*]This version si for B42 and further. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2577903374]Check this other mod for B41 version[/url].
[*]Many other questions are answered in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2577903374/2958293022033269881/]FAQ[/url].
[/list]


[h1]If you still have questions or problem reports, ask on [url=https://discord.gg/theindiestone]Official PZ Discord: mod_support channel[/url].[/h1]


[h1]Tips & Limitations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Keep default settings (except loot configuration) for a vanilla friendly experience.
[*]Set [url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13985282339957860016/AA86AC69D736C6CE02C0372E2191594AD90BDD70/]Auto Loot OFF[/url] in order to not plunder your own carefully ordered base.
[*]KeyRing has the highest priority: "1" and cannot be changed.
[/list]

3396446795.title: Moodle Framework
3396446795.description:
Makes it easy to add moodles for modders.


[h1]Fellow modders:[/h1]
IsoPlayer ModData.Moodles was removed.
If you own a mod accessing it directly, please remove that access.
Use MF.getMoodle and check against nil.
That should be enough.

[h1]Moodle mods users:[/h1]
You can use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3789490511]this mod[/url] for backward compatibility until moodle modders update their interface usage.

[h1]Reports:[/h1]
If you have errors, report with console.txt on [url=https://discord.gg/theindiestone]Official PZ Discord: mod_support channel[/url].



[h1]Moodle Framework Configuration[/h1]
If you want colors to be easier to distinguish, you can set to white the reference color for moodles (default on).
This applies to both vanilla and modded moodles.
You can also deactivate various displays to enhance mod compatibility.
Modded Backgrounds with small extensions right or down are now handled too.


[h1]How to create a new moodle[/h1]
If you wanna create a Moodle * then follow the next steps, replacing * by your moodle name.

[h2]1/ Moodle Texture[/h2]
Add Moodle *.png under media\ui.
Should be 30 by 30 pixels png with alpha enabled.
Note you can also has specific textures per moodle level:
e.g. *_Bad_2.png or *_Good_4.png

[h2]2/ Texture[/h2]
Add the following text under media\lua\shared\Translate\EN\Moodles.json
[code]{
"Moodles_*_Good_lvl1": "text_1",
"Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl1": "text_desc_1",
"Moodles_*_Good_lvl2": "text_2",
"Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl2": "text_desc_2",
"Moodles_*_Good_lvl3": "text_3",
"Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl3": "text_desc_3",
"Moodles_*_Good_lvl4": "text_4",
"Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl4": "text_desc_4",

"Moodles_*_Bad_lvl1": "text_1",
"Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl1": "text_desc_1",
"Moodles_*_Bad_lvl2": "text_2",
"Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl2": "text_desc_2",
"Moodles_*_Bad_lvl3": "text_3",
"Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl3": "text_desc_3",
"Moodles_*_Bad_lvl4": "text_4",
"Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl4": "text_desc_4"
}
[/code]
(json format: don't put a comma on the last entry)
You can implement only a subset of this as long as you call only the implemented part.

[h2]3/ Moodle object creation[/h2]
Add these lines in your mod:
[code]require "MF_ISMoodle"
MF.createMoodle(*);[/code]

[h2]4/ Moodle value updates[/h2]
Access your moodle from your code with
[code]require "MF_ISMoodle"
MF.getMoodle(*,playerNum):setValue(myNewMoodleValue)--float[/code]
0.0 <= myNewMoodleValue <=1.0
Missing playerNum will make the mod incompatible with SplitScreen.

[h2]For tuning options [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2859296947/3380536561724844838/]see dedicated discussion[/url][/h2]


[h1]Limitations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Not tested with splitscreen. (it is expected to work since last version)
[*]Oscillations are not based on vanilla value and the behaviour may depend on performances.
[/list]


[h1]Credits where it is due[/h1]
[list]
[*]This is inspired from the (removed) mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2665369300]Zombie Camouflage[/url] moodle management by the awesome [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Dislaik/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]Dislaik[/url].
[/list]


[h1]Known mods using this[/h1]

3396867685.description:

[h2][b]---> B42 only! <---[/b][/h2]

[h2]What does this mod do?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Attracts zombies to dead bodies (animals included), and makes them eat them.
[*]Attracts zombies to the player.
[/list]

[h2]How does this mod work?[/h2]
[list]
[*]It simulates smell emitted by dead bodies.
[*]It simulates smell emitted by the player, blood that is on the player, and on items in the player's inventory.
[*]It utilises the wind speed to extend the distance smell travels.
[*]It utilises the wind direction to determine if zombies can smell the dead bodies/player.
[*]Smell also radiates in a circle around dead bodies / the player (unaffected by wind).
[*]It does not use sound events, so only zombies in the loaded world (active cell) are affected.
[*]It does not spawn zombies.
[/list]

[h2]Is it configurable?[/h2]
Yes.

3402789975.title: Tatrapan [B42]
3402789975.description:
(WORKS FOR 42.20)

[h1][b]Tatrapan[/b][/h1]

[h2]1994[/h2]
[i]Pressed by the ravaging Knox virus, which had begun to slowly spread across European borders, the UN made the ultimate decision to assist the completely overwhelmed USA. Operation: Blackout, marked the largest UN military deployment in European history. Its single task: to liberate America from the undead and restore order in the ever-growing chaos.

Among the many vehicles used for this mission was a newly engineered armored personnel carrier, one that would be able to hold thousands at bay, and safely transport critical personnel through the most dangerous land on Earth.

Once the operation was initiated, only radio silence remained, never to be heard from again.[/i]


"The Tatrapan, first introduced in the 1990s, is a Slovak-made armored transport vehicle based on the reliable Tatra 815 chassis. Originally developed for military and peacekeeping operations, its modular design allowed for various configurations, from troop transport to command vehicles. Renowned for its durability, off-road performance, and heavy armor, the Tatrapan stands as a testament to robust Cold War-era engineering."


[h3][b]Features:[/b][/h3]

- 3 variations

- Unique color paints for each model

- Fully armorable

- Fully animated

- Adequate storage capacity

-Roof storage

-Spare tires

- Side mounts for axe and shovel


[b]Notes: [/b]

[b]This mod should work in multiplayer[/b]

3404298280.title: Two Chicks At The Same Time
3404298280.description:
Allows carrying more than one animal at a time, as well as carrying animals in cars.

[h3]How To Use this Mod[/h3]

Pick up an animal.  Now pick up another animal, or get into a car, or ready a weapon - instead of dropping the animal you are holding you will move it to your main inventory.

You can right click -> drop the animal to place it on the ground.  If you use a mod like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2950902979]Equipment UI[/url] you can drag animals into each hand, allowing you to dual-wield chickens.

To put an animal in a livestock trailer it needs to either be in your primary hand or on the ground near you.


[b]Warning:[/b] Animals are heavy.  When you move them into your inventory you lose the weight reduction that comes from holding them in your hands, to watch out for muscle strain and the severely overloaded moodle.

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

[b]Can you make it so animals can be placed in bags and vehicle storage?[/b]

I'm still trying to find the bit of code that controls that, and if I can figure out how to make it work I'll let you put a pig in every seat of your car, a flock of chickens in the trunk and a swarm of rats in your hiking bag.

3414634809.title: Spongie's Character Customisation
3414634809.description:
[h1]Adds faces, freckles, scars, visible muscles, and more[/h1]

This is primarily a mod framework that allows servers and other mods to add more variety to character appearances.


[hr]

[h1]SUPPORTS B42.20 STABLE - TESTED AND WORKS IN MULTIPLAYER[/h1]

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3626418462]B41 VERSION HERE[/url][/h2]

[quote]
[h1]COMMON ISSUES[/h1]

[list]
[*][h2]DISABLE LUA CHECKSUM IF YOU GET "FILE DOESN'T EXIST" ERROR[/h2]

[*][h2]IF CRASHING ON WORLD CREATION RESUBSCRIBE TO THE MOD AND IF IT STILL HAPPENS THEN REMOVE THE MOD AND RE-ADD IT AFTER STARTING THE SAVE[/h2]


[*]DO NOT USE THE VANILLA FACE PACK WITH OTHER RETEXTURES IT ONLY WORKS WITH THE DEFAULT TEXTURES

[*]SET MAX TEXTURE SIZE IN SETTINGS TO WHATEVER PLAYER RETEXTURE YOU ARE USING OR YOU WILL HAVE SEAMS (VANILLA IS 256)

[*]NEEDS TO BE LOADED AFTER ELLIE'S TATTOO PARLOR

[*]ENABLING RETEXTURES THAT SUPPORT THIS MOD REQUIRES A GAME RESTART

[*]IN MULTIPLAYER EVERY PLAYER NEEDS THE MOD + RETEXTURES ENABLED ON THE MAIN MENU OR TEXTURES WON'T BE REPLACED ON STARTUP
[/list]
[/quote]

[hr]

[h1]Included with this mod[/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]Base mod[/b] - Framework, doesn't add any customisation options

    [*][b]Vanilla Faces Pack[/b] - Adds 4 male and 4 female faces. Only supports the vanilla body textures [h1]DO NOT USE THIS WITH RETEXTURE MODS[/h1]

    [*][b]Details Pack[/b] - Adds freckles, moles, scars, burns, and missing eyes.
	Missing eyes also affect the players vision cone.

    [*][b]Details Pack HD Textures[/b] - 512x512 textures for the Details Pack.
[h1]DO NOT USE THE HD TEXTURE PACK with vanilla textures or any retextures that are 256x256 or it will cause seams.[/h1]
[/list]


[hr]

[h1]Fully supported mods[/h1]

[list]
	[*][h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3340255334]Spongie's Character Retexture[/url][/h2]

	[*][h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429790870]Tomb's Player Body Overhaul[/url][/h2]
[/list]


[hr]

[h1]Faces and Details[/h1]

    [b]Select from different faces and add additional detail textures to your character[/b]

	Faces work on all skintones and new options can be added by other mods.


[hr]

[h1]Visible Muscles[/h1]

    [b]Characters will have visible muscles at high strength levels[/b]

	Muscle intensity increases at level 6 and level 9 strength (Stout and Strong traits in character creation).

	Can be toggled globally or set to player preference in sandbox settings.

    [b]MUSCLE TEXTURES DO NOT WORK WITH UNSUPPORTED TEXTURE MODS LIKE SIMPLE CHARACTER RETEXTURE.
	TURN OFF MUSCLES IN SANDBOX IF YOU ARE USING ONE THAT DOESN'T SUPPORT THIS MOD[/b]


[hr]

[h1]Body Hair[/h1]

    [b]Head stubble, beard stubble, and body hair (formerly chest hair) will grow in-game and can be shaved[/b]

	[b]The button to shave your stubble and body hair is in the character info panel.[/b]

	Vanilla chest hair has been completely replaced with a new system that works on both body types.

	Can be toggled globally or set to player preference in sandbox settings.


    [b]THIS MOD DOES NOT AFFECT HAIR OR BEARD GROWTH OUTSIDE OF SHAVING HEAD/BEARD STUBBLE[/b]


[hr]

[h1]Works in existing saves and creating a new character mid-save[/h1]

Joining a game with a character from before the mod was added will open the character customisation window so that you can pick faces and details.

Stubble and chest hair will be converted to the new system.


[hr]

[h1]Change Customisation In-Game[/h1]

There is a sandbox option to allow players to open the customisation window and change their face or details in-game.

[b]The buttons to change your appearance and shave are in the character info panel.[/b]


[hr]

[h1]Sandbox Options[/h1]

[list]
[*]Options for changing appearance in-game, toggling muscles, and changing body hair growth

[*]Admins can always change their appearance or add body hair but they can spawn an Appearance Changing Spiffo to give this ability to any player when held

[*]Customisation options with certain tags can be hidden from normal players. Admins can spawn an Appearance Unlocking Bear to unhide these options for any player when held

[*]Body hair growth and visible muscles can be enabled or disabled or set to player preference

[*]You can change the vision modifier used by missing eyes

[/list]

[hr]

[h1]Technical Details[/h1]

See the readme and Example.lua to learn how you can make addons for the mod.

The body hair textures in the base mod will cut off at the underwear which won't look right when using a nude mod.
[b]I've included nude versions of the body hair textures in the files for other modders to use if they want to make their mod compatible.[/b]


The blood/dirt on the face and muscles are occasionally synced to the body's blood/dirt levels so there will always be a slight delay which I've never noticed during gameplay.

To reduce strain on the server, every few ticks the server will try to sync the blood of a single player until it goes through the list of active players.
The tick delay adjusts based on the number of players and currently it will take around 200 ticks to finish checking every player once.
This means that in singleplayer it will do a check every 200 ticks but in a 100 player server it would be doing a check every 2 ticks.
Basically there is always a roughly 2 second delay for blood on a player's face or muscle to become accurate.

[hr]

[h1]Incompatibilities[/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]Some clothing mods might cause transparency issues with customisation. This is caused by having a broken masks folder that is missing textures for bodyparts. To fix this you can copy the missing textures into the masks folder from media\textures\Body\Masks[/b]

    [*]Mods that affect stubble or chest hair won't work (Ras' Body Mod, Reorganised Info Screen)

    [*]Dynamic Body should work fine if you disable visible muscles

    [*]Retextures that replace the chest hair textures with new skins won't be accessible because chest hair is replaced

    [*][b]DOES NOT WORK IN SPLITSCREEN[/b]
[/list]


[hr]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Having too many traits active may cause the info screen to break because of how small it is. You need to use Bigger Character Avatars to fix this

    [*]No controller support
[/list]


[hr]

[h1]Credits[/h1]

I had to take a lot of code from Improved Hair Menu by duckduckquak for the menus.

Studying the code from the Furry mod by Jaql and Wuffwick as well as Ra's Body Mod helped me make this mod, but I haven't used any of their code.


[hr]

[url=https://github.com/LazySpongie/SpongieCharacterCustomisation]View on Github[/url]
This mod is open source so you can do whatever you want with it.

[hr]

Recut allows you to increase or reduce the insulation, water resistance and wind resistance of all repairable items.


[h1]Remove Fabric[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removes 50% from insulation, water resistance and wind resistance.
[*]Requires 8 in tailoring (like vanilla repair).
[*]Requires a needle, thread (1 use), 2 fabrics (fabric can be rags, denim strip or leather strip).

[list]
[*]Restore vanilla insulation, water resistance and wind resistance.
[*]Requires 8 in tailoring.
[*]Requires a needle, thread (1 use), 4 fabrics.
[/list]

[h1]Add Fabric[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adds 50% to insulation, water resistance and wind resistance.
[*]Requires 8 in tailoring.
[*]Requires a needle, thread (1 use), 6 fabrics.
[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[list]
[*]Does not impact weight or condition or protection.
[*]Can be added / removed from existing game.
[*]Is this overpowered ? yes.
[*]Does it work on unrepairable items ? no.
[*]Does it work on other mods items ? yes.
[*]Does it work on multiplayer ? it should.
[*]Percentage of insulation, water resistance and wind resistance added and removed are tunable from sandbox options.
[*]Required tailoring level and fabric number for each action are tunable from sandbox options.
[*]Time required for each action is tunable from sandbox options.
[*]Works for B42 and further versions.
[*]Use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889428155]this version for B41[/url].
[*]If you still have questions, ask on [url=https://discord.gg/theindiestone]Official PZ Discord: mod_support channel[/url].
[/list]

3418701509.title: Mad Crafter [B42]
3418701509.description:
[h2]Compatible with Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3 – 42.20[/h2]
[b]Mad Crafter[/b] adds electrified melee weapons, improvised scrap weapons, custom crafting recipes, and a stronger reason to invest in the Electrician skill.

Batteries, scrap parts, electronics, blades, pipes, spikes and odd tools can now become dangerous homemade weapons. Some are practical. Some are unstable. Most of them look like exactly the kind of thing someone would build in the middle of the apocalypse.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yF9OFTB.png[/img]

[h2]Main Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Electrified melee weapons powered by batteries.
[*] Improvised scrap weapons and multi-purpose tools.
[*] A weapon status bar showing battery charge and malfunction risk.
[*] Sandbox options for battery drain and malfunction balance.
[*] Electric visual effects while electric mode is active.
[*] Unique electric impact sounds for electrified weapons.
[*] Zombies can stagger and be briefly stunned by active electric weapons.
[*] Weapon bonuses while electric mode is active.
[*] Pixel-art item icons designed to fit the Project Zomboid style.
[*] Recipe unlocks through magazines or sufficient skill levels.
[/list]

[h2]Electric Weapons[/h2]
Electric weapons can be used like regular melee weapons, but they can also be switched into electric mode when they have battery power and their circuitry is still functional.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pEPIdtI.png[/img]

When electric mode is active, every swing consumes battery charge. Battery use depends on the weapon, and stronger weapons usually drain more power.

Each electrified weapon also gains its own combat bonus. For example, spear-type weapons can gain extra attack range, while heavy blunt weapons can gain higher damage and critical hit potential.

By default, electric mode can also increase the maximum number of targets hit, but this only matters when multi-hit is enabled.

[h2]Circuit Malfunction System[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sZ2CnFA.png[/img]

Electric weapons are made from scrap parts, improvised wiring and unstable circuitry. They are powerful, but not perfectly reliable.

As you fight, the weapon's malfunction risk can increase. The higher the risk, the more likely the circuit is to fail. If that happens, electric mode becomes unavailable until the weapon is repaired.

The malfunction system is mainly affected by:
[list]
[*] [b]Electrician Level[/b] — affects the base malfunction probability.
[*] [b]Maintenance Level[/b] — affects how much malfunction risk is added with each swing.
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] malfunction risk and malfunction probability are not the same thing. Risk builds up over time; probability decides whether the circuit actually fails.

[h2]Electric Mode Toggle[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/waekNAU.png[/img]

Electric mode can be configured in:

[b]Options → Mods → Mad Crafter[/b]

You can also assign a hotkey to toggle electric mode. No hotkey is assigned by default. The [b]G[/b] key is recommended.

[h2]Scrap Weapons and Tools[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6Nxewkh.png[/img]

Mad Crafter also adds improvised weapons and tools inspired by apocalyptic survival gear, movies and games.

Current scrap weapons and tools include:
[list]
[*] Cleaver Axe
[*] Dagger Trident
[*] Extinguisher Maul
[*] RailSpike Spear
[*] Nail-Spiked ShortSword
[*] Pipe Wrench Hatchet
[*] Saw Blade Claw
[*] Wrench Knife
[*] Zulu Short Spear
[*] Dagger Hatchet
[*] Saw Blade Bolt Cutters
[*] Keychain Screwdriver
[/list]

Yes, you can hang a screwdriver on your keychain.

[h2]Recipe Unlocks[/h2]

[h3]Electric Weapons[/h3]
To craft electric shock weapons, you must either:
[list]
[*] Find [b]Electrician Maniac's Diary[/b], or
[*] Have an Electrician level higher than the recipe requirement.
[/list]

[h3]Wild / Scrap Weapons[/h3]
To craft certain improvised weapons, you must either:
[list]
[*] Find [b]Hollywood Weapons Encyclopedia[/b], or
[*] Have the required skill level plus one extra level.
[/list]

[h2]Sandbox Options[/h2]
Mad Crafter includes sandbox settings so you can adjust how reliable, fragile, efficient or battery-hungry electric weapons are in your world.

You can configure:
[list]
[*] Electric weapon malfunction factor.
[*] Electric weapon battery consumption factor.
[/list]

[h2]Translations[/h2]
The mod currently supports:
[list]
[*] Chinese
[*] English
[*] Russian
[*] French
[/list]

Russian translation thanks to [b]ph0[/b].
French translation thanks to [b]Bobitec[/b].

[h2]Build 42 Compatibility[/h2]
Mad Crafter has been updated for newer Project Zomboid Build 42 versions.

This compatibility work includes support for the newer B42 mod structure, item script changes, registered item tags, translation formats and Lua loading paths.

Supported builds: from 42.12.3 to 42.20

[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]
If you encounter a bug, please report it in the discussion section.

Useful information to include:
[list]
[*] Project Zomboid build number.
[*] SP, hosted MP, or dedicated server.
[*] The exact weapon, recipe, item or action involved.
[*] Any relevant console/log errors.
[*] What happened shortly before the issue appeared.
[*] Your mod list, especially if the issue may be caused by a conflict.
[/list]

[h2]Future Update Ideas[/h2]
Possible future plans include:
[list]
[*] Reworking some weapon textures to reduce the use of very dark colors.
[*] Adding more electric shock weapons.
[*] Adding more scrap-based weapons.
[*] Adding more convenient tools.
[*] Adding more world items to support crafting and exploration.
[*] Exploring dual-mode weapons.
[*] Possibly experimenting with flame weapons once B42 becomes more stable.
[/list]

Suggestions and feedback are welcome.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*] Original mod by [b]Rocco[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199485575276/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[*] Maintenance and compatibility updates for newer B42 builds by [b]Afyrmo[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[/list]

3423660713.title: Mod Load Order Sorter [b42]
3423660713.description:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3180893708]Mod version for build 41 of Project Zomboid[/url]

This mod changes the logic of the automatic sorting of mods added in build 42 of ProjectZomboid.
Now the automatic sorting supports sorting rules, as well as highlights all found violations of the mod loading order.

[h3]How to use:[/h3]
All you need to do is enable this mod and apply the changes. Then activate all the mods you want, go to the mod load order and click the "Sort" button at the bottom of the screen. Apply the changes.
Done!
If necessary, you can manually change the mod load order or set your own rules using the sorting rules editor.

[h3]Warning:[/h3]
Any change in the order of loading mods in the middle of the game can lead to loss of the current save. Do so at your own risk.

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Automatic sorting:
 The list of Active mods is pre-sorted alphabetically and also grouped in the following order:
[olist]
[*]Framework/API/Tweak mods,
[*]Resources/Textures,
[*]Maps/Locations,
[*]Vehicles,
[*]Code-only mods,
[*]Clothing,
[*]Interface,
[*]Other mods,
[*]Localization
[/olist]
 Subsequent application of the [b]topological sorting algorithm[/b] can detect and correct incorrect order of mods according to the requirements of each mod.
[*]Support for [b]Sorting Rules[/b]. Sorting Rules Editor
[*]Highlighting mods with detected violations
[*][b]Search[/b] by mod name or mod ID
[*]Support for [b]multiple file selection[/b] to manually edit the order of loading mods.
[*]When running the game in debug mode, additional information about the mod on which the mouse cursor is hovered will be displayed.
[/list]

[h3]Disclamer[/h3]
This mod is not a cure for all conflicts in the order of loading mods. Some conflicts can only be resolved manually.

[h3]Questions and Answers:[/h3]
[b]Q: What should I do if a mod doesn't appear in the mod list?[/b]
[b]A:[/b]
1) Please make sure you are subscribing to the correct version of the mod: In the main menu of the game at the bottom is written the [b]version of the game[/b]. This version of the mod is only for version b42. [spoiler]For version 41 of the game use the mod of the corresponding version https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3180893708[/spoiler]
2) If you already have some mods enabled and this mod doesn't appear in the list, try disabling all mods and rechecking the list (there are mods that change how mods appear in the mod list).
3) If this mod still doesn't appear, try [b]deleting [/b] the [b]Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\108600[/b] folder, and then [b]verify the integrity[/b] of the game files. [b]WARNING[/b]: All mods you subscribed to will be [b]redownloaded[/b].

[b]Q: How to share load order with friend:[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Use the standard [b]Share [/b] and [b]Add [/b] buttons to export and import mod packs:
1) Go to [b]Mods [/b] (assume you want to share the currently active mod list, which is already sorted as you need).
2) In the bottom-left corner, there’s a [b]preset dropdown menu[/b]. 3) Click the [b]Save [/b] button next to it and give your preset a name.
4) Select your preset (if it isn’t already selected) and click the [b]Share [/b] button.
5) [b]Send[/b] the copied text to a friend.
6) Your friend should go to [b]Mods[/b], click the [b]Add [/b] button (next to the Share button), and [b]paste [/b] the text you sent.

[b]Q: How do I use an exported mod load order list on the server?[/b]
[b]A:[/b]
You have two options:
[b]In-game:[/b]
[list]
1) Enable all necessary mods on the client (this mod should already be [b]enabled[/b]).
2) Go to MineMenu -> Server -> Settings -> [b]Edit [/b]the desired server config or [b]create [/b]a new one.
3) On the mod selection page, [b]click [/b]the button next to "Select Mods" - this will add all mods enabled on the client to the server.
4) [b]Done[/b]. All mods and their workshop IDs have been added to the server config.
[/list]
[b]Manually[/b]:
[list]
1) Go to MineMenu -> Mods -> [b]Mods Load Order[/b], click [b]Copy[/b] button (top right).
2) Go to [b]C:\Users\<Username>\Zomboid\Server[/b] and open the [b]<server_config_name>.ini[/b] file with your favorite text editor. 
3) Find the [b]Mods=[/b] line in the file, delete it, and [b]paste [/b]the copied text.
4) Find the [b]WorkshopItems=[/b] line in the file and [b]delete [/b]it.
5) [b]Save [/b]the file.
[/list]
Start the server and test the mods.

Mod ID: ModLoadOrderSorter_b42

3424497614.title: U.S. M548 Cargo Carrier by Papa_Chad
3424497614.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NrstAKw.gif[/img]

This mod adds M548 Cargo Carrier with Animated Tracks, Doors and a fully functioning Turret to Project Zomboid. It is necessary to have the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2705406713]Military Tool Kit[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2705655822]U.S. M113 APC by Papa_Chad [/url]installed.

 The M548 is a tracked cargo carrier. It is based on the M113 armored personnel carrier. Extremely powerful vehicle with its tracks is the ideal vehicle to smash hordes and with your Browning M2HB carnage is guaranteed.
[h1]Resources[/h1]


*Only for B42 SP and MP
*✅B42.20
*Compatible with old saves
*Compatible with KI5 vehicles

[list]
[*] [b]Animated Tracks[/b]
[*] [b]Tracks Sound[/b]
[*] [b]Animated Doors
[*] [b]Animated Addons
[*] [b]Turret [/b]
    The turrets have heavy coding that adds a completely new ballistics system that is independent of the systems in the Standard Game, performing calculations for each projectile independently, calculating its energy, ability to cause damage and transfix bodies, vehicles and walls.
[/list]

[h1]Advantages[/h1]
[list][*][b]Carrying Capacity[/b] - High carrying capacity
[*][b]Browning M2HB[/b] - It uses the powerful 12.7 x99mm (.50 BMG) ammunition capable of annihilating anything in front of it. (Just like in real life, the projectile can transfix walls, vehicles and bodies).[/list]

[h1]Disadvantages[/h1]
[list][*] [b]High consumption of gasoline[/b] - Because of its weight and tracks it will need much more gasoline than normal vehicles.
[*] [b]Low speed[/b] - Slowly but with style.
[*] [b]No Armor[/b] - Unlike the M113, the M548 is unarmored.
[*] [b]Very noisy[/b] - Make a lot of noise that can attract a lot of attention wherever it goes.[/list]
	In future updates, The tracks may break and will need to be repaired.

[h1]How to use the Machine Gun[/h1]
[list]
[*]	The machine gun must be installed in the vehicle
[*] You must sit in the Gunner's seat
[*] You must place the [b]12.7x99mm (.50 BMG) Ammo Box[/b] already loaded with [b]12.7x99mm (.50 BMG) Round[/b] in the gun compartment.
- Due to limitations in B42.13, the Ammo Box is no longer necessary in this version, so just drop the ammunition into the weapon’s compartment.

3428369137.title: Dismantle Any Car
3428369137.description:
Are you sick and tired or looking at all the vehicles around you and thinking "I wish I could use this welding torch to convert those cars to scrap metal but alas!  The creators have decreed that only wrecked or burnt cars may be dismantled, and no matter how many parts I break off or how many molotovs I throw at this car it shall never be considered a wreck, for to be a wreck is a condition a car must be born with."

This mod has you covered!  It extends the "Dismantle Wrecked Car" context menu to include "Dismantle Car" when you right click on a non-wrecked, non-burnt vehicle.

Additional sandbox options on the [b]Vehicle[/b] page allow you to adjust the amount of fuel needed for disassembly, change the amount of material generated and replace use of a welding mask with good ol' Kentucky safety squints.


[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Is it safe to add/remove this mod on an existing save?[/b]

Yes.  If you change the sandbox settings you will need to quit and restart the game before the new setting take effect.

[b]Is it safe to squint tightly while welding instead of using a welding mask?[/b]

The Australian prime minister has [url=https://i.imgur.com/7qDwU0J.png]personally certified the use of safety squints when welding.[/url]


[b]Does dismantling a functional car produce more raw materials than a wreck/burnt out car?[/b]

Additional materials are generated based on the condition of the vehicle's parts.  A car with all parts at 100% will generate approximately 80% more raw materials.  The type of materials generated is unchanged.


[b]What if I want to keep some of the car parts?[/b]

Remove them before dismantling.


[b]What happens to items inside a car when I dismantle it?[/b]

They get dropped on the ground with the rest of the scrap metal.


[b]What happens to animals inside an animal trailer when I dismantle it?[/b]

They get teleported to a farm upstate to happily live out the rest of their lives in a place of peace and contentment with a friendly farmer who takes care of all of their needs.


[b]Really?[/b]

There is no evidence that this is not true.

3434796669.title: Risky Unarmed
3434796669.description:
[b]Shoving and stomping now carries a risk of being counterattacked. Highly customizable.[/b]

NOTE: Temp fix for b42.20. Traits have no effect in the mod with b42.20. Full repair is WIP. No change on b42 version.

[hr][/hr]
Ever wonder why zombies become helpless when they're knocked over? Or why you never get bitten when you're shoving away a horde and putting your limbs right in front of their gnashing faces? Or maybe you just feel too powerful curb stomping dozens of zombies and walking away without a scratch on the first day?

The idea behind this mod is to simulate the risk of fighting zombies without any range advantage. In short, it introduces [b]a small chance for any one shove or stomp to backfire and result in a wound on the attacker[/b] with the same consequences of a normal zombie attack.

This change discourages fighting when unprepared, especially at the very beginning of the game. Any last-resort improvised weapon becomes safer than going unarmed. In this time it might be better to flee and break line of sight than to kill a threat with your bare hands.  When you do get a weapon, [i][b]it becomes very important to keep zombies outside the weapon's minimum range[/b][/i] so your melee attacks aren't automatically swapped into shoves. Crowd control with low-knockback weapons should be more difficult. The practice of preserving weapon durability by using unarmed is now risky.

By default it's safe to shove zombies who are unalerted, facing away from the player, or who have already counterattacked a player within the last couple seconds. The player also has a separate shorter grace period after being counterattacked. Wearing armor on your limbs can reduce or eliminate the danger from this mod. The strength and fitness skills affect the chance of being injured, as do the thick and thin skinned traits.

[hr][/hr]
[b]Almost every part of the mod is customizable in sandbox options so you can use as much or as little of it as you want.[/b] For example, you could configure the mod to:

[i]- Simulate the roughness of unarmed combat without actually being "attacked" by zombies by disabling all wounds except non-infectious scratches on the hands and feet, ignoring defense and not causing holes in clothing. With this setup you might get blisters or abrasions on those parts but it shouldn't ever be directly lethal.

- Enable shove safety when holding two-handed weapons, allowing you to safely push zombies away using brooms, planks, or other long weapons. You could even hold something like a pillow to protect yourself from being bitten if you set shove safety to recognize "any item"

- Set shoving to only affect the forearms, and stomping to only affect the feet; that way the counterattacks from this mod can be absorbed by more easily accessible clothes. Assuming you aren't using mods that add armor for the hands and shins.

- Set the cooldown very high to (in effect) prevent a zombie from counterattacking you more than once. In case you want the risk to still be significant but don't like the chance of being ripped to shreds because you won an unarmed fight.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
I personally play with low-pop [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2872586942]vaulting[/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2716710487]runners[/url] and transmission off. If you play with high pop, shamblers, or transmission on, this mod might make less sense or feel excessively punishing. It was just bothering me that my character could 1v1 a rabid monster the size of a full grown human while bare-handed and at little to no personal risk.

Note: I have not tested this in multiplayer or with most other mods. I don't see a reason why it wouldn't work, but let me know if it doesn't and I'll mention incompatibilities here.

3436499337.title: Vehicle Military Zones
3436499337.description:
[h1] I warn you, all screenshots were taken on B42, it has quite noticeable differences from B41. [/h1]

The main goal of the mod is to add spawn zones for military vehicles in the appropriate places on the vanilla map. However, at the moment, several mod maps are also supported.
If you have ideas where else I can add military zones, I will listen to you.

The mod is designed to use modded vehicles, as there are no military vehicles in vanilla. So if you only play with vanilla vehicles, this mod is useless for you.

[b][i][u] Can be added to/removed from existing save. [/u][/i][/b] When added to an existing save, the changes will only apply to unexplored areas. When removed from a save, already spawned cars will remain, but will no longer appear in other places.

If you want the cars to spawn only in military zones then load it after vehicle mods.

The mod also adds 4 new road stories: Military Blockade | Convoy | Blockpost, Biohazard Crash. All road stories don't spawn in first 5 days of apocalypse. To understand what to expect, you can look at the mod's images.
To ensure that semi-trailers spawn normally in stories, use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3740300378]KI5 Mini-fixes[/url].

[h3] ---> [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3682033568]Old version[/url] <--- [/h3]

[hr][/hr]
[h3] Where are the zones: [/h3]
[list]
[*]Military base
[*]Louisville checkpoint
[*]East Army Camp near Louisville
[*]Brandenburg
[*]March Ridge
[*]In small camp between Irvington and Brandenburg
[/list]
[h3] Supported maps: [/h3]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1516836158]Fort Redstone[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1414568604]Fort Knox[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2806456685]Fort Rock Ridge[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2934132344]Louisville Quarantine Zone[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2196102849]Raven Creek[/url]/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3484263516]Raven Creek B42[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3476333350]Echo Creek Military Base[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3494374578][B42] SecretZ Pandemic (Alpha)[/url]/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3733167464][B42] SecretZ Pandemic [MODULAR][/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3600377019]Foxtrot Warehouse [B42][/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747335481]Falcon Ridge B42[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3659676359]AnruisiTown (Military Bastion)[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3522517059]Safeharbor Garrison[/url]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2] Little bit of technical part [/h2]

All vehicles are sorted from VehicleZoneDistribution.military, but it also works with army, just adding vehicles from army to military.
The mod automatically removes all vehicles from other zones, so if you don't enable a special sandbox option, military vehicles will only spawn in military zones.

As I said earlier, the mod versions for B41 and B42 are slightly different and the main difference is the number of different zones.
[b] B41 version: [/b]
-> military_burnt (burnt military vehiles; determined by the presence of "burnt" in the vehicle's script name)
-> military_container (containers added by the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2625625421]Containers![/url]; determined by the presence of "container" in the vehicle's script name)
-> military_trailer (trailers; determined by the presence of "trailer" in the vehicle's script name)
-> military_trailer_light (only small trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is less than or equal to 1)
-> military_trailer_heavy (only huge heavy trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is more than 1)
-> military_vehicle (military cars; remainder after sorting)
-> military_vehicle_light (light military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce)/(maxSpeed*1000) is less than or equal 60)
-> military_vehicle_heavy (heavy military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce)/(maxSpeed*1000) is more than 60)

[b] B42 version: [/b]
-> military_burnt (burnt military vehiles; determined by the presence of "burnt" in the vehicle's script name)
-> military_container (containers added by the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2625625421]Containers![/url]; determined by the presence of "container" in the vehicle's script name)
-> military_container_angled (slightly rotated containers)
-> military_trailer (all trailers; determined by the presence of "trailer" in the vehicle's script name)
-> military_trailer_angled (slightly rotated trailers)
-> military_trailer_light (only small trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is less than or equal to 1)
-> military_trailer_light_angled (slightly rotated light trailers)
-> military_trailer_heavy (only huge heavy trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is more than 1)
-> military_trailer_heavy_angled (slightly rotated heavy trailers)
-> military_vehicle (all military cars; remainder after sorting)
-> military_vehicle_angled (slightly rotated military cars)
-> military_vehicle_light (light military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce*engineLoudness)/10^6 is less than or equal 425)
-> military_vehicle_light_angled (slightly rotated light military cars)
-> military_vehicle_heavy (heavy military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce*engineLoudness)/10^6 is more than 425)
-> military_trailer_heavy_angled (slightly rotated heavy military cars)

[h3] Making your own compatibility [/h3]
[b] For vehicle mods: [/b]
Just add your vehicle in VehicleZoneDistribution.military or VehicleZoneDistribution.army. If you are interested in where your vehicle will be distributed, read above about the zones.

[b] For map mods: [/b]
Will be a bit later.

3436537035.title: Useful Barrels
3436537035.description:
[h1] Barrels can actually be more than just a sprite! [/h1]
[b]Important: GigaWatte has stopped active development of this mod but I will do my best to fix bugs and keep the mod working for current version of the game. Updates may be slow but the mod is not dead. - SP4RTAN[/b]
Multiplayer support is currently not fully implemented or tested. Please use it in MP at your own risk.

[h2] Features available [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Use your Pipe Wrench to open the lid of the barrel!
    [*]Store any fluid inside
    [*]The amount of liquid inside the barrel affects the encumbrance
    [*]Rubber Hose to take gas from the barrel
    [*]Funnel for pouring gas into the barrel
    [*]Funnel may speedup pouring action
    [*]Refueling vehicle from the barrel. and vice versa
    [*]Refueling generator from the barrel
    [*]Randomized initial fluid and amount
    [*]Sandbox vars to control mod behaviour as you want
    [*]Chuckleberry Finn's Mod Update and Alert System integration for ingame ChangeLog
[/list]

[h2] Notes [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Uses new FluidContainer system of B42
    [*]Barrels are now less fragile! But anyway Walkers will break it pretty quickly
    [*]Gasoline does not evaporate from the barrels with closed lid
    [*]Modded vehicles and trailers are supported if the vehicle has a part with the "gastank" category and the part containerType contains the word "Gasoline" (this information is mostly for modders)
    [*]Please! Any full 800L barrels in your characters pocket or car trunk is your responsibility, there is no proper way to haul them. For now at least.
    [*]I'd also recommend checking out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3439305933]Functional Gutters[/url] mod.
[/list]

[h2] How to [/h2]
[h3] Base usage [/h3]
[list]
    [*]Find a Pipe Wrench and any metal barrel in the game (there are only four types available)
    [*]Move it to the garage at your base
    [*]Right click on it and select "Uncap ..." option
    [*]Find a Rubber Hose and a Funnel, then place them on the barrel to enable fluid transfer
[/list]
[h3] Refuel generator [/h3]
[list]
    [*]The generator must be near the barrel with at least 1 liter of fuel
    [*]The generator must be turned off and have free space for fuel
    [*]Find a Rubber Hose if you haven't found it yet, then place it on the barrel (or keep it in your inventory)
    [*]Right click on the generator and select "Refuel From Barrel"
[/list]
[h3] Refuel vehicle [/h3]
[list]
    [*]The vehicle must be near the player
    [*]The vehicle's engine must be turned off
    [*]The gas tank must have free space
    [*]The barrel with gas must be near the vehicle
    [*]Find a Rubber Hose if you haven't found it yet, then place it on the barrel (or keep it in your inventory)
[/list]
[h3] Rain collector barrel [/h3]
[list]
    [*]Find a Welding mask and a Welding torch with at least 2 uses
    [*]Right-click on the barrel
    [*]Find the "Cut Lid" option - it may appear at the top or inside the existing barrel submenu
[/list]

[h2] Future plans [/h2]
[list]
    [*] Better multiplayer support
[/list]

[h2]Mods compatibility[/h2]
[list]
    [*] Modded vehicles (and fluid trailers) should be compatible if: vehicle has part and part category contains "gastank", part contentType contains word "Gasoline".
    [*] Other mods, such as IDBFS, could introduce their own overrides of the game's tiles, which may lead to issues with UB.
[/list]

[h2] Known bugs [/h2]
[list]
    [*] In case of game crash FuidContainer may not save it's contents.
    [*] Water level updates are not triggered while it's raining, so changes in the water level won't be rendered unless there is some manual interaction with the fluid.
[/list]

[h2] FAQ [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Q: b41 when?
    [*]A: I dont have any plans to port it on b41. And there is already a mod for b41, it's called "Fuel API"
    [*]Q: How to move my 800l barrel now?
    [*]A: It's quite hard to implement right now properly. I hope TIS devs add some good functionality to makeit in the future.
[/list]

3437629766.title: CleanUI [B42]
3437629766.description:
[h2]Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3-42.20.x - SP / MP[/h2]
[b]CleanUI[/b] is a streamlined inventory and loot interface overhaul for Project Zomboid Build 42.

It makes inventory panels cleaner, more compact, more configurable, and easier to read while keeping the familiar vanilla gameplay flow.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TFFM7ZZ.png[/img]

[hr]
[h2]Requirements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]NeatUI Framework is required[/b] and must load before CleanUI.
[*]NeatUI Framework [b]v1.0.6 or newer[/b] is recommended.
[*]Build 42 only.
[/list]

Server configuration:
[code]Mods=NeatUI_Framework;CleanUI
WorkshopItems=3508537032;3437629766[/code]

Restart the server fully after changing it.

[hr]
[h2]Main Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cleaner, compact inventory and loot panels.
[*]Configurable container-button position and scale.
[*]Player container reordering by dragging container icons.
[*]Collapsible utility panel.
[*][b]Transfer All[/b] and [b]Take All[/b] integrated into capacity.
[*]Search by item name, category, or both.
[*]Single-menu or split quick transfer buttons.
[*]Sorting, configurable text, and automatic truncation.
[*]Optional Weight column and column headers.
[*]Merged hotbar items under [b]Equipped Items[/b].
[*]Quick switch between CleanUI and vanilla inventory.
[*]Client-side options for layout, opacity, colors, scaling, and transfers.
[/list]

[h2]Search and Transfer[/h2]

Right-click the search box to search by [b]name[/b], [b]category[/b], or [b]both[/b]. Matching rows move to the top.

Transfer controls can use one compact menu or separate quick buttons for item names, categories, and Move To Floor. Supported actions can target the selected container or nearby containers.

[h2]Interface Guide[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qBGq7M.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b](1) Transfer:[/b] menu or quick transfer actions.
[*][b](2) Transfer All / Take All:[/b] moves all items and shows capacity.
[*][b](3) Lock:[/b] prevents dragging and resizing.
[*][b](4) Search:[/b] uses the selected search mode.
[*][b](5) Divider:[/b] adjusts column widths.
[*][b](6) Sort:[/b] opens sorting options.
[*][b](7) Collapse / Expand:[/b] controls item stacks.
[*][b](8) Equipped Items:[/b] hides or shows that section.
[/list]

[b]Reorder containers:[/b] drag their icons in the player inventory.

[b]Use vanilla inventory:[/b] right-click the [b]open-box icon[/b] in the left button bar and toggle [b]Use CleanUI Inventory[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0goWZXm.png[/img]

Open CleanUI settings through:

[b]ESC > Options > Mods > CleanUI[/b]

Settings are client-side, so every player can configure their own interface.

[hr]
[h2]Compatibility[/h2]

Most gameplay, item, map, and content mods should work normally. Conflicts are more likely with mods that replace inventory/loot UI files, context menus, or container behavior.

Tested compatibility includes:

[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3662387304][b]Item Rarity UI[/b][/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3586216562][b]Better Containers[/b][/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3669550831][b]Proximity Inventory B42.19+[/b][/url]
[/list]

[b]Better Containers and Proximity Inventory are not compatible with each other.[/b]

CleanUI overlaps with Reorder Containers, Search Container, Smart Stack, and Auto Drop n' Loot. Other inventory overhauls, Bigger Inventory Container Icon, and JB Max Capacity Override may conflict or cause display problems.

Compatibility can depend on load order, versions, game build, and server configuration.

[hr]
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]

CleanUI preserves vanilla controller behavior where possible, but it has not been fully tested and some limitations may remain.

Controller users may try [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3475293985][b]Clean UI Menu Support[/b][/url]. I have not personally tested that addon with a controller.

[hr]

[list]
[*]Close Project Zomboid.
[*]Unsubscribe from CleanUI.
[*]Wait for Steam to remove the old Workshop download.
[*]Subscribe again and wait for the download to finish.
[*]Verify game files:
[b]Steam Library > right-click PZ > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files[/b]
[/list]

Verification may remove manual changes to vanilla files.

[b]Test the minimum mod set:[/b]

Use a new save or a backup test copy with only [b]NeatUI Framework + CleanUI[/b], with NeatUI first. If it works, restore other mods in small groups until the problem returns.

[b]For container FPS drops:[/b]

[list]
[*]Disable [b]Optimize Large Stacks[/b] and the optional [b]Weight[/b] column.
[*]Keep large stacks collapsed and clear searches/filters.
[*]Enable [b]UI Offscreen Rendering[/b] in [b]Options > User Interface[/b].
[*]Limit [b]UI Rendering FPS[/b] to 60; try 30 if needed.
[*]Compare the same container with [b]Use CleanUI Inventory[/b] on and off.

High Beams!  Because driving at night needs more than 8 feet of visibility.

[b]How do I use this mod?[/b]

First, you need to be playing [b]B42[/b] and you need a vehicle with working headlights.  Then get in your car and toggle high-beam mode with the hotkey (set to '.' by default.) The headlight indicator will be blue when headlights are on and in high-beam mode.

[*]Radial Menu: Adds a high beam toggle to the vehicle radial menu.

After changing settings turn high beams off and on again for them to take effect.

This mod is B42 only.  It relies on new functionality added in B42.9.0 and can't be back-ported to B41.

[b]Can this mod be safely removed mid-save?[/b]

Yes.

In Options -> Display & Performance -> Lighting Updates  set the number of lighting updates to a value higher than 15 per second. 3439305933.title: [B42] Functional Gutters
3439305933.description:
Realistically harvest rain water from a building's roof by connecting a container to the gutter's drain.

Tap into existing gutters or build your own custom gutter system using a variety of new craftable gutter pipes.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Does this mod work in multiplayer (build 42.13+)?[/b]
[list]
  [*]Yes, the mod has been updated with initial multiplayer support. Servers will use the default mod options (1.0 rain factor, pipe wrench required) until configurable sandbox values are added in a future update.
[/list]

[b]Can this mod be safely added mid-save?[/b]
[list]
  [*]Yes, but it will not change any already existing collectors that happen to be placed on a gutter tile.
[/list]

[b]Can this mod be safely removed mid-save?[/b]
[list]
  [*]Yes, but extra steps are required for multiplayer. See the removal section below.
[/list]

[b]Do gutter collectors work indoors?[/b]
[list]
  [*]No, currently they still require being outdoors without a covered overhead tile.
[/list]

[b]What can I connect to the gutter[/b]
[list]
  [*]All vanilla rain collectors, troughs, and the amphora are supported. Additionally, any modded entities that use the game's FluidContainer system should work out of the box such as the Useful Barrels mod.
[/list]

[b]Does this work for build 41?[/b]
[list]
  [*]This mod relies on systems introduced in build `42.4+` and will not function in build `41`.
[/list]

[h2]How To Use[/h2]
[olist]
  [*]Build/place supported collector on the same tile as a gutter drain. Either tile works for multi-tile troughs.
  [*]Open the context menu by right-clicking on the collector.
  [*]Find the [b]"Gutter Drain"[/b] submenu and select the [b]"Connect"[/b] option. Requires a pipe wrench unless turned off in mod settings.
  [*]Enjoy the benefits of a highly-efficient rain collector system.
[/olist]

[h3]Pre-Existing Structures[/h3]
Pre-existing structures already have roof gutters meaning you won't have to build your own. To tap into these roof gutters, you will either need to find a building with an existing drain pipe or build a new drain pipe.

On its own a drain pipe will reach the next level above. Additional vertical pipes can be built on top of the drain pipe to access roofs on higher floor levels.

[h3]Player-Built Structures[/h3]
Unlike pre-existing structures, player-built structures will require horizontal gutter pipes to expand the size of the roof's area being covered by the drain pipe. Each gutter pipe can collect rain from up to 4 grid-squares from its attachment point in a line. A roof square will be considered valid if it has a floor, isn't covered by a roof, and isn't occupied by an item such as a rain collector.

Use the "View Pipes" and "View Roof" buttons in the gutter ui panel to help visualize the connected pipes and covered roof area.

[h2]Mod Settings[/h2]
Options -> Mods -> Functional Gutters

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Option[/th]
        [th]Description[/th]
    [/tr]
[tr]
        [td]Roof Rain Factor[/td]
        [td]The rain factor for a single square of roof which defaults to 1.0.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Require Pipe Wrench[/td]
        [td]If true, requires a pipe wrench to connect/disconnect containers with a gutter.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Debug Mode[/td]
        [td]If true, prints debug messages to the console and adds an additional context menu option. *Requires Restart[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Removing Mod from Multiplayer[/h2]
As of 42.13.1, there is an extra step required to properly remove the mod from multiplayer servers. This process is not specific Functional Gutters and will be required for any mods that add custom entities until a fix is added in the base game.

[h3]Removal Methods[/h3]
Choose one of the following methods to maintain an active multiplayer save:

[b]Placeholder Mod[/b]
To help facilitate removal, a second mod titled "[42] Functional Gutters (Removed)" has been included alongside the main mod. This placeholder mod maintains all entity scripts and tile definitions but none of the main mod's core functionality.
[olist]
  [*]Stop the server
  [*]Backup the server files if not done automatically on server shutdown
  [*]Disable the main mod "[42] Functional Gutters" in the server settings
  [*]Enable the placeholder mod "[42] Functional Gutters (Removed)" in the server settings
  [*]Start the server back up
[/olist]

[b]Manual[/b]
[olist]
  [*]Remove any player-crafted gutters from the game world - not required but will prevent invisible asset warnings being logged
  [*]Stop the server
  [*]Backup the server files if not done automatically on server shutdown
  [*]Remove the mod from the server settings
  [*]Locate and delete the following server files: WorldDictionary.bin, WorldDictionaryLog, WorldDictionaryReadable - location may differ but for hosted files on windows will be Users/<user name>/Zomboid/Saves/Multiplayer/<server name>
  [*]Start the server back up - this will automatically regenerate the WorldDictionary files and allow clients to connect without crashing
[/olist]

[h3]But why do I need to do all of this?[/h3]
The client syncs its own local copy of the server's WorldDictionary when connecting to the server. Any custom entities will still exist in the server's WorldDictionary with the flag removed=True whenever a mod is removed. Unfortunately in the current version of project zomboid multiplayer, this flag appears to be ignored and the client will crash with a reference error since the referenced entity scripts no longer exist for it locally.

Deleting the server's WorldDictionary files forces the server to recreate them from scratch and they will no longer contain any entities from the removed mod allowing the client to properly connect once again.

[h2]Translations[/h2]
[olist]
  [*]Italian - thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/nycotex_]Nycotex[/url] <3
  [*]Spanish - needs validation
  [*]Portuguese - needs validation
[/olist]

[url=https://github.com/harlanrs/zomboid-functional-gutters] View on github for more information [/url]

[td]✅[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]

[td]✅[/td]

    "-Xms4096m",
    "-Xmx8192m",
    "-XX:+UseParallelGC",
    "-XX:ParallelGCThreads=4",
    "-XX:+UseNUMA",
    "-XX:+AlwaysPreTouch",
    "-XX:+DisableExplicitGC",

3460812542.title: Washing Menus Improved [B42]
3460812542.description:
[h1]Build 42.12.3 – 42.20.3 Support (SP/MP)[/h1]
[h3]Better [b]Wash[/b] and [b]Clean Bandages[/b] menus for every water source[/h3]

[b]Washing Menus Improved[/b] improves the vanilla washing menus with cleaner submenus, smarter batching, clearer tooltips, and reliable handling of items inside [b]equipped bags[/b].

Instead of canceling the whole action when water is limited, the mod washes [b]as many items as the available water allows[/b].

[b]Safe to enable or disable mid-save.[/b]
No vanilla files are overwritten.

[hr]
[h2]Main Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Smarter washing menus[/b] — cleaner, easier-to-read submenus on valid water sources.
[*][b]Partial washing[/b] — if there is not enough water for everything, the mod washes what it can instead of canceling the whole action.
[*][b]Equipped bag support[/b] — items can be transferred from equipped bags, washed, and returned to their original bag automatically.
[*][b]Clearer tooltips[/b] — shows water and soap requirements, plus dirt and blood information.
[*][b]Dedicated bandage cleaning[/b] — adds a separate [b]Clean Bandages[/b] submenu right after [b]Wash[/b].
[*][b]Multiplayer-friendly design[/b] — built around vanilla timed actions and inventory transfers.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Wash Submenu[/h2]
Washing Menus Improved replaces the vanilla [b]Wash[/b] submenu on [b]all valid water sources[/b], including:
[list]
[*]Sinks
[*]Wells
[*]Rivers
[*]Bathtubs
[*]Rain collectors
[*]Water containers placed on the ground
[/list]

The washing menu includes:
[list]
[*][b]Yourself[/b]
[*][b]Inventory[/b] → All / Clothing / Weapons / Equipped / Other + per-item lists
[*][b]Equipped Bags[/b] → All / Clothing / Weapons / Other + per-item lists
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Clean Bandages Submenu[/h2]
The mod adds a dedicated [b]Clean Bandages[/b] submenu immediately after [b]Wash[/b] on each valid water source.

It works with dirty medical materials in both your [b]main inventory[/b] and your [b]equipped bags[/b]:
[list]
[*]Dirty bandages
[*]Dirty rags / ripped sheets
[*]Dirty denim strips
[*]Dirty leather strips
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Sandbox Options[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Allow tainted water for cleaning[/b] — default: ON.
[*][b]Water per bandage/strip[/b] — default: 4.00, decimals supported.
[/list]

[i]Note:[/i] the vanilla [b]Enable "Tainted Water" tooltip[/b] option only shows or hides the warning tooltip. It does [b]not[/b] enable or disable cleaning actions.

[hr]
[h2]Take A Bath And Shower Compatibility[/h2]
Compatible with the context menus from:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3592172476][b][B42] Take A Bath And Shower[/b][/url]

[list]
[*][b]Bathtubs:[/b] WMI adds [b]Wash[/b] and [b]Clean Bandages[/b] to the end of the TABAS bathtub submenu.
[*][b]Showers:[/b] WMI replaces the TABAS shower [b]Wash[/b] entry with the WMI [b]Wash[/b] menu and adds [b]Clean Bandages[/b] right after it.
[*]Works regardless of load order.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Compatibility Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3 – 42.20.3[/b].
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer host testing.
[*]Uses versioned Build 42 branches for older B42 compatibility.
[*]Safe to add to existing saves.
[*]Safe to remove.
[*]Does not add items, traits, recipes, map content, or permanent save data.
[/list]

Possible conflicts are more likely with mods that also modify water-source context menus, washing actions, clean bandage actions, inventory transfer behavior, or bathtub/shower context menus.

[hr]
[h2]Feedback & Bug Reports[/h2]
If something goes wrong, please use the
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3460812542/596286923597034717/][b]Bug Reports[/b][/url]
discussion and include:
[list]
[*]WMI and Project Zomboid versions.
[*]SP, MP Host, or Dedicated Server.
[*]The water source and item involved.
[*]Exact steps to reproduce the problem.
[*]Your mod list and load order.
[*]The first relevant [b]ERROR[/b] and full [b]STACK TRACE[/b].
