3461263912.title: Clean HotBar [B42]
3461263912.description:
[h2]Compatible with Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3–42.20.4 (SP / MP)[/h2]

[b]Clean Hot Bar[/b] improves Project Zomboid’s hotbar and hand-equipped UI with clearer item information, cleaner visuals, customizable scaling and opacity, compatible-slot highlighting, and built-in slot reordering.

Its goal is simple: show useful information at a glance without turning the hotbar into visual clutter.

[h2]Item Status at a Glance[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vSq7e8H.png[/img]
Clean Hot Bar displays Build 42 item information directly in each slot:
[list]
[*][b]Overall condition[/b] through the slot background and its color
[*][b]Weapon head condition and sharpness[/b] in a combined bar on applicable weapons
[*][b]Firearm status:[/b] loaded ammo, spare ammo in the player’s inventory, and weapon jams
[*][b]ON / OFF indicators[/b] for flashlights and other activatable items
[*][b]Remaining contents[/b] for drainable and liquid containers
[*][b]Compatible-slot highlighting[/b] when dragging an item over the hotbar
[/list]

For applicable weapons, white represents current sharpness and the remaining colored section represents head condition above that sharpness. Since sharpness cannot exceed head condition, both values share one bar instead of using two separate indicators.

[h2]Hand-Equipped UI[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qdn3lSz.png[/img]
The main-hand and off-hand slots use the same cleaner visual style and can display item condition, weapon status, ammunition, liquids, and activation states.

Status indicators and tooltips can be configured separately for the hotbar and the hand-equipped interface.

[h2]Liquid System Integration[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hx8z1gT.png[/img]
Build 42 liquid containers use color-coded bars so their contents and remaining amount are easier to recognize.

Some liquid colors were originally created with AI assistance, so feedback is welcome if a color looks inaccurate or is difficult to distinguish.

[h2]Visual Feedback[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KMJ1EZb.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Items briefly shake and flash when condition decreases
[*]Liquids use a smooth drain animation while being consumed
[*]An optional warning appears above the character when the equipped weapon loses durability
[*]Dragging an item previews compatible visible slots and potential replacements
[/list]

[h2]Customizable Settings[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tr3AbW6.png[/img]

Move the pointer over the hotbar and click the button with [b]three horizontal lines[/b] to open the settings panel.

You can:
[list]
[*]Show or hide item condition, head condition, sharpness, and ammunition information
[*]Adjust status-bar height and ammunition-text size
[*]Configure hotbar and hand-equipped tooltips separately
[*]Enable or disable the weapon-condition warning
[*]Set hotbar opacity from 20% to 100%
[*]Scale the hotbar from 0.6x to 2.0x
[*]Configure the built-in reordering system
[/list]

[b]Settings are client-side.[/b] Each player can configure their own UI independently.

[h2]Empty Slots and Extra Attachments[/h2]
The circular-arrow button on the left of the hotbar shows or hides empty attachment slots without removing them.

This keeps the hotbar compact when equipment or mods add many slots, including backpack upgrades from [b]Authentic Z[/b].

[h2]Built-in Hotbar Reordering[/h2]

Unlock reordering in the settings panel and drag slots to rearrange them:
[list]
[*][b]Swap[/b] exchanges two slot positions
[*][b]Insert[/b] moves a slot and shifts the slots between both positions
[*][b]Lock[/b] prevents accidental changes
[/list]

The selected order is saved and restored automatically.

[b]Reorder The Hotbar[/b] is normally unnecessary. If detected, Clean Hot Bar disables its own reorder implementation and lets the external mod handle it. Using only one reordering system is recommended when troubleshooting.

If you use [b]QoL Compendium[/b], disable [b]Change quick access bar order[/b] when using Clean Hot Bar’s built-in reordering.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*]Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3 through [b]42.20.4[/b]
[*]SP, MP Host, and dedicated servers
[*]Compatible with [b]CleanUI[/b]
[*]Supports additional attachment slots, including [b]Authentic Z[/b] backpack upgrades
[*]No framework dependency
[*]Best placed near the bottom of the mod load order
[/list]

Conflicts are most likely with mods that replace hotbar rendering, attachment-slot logic, drag-and-drop handling, tooltips, equipping or unequipping behavior, or the hand-equipped UI.

Clean Hot Bar already includes slot reordering. Test suspected hotbar or attachment conflicts on a new save with the smallest possible mod set.

A compatible automatic hotbar-hiding option is also available through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3688576740][B41/B42] Minimal Hotbar[/url]

It has worked in my tests, although every possible mod combination has not been tested.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
Clean Hot Bar works on [b]Build 42 only[/b].

Enable it for an existing save through:
[b]Main Menu > Load > select save > More... > Choose Mods...[/b]

For multiplayer servers, include:
[list]
[*]Mods=...;CleanHotBar;...
[*]WorkshopItems=...;3461263912;...
[/list]
Then fully restart the server.

[h2]Settings and Troubleshooting[/h2]
Current versions save client-side settings in:
[b]C:\Users<YourName>\Zomboid\Lua\CleanHotbarConfig.txt[/b]

The legacy [b]CleanHotbarConfig.lua[/b] file may still be read to migrate settings from older versions.

Since [b]v1.12.4[/b], configuration files are read with a restricted parser compatible with Build 42.20.4. Invalid files are rejected and valid defaults are used instead.

If the mod or its settings stop working after an update, close Project Zomboid and:
[list]
[*]Unsubscribe and wait for Steam to remove the old Workshop download
[*]Subscribe again and wait for the download to finish
[*]Verify Project Zomboid’s files through Steam
[*]If only settings are affected, back up and delete both Clean Hot Bar configuration files
[/list]

Deleting those files resets only Clean Hot Bar’s local settings.

[h2]Questions and Bug Reports[/h2]
For setup questions, item-disappearance reports, slot problems, errors, or compatibility issues, use:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3461263912/588433820963856761/][b]Questions and Bug Reports[/b][/url]

Please include the exact game version, SP/MP environment, reproduction steps, affected item and slot, mod list and load order, relevant logs, and a screenshot or video when useful.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*]Original mod by [b]Rocco[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199485575276/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[*]Maintenance and compatibility updates by [b]Afyrmo[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[/list]

Support the original author:

[url=https://afdian.com/a/23754956rocco][img]https://i.imgur.com/WLIHcQs.jpeg[/img][/url]

3461415167.title: [B42.20+/MP] Bicycle!
3461415167.description:
[h2] Works for b42.20+ with MP support![/h2]

It's a bicycle, hop on!

[h2] There is also a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3502018012]B41 version of the mod[/url], with multiplayer support![/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3456675747] There's also a skateboard!  [/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3453879909] And a kick scooter!  [/url]

------------------------------
[h2] FEATURES [/h2]
------------------------------
[list]
[*]A rideable bicycle that increases movement speed while equipped.

[*]Hold SHIFT to go faster!

[*]Hold Right Mouse Button or CTRL to steer using the mouse.

[*]Press E while near a bicycle to hop on, and press E again while riding to hop off. Can be changed to a different button in mod options.

[*]Riding the bicycle without holding SHIFT takes as much stamina as walking (none), and holding shift takes as much stamina as running.

[*]Custom interactions and animations, right click the bicycle near a fence and use the "throw bicycle" option to get it over to the other side.

[*]The bicycle speed can be adjusted in mod options.

[*]Immersive Mode toggle in mod options, with it enabled you will go slightly slower on rough surfaces like grass/gravel/sand/dirt.

[*]Spawns in garages, storage units, sport stores, and a few other places where it makes sense to find bicycles.

[*]Parts system, find attachable containers, lamps, wheels and other parts to upgrade your bike!

[*]Sidecars! Find them in same places as bicycles (garages, storage units, etc.) and use them to transport loot and live animals!

[*]Is affected by leg/foot injuries and health. If you have a broken leg or foot then you can't pedal at all.
[/list]

----------------------------
[h2] MOD INCOMPATIBILITIES [/h2]
----------------------------
[h3] !! IMPORTANT NOTE !![/h3]
Most issues should be resolved by [b]placing the Bicycle at the TOP of the mod list[/b], so try that if you're having an issue that is not listed below.

[list]
[*]Context menu to place bicycle in trunk might not work with some modded vehicles (tested and works with KI5 cars)
[/list]

------------------------------
[h2] FAQ [/h2]
------------------------------
[h3]How do I attach/detach parts like containers and wheels?[/h3]
Follow these instructions:
-- 1. Have the parts in your [b]main player inventory (!)[/b] NOT in a backpack/container.
-- 2. Drop the bike on the floor and stand near it
-- 3. Right click the bike choose "Upgrade"

[h3]Why are the bicycles spawning without wheels and I can't attach anything to the bike?[/h3]
Most likely you're using Gael's Gun Store mod, or another weapon mod that interferes with the upgrade/remove upgrade actions. They cause conflicts with my mod.

[h3]Why can't I put the bike in my inventory?[/h3]
You have to enable the "Allow transfer to inventory" in the mod options.

[h3]How do I use the kickstand?[/h3]
Hold E to dismount with kickstand, press E to throw the bike to the ground.

[h3]How do I ring the bicycle bell?[/h3]
Press Q (or your shout button if not using default)

[h3]What's the difference between street wheels and offroad wheels?[/h3]
Street wheels go faster on smooth surfaces like roads, but slower on rough terrain like dirt, sand, and grass. There's also a chance to get flats if riding on rough terrain.
Offroad wheels go slightly slower on smooth surfaces, but has no speed penalty and can't get flats on rough terrain.

[h3]How do I repair a flat wheel?[/h3]
You can repair it with a rubber hose and tire pump, there's a recipe for it.

------------------------------
[h2] Credits [/h2]
------------------------------
[h3] Big thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198046849708]Nik[/url] for making the beige bike model and attachments, as well as helping set up the attachment system![/h3]

[h3] Big thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199108422568]Viruana[/url] for letting me use their spawn system! [/h3]

[h3] Big thanks to Large_Flamingo for making the new red bike model and all of the sidecars![/h3]

Special thanks to Albion, SimKDT, Paddlefruit, DrStalker, Jimbeamdiablo, and CrystalChris from the Project Zomboid discord for helping answer my questions!

------------------------------

[/list]

------------------------------
[h2] PLANNED FEATURES [/h2]

[/list]

3469292499.title: [B42] Bandits Creator
3469292499.description:
[h1]Bandit creator[/h1]
Bandit Creator is an extension of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3268487204]Bandits [/url]mod, allowing you to fully customize Bandits and their Clans. Want to decide how your future killer looks? Now you can!

Accessible from main screen menu or in game using debug mode in single player.

Compatibile with B42 version for single and multiplayer.

[h2]Customization Options[/h2]
Here's what you can modify:
[list]
[*]Outfit – Clothing, jewelry and accessories for each body part.
[*]Physical appearance – skin tone, hair / beard style and color, makeup.
[*]Attributes: 
[list]
[*]Health, 
[*]Sight (affects weapon accuracy),
[*]Endurance (determines when they need to stop to catch their breath)
[*]Strength (affects melee combat, shoves, and barricade damage)
[/list]
[*]Weapons – melee, primary, and secondary weapons, plus ammo count.
[*]Bag type – the contents are auto-generated based on their expertise.
[*]Bandit special skills (expertise)
[*]Clan spawn settings: Define AI behavior, spawn location, time frame, and group size.
[/list]

[h2]Problems[/h2]
[list]
[*] After the game starts, some assets are loading in parallel for a short while. As a result if you open the Bandit Creator, it is possible that some of the clothing may be missing. Simply reload the creator again.
[*] Sometimes the creator may load longer than expected and freeze the game for 5-15 seconds. Just be patient
[*] Be mindful about screen resolution and font size. Creator adapts to resolution to a degree, but if the resolution is very low and font size is very big, you will experience problems.
[/list]

[h2]Bandit Expertise[/h2]
Each bandit can have up to three unique skills, called expertises. Some are not yet implemented and are marked accordingly:
[list]
[*]Assassin – Only approaches if unseen; can kill with one stab; silent. (Not implemented)
[*]Breaker – Breaks barricades/doors quickly; carries extra tools.
[*]Electrician – Sabotages generators and electrical devices; carries tools.
[*]Cook – Steals or sabotages crops; carries food.
[*]Goblin – Performs mischievous (but non-lethal) actions in your base. (Not implemented)
[*]Infected – Can bite the player like a zombie, with the same consequences.
[*]Mechanic – Sabotages cars and steals fuel; carries tools and a gas can.
[*]Medic – Heals themselves or allies; carries medical gear. (Not implemented)
[*]Recon – Moves faster than others.
[*]Thief – Specializes in stealing from the player.
[*]Repairman – Carries useful tools and supplies.
[*]Tracker – Tracks the player more easily; carries maps.
[*]Trapper – Plants bear traps. (Not implemented)
[*]Traitor – May pretend to be a friend. (Not implemented)
[*]Sacrificer – Explodes on death. (Not implemented)
[*]Zombiemaster – Attracts zombies to the player. (Not implemented)
[/list]

[h2]Mod integrations[/h2]
The mod comes with several pre-built clans and bandits using vanilla items. However, it also supports external mods that add new weapons and clothing. Just enable the mods, and Bandit Creator will let you use those items.
Note: If you disable those mods later, affected bandits will spawn without their gear. Your configurations will remain intact unless you re-save them.

Here is a nice [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3479480823]set of mod integrations[/url].

[h2] How creations are stored[/h2]
The configuration files of bandit creations (and their clans) consist of two text files (bandits.txt and clans.txt) that are saved on your local computer. 

There are two different storage place types for these files, and you must decide which one to use for every individual bandit profile you create. Understanding this is crucial and while this may look complicated at first, it gives the necessary flexibility.

[h3] Local storage [/h3]
This is a single storage that exists outside of mod folders. Every bandit created in local storage will not be impacted by future mod updates. This is the best storage for players who want to:
[list]
[*]create their bandits for single player games
[*]server admins who want to decide how bandits will look like for every players on that server. 
[/list]
Local files reside in /Zomboid/Lua/bandits folder. 

If you are not a modder you may stop reading here.

[h3] Mod storage [/h3]
This storage ties every bandit creation to a specific mod and puts its configuration files in that mod. You should only tie your creations to a mod that you own. Just like I tied default bandit creations to Bandits mod. If you edit this creations your changes will get overwritten when I update the mod on Steam. So the only situation when you would chose this storage is when you are the mod author who controls the updates. For example:
[list]
[*]You created a weapon or clothing mod and you also want to create some bandits using them. This way if someone uses Bandits and your mod they will get some new fresh bandits using items from your mod. 
[*]You want to create an integration mod that only defines the bandits and sets the dependency to both Bandits mod and the mod providing with the clothing / weaponry.
[/list]
Files reside in /<modid>/common/bandits folder. You will be able to save to a mod only if if these folders exist in the mod folder and bandits.txt and clans.txt empty files are created in there. 

Configuration files from mods and local storage are loaded simultaneously and merged in memory. Local is loaded last. The merging process allows you even to have bandits from the same clan defined in different storages. So you don't need to make clans, you can just expand what there already is. 

[table][tr][td]
[h3]
IMPORTANT: For dedicated servers, you can transfer your bandits to the remote server using the "Bandit Sync" option from context menu if you connect with debug mode.  [/h3]
[/td][/tr][/table]

If you like my work, be sure to give it a [b]LIKE[/b] and

[url=/ko-fi.com/M4M7SGR4P][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/kofi2.png?v=3[/img][/url]

[h3]Credits[/h3]
Ravense - art

Mod ID: BanditsCreator

3470659758.title: The Shortcut [B42]
3470659758.description:
[h2]Compatible with Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3 – 42.20.x SP/MP[/h2]
[h3]Fast shortcuts for items, crafting recipes, and building projects[/h3]

[b]The Shortcut[/b] adds a customizable shortcut bar for [b]items[/b], [b]crafting recipes[/b], and [b]building projects[/b].

Add what you use most, then [b]double-click[/b] to use, craft, or build instantly when requirements are met. You can also [b]right-click[/b] a shortcut to jump directly to the relevant menu with the entry selected.

[b]Requires NeatUI Framework.[/b]
Make sure [b]NeatUI Framework[/b] loads before [b]The Shortcut[/b].

[hr]
[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Default hotkey:[/b] TAB.
[*]Use the hotkey to show or hide the shortcut panel.
[*]Use the mouse wheel over the panel to switch pages.
[*]Hotkey, size, layout, position and transparency can be changed from the settings page.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Main Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shortcut pages for [b]items[/b], [b]crafting recipes[/b], and [b]building projects[/b].
[*]Double-click shortcuts for fast actions.
[*]Right-click shortcuts to open the relevant vanilla menu.
[*]Customizable rows, columns, slot size, transparency, position, and hotkey.
[*]Supports large layouts, up to [b]16x16[/b] slots.
[*]Designed for the Build 42 crafting and building systems.
[*]Build 42.20+ config migration to [b]ShortcutConfig.txt[/b].
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Item Page[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SJmEFGV.png[/img]

Drag items from your inventory into shortcut slots.

[list]
[*][b]Double Click[/b] — quickly perform supported actions, such as drinking, eating, smoking, or reading.
[*][b]Right Click[/b] — open the item’s context menu.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sJBa4f3.png[/img]

[hr]
[h2]Crafting Page[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KYrO6mj.png[/img]

In the crafting interface, press the [b]+[/b] button to add recipes to shortcut slots.
[list]
[*][b]Double Click[/b] — craft immediately if requirements are met.
[*][b]Green checkmark[/b] — the recipe can currently be crafted.
[*][b]Right Click[/b] — open the crafting panel and select the recipe.
[*][b]Mouse over[/b] — view basic recipe information.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Building Page[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DtPjkGv.png[/img]

In the building interface, press the [b]+[/b] button to add building projects to shortcut slots.
[list]
[*][b]Double Click[/b] — start building if requirements are met.
[*][b]Green checkmark[/b] — the project can currently be built.
[*][b]Red preview[/b] — shown when the project cannot currently be placed or built.
[*][b]Right Click[/b] — open the building panel and select the project.
[*][b]Mouse over[/b] — view basic project information.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Settings[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PZfU7OW.png[/img]

You can customize rows, columns, slot size, widget position, panel transparency, slot transparency, hotkey, and reset settings.

[h3]Build 42.20+ config note[/h3]
Starting with [b]version 1.2.7[/b], The Shortcut saves settings to:
[b]ShortcutConfig.txt[/b]

Older versions used:
[b]ShortcutConfig.lua[/b]

Old Lua config files are still read for migration, but TXT is now the current save file.

[hr]
[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2]
If settings do not save, slots reset, the panel returns to its default position, or only default slots appear, try this with [b]Project Zomboid closed[/b]:
[list]
[*]Unsubscribe from [b]The Shortcut[/b].
[*]Wait until Steam fully removes the old Workshop download.
[*]Subscribe again.
[*]Verify game files in Steam:
[b]Project Zomboid > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files[/b]
[/list]

Then reset the config files in:

[b]C:\Users<YourUser>\Zomboid\Lua[/b]
[list]
[*]Current file: [b]ShortcutConfig.txt[/b]
[*]Old file, if present: [b]ShortcutConfig.lua[/b]
[/list]

You can back up and delete both files to fully reset settings.

If the issue continues, test a new save with only [b]NeatUI Framework[/b] + [b]The Shortcut[/b]. If it works there, add other mods back in small groups.

Detailed bug reports should go here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3470659758/595147245062547525/][b]Bug Report[/b][/url]

Please include PZ build, mod version, SP/MP mode, OS, console errors, mod list/load order, and reproduction steps.

[hr]
[h2]Compatibility Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Build 42.12.3 – 42.20.x[/b].
[*]Requires [b]NeatUI Framework[/b].
[*]Make sure [b]NeatUI Framework[/b] loads before [b]The Shortcut[/b].
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer host testing.
[*]Does not add items, recipes, traits, map content, or permanent world data.
[/list]

Possible conflicts are more likely with mods that heavily modify crafting, building, inventory, or UI systems.

[h3]Vanilla moodles[/h3]
Hiding the vanilla moodles on the right side is not a feature of The Shortcut. You can do that with [b]Modern Status[/b]. The Shortcut and Modern Status are compatible.

[hr]
[h2]Performance / Gamepad Notes[/h2]
Very large layouts, such as [b]16x16[/b], may have some FPS impact. If needed, use fewer slots or a smaller layout.

Gamepad support is not currently implemented. The mod is mainly designed for mouse and keyboard.

[hr]
[h2]More Mods & Support[/h2]
If you enjoy this mod and your circumstances allow, it would be amazing if you could buy the original author a cup of coffee — but first and foremost, enjoy your game!
[url=https://afdian.com/a/23754956rocco][img]https://i.imgur.com/WLIHcQs.jpeg[/img][/url]

[hr]
[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*]Original mod by [b]Rocco[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199485575276/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[*]Maintenance and compatibility updates for newer B42 builds by [b]Afyrmo[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[/list]

3475536311.title: [B42MP] Lawn Care: Scythe & Rake
3475536311.description:
[h1]Don't forget to rate my mod if you enjoy it. Thank you![/h1]

[h2]Description[/h2]
Tired of pulling grass by hand just to get a nice lawn?
And you don’t want to turn your garden into an ugly patch of dirt?
Thanks to this mod, you can finally mow your lawn properly with a scythe, bring back its former beauty, and even sow new grass!

[h2]How does it work?[/h2][list]
[*] A new option, "Mow the lawn", appears in the Gardening context sub menu when you have a scythe in your inventory. You can also scythe dead crops along Knox County. The scythe’s regular behavior remains unchanged: you can still create farmland but the option is named now "Uproot grass" (tell me if you have a better idea).
[*] Use the rotate key to change the cursor size: 3x3, 2x2, or 1x1 (just like with regular scythe use, in case you didn’t know).
[*] The time required depends on the number of grass tufts to cut.
[*] Also works with the hand scythe, but the cursor size is limited to 1x1 (still way faster than doing it all by hand).
[*] Clearing grass has a chance to yield [b]Grass Seeds[/b].
[*] You can sow [b]5 Grass Seeds[/b] on dirt (include player placed dirt using a dirt bag) to let fresh grass grow over time. Grass growth speed is tied to the vanilla sandbox option: [i]Livestock -> Grass Regrowth Time[/i] (default: 240 hours).
[*] A new option, "Rake Leaves", lets you collect fallen leaves with a rake.
[*] Fallen leaves can be used to light a fire (or feed one, though they won’t burn for long) or added to a compost bin.
[*] You can now cut down certain bushes that cannot be cut down in vanilla.
[/list]

[h2]Limitations[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Grass Regrowth:[/b] Sowing grass seeds relies on the game's native grass regrowth system. Due to how vanilla engine handles ground updates, you need to leave the area (unload the chunk) and come back later to see the visual change once the grass has regrown.
[/list]

[h2]Planned features[/h2][list]
[*] Add the ability to place fallen leaves on the ground in the world.
[/list]

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[b]Code & Design:[/b] Amenophis
[b]Workshop Thumbnail:[/b] Amenophis

[hr][/hr]
Restore your garden’s glory without breaking your back.
A small, simple, practical, and realistic mod — for everyone who loves a nice yard, even during the apocalypse.
[hr][/hr]

3478922403.title: More Packing[SP/MP][42.20]
3478922403.description:
[h1]No need to worry about 12 per stack or 100 per box—your can start packing at just 2 items.[/h1]
[h1]Unpacking doesn't return everything at once. You can take exactly what you need, and the rest stays safely in the parcel.[/h1]
[h1]The parcel weight reduction rate is adjustable in the Sandbox Options.[/h1]
[h1]Directly compatible with items from any mod.[/h1]
[h1]Doesn't clutter your game with a bunch of extra boxed and crated item scripts.[/h1]

Using this mod can significantly save a large amount of memory (reducing memory usage by 50%–80%, depending on the complexity of the item data) and cut down item lookup time. The more items are packed, the more noticeable the improvement.

Feature:
Pack items that share the same Script ID​ into a parcel. (The parcel appears as a sealed carton box in-game).
Unpack a parcel to retrieve all the original items.
Alternatively, you can withdraw items directly from a parcel in quantities of 1, 5, or 10.
Multiple parcels containing the same script ID of items can be merged into a single, larger parcel.


Notice:
Each parcel weighs 90% less​ than its contents, with a maximum weight of 30 kg. This allows you to bundle items weighing up to 300 kg. （can be modified in sanbox)
Backpacks expanded using modded tools might not be packable or may lose their expanded capacity after being unpacked.
Packing water container items is currently bugged; a fix will be attempted later.


About the "extension" mod:

6.1This is an optional add-on module that requires the main Parcel Packing Mod.
When enabled, you can find mystery parcels containing random loot.
These parcels can spawn in the world or be dropped by corpses.

6.2 Acquire a packing cardboard
Put anything inside and  packing items inside this cardboard



[h1] MP mode OK! [/h1]

[h1] Special Notes When using this mod to pack items from other mods, please note: [/h1]
[list]
[]​ If you uninstall other mods midway, the corresponding parcel will not disappear, but may exhibit unknown anomalies. [/]
[]​ Please regularly check the update logs​ of other mods. If the corresponding items are removed in updates, the aforementioned situation may also occur. [/]

3480305875.title: Quality of Life Modpack
3480305875.description:
[img]https://imgur.com/BaUyxax.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
This is a personal quality-of-life modpack: a collection of small, targeted tweaks that make everyday gameplay smoother without changing the core experience.

This is a [b]modpack[/b].
Please [b]do not use other mods that overlap with features already included here[/b].
Most error reports I receive are caused by duplicate or overlapping mods being used alongside this pack.
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[b]TwisTonFire QoL Modpack[/b]

Choose a version below to view its complete feature overview:
[quote]
[h2]Standard Edition[/h2]

[url=https://mytwist.de/mods/QoL_Features.html][img]https://i.ibb.co/R4YyX5cQ/qol-button-small2.png[/img][/url]
[/quote]
[quote]
[h2]Rat Race Edition[/h2]

[url=https://mytwist.de/mods/QoL_Rat_Race_Features.html][img]https://i.ibb.co/wr49G46D/rat-race-banner.png[/img][/url]
[/quote]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
This pack is designed to work smoothly alongside most mods and to avoid unnecessary overlap wherever possible.

If certain inventory-related mods are detected, overlapping features from this pack will automatically stay disabled and be hidden from Mod Options.
This includes features such as the inventory name header, container reordering, and inventory icon scaling.

[b]Important:[/b] if you are using mods that override the inventory UI, then my inventory changes are [b]supposed[/b] to not load or appear.
That is intentional behavior, not a bug.
The goal is to prevent conflicts, broken layouts, and useless settings in Mod Options.

Known examples include [b]CleanUI[/b], [b]Reorder Containers[/b], and [b]Better Containers[/b].

Some settings are also intentionally limited to [b]singleplayer[/b]. In multiplayer, options that have no real effect are hidden automatically, so you only see settings that are relevant to your current environment.

Previously saved values are preserved. If you return to a compatible setup later, your earlier settings will still be there.
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[quote]
[b]My main Project Zomboid philosophy is to keep the game as original and authentic as possible.
That said, I do want to improve small details where it makes sense.[/b]

I do not intend to change the fundamental nature of Project Zomboid or turn it into something completely different from what the developers created.

As mentioned, this is a Quality of Life modpack.
It supports the vanilla game instead of completely changing it.
It is meant to make everyday gameplay and usability feel smoother, while still staying true to the original Project Zomboid experience.
[/quote]

3480990544.title: Constown (B42)
3480990544.description:
[h1] Constown, KY [/h1]

This mod adds the town of Constown to the standard map.

This is a small town in Knox County, the center of which is pierced by a four-lane highway, which is the main source of income for local residents. Any traveler passing through the town can stay at our wonderful "Summer tree" motel. And if your car suddenly breaks down, there are two auto repair shops along the highway where you can inexpensively repair your vehicle.

Unfortunately, time makes its own adjustments and small businesses are unable to compete with large entrepreneurs. Therefore, in Constown you can find restaurants and shops that have recently been the pearls of the city, closed forever.

But despite the fact that now is not the most favorable period, Constown is a town where you want to stay.

[h2] The town is divided into 4 areas: [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Commercial area along the highway.
    [*]Residences divided into new houses of the same type and the old private sector.
    [*]Trailer park.
    [*]Farms.
[/list]

[h2] Town Location: [/h2]

Constown is located west of Rosewood on the main highway.

[h2] Description: [/h2]

When I created this map, my goal was to make a town that would not stray from the style of vanilla towns.
Each building was created by me personally, but with an eye on existing buildings in the game, so that the feeling of the integrity of the map is not lost. Some shops and restaurants have already been found in the game, while others were invented by me and this is my special pride.

In Constown you will find unique elements of furniture, interior decor and simply elements of everyday life that you will not find in any other town in Knox County! And also on the walls you will find paintings by local artist Konstantin Ananas.

3486968089.title: Aging Mod
3486968089.description:
PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
This mod aims to give the player more immersion by introducing aging that eventually leads to death. The game will then have an ultimate goal: to live long enough to die of old age. The mid-term goal is for aging to affect the character’s abilities due to the frailties of age, ultimately leading to death. In this scenario, you won’t just be fighting zombies, but also time itself.

So far, the features that should be implemented are:

Implemented features:

1- Character aesthetic changes (hair color).
2- Random death by old age between 70 and 100 years old.
3- Character age displayed when pressing "U" (Configurable in options).
4- Age options configurable from the options menu.
5- Configurable year duration (No, you don't have to play a real year if you don't want to, but you can).
6- Higher chance of getting sick and experiencing negative effects at an advanced age.
7- Greater loss of physical condition at an advanced age (you'll still be strong if you train, but you'll lose condition faster, which will lead to having to train more often).
8- Add the option in the configuration menu to disable all negative effects and keep only the aesthetic part, or vice-versa.
9- Include effects for ages 80 and 90 that make these stages more challenging.
10- Create 3 difficulty levels for negative effects and allow their intensity to be configured from the mod's configuration menu.

Single-player only for now.

The mod is ready and it's what I wanted, but if you have any suggestions, I'm open to all of them in the comments.
If you find a bug, please give me all the details you can in the comments and I'll try to fix it as soon as possible.

Thank you!

3487312010.title: Easy Distributions API
3487312010.description:
A library to simplify loot distribution for modders by allowing a new item to copy an existing item's loot probabilities.

[h2]For non-modders:[/h2]

Install this mod if it is a requirement for another mod you want.  This mod can be added and removed freely, but the mods that depend on this may not be so easy-going.

[h2]For Modders:[/h2]

[h3]Enabling the Library[/h3]

Just add the following require line to a lua file in your mod's /media/lua/server folder, then place any calls to library below that so they execute as the .lua file is loaded.

[code]local easyDistroLibrary = require("EasyDistro")[/code]

In your mod.info file add [b]require=\NepEasyDistro[/b] and add the library as a requirement on Steam to make it easier for users to download.

[h3]Adding Items[/h3]

To copy the loot distribution of an existing item call [b]EasyDistro.Add[/b] with the identifier of your new item and the identifier of the item you want to copy. For example, if you create a new type of handgun and want it to show up everywhere the standard 9mm pistol shows up:

[code]easyDistroLibrary.AddItem("Base.MyNewGun","Base.Pistol")[/code]

The [b]Add[/b] function supports an optional third parameter that will multiply the new items probability. For example, to add a purple pen that appear with 25% of the probability of a green pen:

[code]easyDistroLibrary.AddItem("Base.MyPurplePen", "Base.GreenPen", 0.25)[/code]



That's it.  Everything else is optional.


[h3]Enabling verbose mode[/h3]

To aid troubleshooting, you can call [b]EnableVerbose()[/b] which will list every entry as they are found, and again as they are added to the loot table.  Please don't leave this enabled in your mod when publishing, because it will affect all mods using this library and result in log file spam for all users!

[h3]Force Updating the Item picker[/h3]

If for some reason you update the loot tables after the ItemPicker has already initialized, [b]UpdateItemPicker()[/b]  will force the ItemPicker to re-read the ProceduralDistributions table.  This isn't needed if you call [b]AddItem()[/b] as described above, but it you call it later for some reason this allows your changes to take effect.


[url=https://github.com/DrStalker/Zomboid-EasyDistributions/]Github Link[/url]

3490188370.title: Project Cook [B42]
3490188370.description:
[h2]Compatible with Project Zomboid Build 42.10–42.20.4 — SP / MP[/h2]
[b]Project Cook[/b] adds a dedicated cooking interface while keeping the underlying cooking rules as close to vanilla as possible.

Its main focus is [b]Base Cooking[/b]: evolved recipes where you start with a base item and add compatible ingredients or seasonings — soups, stews, salads, stir-fries, burgers, sandwiches, pasta-style meals, and more.

Project Cook helps you choose valid base items, browse nearby food, queue additions, manage portions, inspect cooking/nutrition information, and control nearby cookers through a cleaner UI.

[hr]
[h2]Required Mod & Load Order[/h2]
[b]Project Cook requires [B42] NeatUI Framework.[/b]
[list]
[*][b][B42] NeatUI Framework[/b]
[*][b]Project Cook[/b]
[*][b]Project Cook Pixel Icon Pack[/b] — optional
[/list]

The Pixel Icon Pack only replaces some Project Cook icons. If enabled, load it [b]after Project Cook[/b] and restart the game after changing icon packs.

[hr]
[h2]Base Cooking[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BEiM234.png[/img]

Use this tab for vanilla-style evolved-recipe cooking.
[list]
[*]choose or automatically detect a valid base item
[*]browse ingredients and seasonings from your inventory and nearby containers
[*]double-click an ingredient or use [b]+[/b] to queue several additions
[*]right-click ingredient stacks to choose a specific item
[*]fill supported containers from nearby water sources
[*]empty supported recipe containers and recover the empty container
[*]rename finished foods
[*]view recipe rating information when available
[/list]

Project Cook follows vanilla evolved-recipe rules for ingredient use, Cooking-skill modifiers, frozen/burnt/rotten food, seasoning limits, and maximum ingredient counts.

[h3]State-aware ingredients[/h3]
Foods of the same type are separated when their state matters:
[list]
[*]Fresh / Stale / Rotten
[*]Raw / Cooked / Burnt
[*]Frozen / Thawed
[/list]

This helps prevent raw and cooked versions of the same ingredient from being mixed in salads, sandwiches, and similar foods.

If an item is fully consumed, queued additions can continue with another matching item instead of aborting the remaining queue.

[h3]Full & Partial Portions[/h3]
Project Cook distinguishes ingredients that can still provide a [b]full portion[/b] for the current recipe from leftovers that can only provide a [b]partial portion[/b].

Portion policies:
[list]
[*][b]Full portions only[/b]
[*][b]Full portions first[/b]
[*][b]Partial portions first[/b]
[/list]

Ingredient amount filters:
[list]
[*]All items
[*]Intact items only
[*]Items with at least one full portion
[*]Items with only partial portions
[/list]

The [b]+[/b] limit reflects what can actually be added with the current settings.

[h2]Ingredients, Filters & Sorting[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/woYddll.png[/img]

Ingredients and seasonings are handled separately. Right-click the visibility control for filters such as Frozen, Stale, Rotten, Burnt, and compatible but currently unavailable items.

Sorting includes Hunger, Thirst, Boredom, Unhappiness, Weight, and nutrition values when the character is allowed to know them.

Ingredient-group data is cached, so changing filters, sort modes, or most settings does not require repeatedly rescanning nearby containers.

[h2]Nutrition[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Cooking 2:[/b] categories become readable
[*][b]Cooking 4:[/b] rough values
[*][b]Cooking 6:[/b] closer estimates
[*][b]Cooking 8:[/b] exact values
[*][b]Nutritionist:[/b] full nutrition details and nutrition sorting
[/list]

[h2]Project Cook Settings[/h2]
Project Cook includes a movable settings window with persistent local configuration.
[list]
[*]window background opacity
[*]inner-panel opacity
[*]slot opacity
[*]title-bar height
[*]title-bar position — Top / Bottom
[*]independent Pinned / Auto-collapse behavior for the main window and Settings
[/list]

[h2]Cooker — WIP[/h2]
The Cooker tab can manage nearby ovens, microwaves, gas/charcoal barbecues, fireplaces, campfires, and other supported cookers.

Depending on the cooker, you may be able to turn it on/off, adjust supported settings, add fuel, insert/remove propane tanks, move food into the cooker, return food to its previous container, and browse nearby food through [b]All Containers[/b].

This tab is usable but still being improved. You can always use the normal inventory/loot interface instead.

[h2]Cooking By Recipes — WIP[/h2]

This tab is for normal crafting-style cooking recipes.

Some cooking actions belong to Project Zomboid's regular Crafting system rather than evolved recipes. For those, you can also use vanilla Crafting or [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3502080466]Neat Crafting[/url][/b], then continue in Base Cooking if the result supports evolved-recipe ingredients.

[h2]What's New in 1.4.0[/h2]
[list]
[*]state-aware ingredient grouping
[*]reworked multi-item ingredient queues
[*]Full / Partial Portion controls and amount filters
[*]advanced visibility filters and improved sorting
[*]Project Cook Settings with opacity, auto-collapse, and title-bar customization
[*]full UI translation audit
[*]localization expanded to all normal B42.20.4 languages used by Project Zomboid
[*]correct legacy translation formats/encodings; B42.15+ uses JSON translations only
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Project Cook mainly uses vanilla cooking, crafting, inventory, and evolved-recipe systems.

Mods that register ingredients through vanilla evolved recipes should normally be detected automatically. Mods that add normal craft recipes can work alongside Project Cook, but those recipes may belong in Crafting / Cooking By Recipes instead of Base Cooking.

For compatibility reports, please provide the exact mod/fork and Workshop ID.

[h2]Guide, Help & Feedback[/h2]
Detailed instructions, controls, nutrition information, Cooker help, MP notes, and FAQ:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3490188370/581680031271614391/][b]Project Cook Guide & FAQ[/b][/url]

Questions, crashes, errors, performance problems, MP issues, compatibility reports, and troubleshooting:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3490188370/581680031271586842/][b]Questions, Troubleshooting & Bug Reports[/b][/url]

Suggestions and feature requests:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3490188370/588433527532517028/][b]Suggestions[/b][/url]

When reporting a problem, please include your exact PZ version, Project Cook version, SP / MP Host / dedicated server, mod list/load order, reproduction steps, and relevant logs.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*]Original mod by [b]Rocco[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199485575276/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]Workshop Items[/url]
[*]Maintenance / Build 42 compatibility by [b]Afyrmo[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]Workshop Items[/url]
[*]Pixel icon inspiration and assets by [b]ivmakk[/b]
[/list]

[h2]More Mods & Support[/h2]
If you enjoy the mod and your circumstances allow, buying me a coffee is appreciated — but most importantly, enjoy your game!

3494474677.title: [B42] More Item Information
3494474677.description:
Provides additional useful information in the tooltip for a variety of items.

Some items such as food will have the amount of information shown be tied to a relevant skill, such as cooking. This can be disabled in the sandbox settings.

All types of information can be toggled on or off in the mod options if there is something that you don't want to see.

This mod is work in progress. If you have suggestions for more information that could be shown on items or have noticed any bugs then please comment it!

[h3][b]Liquids[/b][/h3]
Can see the hunger satiation and calories of edible fluids such as milk or soda. If the player has the nutritionist trait they can also see the additional nutritional information.

[h3][b]Food[/b][/h3]
[b]Cooking 1:[/b] Shows number of days until the food rots.
[b]Cooking 2:[/b] Shows number of days until the food gets stale.
[b]Cooking 3:[/b] Shows more precise amount of time until the food rots.
[b]Cooking 4:[/b] Shows more precise amount of time until the food gets stale and shows the rough amount of calories the food has, to the nearest 100.

This mod add semi-real time decay updates to cars in the world without demand for heavy resources

3495788089.title: Auto Smash, Clear & Jump through windows
3495788089.description:
[h1]ALPHA TESTERS wanted![/h1]
[b]A new sorting mod, successor of Better Sorting and Core Categories[/b] is under development. if you would like to take part in the testing phase, please register at [url=https://forms.gle/rmHeBbdkvXT6SYcc8]this form[/url], Testing starts 7th January.

[h1]Auto Smash & Climb[/h1]

[b][i]Horde's coming. Window's jammed. What do you do?[/i][/b]

You break it. You clean it. You YEET through it.
But ain't nobody got time and nerve to do it [i]manually[/i].

With this mod, you get a [b]1-click option in the context menu[/b] that automatically makes your survivor:

[b]0. Walk up to the window[/b]

[b]1. Smash the window glass[/b]

[b]2. Remove the broken glass shards[/b]

[b]3. Immediately jump through[/b] — no questions asked, just pure action.

The entire sequence gets executed smoothly, just like any survivor with 2 neurons and a panic debuff would do IRL.
[b]No more fiddling with clunky right-click menus under pressure.[/b] Now you just click once and GO.
[i]Efficiency is survival.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Setup[/h2]

[b]No mod configuration needed[/b] — works out of the box

[hr][/hr]
[h2]How To Use[/h2]

Right-click on to any [b]closed window[/b]

Choose [b]“Smash, clear and climb”[/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Compatibility[/h2]

[b]Does NOT override vanilla scripts, so compatibility should be top notch, no problem with (un)installing it mid-save.[/b]

This mod has been created for [b]Build 42 single player[/b], it [u]might work in Build 41 (mulitplayer)[/u] although I've not tested the mod in this mode. Please send your feedback.

If you find a mod that breaks it, [b]let me know and I’ll throw a wrench at it[/b].

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Planned Features / Wishlist[/h2]

Currently no plans for expansion, but hey:

Would you like the survivor to scream [b]“GERONIMOO”[/b] when jumping?

Your feedback could make it happen ?

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Translations[/h2]

Currently available in:

[b]English[/b]

[b]Polish[/b] (myself)

[b]Russian[/b] by [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198810145584]Slobodskoy[/url][/b]

[b]Simplified Chinese[/b] by [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/takami_chika/]?????[/url][/b]

[b]Brazilian Portugese[/b] by [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/asmdf]Alexandre[/url][/b]

Want to contribute your language? Hit me up and I’ll include it in the next update!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[strike]The character may choose to walk up to the window from the opposite side (they'll do everything to get there, including jumping from 3rd floor!), it may happen when you're as close to the window as to have game decide that the tile closest to your position is on the opposite side of the window. Happened to me once. Please be wary of that.[/strike]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Feedback & Support[/h2]

This mod was created in a few hours and the code is quasi-reliable so to speak, with that in mind, I've named this initial version of the mod as alpha. Please make sure to report any issues you may come across. Fingers crossed you won't!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vo2KAEk.png[/img]
Hovering over the mannequin now shows a tooltip with the character's health status.

[h3][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/h3]
Moving and customization have been disabled and the position is now fixed, so please don't send complaints about it to the mod author.

[h1][b]Compatibility[/b][/h1]
Supports the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3389003300]Moodle Descriptions Expanded[/url] mod:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/q17a1Uj.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tZ9ZNM4.png[/img]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3397396843]Knox Event Expanded NPC[/url] (partly) — The icons overlap some of the group control buttons, but there is no direct incompatibility.

[h1][b]F.A.Q[/b][/h1]

No.

Comments are not a bug tracker, and reports there are ignored and/or deleted. Open an issue on GitHub instead:

[url=https://github.com/DeadEnvoy/SurvivalHUD/issues][img]https://i.imgur.com/9E2FeVU.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Donations[/b][/h1]
If you want to see updates and new mods come out faster, or just want to say thanks, you can support me via Tribute ([url=https://web.tribute.tg/d/KU3]https://web.tribute.tg/d/KU3[/url]):

3498294068.title: Blacklist & Proximity Inventory
3498294068.description:
[img]https://imgur.com/BaUyxax.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[b]This workshop entry contains TWO separate mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]TwisTonFire - Blacklist[/b] — hide unwanted loot items in containers
[*][b]TwisTonFire - Proximity Inventory[/b] — shared looting from nearby containers
[/list]

[b]Each mod works completely standalone.[/b]
Use only Blacklist, only Proximity Inventory, or both together — they are designed to complement each other.

[b]CleanUI:[/b] No known incompatibilities.

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h1]TwisTonFire - Blacklist[/h1]
Tired of seeing (and accidentally looting) junk you’ll never use?
With [b]TwisTonFire - Blacklist[/b], you can hide any item you don’t want to deal with in loot containers.
Keep looting fast, clean, and focused on what actually matters.

[h1]Blacklist Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Hide unwanted items:[/b] Blacklist anything you don’t want to pick up.
[*][b]Beginner-friendly UI:[/b] Manage your blacklist in a clear interface. Add/remove items anytime.
[*][b]Presets system:[/b] Save multiple blacklist setups for different playstyles.
[*][b]Search and filter:[/b] Quickly find specific entries in your blacklist.
[*][b]Multi-select tools:[/b] Select and edit multiple items at once.
[*][b]Quick enable/disable:[/b] Turn filtering on or off instantly.
[*][b]Transfer actions ignore blacklisted items:[/b] Optional setting so transfer handlers skip blacklisted items.
[*][b]Damaged clothing only:[/b] Optional filter to blacklist [b]damaged clothing only[/b].
[*][b]Corpse-only mode:[/b] Optional mode to apply the blacklist to [b]corpse inventories only[/b].
[*][b]Hotkeys (customizable):[/b]
[list]
[*]Open the blacklist menu: [b]KP_2 (Numpad 2)[/b] by default
[*]Global toggle on/off: [b]KP_5 (Numpad 5)[/b] by default
[/list]
[/list]

[b][i]Stay organized. Save time. Enjoy cleaner looting with TwisTonFire - Blacklist.[/i][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[quote]
[b]Your Blacklist Modoptions:[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/cuz7NZk.png[/img]
MAINMENU -> OPTIONS -> MODOPTIONS
[/quote]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h1]TwisTonFire - Proximity Inventory[/h1]

Loot faster by combining nearby containers into a single shared “proximity” view.
Perfect for quick scavenging runs, while still being fully optional and easy to control when you want to sort or organize items more carefully.

[b]⚠️ Heads-up:[/b]
If you are doing bigger storage or sorting sessions, you can now [b]SNAP[/b] or [b]UNSNAP[/b] the shared inventory much more easily.

[list]
[*]Right-click the Proximity Inventory icon (my head) to [b]Snap / Unsnap[/b] the shared inventory whenever you want.
[*]This makes moving items into specific containers much smoother and more predictable.
[*]You can still toggle Proximity Inventory completely with [b]KP_1 (Numpad 1)[/b] by default. The keybind is customizable.
[/list]

[b]Force Selected Mode behavior:[/b]
[b]Force Selected Mode is ON by default[/b] to keep looting fast and consistent.
If you want more manual control while organizing, you can simply use the [b]Snap / Unsnap[/b] option.
You can also still unlock it by switching to another nearby container.
[i]Hint: Clicking a world container such as a fridge or furniture will also let you change focus.[/i]

[h1]Proximity Inventory Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Shared proximity looting:[/b] Access nearby containers through one combined view.
[*][b]Highlight / outlines:[/b] Optional outlines for bodies and containers for easier scanning.
[*][b]Force Selected Mode:[/b] Keeps looting fast and focused by default.
[*]Added a proper [b]Snap / Unsnap[/b] toggle directly on the Proximity Inventory icon.
[*][b]Better for organizing:[/b] Sorting and transferring items into specific containers now feels much smoother.
[*]Custom shared inventory names are remembered between sessions.
[*][b]Pinned Items:[/b] Pin item types in shared inventories and keep them shown first when sorting by name or category.
[*][b]Pinned Items are saved locally[/b] and persist between sessions.
[*][b]NEW - Smart Deposit:[/b] Items moved into the shared Proximity Inventory are now automatically sorted into nearby valid containers.
[*][b]NEW - Sort All Into Containers:[/b] When the shared inventory is selected as your target container, the Player Inventory [b]Transfer All[/b] button changes into [b]Sort All Into Containers[/b].
[*][b]Safe fallback:[/b] If no suitable nearby container is found, items are placed on the floor instead of being rejected.
[*][b]Logical sorting:[/b] Smart Deposit prefers containers that already contain the same item type, then falls back to matching item categories.
[*][b]Protected items stay safe:[/b] Favorite, equipped, hotbar, and protected inventory items are not automatically moved.
[*][b]Corpse inventories are ignored[/b] by Smart Deposit and Sort All logic.
[*][b]Hotkeys customizable:[/b]
[list]
[*]Toggle Proximity Inventory: [b]KP_1 (Numpad 1)[/b] by default
[*]Snap / Unsnap can also be assigned to its own shortcut
[/list]
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h1]Current Translations[/h1]
[list]
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Spanish
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Turkish

3498347699.title: Somewhat Traits
3498347699.description:
[h1]Adds 16 positive, 16 negative and expands 14 vanilla traits[/h1]
(and optional "bonus to skill" traits module)
The information below is for the most recent version of the game, older versions might slightly differ.

[h3]This is Multiplayer focused mod. Though it should work fine overall in Single Player[/h3]
It targets hardcore setting: high pop, tough zombies, sprinters, pinpoint. Please report bugs in discussion thread which corresponds to the version used

[h3]About the traits which affect character stats[/h3]
[list]
[*]The positive traits have very subtle effects, stacking is helpful but won't be game changing
[*]The negative traits on the other hand hit pretty hard as soon as player meets the conditions and some go away as soon as those are no longer met
[*]While positive traits won't counter the effects of negative traits while those are active, they will help with the aftereffects and the amount of character maintenance in general
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]MODULES[/h1]
[h3]Somewhat Traits[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adds traits with special mechanics, includes traits like "Dexterous" which make corresponding timed actions twice faster
[*]Removes the restriction of First Aid actions on other players from "Fear of Blood"
[*]Removes the fatigue increase from small amounts of alcohol (i.e. a bottle of beer)
[*]Adds a small chance to trip when running while being very drunk which grows with exhaustion
[*]Frog Companion trait can be expanded with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3582919946]Somewhat Companions[/url] mod
[*]Here you can read all [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3498347699/563626538148338477/]Traits Descriptions[/url] and which vanilla traits were expanded
[/list]
[h3]Somewhat Traits Core[/h3]
[list]
[*]Handles the traits mechanics
[/list]
[h3]Somewhat Traits Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adds +1 to skill traits
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Does not add new professions or change the existing ones (long term compatibility reasons)
[*]Does not add traits which affect interactions/communication between players or the experience gain (apart from "bonus to skill" traits module)
[*]Big thanks to [b]@clementine[/b] for creating pixel art for traits
[*]A group of experienced players was helping with the ideas for the traits
[*]Compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3427091746]Combat Traits[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3685392864]Keen Perception[/url]
[*]Made for [url=https://discord.gg/sunday-drivers]Sunday Drivers[/url] server
[*]Should be compatible with other small trait mods but there might be issues when used with other big trait mods, please do not report bugs related to incompatibility with other trait mods
[*]Can be added to existing save/server
[*]The initial release of this mod took about 80 hours to develop
[/list]

[h3]To Server Owners[/h3]
[list]
[*]This mod avoids [i]sendClientCommand[/i] and doesn't use it for anything meaningful
[*]All stats management is handled entirely by the server
[*]It should have little to no performance impact for both client and server, the load is equally distributed over time instead of running for all players at once
[/list]

A thumbs up helps with the mod's discoverability, thank you if you left one
Check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/somewhatfrog/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]my other mods[/url], maybe you'd like some of them

[code]Modpacking or reuploading is not allowed as long as the original version is present.[/code]

3502080466.title: Neat Crafting [B42]
3502080466.description:
[h2]Build Support: B42.9 to B42.20.x SP/MP — Build 42 only[/h2]

[b]Neat Crafting[/b] replaces the default Build 42 crafting menu with a cleaner, faster, and more compact interface.

It is designed to make recipe browsing easier, with clearer categories, better input/output panels, recipe-chain navigation, improved handling of large modded recipe lists, and a NeatUI-style layout.

[b]Dependency:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3508537032][b]NeatUI Framework[/b][/url] must be enabled and loaded [b]before[/b] Neat Crafting.

[hr]
[h2]Main Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cleaner and more compact crafting window
[*] Improved category list with clearer icons
[*] Better recipe input and output panels
[*] Useful search shortcuts for recipe chains
[*] Better handling of large modded recipe lists
[*] Clearer fluid/container ingredient details
[*] Optional transparent UI styling
[*] SP / MP Host / Dedicated Server support on recent Build 42 versions
[/list]

[h2]Recommended Load Order[/h2]
[list]
[*] NeatUI Framework
[*] Neat Crafting
[*] Neat Crafting addons, if any
[/list]

If NeatUI Framework is missing or loaded after Neat Crafting, the UI may not open correctly.

[h2]Optional Addon[/h2]
If you want recipe XP gain and source mod information in the recipe list, try:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3540503606][b]Neat Crafting & Neat Building – XP & Mod Display[/b][/url]

It adds optional XP lines, XP breakdown formats, source mod lines, and XP/mod filters.

[h2]Build 42 Only[/h2]
If the mod does not appear in your mod list, you are probably running Build 41.

This mod requires [b]Project Zomboid Build 42[/b].

[b]Tested on:[/b] multiple Build 42 versions, including recent [b]42.20.x SP / MP Host / Dedicated[/b] setups.

[hr]
[h2]Better Layout[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wLbT9k9.png[/img]

Neat Crafting redesigns the default crafting panel so important information is easier to spot.
[list]
[*] More visual and recognizable icons
[*] Cleaner recipe list layout
[*] Less unnecessary text in the main panel
[*] Better use of tooltips for long names and descriptions
[*] Moderate transparency for a cleaner NeatUI-style look
[/list]

[h2]Better Categorization[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7cwgO6O.png[/img]

The category list stays compact to save screen space, while detailed category names appear on hover.

For modders:
[list]
[*] Custom category icons can be added in [b]media/ui/CategoryIcon[/b]
[*] A base PSD file is included for convenience
[/list]

[h2]Better Input / Output Panels[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ViQqEoO.png[/img]

The input and output panels are simplified so recipe requirements and results are easier to understand.
[list]
[*] Kept and partially consumed items are marked clearly
[*] Kept items are shown first
[*] Popup item lists help compare available and missing items
[*] Fluid-container inputs now show liquid requirements more clearly
[*] Selected, available, and possible liquids are separated from container/item requirements
[/list]

[h2]Recipe Chain Navigation[/h2]
Neat Crafting includes search shortcuts to help follow recipe chains.

If a recipe requires an item that can also be crafted, use the magnifying glass button to search for recipes that produce it.

Output navigation is also supported:
[list]
[*] Output slots can be selected and highlighted
[*] Possible output items can be shown in a dedicated panel
[*] Output item search can help find recipes that require that output
[/list]

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ieAnMMg.png[/img]

The crafting panel logic has been reworked so it updates only when needed.

This helps reduce unnecessary UI work and can improve responsiveness, especially with large modded recipe lists.

[h2]Gamepad / Controller Support[/h2]
Neat Crafting is currently designed mainly for mouse and keyboard.

Controller support is not fully implemented yet. It may be improved in the future as Build 42 controller support continues to change.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[b]Compatible:[/b]
[list]
[*] Craft and Build Category Translate [B42]
[*] The Shortcut
[/list]

[b]Known incompatible:[/b]
[list]
[*] what can i craft
[*] what can i craft addon
[/list]

Other mods that directly modify the vanilla crafting panel usually should not affect Neat Crafting, but mods that add unusual or broken recipes may still cause issues.

[h2]Multiplayer / Server Saves[/h2]
Build 42 server saves may keep [b]WorldDictionary[/b] references to mods that were previously enabled. If a world was saved with certain mods enabled and they are later removed, that save may fail to load.

[b]Rule of thumb:[/b]
[list]
[*] Neat Crafting can be added to existing saves/servers
[*] If a world/server has used Neat Crafting, avoid removing it unless you have a backup
[*] Always make a full backup before changing the mod list on a save/server you want to keep
[/list]

In single player, removing Neat Crafting is usually safer, but making a backup is still recommended.

[h3]Safe Uninstall Support[/h3]
If an old save/server no longer loads after removing Neat Crafting and shows a missing Neat Crafting / WorldDictionary entry, you may need:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3739088343][b]Neat Crafting – Safe Uninstall Support[/b][/url]

This is a small support mod for saves/servers that removed Neat Crafting. It is not the full crafting UI and should not be enabled together with the main Neat Crafting mod.

[h2]How to Force a Workshop Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Close Project Zomboid completely
[*] Unsubscribe from this mod
[*] Wait until Steam finishes removing it
[*] Subscribe again and wait for the download to finish
[*] Launch the game
[/list]

If something still seems outdated after a Project Zomboid update, you can also verify game files:

[code]Steam Library → right-click Project Zomboid → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity of game files[/code]

[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]
If you find an issue, please report it with:
[list]
[*] Project Zomboid version
[*] SP / MP Host / Dedicated Server
[*] Mod list and load order
[*] Steps to reproduce
[*] Relevant part of [b]console.txt[/b], [b]coop-console.txt[/b], or server log
[*] Screenshot or short video if possible
[/list]

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*] Original mod by [b]Rocco[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199485575276/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[*] Maintenance, compatibility updates, and newer improvements by [b]Afyrmo[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[/list]

This Workshop item is shared with credit to [b]Rocco[/b], the original creator of Neat Crafting.

Mod ID: Neat_Crafting

3508537032.title: NeatUI Framework [B42]
3508537032.description:
[h2]Build Support: B42.0.2 to B42.20.x SP/MP — Build 42 only[/h2]
[b]NeatUI Framework[/b] is a lightweight shared UI framework for [b]Project Zomboid Build 42[/b].

You usually do [b]not[/b] use this mod by itself. Install and enable it when another mod lists [b]NeatUI Framework[/b] as a requirement.

[b]Important:[/b] NeatUI Framework must load [b]before[/b] mods that depend on it.

[hr]
[h2]What Does NeatUI Framework Do?[/h2]
NeatUI provides reusable interface components and compatibility helpers used by other mods.

It includes shared systems for things such as:
[list]
[*]UI elements and widgets
[*]Buttons, scrolling and virtual lists
[*]Layout and positioning helpers
[*]Text rendering and truncation
[*]Reusable styling and visual components
[*]Compatibility helpers for UI changes between Build 42 versions
[*]Performance improvements shared by dependent interfaces
[/list]

[b]NeatUI Framework does not add gameplay features, recipes, items or world objects by itself.[/b]

What you see in-game depends on the mods using the framework.

[h2]Mods Using NeatUI Framework[/h2]
NeatUI is required by several UI-focused mods, including:
[list]
[*][b]CleanUI[/b]
[*][b]Modern Status[/b]
[*][b]Neat Crafting[/b]
[*][b]Neat Building[/b]
[*][b]The Shortcut[/b]
[*][b]Project Cook[/b]
[*][b]Neat Crafting & Neat Building – XP & Mod Display[/b]
[/list]

Other mods may also use NeatUI Framework.

If none of your enabled mods require NeatUI, you normally do not need to enable it.

[h2]Recommended Load Order[/h2]
Load the framework first:

[code]NeatUI Framework
↓
Mods that require NeatUI Framework[/code]

For example:

[code]NeatUI Framework
Neat Crafting
Neat Crafting addons[/code]

or:

[code]NeatUI Framework
Neat Building
Neat Building addons[/code]

Loading a dependent mod before NeatUI can prevent its interface from opening or cause UI errors.

[h2]Multiplayer / Server Setup[/h2]
For MP Host and Dedicated Server, NeatUI Framework must be included in [b]both[/b] server lists.

[u]Mod ID[/u]
[code]NeatUI_Framework[/code]

[u]Workshop ID[/u]
[code]3508537032[/code]

Your server INI should therefore contain something like:

[code]Mods=NeatUI_Framework;DependentMod1;DependentMod2;...
WorkshopItems=3508537032;WorkshopID1;WorkshopID2;...[/code]

[b]Important:[/b] adding `NeatUI_Framework` only to `Mods=` is not enough. Workshop ID [b]3508537032[/b] must also be present in `WorkshopItems=` so the server can download the correct Workshop files.

NeatUI Framework should also appear [b]before its dependent mods[/b] in the `Mods=` load order.

[h3]Server / Client Files Must Match[/h3]
If the server has one version of NeatUI while a client has another, you may see:
[list]
[*]"Client does not have mod" errors
[*]Lua checksum mismatches
[*]Missing-file errors
[*]Dependent UI mods failing to load
[/list]

When troubleshooting MP, always make sure the server and clients have fully updated Workshop copies.

[h2]Build 42 Compatibility[/h2]
NeatUI Framework has been maintained across multiple Build 42 releases and includes compatibility work for newer UI/API changes.

Recent updates include:
[list]
[*]Compatibility helpers for Build 42 UI changes
[*]Linux/case-sensitive path and Lua checksum cleanup
[*]Performance improvements for frequently updated UI elements
[*]Required `media/AnimSets` and `media/actiongroups` directories for newer B42 server scanning
[/list]

[b]Build 41 is not supported.[/b]

If NeatUI does not appear in your mod list, check that you are running Project Zomboid Build 42.

[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2]
If NeatUI or a dependent mod does not work:

[list]
[*]Close Project Zomboid completely
[*]Make sure NeatUI Framework is enabled
[*]Make sure it loads before dependent mods
[*]In MP, check both `Mods=` and `WorkshopItems=`
[*]Make sure server and clients use the same current Workshop files
[*]Verify Project Zomboid files through Steam if needed
[*]Test with NeatUI + the affected dependent mod only
[/list]

If the minimum setup works, add your other mods back in small groups to identify the interaction.

[h3]Clean Workshop Redownload[/h3]
If Steam appears to be using outdated or incomplete files:

[list]
[*]Close Project Zomboid
[*]Unsubscribe from NeatUI Framework
[*]Wait for Steam to finish removing it
[*]If the Workshop folder remains, remove the stale copy:
[/list]

[code]...\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\108600\3508537032[/code]

Then subscribe again and allow Steam to finish downloading before launching Project Zomboid.

For dedicated servers, also make sure SteamCMD / your server host actually downloaded Workshop ID [b]3508537032[/b] and that the server Workshop directory is writable.

[h2]Linux Dedicated Servers / Lua Checksum[/h2]
NeatUI Framework includes path and line-ending cleanup intended to improve compatibility with case-sensitive Linux dedicated servers and Lua checksum validation.

If you encounter a checksum issue, please report it rather than immediately disabling Lua checksum protection.

Useful information includes:
[list]
[*]Server OS / Linux distribution
[*]Project Zomboid version
[*]Enabled NeatUI-dependent mods
[*]Exact checksum or missing-file error
[*]Relevant `Mods=` and `WorkshopItems=` lines
[*]Your `DoLuaChecksum` setting
[/list]

[h2]Removing NeatUI Framework[/h2]
NeatUI Framework itself is a shared UI library and does not add world objects or gameplay content.

However, [b]do not remove NeatUI while mods that require it are still enabled[/b].

Also check the uninstall instructions of each dependent mod separately. Some dependent mods may register their own recipes, entities, XUI/WorldDictionary data or world content and may require special uninstall procedures.

[h2]For Mod Authors[/h2]
If you want to use NeatUI Framework in another mod, please add it as a Workshop dependency rather than repacking its files into your own Workshop item.

Keeping NeatUI as a shared dependency:
[list]
[*]Avoids outdated duplicate framework copies
[*]Reduces server/client version mismatches
[*]Lets compatibility fixes reach all dependent mods
[*]Makes troubleshooting considerably easier
[/list]

Compatibility patches and addons that depend on NeatUI are welcome.

[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]
When reporting an issue, please include:
[list]
[*]Project Zomboid version
[*]SP / MP Host / Dedicated Server
[*]Client and server operating system where relevant
[*]Mod list and load order
[*]Exact steps to reproduce
[*]Relevant `console.txt`, `coop-console.txt` or server log lines
[*]The first relevant ERROR / stack trace
[*]Screenshot or short video for visual issues
[/list]

If the problem only occurs with a particular NeatUI-dependent mod, please mention which one.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*]Original framework by [b]Rocco[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199485575276/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[*]Maintenance, compatibility updates and newer Build 42 support by [b]Afyrmo[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[/list]

Workshop ID: 3508537032
Mod ID: NeatUI_Framework

3508590486.title: Better Jaw Stabs [B42.20.4 SP/MP]
3508590486.description:
[h2]Version 1.5.4 for Build 42.20.4 Stable[/h2]

[i]Note: You don't need manual install anymore! But this mod needs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619862853]ZombieBuddy[/url] to work properly. If you update from an old version, please resubscribe so you get the newest files.[/i]

[h1]BETTER JAW STABS[/h1]

Fighting with short blades in vanilla PZ is very annoying. Jaw stabs (one hit kill) get disabled when more than one zombie is aware of you. Even if they are far away, high zombie awareness can make you unable to do the move.

This mod changes the vanilla jaw stab logic to something you can customize, with tile based awareness check, animation speed based on skill, and some quality of life options. Very recommended for Extinction Mode. Make short blades great again!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Smart Awareness Check[/b]: Jaw stab still works as long as there is not more than 1 aware zombie inside your safe radius (be careful with sprinters!). Default: 3 tiles.
[*][b]Bonus Critical Chance[/b]: Add configurable bonus to your weapon crit chance so jaw stab triggers more often (5–10% feels balanced, not too cheat). Default: 10%.
[*][b]Skill Based Animation Speed[/b]: Jaw stab animation gets faster as your Short Blade skill goes up. Default: 2% faster per level.
[*][b]Prevent Knife Stick[/b]: Option to stop your knife from getting stuck in zombies when you do a jaw stab.
[/list]

You can configure all of these in Sandbox Options.

[h2]REQUIREMENTS[/h2]

[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619862853]ZombieBuddy[/url] (must be installed and enabled)
[/list]

[h2]INSTALLATION[/h2]

[list]
[*]Install Zombie Buddy and do all the steps needed to install it.
[*]Allow this mod in the Zombie Buddy Mod Authorization Panel while the game is booting (hold SHIFT to force open it).
[*]If you can't allow the mod [b](invalid signature)[/b] you need to go to this location: [b]..\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\108600\3508590486\mods\Better Jaw Stabs\42\media\java[/b] and delete [b]BetterJawStabs.jar.zbs[/b].
[*]Enable the mod in Mod Manager.
[*]Exit the game and open it again.
[/list]

[h2]Why does this mod need Zombie Buddy?[/h2]

Better Jaw Stabs changes vanilla combat behavior that is hardcoded in the game and not exposed to Lua. Because of this, the mod cannot be made as a normal Lua mod.

Zombie Buddy patches the game classes needed at runtime, so this mod can replace the vanilla jaw stab logic and still stay compatible when the game updates. It is much easier to maintain this way than changing the game class files directly, especially when Project Zomboid updates its code.

Zombie Buddy only needs to be installed one time. After that, any mod that uses it will work without any extra setup.

[h2]Tested on Build 42.20.4 Stable. Compatible with all other mods.[/h2]
