3520758551.title: More Car Features + Spawn Zones Expansion [B42.20 Stable]
3520758551.description:
Being the 'Common Sense' of vehicles, this mod adds A LOT of Features and QOL/Rebalancing Changes, I urge you to read the full list below! Trust me, you'll be wishing some of these options were in the vanilla game.

[WIP Mod for Multiplayer/Singleplayer B42.20 Stable]. Supports all modded vehicles. Can be added/removed mid-save safely. Almost everything can be selectively disabled/enabled (the important stuff at least), most options are enabled by default.

Climbable Vehicles does not currently work for multiplayer, requires enabling in the sandbox settings, and will be moved to a different mod page when enough vanilla bugs are fixed. I only recommend using it for screenshots as it's very outdated and I cannot, nor will I, confirm if it works since it's basically abandoned, for now. Don't ask about it in the comments either, I'll finish it when I finish it.

If you use any mod that removes/replaces vanilla vehicles for modded, please drop it and use my sandbox setting for compatibility purposes.

LOAD ORDER INSTRUCTION: In general, at the top, but after map mods.

NEW FEATURES:
 - Adds vehicle zones across the entire map (literally thousands) including vehicles in garages, gas station, more traffic in your traffic jams, farms, and more.
 - Adds a new custom vehicle spawn rate, chance to spawn burnt, damaged, and more customization in the sandbox settings.
 - Spawns more corpses in cars, you'll find quite a few here and there on car seats.
 - Some vehicle zone types, like parking lots, can spawn vehicles facing in random directions to simulate the initial waves of chaos of the apocalypse.
 - Improves junkyards and traffic jams by adding back wrecked vehicles, removal of random parts, rebalanced vehicle qualities, and randomly opened doors/windows.
 - Bombs can now trigger car alarms AND be planted on vehicles to explode them (smoke, pipe, aerosol, remote detonators, plant on doors, above wheels, and in the ignition, etc.).
 - A new system for refueling vehicles from pumps at gas stations, which includes, but is not limited to, not needing to stand still for a minute while pumping gasoline, repairing the pump you just ripped out after driving away with it still attached, sounds, fuel station status, etc.
 - Adds the ability to exit from a moving vehicle, but I'd be careful at higher speeds!
 - Weather affects players with an open door, a window open, or a windshield smashed (more detailed than worth explaining).
 - Adds Jackie Jaye's LBMW Radio Van. It will only spawn at her trailer north of the main LV military checkpoint.
 - Adds vehicles hoods, trunks, and trailers as a generic crafting surfaces; for crafting recipes that require a table.
 - Adds a crafting recipe to clone a car key, either as a backup or for a friend. It is very similar to the 'Copy Building Key' recipe and it requires reading the same magazine from it.
 - Adds several scripts for smelting vehicle parts into steel, crafting tires and windows/windshield glass, and repairing tires and mufflers.
 - Adds the ability to open/close and unlock/lock your own door while in a vehicle.
 - Adds the ability to enter/exit some vehicles through the trunk (assume for most heavy-duty vehicles it will work). Only works if you can see the "Trunk" container icon from the seat you're in (usually the rear row). That feature, that is accessing the trunk from the inside if you're in a specific seat, is vanilla and I made this to work based on that.
 - As the driver of a vehicle, you can electronically open/close any window. Press "Z", or enter the Vehicle Seats UI another way, then hold LEFT or RIGHT ALT to see your options. From there, you can either click an individual window or press a number on your keyboard to open the corresponding window.
 - You can now unhotwire (rewire?) hotwired vehicles at level 3 electrical and level 2 mechanics.
 - Adds a TWD reference, a flipped prison bus in Rosewood (if you have the correct KI5 vehicle mod enabled), there's more potential here (WIP).
 - Normal trailers have the ability to add and remove their cover (right-click trailer part in the trailer's mechanics ui).
 - Advert trailers now have trailer storage (access from either open side, still the same storage).
 - Adds extra seating to the back of Pick Up Trucks, great for transporting friends AND corpses, which may be the same thing if they died... (no visible player model is shown, vanilla bug would make it look weird unfortunately).
 - Adds context menu option to cut tire pieces from tire stack world objects, most commonly found at 'Irvington Speedway' as bumper barriers. Supports the vanilla red, white, and black tire stacks.
 - Adds context menu option to take propane from the large world propane tanks, which can be commonly found at newer/updated gas stations and basements in B42.20 stable.

SANDBOX SETTINGS:
 - NO VANILLA VEHICLES option, defaulted to off.
 - General spawn rate defaults to vanilla if no value is entered. Junkyards, traffic jams, and special traffic jams ignore this setting.
 - Spawn rate for traffic jams (otherwise recognized as bumper to bumper traffic) is defaulted to very high, but the vanilla Vehicle Spawn Rate value slightly alters it.
 - The Traffic Jams in LV toggle enables/disables all the new traffic jams I added in LV specifically.
 - The Traffic Jams outside LV toggle enables/disables all the new traffic jams I added everywhere else.
 - Random Vehicle Angles is a toggle for if some specific types of car zones, such as parking lots and ambulances, will be rotated around at random. Basically, it is a slight immersion thing.
 - Corpses Spawning in Vehicles can be set to "None", "Rare", "Normal", and "Common" (default is 'Normal' which is about 8%).
 - Bombs interacting with vehicles can be toggled off/on.
 - The new system for refueling vehicles from pumps at gas stations can be toggled off/on.
 - Weather affects players in vehicles can be toggled off/on.
 - Jumping out of a fast moving vehicle can toggled off/on and the damage received can be reduced/increased.
 - The ability to turn all vehicle zones into burnt wrecks, completely configurable at a set rate.
 - The ability to completely customize the quality of cars you find for all vehicle zones.
 - The ability to prevent 'Good' vehicles from spawning ('Good' vehicles are a VANILLA thing).
 - MIN / MAX propane amounts in industrial propane tanks, it is a multiplier counted in number of propane tanks for easy understanding. Each propane tank is 81 units (propane torches contain 10), so the default maximum would be 170 X 81 = 13770 units of propane (with a minimum of 0).
 - The 'Climbable Vehicles' addon (read at the top of the workshop description for 'use warning').

For more detailed MILITARY VEHICLE ZONES options:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3436499337

Shoutout to KI5's (year accurate / lore friendly) vehicle mods which are primarily supported (but not the only ones) in this mod for balancing and special treatment (I still take suggestions for other vehicles like the W900 trucks mod):
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2490220997
...and if you want corpses to spawn in KI5 vehicles specifically, install this mod and follow THEIR load order instruction which allows me to spawn the corpses on KI5's vehicles' seats.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3457132019

EXTRA SPECIAL SHOUTOUT TO (Alex) @RedChili FOR HELPING ME WITH CLIMBING ANIMATIONS
https://steamcommunity.com/id/mreastman/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600

Mod ID: WayMoreCars

3523472206.title: No more wiggly vehicle
3523472206.description:
[h1]No More Wiggly Vehicle[/h1]

[b]Stop mashing A and D just to drive straight.[/b]
This mod is designed to ease the fatigue of long drives on narrow roads. When your vehicle gets close to one of the 8 cardinal directions, it gently nudges the wheels with physics to keep you going straight.

[h2]How it works[/h2]
[list]
[*] Activates only when you are within a [b]5-degree[/b] margin of one of the 8 cardinal/diagonal directions.
[*] Instantly disengages the moment you touch A or D.
[*] You must keep your hands on the wheel ([b]W[/b]) to align the vehicle.
[/list]

[h2]Mod options[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Cruise control alignment[/b] - keep auto-align active during cruise control, even with hands off W.
[*] [b]Sunday Driver disable[/b] - automatically disables the assist for characters with the Sunday Driver trait, for that authentic struggle.
[*] [b]Alignment force strength[/b] - adjust how snappy or gentle the alignment feels (x0.50 ~ x2.00).
[*] [b]Activation speed[/b] - choose the minimum speed at which the assist kicks in (20 ~ 60 km/h).
[/list]

Tested with 'Realistic Car Physics'.
Safe to add or remove mid-save.
Multiplayer compatible.

[h3]B41 Note[/h3]
For mod options to appear in B41, please subscribe to 'Mod Options (Build 41)'.

[b]Neat Building[/b] replaces the default [b]Build[/b] menu with a cleaner, faster, more compact interface for [b]Project Zomboid Build 42[/b].

[hr]
[h2]Choose the Right Setup[/h2]
This Workshop item includes several variants. Choose carefully, especially for existing saves/servers.
[list]
[*][b]Neat Building[/b] — full version. Includes UI, extra buildables, and railings. Recommended for saves/servers that already used the full variant.
[*][b]Neat Building - UI Only[/b] — UI replacement only. Does not add buildable entities. Can be used together with one modular buildable variant if you want the UI plus selected extra buildables.
[*][b]Neat Building - Buildables - SES Compatibility[/b] — extra buildables without the metal railings that conflict with [b]Stairs East & South[/b]. Use with [b]Neat Building - UI Only[/b] if you also want the Neat Building UI.
[*][b]Neat Building - Railings[/b] — only the separated metal railing buildables. Can be used with [b]Neat Building - UI Only[/b], but do not use with [b]Stairs East & South[/b].
[/list]
[b]Do not enable the full [b]Neat Building[/b] variant together with the modular buildable variants.[/b]

Manual edits to [b]pz_modlist_settings.cfg[/b] or server INI files can still create invalid setups.

[h3]Recommended setups[/h3]
Existing saves/servers that already used full Neat Building:
[list]
[*]NeatUI Framework
[*]Neat Building
[/list]
New saves/servers using [b]Stairs East & South[/b]:
[list]
[*]NeatUI Framework
[*]Stairs East & South
[*]Neat Building - UI Only
[*]Neat Building - Buildables - SES Compatibility
[/list]
New saves/servers without [b]Stairs East & South[/b], using the modular setup:
[list]
[*]NeatUI Framework
[*]Neat Building - UI Only
[*]Neat Building - Buildables - SES Compatibility
[*]Neat Building - Railings
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Existing Saves / Servers / Safe Uninstall[/h2]
Buildable/entity variants add recipes, entities, SpriteConfig data, tiles, and placed world content. [u]Once a save/server has used one of those variants, simply disabling or removing it can break old placed objects.[/u]

This applies to both [b]single-player[/b] and [b]multiplayer[/b].
[list]
[*]Make a [b]backup[/b] before changing variants or removing mods from an existing world.
[*]For active saves/servers, the safest option is usually to keep the same variant enabled.
[*]If you only want the [b]vanilla Build menu[/b] back, do [b]not[/b] remove the mod. Use the UI toggle below.
[*]If you disable/remove a buildable/entity variant from an old save/server, enable the matching Safe Uninstall Support variant before loading that world again.
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3743063232][b]Neat Building – Safe Uninstall Support[/b][/url]

[table]
[tr][th]Used before[/th][th]Use after removing[/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Neat Building[/td][td]Neat Building – Safe Uninstall Support[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Neat Building - Buildables - SES Compatibility[/td][td]Neat Building – Safe Uninstall Support - SES Compatible[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Neat Building - Railings[/td][td]Neat Building – Safe Uninstall Support - Railings[/td][/tr]
[/table]

Safe Uninstall Support is not the full Build menu UI and should not be enabled together with the main Neat Building variants. It may need to stay enabled in old saves/servers because old placed objects can remain in the world.

The [b]UI Only[/b] variant does not add buildable entities and should not normally need Safe Uninstall Support.

[h3]Want the vanilla Build menu without removing the mod?[/h3]
Switch between Neat Building UI and vanilla UI from:
[list]
[*][b]ESC → Options → Mods → Neat Building[/b]
[*][b]Right-click[/b] the vanilla [b]Build[/b] sidebar button
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Main Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cleaner and more compact Build menu
[*]Clearer building categories grouped by type
[*]Better icons where possible
[*]Stacked related recipes, with buildable versions prioritized
[*]Filters: Only Can Build, Only Met Skill Requirements, Only Known Recipes
[*]Optional compact / minimal layout
[*]Transparent recipe info panel for better world visibility
[*]Extra buildable constructions, depending on variant
[*]Persistent vanilla/Neat UI toggle
[/list]

[h2]Optional Addon: XP & Mod Display[/h2]
For build XP gain, source mod information, XP breakdowns, and XP/source-mod filters, use:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3540503606][b]Neat Crafting & Neat Building – XP & Mod Display[/b][/url]

It can add XP gain lines, XP breakdown formats, source mod lines, and XP/mod filters.																					 

[h2]Compatibility Notes[/h2]
[b]Build 42 Only[/b]
[list]
[*]If the mod does not appear in your mod list, you are probably running [b]Build 41[/b].
[*]This mod requires [b]Project Zomboid Build 42[/b].
[*][b]Tested on[/b] multiple B42 versions, including recent [b]42.20.x SP / MP Host / Dedicated[/b] setups.
[/list]

Known conflicts / special cases:
[list]
[*][b][B42] Buildables Expansion[/b]
[*][b]Rebalanced Prop Moving[/b]
[*][b]Stairs East & South[/b] — use the modular SES-compatible setup instead of the full variant.
[/list]

Mods that replace or heavily modify the same Build panel files may also conflict depending on load order, versions, PZ build, and server settings.

[h2]Gamepad Support[/h2]
Neat Building is currently designed mainly for mouse and keyboard. Gamepad / Steam Deck support is not fully implemented yet.

[h2]Update Troubleshooting[/h2]
After major Project Zomboid updates, a clean Workshop redownload can help if files are mismatched:
[list]
[*]Close Project Zomboid completely
[*]Unsubscribe from Neat Building
[*]Wait until Steam finishes uninstalling it
[*]Subscribe again and wait for the download
[*]Verify Project Zomboid files in Steam if needed
[/list]

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*]Original mod by [b]Rocco[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199485575276/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]Rocco's PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[*]Maintenance, compatibility updates, and newer B42 support by [b]Afyrmo[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]Afyrmo's PZ Workshop Items[/url]
[/list]

3538602374.title: Break Big Rocks
3538602374.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hf3579r.png[/img]

[h1]Break Big Rocks – Enhanced Mining & Crafting Update[/h1]

Break massive rocks, gather valuable resources, and experience a deeper and more immersive mining system in Project Zomboid.
Giant Rock Crusher turns heavy tools into true mining equipment, introducing a balanced survival-focused mining loop built around endurance, skill progression, and vanilla-friendly crafting.

[i]Mine smarter, manage your endurance, and build a sustainable resource chain with Break Big Rocks.[/i]

[hr]

[h2]What’s New in the Enhanced Mining & Crafting Update[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reworked mining progression that reduces RNG dependency while preserving survival balance.
[*] Dynamic mining time based on your equipped tool and Strength level.
[*] Mining now consumes physical endurance through the vanilla metabolism system.
[*] Vanilla-style tool durability checks respect each tool's resistance instead of removing condition deterministically.
[*] Strength, Maintenance, and Masonry XP awarded for mining actions.
[*] Custom sounds for a better mining experience.
[*] Expanded mining loot table with rare, sandbox-configurable resources.
[*] New and expanded Sandbox options to fine-tune mining balance and rarity.
[*] Event-driven Blacksmith recipe progression removes recurring player recipe polling and checks only on load or skill advancement.
[*] Optional Sandbox setting lets mining sounds attract nearby zombies; disabled by default.
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]Vanilla Tool Crafting & Progression[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a complete vanilla-friendly crafting loop for mining tools.
[*] Pickaxes can now be assembled using existing vanilla parts (Pickaxe Head + Handle).
[*] Pickaxe heads can be forged through Primitive Forge systems.
[*] No new items, models, or animations added — fully compatible with vanilla gameplay.
[*] No books required: progression is driven by skills, materials, and effort.
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]Carving & Emergency Mining[/h2]

[list]
[*] Carving tools (Stone Chisel, Metalworking Chisel, Stone Drill) can be used for limited mining.
[*] Carving tools require a hammer or striking tool to function.
[*] Limited mining allows extraction of small stone materials only.
[*] Large boulders cannot be fully destroyed without proper heavy tools.
[*] This provides an early-game fallback when heavy mining tools are unavailable.
[/list]

[hr]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WUQurYd.png[/img]
[h2]How It Works[/h2]

[list]
[*] Right-click any large rock and choose "Extract Rocks".
[*] Requires a compatible tool setup (see below).
[*] Mining takes time and consumes endurance based on tool type.
[*] Stones and materials drop directly onto the ground.
[*] Larger rocks take longer to break but may yield better resources.
[*] Mining rewards preparation, skills, and long-term progression.
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]Tool Compatibility[/h2]

[list]
[*] Sledgehammer (all variants)
[*] Pickaxe / Forged Pickaxe
[*] Club Hammer / Forged Club Hammer (full mining without a chisel)
[*] Stone Maul / Block Maul
[*] Long Stone Mace
[*] Carving tools + hammer (limited mining only)
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]Loot & Mining Details[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rocks drop Stone (Base.Stone2) based on size and Sandbox settings.
[*] Low-probability rare drops (all sandbox configurable):
[list]
[*] Flint
[*] Iron Ore
[*] Large Stone
[*] Iron Bloom
[*] Aluminum Fragments
[*] Copper Ore
[*] Flat Stone
[*] Stone Blocks
[*] Steel-related fragments
[/list]
[*] Rare materials are intentionally uncommon to preserve long-term balance.
[*] Higher Strength reduces mining time.
[*] Improvised or carving tools consume significantly more endurance.
[*] Tools degrade based on mining intensity.
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]Sandbox Options[/h2]

Fully customizable under:
[b]New Game → Sandbox → Break Big Rocks[/b]

[list]
[*] Stone Min / Max
[*] Individual rare drop chances
[*] Limited mining behavior tuning
[*] Overall mining balance for SP or MP servers
[/list]

[hr]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fully compatible with Build 42.
[*] Works on any map.
[*] Does NOT replace vanilla rocks or construction systems.
[*] Multiplayer-safe and server-authoritative.
[*] Lightweight and designed for long-term survival playthroughs.
[/list]

[hr]

[Code]
This mod's permissions fall under TIS's policy Ask for permission[theindiestone.com]

This mod can only be added to and extended with the express permission from the original creator. Having received permission, credit must be given to the original creator, both within the files of the mod and wherever the mod roams online.

If no permission is received you may not alter the mod, and it must be treated as a mod that is 'On Lockdown'.

The only exception is that servers may freely include this mod in their modpacks, with the freedom to alter it or make modifications as they see fit, as long as credits are properly given to the original creator.
[/code]

[h2]Support the Mod[/h2]

[b]Support the Project[/b]

If you enjoy this mod and want to support future updates and new systems:

[url=https://ko-fi.com/darylmastergg]

[/url]

Your support helps expand the project and keep development active.

[i]Every contribution makes a difference.[/i]

3540503606.title: Neat Crafting & Neat Building – XP & Mod Display
3540503606.description:
[h2]Build Support: B42.12.0 to B42.20.x — Build 42 only[/h2]

[b]Neat Crafting & Neat Building – XP & Mod Display[/b] is a lightweight companion Workshop item for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3502080466][b]Neat Crafting[/b][/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3536052310][b]Neat Building[/b][/url].

It adds clear optional [b]XP gain[/b] and [b]source mod[/b] information directly to recipe/build lists, with multiple XP display modes, useful filters, text scaling, and clean auto-sizing entries.

[hr]
[h2]What This Workshop Item Includes[/h2]

This Workshop item contains [b]two separate addons[/b]. Enable only the ones you actually use.

[list]
[*][b]Neat Crafting — XP & Mod Display[/b]
Adds XP and source mod information to the Neat Crafting recipe list.
Mod ID: [code]Neat_Crafting_AddonXP[/code]

[*][b]Neat Building — XP & Mod Display[/b]
Adds XP and source mod information to the Neat Building recipe list.
Mod ID: [code]Neat_Building_AddonXP[/code]
[/list]

You do [b]not[/b] need to enable both addons unless you use both base mods.

[h2]Required Base Mods[/h2]

[h3]For Neat Crafting XP[/h3]
Use:
[code]NeatUI Framework
Neat Crafting
Neat Crafting — XP & Mod Display[/code]

[h3]For full / legacy Neat Building XP[/h3]
Use:

[code]NeatUI Framework
Neat Building
Neat Building — XP & Mod Display[/code]

[h3]For modular Neat Building setups[/h3]
If you use the new [b]Neat Building - UI Only[/b] variant with separate buildable modules, use:
[code]NeatUI Framework
Neat Building - UI Only
Neat Building — XP & Mod Display[/code]

The buildable/entity modules do not need their own XP addon. The XP display attaches to the Neat Building UI.

[h2]Recommended Load Order[/h2]
[list]
[*]NeatUI Framework
[*]Neat Crafting, if used
[*]Neat Building or Neat Building - UI Only, if used
[*]Neat Crafting — XP & Mod Display, if used
[*]Neat Building — XP & Mod Display, if used
[/list]

[h2]Core Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]XP per recipe:[/b] shows how much XP a recipe/build gives and which skill receives it
[*][b]Multiple XP display modes:[/b] Base XP, Final XP, Multiplier, or Full Breakdown
[*][b]Multiplier breakdowns:[/b] includes starting skill bonuses, books, traits, sandbox XP, and global XP multipliers where applicable
[*][b]Optional Mod line:[/b] shows which mod a recipe/build comes from
[*][b]XP-only and Mod-only filters:[/b] quickly find recipes that grant XP or come from mods
[*][b]Auto-resize and text scaling:[/b] recipe entries grow cleanly to avoid clipped text
[/list]

[h2]Neat Crafting Addon[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adds XP and optional source mod lines to the Neat Crafting recipe list
[*]Supports all XP display formats through Mod Options
[*]Adds optional [b]XP only[/b] and [b]Mod only[/b] filters
[*]Automatically resizes recipe entries for longer XP and mod text
[*]Handles recent Build 42 recipe XP behavior, including electricity recipes
[/list]

[h2]Neat Building Addon[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adds XP and optional source mod lines to the Neat Building recipe list
[*]Supports the full [code]Neat_Building[/code] variant
[*]Supports the modular [code]Neat_Building_UIOnly[/code] variant
[*]Adds optional [b]XP only[/b] and [b]Mod only[/b] filters
[*]Supports vanilla building recipes and Neat Building recipes
[*]Includes XP/source display support for the new Dark Wooden Door Frame recipes
[/list]

[h2]Recent Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated for [b]Project Zomboid Build 42.20[/b]
[*]Added support for the new modular Neat Building variants
[*]The Neat Building XP addon can now work with either [code]Neat_Building[/code] or [code]Neat_Building_UIOnly[/code]
[*]Removed the hard dependency on only the original Neat Building mod ID
[*]Added safer Lua guards so the addon stays inactive instead of breaking if no compatible Neat Building UI variant is loaded
[*]Added XP/source display support for Dark Wooden Door Frame recipes
[/list]

[h2]Mod Options[/h2]
XP display can be configured through Mod Options.

Available XP formats include:
[list]
[*]Base XP
[*]Final XP
[*]Multiplier
[*]Full Breakdown
[/list]

The source mod line and filters can also be enabled or disabled depending on how much information you want in the recipe/build list.

[h2]Translations[/h2]
[list]
[*]CH, CN, DA, DE, EN, ES, FR, HU, IT, JP, KO, NL, PL, PT, PTBR, RU, TH, TR, UA
[/list]

[h2]Multiplayer / Saves Note[/h2]
This Workshop item is UI/display-focused. It does not add world objects by itself.

However, the base mods [b]Neat Crafting[/b] and [b]Neat Building[/b] may register Build 42 data such as recipes, entities, or WorldDictionary references. Please read the save/server notes on their own Workshop pages before removing them from an existing save/server.

[b]Rule of thumb:[/b]
[list]
[*]Always make a full backup before changing mod lists on MP
[*]If a world has used Neat Crafting or Neat Building, avoid removing the base mod without checking its Safe Uninstall instructions
[*]This XP & Mod Display addon should be safer to remove than the base mods, but backups are still recommended
[/list]

[h2]How to Force a Workshop Update[/h2]
[list]
[*]Close Project Zomboid completely
[*]Unsubscribe from this Workshop item
[*]Wait until Steam finishes removing it
[*]Subscribe again and wait for the download to finish
[*]Launch the game
[/list]

[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]

If you find an issue, please report it with:
[list]
[*]Project Zomboid version
[*]SP / MP Host / Dedicated Server
[*]Enabled base mods and addon variants
[*]Mod list and load order
[*]Steps to reproduce
[*]Relevant part of [b]console.txt[/b], [b]coop-console.txt[/b], or server log
[*]Screenshot or short video if possible
[/list]

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3502080466][b]Neat Crafting[/b][/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3536052310][b]Neat Building[/b][/url] — base mods by [b]Rocco[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3378285185][b]Starlit Library[/b][/url] — reflection logic by [b]albion[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3428715523][b]Crafting XP Display[/b][/url] — inspiration by [b]N0wh3re[/b]
[*]Maintenance, compatibility updates, and newer Build 42 support by [b]Afyrmo[/b]
[/list]

[h2]More Mods & Feedback[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]You can find my other Project Zomboid mods here[/url]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/819002974403344349/DD18664314A26EA83C62E9B0127FFCB35092B53A/[/img]

If you find this Workshop item useful, please consider leaving a [b]thumbs up[/b] and adding it to your [b]favorites[/b]. It helps other players discover it.

Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are always welcome.

[list]

See Features Discussion for more info

[h2]Disclaimer:[/h2]
The latest update will reset your Pack Mule settings (due to code changes), this should not break any saves however equipment may not behave according to the settings you have selected. To fix this navigate to your sandbox options and readjust your settings, once the lua reloads (or game is relaunched) your settings will return. If playing single-player and you experience different settings mid-save you can fix them by downloading the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3386906181][B42+]Sandbox Options[/url] mod, once in-game hit the sandbox options keybind, adjust your settings from the in-game menu, save, and relaunch. If done correctly your settings will be restored.
Sorry for the game disruptions, I had to rewrite large portions of the mod to properly fix some visual bugs and hope the results out-weighs the inconvenience. 

[h2]Details:[/h2]
When a feature is enabled it will change the equipping behavior of all affected items without overwriting them. This allows Pack Mule to work along side most mods and can easily be added or removed from existing saves without destroying items or requiring exploring unseen cells to find new ones. No item stats or drop rates are changed unless explicitly mentioned in the Sandbox Setting's tooltips.
All features from Pack Mule will behave as expected from the base game. Gear layering, combination exclusions, and alternative models have been added to avoid visual inconsistencies and to maintain game balance.
All options are toggle-able meaning you could strip Pack Mule down to just a Duct Tape Ankle Holster mod if desired.

[h2]Special Thanks:[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/drstalker/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]Nepenthe[/url]
Nepenthe has an incredible catalogue of mods and has been tremendously kind and helpful on my journey learning to create mods, please show them your love and support!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/angelbion/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]Albion[/url]
Could not for the life of me figure out how to establish Sandbox Settings without their guidance/resources, so if you enjoy being able to choose from the features of Pack Mule you have Albion to thank!



[hr][/hr]

3545533939.title: [B41/B42] Toughness Skill
3545533939.description:
Adds a new skill in the survival category called toughness. This is your character's mental resilience to the hardships of the apocalypse, with each level reducing the amount of panic, pain and discomfort they'll feel. Toughness XP can be earned by killing zombies.

It will take about 4450 total zombie kills to reach max level in toughness at x1 XP rates. The new positive trait "tough" provides a starting toughness level of +1 and a x4 XP multiplier, reducing the total number of zombie kills for max level to only around 1000.

Each level of toughness reduces the total amount of panic felt by your character by -10%, pain by -5%, discomfort by -5% and an extra 10% added to the discomfort nullification threshold. This means a character with level 2 toughness will not gain any discomfort at all if the total combined discomfort of their clothes and moodles is at or below 20%. Since the total discomfort pecentage level can go above 100%, level 10 toughness won't completely remove discomfort if enough uncomfortable clothes are being worn.

3549290115.description:
[b]Surviving the apocalypse just got a little more hydrating.[/b]

My Own Well lets you build your own functional well — no more relying on pre-placed ones! With a deep crafting system, skill-based progression, and realistic mechanics, this mod brings a new layer of survival immersion to your world.

[h1]🔨 Build Requirements[/h1]

You'll need more than just a hammer — only true survivors can construct a well!
To craft your own, you'll need:

[h2]Pump Well[/h2]

[h3]— Skill Requirements:[/h3]

[h3]— Materials Needed:[/h3]
• Hammer → May Degrade Light

[b]The mod includes options to set the requirements and materials and skills to 50%.[/b]

[h1]💦 New Water System Features[/h1]

• See how much water is left in each well (Using default liquid container system, personal fixed after last game release).
• Wells collect 15% of rainwater automatically.
• Every in-game hour, wells refill with 25–75L of water (configurable).
• Water gets split between nearby wells within 20 tiles to avoid construction abuse.

By default, between 25 and 75 liters per hour can fill a 10,000 liter well in 7 to 10 days.

[h1]☣ Contamination System[/h1]

• If you leave rotting zombie corpses near wells, each in-game hour there is a chance the well water will become contaminated by the bodies. 
• The chance increases with both the number of corpses nearby and the time they remain unremoved. 
• It is possible to clean a contaminated well using charcoal. (The amount of charcoal required depends on how much water is in the well)
• The contamination risk and the cleaning cost are configurable in the mod options.

[h1]🚧 Smart Restrictions[/h1]

You can’t build wells underground or on rooftops. Designed to be realistic and balanced for long-term survival. [b]But you can enable build underground in sandbox settings.[/b]

Whether you’re building a forest base, running a self-sustaining farm, or just tired of boiling toilet water — My Own Well is your new best friend.

[h1]🚧 MP Common Server Errors[/h1]

If a client connects to the server using the mod and encounters error "File doesn't match the one on the server" — a problem that typically arises when the server runs on Linux and the client on Windows (since most web hosts use Linux) — you can resolve the issue simply by adding the setting "DoLuaChecksum=false" to the server's configuration .ini file.

some "floor" moat tiles mix poorly with shores. (like Vanilla Grave, SP & MP)
some "floor" moat tiles stil masking players on current tile. (in MP only)
water tile created from full moat tile is not updated (black square) until relog. (in MP only)

3551139118.description:
Disassemble guns into parts. Use those parts to repair and upgrade firearms of the same type. Tinker, tune, and turn junk into your new favorite zombie popper.

[b]Yes, you can finally stop hoarding 27 half-broken pistols “just in case”.[/b]

Disassemble any supported firearm to salvage parts.
Repair & upgrade weapons of the same type using those parts.
Maintenance and Aiming skills reduce costs, speed up actions, and boost part yield.
Maintenance XP bonus on every action performed with the mod.
Attachments, magazine, and loaded rounds are safely moved to your inventory during disassembly—no more “oops, where did my suppressor go?”.
Built on vanilla firearm classes, so it plays nice with most Workshop gun packs.

Action Time scales with your settings and skills (see Sandbox). Faster hands, fewer groans.

[h1]🎓 Skills[/h1]

Maintenance: reduces tool wear and failure chance, increases part yield, speeds actions, and gives bonus XP for every mod action.
Aiming: improves upgrade success/quality effects and also helps with cost reductions and timings.

No lost gear: attachments, magazines, and chambered rounds are automatically moved to your inventory when you take a gun apart.
Works with any weapon mods thanks to vanilla-class integration.

Loot two or more guns of the same type.
Disassemble the worst one for parts.
Repair/upgrade the keeper.
Repeat until your pistol feels like a tiny railgun. (Kidding… mostly.)

3554424111.title: U.S. M998 Humvee by Papa_Chad
3554424111.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NrstAKw.gif[/img]

This mod adds M998 HMMWV (Humvee) with Animated Doors and a fully functioning Turret to Project Zomboid. It is necessary to have the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2705406713]Military Tool Kit[/url]installed.


*Only for B42 SP and MP
*✅B42.20
*Compatible with old saves
*Compatible with KI5 vehicles

[h1]Resources[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Animated Doors
[*] [b]Animated Addons
[*] [b]Turret[/b]
    The turrets have heavy coding that adds a completely new ballistics system that is independent of the systems in the Standard Game, performing calculations for each projectile independently, calculating its energy, ability to cause damage and transfix bodies, vehicles and walls.
[*] [b]Doors, hoods, trunk lids and more.[/b]
They have their own colors, so you can assemble your Humvee with the color variation of the parts you want.
[/list]

[h1]How to use the Machine Gun[/h1]
[list]
[*]	The machine gun must be installed in the vehicle
[*] You must sit in the Gunner's seat
[*] You must place the [b]12.7x99mm (.50 BMG) Ammo Box[/b] already loaded with [b]12.7x99mm (.50 BMG) Round[/b] in the gun compartment.
[*] Press the [b]Right Mouse Button to aim[/b] and the [b]Left Mouse Button to fire[/b].
[*]	[b] ATTENTION[/b], the projectile will be fired where the barrel of the machine gun is pointing and not necessarily where you are aiming, so for more precise shots it is recommended that you wait for the turret stop before firing. (It is still possible to fire with it moving)
[*]	[b] ATTENTION[/b], when the projectile is fired, it will travel all the way until it completely loses its synergy and stops, so if there are vehicles in its path and the projectile has enough synergy, it will cause damage and may or may not transfix them. The same logic applies to walls, just as in real life a .50 BMG projectile can transfix some walls and still have the energy to destroy things in its path. 3555588616.title: [B42.20] [SP-Only] Ogrim Mod's - Sewing Workbranch
3555588616.description:
Custom sewing machines with a proper workbench UI, real maintenance, and oil-fueled operations.

[h1]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer[/h1]

I haven't finished updating the mod to make it compatible with multiplayer yet.

[h1]🔍 What is this?[/h1]
Sewing Workbranch adds three types of sewing machines to Project Zomboid, each with its own efficiency, requirements, and risks. Use a clean, custom interface (not just another crafting tab) to:

Repair clothes (by fabric type)
Tear down garments into rags/thread
Consolidate thread and supplies

All actions consume Machine Oil and can damage the needle or the machine over time. Keep it maintained, keep it running.

Requires: Machine Utils (API) — provides Machine Oil and shared logic.

[h1]🧵 Machine Types[/h1]

🏚️ Old — Rustic and heavy. No power required, but uses more material and breaks more easily.
🏠 Personal — Modern home machine. Needs electricity. The most common to find.
🏭 Industrial — Highest efficiency, supports all recipes/features, but is rarer.

Each tier has its own efficiency multipliers, required Tailoring level, and chance to break. Tune it in Sandbox.

[h1]🧰 What you can do[/h1]

🩹 Repair Clothes: Fix garments by fabric type with skill-based costs and time.
✂️ Tear Down: Turn clothing into rags/thread, with better yields for good condition.
🧶 Consolidate Thread: Merge partial spools and tidy up your stock.
📚 Batch Queue: Repair or dismantle multiple garments at once—add a whole list and the machine processes them in order.
⌨️ Quick Access: Press [E] near a sewing machine to open the Workbranch UI instantly (no mouse required).
🛢️ Maintenance Loop: Actions consume Machine Oil; machines suffer wear and may need repairs.
🎚️ Skill scaling: Tailoring/Maintenance reduce time & materials and improve outcomes; you earn XP as you work.

[h1]🧪 Fabric System (extended)[/h1]

Support for richer materials beyond vanilla:
Cotton, Denim, Stuffing Denim, Leather, Rubber, Kevlar, Stuffing Kevlar, Burlap, Tarp.
Recipes, requirements, and minimum conditions are handled per fabric.

[h1]⚙️ Sandbox & Balance (server-friendly)[/h1]

Everything important is configurable, including but not limited to:
Oil economy: base oil use per operation; oil rarity multiplier (from API).
Wear & tear: base chance to damage needle / machine; minimum condition to run.
Progression: required Tailoring level per Old/Personal/Industrial machine.
Efficiency: per-tier throughput multipliers and action time scaling.
Fabric rules: enable/disable repair by fabric, minimum condition, material costs.
XP: Tailoring/Maintenance XP multipliers.

[b]Set it hardcore or comfy — your apocalypse, your sliders.[/b]

[h1]🧭 How to use[/h1]

Find a sewing machine (Old / Personal / Industrial).
Stock Machine Oil (from the Machine Utils API).
Insert a needle, open the Sewing Workbranch UI, pick a tab:
Machine Status · Sewing Recipes · Repair Clothes · Cut Down Rags
Watch oil, needle wear, and machine condition while you work.

[h1]📦 Compatibility[/h1]

Built on vanilla systems; adds new machines and fabric handling.
No loot table overrides beyond machine/oil distribution (tuned by Sandbox).

[h1]🌍 Languages[/h1]
English, Español, Português (BR)

[h1]❓FAQ[/h1]
[b]Does it run without oil?[/b] 
No — every operation uses Machine Oil.

[b]Can I use it without power?[/b] 
Only the Old machine type. Personal/Industrial need electricity.

[b]Is it OP?[/b] 
It’s as strong (or punishing) as your Sandbox settings.

[b]Safe to add/remove?[/b] 
Adding is generally safe. Removing after placing machines may cause missing-item warnings (like any dependency).

Machine Utils (API) ✅ (provides Machine Oil, shared code)

3557228372.title: [B42.20] Ogrim Mod's - Sandbox Group Titles
3557228372.description:
Make the Sandbox Options screen readable by adding section headers that group related settings — [b]perfect for mods with lots of sliders and toggles.[/b]

[h1]🔍 What it does[/h1]
This API lets you insert group titles/subsections inside the game’s Sandbox window.
You define the first option of a group with a special _T_ marker; everything before "_T_" becomes the group’s key/title. The options after that entry are visually grouped until the next title.

[h1]🎯 Why use it[/h1]

Cleaner UX for big configuration sets
Faster player onboarding & better readability
Drop-in, mod-agnostic and server-friendly

[h1]🧪 How to use (for modders)[/h1]

1) Mark the first option of a group in your sandbox-options.txt
Everything left of "_T_" = group key

[i]
option ElectricSewing.IndustrialMachine_T_EfficiencyMultiplier
{
    type = double,
    min = 0.1, default = 3.0, max = 10.0,
    page = ElectricSewing,
}
option ElectricSewing.IndustrialMachine_ActionTimeMultiplier
{
    type = double,
    min = 0.1, default = 1.0, max = 10.0,
    page = ElectricSewing,
}
[/i]

Above, IndustrialMachine becomes the group title. All following options are grouped until another *_T_* appears.

2) (Optional) Add a localized title in your language file (e.g., Sandbox_EN.txt):

Sandbox_Title_ElectricSewing.IndustrialMachine = "Industrial Sewing Machine"

Key format: Sandbox_Title_<Module>.<GroupKey>

If missing, the raw group key is shown.

3) Repeat for each section you want (e.g., OldMachine_T_*, PersonalMachine_T_*, etc.).

3566766862.title: Trap Manager
3566766862.description:
[h2]Compatibility: Build 42.12.3 to Build 42.20.x[/h2]

[b]Trap Manager[/b] is a clean and practical interface for monitoring, comparing, and understanding your traps in [b]Project Zomboid Build 42[/b].

It gathers your traps into one clear window, shows their current status in a sortable table, explains key values with helpful tooltips, and includes a built-in simulator to preview vanilla catch chances by animal, trap, bait, zone, and Trapping skill.

[b]Trap Manager does not change vanilla trap mechanics.[/b]
It only reads, organizes, and explains trap information.

[quote][b]Sidebar shortcut:[/b] hover the [b]Zone[/b] icon on the left sidebar to reveal the matching [b]Trap[/b] button, then click it to open or close Trap Manager.[/quote]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]What Trap Manager Does[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shows all your traps in one window instead of checking them one by one.
[*]Displays trap data in a clear, sortable table.
[*]Adds tooltips that explain what each value means.
[*]Includes a built-in catch chance simulator.
[*]Helps compare traps, bait, zones, and skill levels more easily.
[*]Keeps vanilla gameplay untouched: no changes to capture logic, items, recipes, animals, loot, or odds.
[/list]

[h2]Trap List Window[/h2]
[list]
[*]View all your traps in one place.
[*]Sort rows by clicking column headers.
[*]Resize columns by dragging separators.
[*]Hide or show columns from the header context menu.
[*]Use per-row visibility toggles to temporarily hide rows from the list.
[*]Check practical details such as bait, freshness, distance, catch chance, hours alive, trap status, and more.
[/list]

[h2]Built-in Catch Chance Simulator[/h2]
The simulator lets you preview vanilla trapping chances by combining:
[list]
[*][b]Animal[/b]
[*][b]Trap[/b]
[*][b]Bait[/b]
[*][b]Zone[/b]
[*][b]Trapping Skill[/b]
[/list]

Selecting an animal can automatically populate other fields with valid values, and tooltips help explain how each factor affects the result.

[b]Note:[/b] displayed chances are based on vanilla trapping logic. They are best understood as base vanilla candidate/catch chances. Mods that change trapping rules, cold modifiers, nearby-player behavior, bait logic, or trap processing may affect the real result in-game.

[h2]Window Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Refresh[/b] — updates the trap list immediately.
[*][b]Auto[/b] — enables hourly in-game auto-refresh while the window is open.
[*][b]Vector[/b] — draws a line from your character to the trap currently hovered in the table.
[*][b]Reset[/b] — restores your default column layout.
[*][b]Full[/b] — shows every column and resizes the window to fit them.
[*][b]Show all[/b] — temporarily shows rows you previously hid.
[/list]

[h2]Mod Options[/h2]
[list]
[*]Choose the hotkey used to open or close the window.
[*]Enable or disable hourly auto-refresh.
[*]Enable or disable longer explanatory tooltips.
[*]Choose which columns should be shown after pressing [b]Reset[/b].
[*]Restore factory defaults for the reset layout at any time.
[/list]

[h2]How to Open Trap Manager[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Left sidebar:[/b] hover [b]Zone[/b], then click the slide-out [b]Trap[/b] button.
[*][b]Hotkey:[/b] use the key configured in ModOptions.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Project Zomboid [b]Build 42.12.3 to 42.20.x[/b].
[*]Designed specifically for [b]Build 42[/b].
[*]Works in Singleplayer and Multiplayer.
[*]Safe to add or remove from existing saves, since it is UI-focused.
[*]Does not alter vanilla trap mechanics.
[*]Generally compatible with other UI mods.
[*]Mods that heavily change vanilla trapping internals may affect simulator accuracy or trap data display.
[/list]

[h2]Languages[/h2]
Includes translations for:

[b]AR, CA, CH, CN, DA, DE, EN, ES, FI, FR, HU, ID, IT, JP, KO, NL, PH, PL, PTBR, RU, TR, UA[/b]

If your language is not available, the mod falls back to English.

Translation suggestions and corrections are welcome.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]Does Trap Manager change catch chances or trap mechanics?[/b]
No. It only reads, organizes, and explains trap information.

[b]Are the simulator chances exact?[/b]
They are based on vanilla trapping logic and are intended as practical guidance. If several animals are valid candidates at the same time, vanilla may choose between candidates, so the displayed value should be read as a base chance estimate rather than a guaranteed final outcome.

[b]What is the difference between “Shown columns” and “Default columns”?[/b]
[b]Shown columns[/b] are the columns visible right now.
[b]Default columns[/b] are the columns restored when you press [b]Reset[/b].

[b]What does “Apply factory defaults” do?[/b]
It restores the original default column setup used by [b]Reset[/b].

[b]What does “Vector” do?[/b]
It draws a line from your character to the last trap you hovered in the table, helping you orient yourself more easily.

[b]Is the mod performance-heavy?[/b]
No. It is lightweight, and auto-refresh only runs once per in-game hour while the window is open.

[h2]Feature Summary[/h2]
[list]
[*]One clean window for all your traps.
[*]Sortable, resizable, and hideable columns.
[*]Helpful tooltips across the interface.
[*]Built-in catch chance simulator.
[*]Sidebar shortcut and hotkey support.
[*]Native Build 42 ModOptions.
[*]Save-safe and gameplay-safe.
[*]Multilingual support.
[/list]

[b]Install it, open the panel, and understand your traps at a glance.[/b]

[h2]Feedback & Bug Reports[/h2]
Feedback, bug reports, balance suggestions, compatibility reports, and translation improvements are always welcome.

Useful reports include:
[list]
[*]Project Zomboid build.
[*]Trap Manager version.
[*]Singleplayer, MP Host, or Dedicated Server.
[*]Relevant mod list and load order.
[*]Whether another mod changes trapping behavior.
[*]Steps to reproduce the issue.
[*]Console errors or logs, if available.
[/list]

[h2]More Mods & Feedback[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199133259679/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]You can find my other Project Zomboid mods here[/url]

If you find [b]Trap Manager[/b] useful, please consider leaving a [b]thumbs up[/b] and adding it to your [b]favorites[/b] — it helps other players discover the mod.

3570485296.title: TwisTonFire - Better Fishing
3570485296.description:
[img]https://imgur.com/BaUyxax.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h1]Better Fishing — Vanilla First, Fully Adjustable[/h1]
[b]Made for Project Zomboid Build 42.20+[/b]

Better Fishing keeps vanilla fishing intact unless you explicitly change its Sandbox Settings.

[quote]
[h2]Important: Installing the mod does NOT rebalance fishing[/h2]

[b]If you install Better Fishing and leave all Better Fishing Sandbox Settings untouched, fishing remains 100% vanilla.[/b]

A pure installation only adds:
[list]
[*][b]Fishing Status UI[/b]
[*][b]Reload Bait[/b]
[/list]

[b]You must change Better Fishing Sandbox Settings yourself before this mod changes vanilla fishing logic.[/b]
[quote]
REMINDER:
You cannot change sandbox values during challenges like "RAT RACE" or similar.
So this mod should be fine to use during your RAT RACE challenge.
[/quote]
Any setting left at its default continues to use vanilla behavior.
[/quote]

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h2]Fishing Status UI[/h2]
Better Fishing includes an optional movable UI while using a fishing rod.

It shows:
[list]
[*]Bonus fishing time
[*]Near-shore status
[*]Weather condition
[*]Whether your fishing rod has valid bait attached
[/list]

Each icon includes a tooltip.
The UI can be moved, scaled, or disabled in Mod Options.

[img]https://imgur.com/uyvKuzk.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h2]Reload Bait[/h2]
Press [b]Reload[/b] to attach the first valid bait found in your inventory.

Press and hold [b]Reload[/b] to open a radial menu and select a specific bait.

Backpacks and nested containers are supported.

[img]https://imgur.com/UTWQCIk.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h2]What can be customized?[/h2]

Open:
[b]Sandbox Settings → Better Fishing[/b]

You can selectively adjust:
[list]
[*]Shore detection
[*]Casting distance
[*]Morning and evening fishing bonus windows
[*]Time bonus strength
[*]Fog, wind, and rain multipliers
[*]Temperature modifier
[*]Near-shore fish size shift
[*]Optional Better Fishing size distribution
[/list]

[b]Only settings changed away from their vanilla defaults modify fishing.[/b]

For example:
[list]
[*]Want only the UI and Reload Bait? Change nothing.
[*]Want better fishing in small ponds? Change Shore Detection only.
[*]Want different weather effects? Change only those multipliers.
[*]Want Better Fishing's size distribution? Enable that option.
[/list]

Everything else remains vanilla.

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h2]Vanilla Tables and Better Fishing Tables[/h2]

[b]Vanilla is now the default.[/b]

Better Fishing does not replace vanilla bait or lure tables when its Sandbox Settings are untouched.

The optional Better Fishing size distribution is [b]disabled by default[/b].

When disabled:
[list]
[*]Vanilla Small / Medium / Big distribution is used
[*]Vanilla skill-based fish limits are used
[/list]

When enabled:
[list]
[*]Better Fishing adjusts Small / Medium / Big chances
[*]Vanilla skill-based species and weight limits are still preserved
[/list]

This means Better Fishing no longer overrides vanilla species progression simply because the mod is installed.

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h2]Small Ponds and Shore Detection[/h2]

Vanilla checks a relatively large area around the fishing target when deciding whether you are near shore.

This can be restrictive on small ponds, pools, and narrow water areas.

Better Fishing lets you reduce that detection distance.

[b]Default setting = vanilla shore detection.[/b]

Only changing the Shore Detection Sandbox value activates Better Fishing's smaller shore check.

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[h2]Other Sandbox Options[/h2]

[b]Casting Distance[/b]
Default: [b]16 tiles — Vanilla[/b]
Range: [b]16–20 tiles[/b]

[b]Time Bonuses[/b]
Adjust morning/evening bonus windows and their strength.
Default values use vanilla time logic.

[b]Weather[/b]
Adjust fog, wind, and rain effects.
Default values use vanilla weather behavior.

[b]Temperature[/b]
Better Fishing uses a flat modifier when changed.
[b]100% = Vanilla temperature behavior.[/b]

[b]Near-Shore Size Shift[/b]
Adjust how strongly near-shore fishing pushes catches toward smaller fish.
Default = Vanilla.

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Does installing Better Fishing make fishing easier?[/b]
No. Untouched Sandbox Settings mean vanilla fishing.

[b]What do I get without changing Sandbox Settings?[/b]
Fishing Status UI and Reload Bait only.

[b]Do I have to change Sandbox Settings to alter fishing?[/b]
Yes. Fishing logic only changes when you deliberately modify Better Fishing's Sandbox values.

[b]Does Better Fishing replace vanilla bait tables?[/b]
No. Vanilla bait and lure tables remain active.

[b]Does the optional size distribution remove vanilla skill limits?[/b]
No. Vanilla species and weight limits remain intact.

[b]Is this safe for existing saves?[/b]
Yes.

[b]Is this compatible with other mods?[/b]
Usually yes. Conflicts are mainly possible when another mod overrides the same fishing functions you have configured Better Fishing to modify.

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

[url=https://streamlabs.com/twistonfire/tip][img]https://imgur.com/Vqt9lif.png[/img][/url]
Your support helps me keep going—thank you very much in advance!

[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]

3572846242.title: Detailed Skill Tooltips
3572846242.description:
[h1]Detailed Skill Tooltips (Build 42.x)[/h1]
[i]Thanks to Champy for the Original Idea - [/i][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3134776712]Descriptive Tooltips for Skill Levels[/url]

[i]Crystal-clear, data-rich skill tooltips for Project Zomboid. See exactly what each level does - no need to tab out.[/i]

[hr]
[h2]What it does[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Data-rich tooltips[/b] for every supported skill: shows real numbers (%, caps, multipliers) per level (1-10).
[*][b]Auto-learn & unlock lists[/b]: optional lists of recipes/buildables you gain as you level.
[*][b]Consistent formatting[/b]: uniform headers, spacing, and line wording across all skills.
[*][b]Per-skill logic[/b]: shows only values that actually change; hides irrelevant/zero lines.
[*][b]Configurable[/b]: toggle recipe/buildable sections and other extras in Mod Options.
[*][b]Extensible API[/b]: other mods can add/override skill definitions without forking this mod.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Mod Support and Twitch[/h2]
Any questions you can find me in any of the places below:

[url=https://twitch.tv/eurymachus]Twitch[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/eurymachus]Discord[/url]

[hr]
[h2]Features in detail[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Per-level values:[/b] attack/block bonuses, carry capacity, endurance/fatigue multipliers, stealth radius, climb bonuses, etc. (varies by skill).
[*][b]Recipe/buildable intel:[/b] optional sections for [i]Auto-learned[/i] and [i]Requires Skill[/i] items, pulled from in-game recipe data.
[*][b]Localized text:[/b] uses standard IGUI_ translation tables; falls back to English if a key is missing.
[*][b]Performance-friendly:[/b] caches lookups; no heavy polling or OnTick spam.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Mod Options[/h2]
[i]Options -> Detailed Skill Tooltips[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Show Auto-learn Recipes:[/b] toggle the auto-learned list (on hover).
[*][b]Show Craftable Recipes:[/b] toggle the craftable recipes for required level list (on hover).
[*][b]Show Buildable Recipes:[/b] toggle the buildable recipes for required level list (on hover).
[*][b]Recipe Display Limit[/b]: limit or uncap list length for crafts/buildables.
[*]More presentation toggles will be added over time.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Build:[/b] 42.x
[*][b]UI mods:[/b] Generally compatible. Mods replacing vanilla skill tooltip code may need load-order tweaks.
[*][b]Recipe/Profession mods:[/b] Compatible; their recipes will appear if registered via ScriptManager.
[*]No vanilla files are overwritten; everything is added via Lua hooks/API.
[/list]

[hr]
[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]Q: Does this change XP rates or balance?[/b]
[i]A: No - its a UI/info mod only.[/i]

[b]Q: Why dont I see a recipe in the list?[/b]
[i]A: Some recipes are gated by magazines, traits, or context. We list whats available via your current level/source data.[/i]

[b]Q: Can I add my mods skill?[/b]
[i]A: Yes - use the API _Template and ship a small file in client/SkillDefs/.[/i]

• Adjust bonus multipliers for all combat skills.
• Set the probability of triggering at the starting hour (default: 100%, equivalent to every day).

[h1]Better Trapping[/h1]
[b]TL;DR[/b]
Adds a smart in-game trapping helper, optional expanded bait tables, and several quality-of-life improvements to make vanilla trapping clearer, smoother, and more practical.
[h2]Included Variants[/h2]
This workshop item contains [b]two variants[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Better Trapping[/b] – expanded bait tables
[*][b]Better Vanilla Trapping[/b] – vanilla bait tables, with the same helper UI and QoL improvements
[/list]
[quote]
[b]Please only enable one version at a time.[/b]
[list]
[*][b]twisttrapping[/b] = expanded bait list by TwisTonFire
[*][b]twisttrappingvanilla[/b] = vanilla bait tables with QoL improvements only
[/list]
[/quote]
[h2]Expanded or Vanilla Bait Tables[/h2]
With Build 42, The Indie Stone greatly expanded the loot pool for vegetables and fruits. However, animal bait tables were not adjusted to match this change.

As a result, trapping became noticeably harder, because animals still rely mostly on the old Build 41 vegetables and fruits. Even raccoons currently use a bait list copied directly from rabbits.

That is why the [b]Better Trapping[/b] version expands the bait pool in a way that fits the new Build 42 food variety. If you prefer the strict vanilla experience, use [b]Better Vanilla Trapping[/b] instead.
[h2]What You Get[/h2]
[b]In-game wiki and trapping helper[/b]
With just a few clicks, you can check:
[list]
[*]which animals can be caught
[*]which zones they appear in
[*]when they are active
[*]which traps can catch them
[*]which bait they accept
[/list]
[b]Your choice: expanded or vanilla bait tables[/b]
[list]
[*]Use [b]pure vanilla[/b] bait tables
[*]Or use the [b]expanded Better Trapping[/b] bait tables for a broader and more practical bait pool
[/list]
[h2]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Double-click empty traps to automatically add the best available bait from your inventory
[*]Smart bait selection checks which animals the selected trap can actually catch
[*]Rabbit bait is preferred first if the trap can catch rabbits
[*]If no rabbit bait is available, the mod falls back to the best available bait for other valid animals
[*]Mouse traps, bird traps, and other trap types choose bait based on their valid target animals
[*]Auto-baiting avoids stale, rotten, burnt, cooked, drink, and evolved-food items
[*]Bait can be used directly from backpacks and bags
[*]After placing a trap, another trap of the same type can be selected automatically if one is still available in your inventory
[*]Traps can be highlighted with different colors depending on their bait state
[/list]
[h2]Quality-of-Life Examples[/h2]
[b]Place traps faster if you have multiple traps of the same type in your inventory:[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/4ScypCZ.png[/img]

[b]Bait traps faster if you have valid bait available in your inventory via double click:[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/dObYBRu.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h1]How to Access the Options[/h1]
[b]Mod Options for QoL improvements:[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/UHKUWtS.png[/img]
[b]At the bottom of your screen, you will find a small black bar. Move it wherever you like and open it:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Trap icon[/b] = Trapping Helper
[*][b]Book icon[/b] = Wiki
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/07tbzJZ.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h1]How It Works[/h1]
Set your home location, usually where you sleep, and walk at least 75 tiles away.
[img]https://imgur.com/mbarksU.png[/img]
Then click on the animal you want to check:
[img]https://imgur.com/5VxHJpw.png[/img]
You can see all important trapping information here, including valid bait, trap types, activity time, and zones.
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h1]Bait List: Vanilla vs. Better[/h1]
[b]Example: Rabbit[/b]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/CKZ9XPsJ/baitlist-Rabbitpsmall.gif[/img][/url]
[b]The choice is yours:[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/gX7d3Q0.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h2]🌐 Current Translations[/h2]
[list]
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Portuguese (Brazil)
[*]Russian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Spanish
[*]Traditional Chinese
[*]Polish
[*]Turkish
[*]Ukrainian
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/RQYClYI.png[/img]
[h1]F.A.Q.[/h1]
[b]Is this mod compatible with other trapping mods?[/b]
[i]This mod is compatible as long as the other mod does not modify animal pools or bait pools.

My traps are too small to catch cows or pink elephants. Only vanilla catchable animals work with these traps, and the mod only provides information for those animals.[/i]

[b]I already use a trapping mod that removes the 75-tile radius requirement. Can I use this mod too?[/b]
[i]Yes. My mod does not modify the 75-tile minimum-distance logic. If another mod removes or bypasses that requirement, this mod can still work alongside it. However, the Set Home and Reset buttons will become redundant.[/i]

[b]Can I use this mod in an existing save?[/b]
[i]Yes. You can add or remove this mod mid-playthrough without issues. Your traps will not disappear. However, traps that were already baited may stop catching with their current bait until you rebait them.[/i]

[b]Why did you make this mod?[/b]
[i]I want to [b]enhance[/b] the vanilla experience, [b]not overhaul it[/b].

I also spoke with the developer behind the trapping feature, and even he agreed that the system is quite old and probably due for a full rework at some point.

Until The Indie Stone updates trapping themselves, this mod is here to bridge the gap and make trapping feel better in the meantime.[/i]

3592172476.title: [B42:SP/MP] Take A Bath And Shower
3592172476.description:
[h1]If you encounter minor issues or bugs, please first test this mod in isolation or with a minimal mod list. Then, please report the issue.
Doing so makes it easier to investigate the cause of the issues.[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zqj7g7S.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ihe3opv.png[/img]
[b]This mod was developed with this theme in mind.[/b]

Bathing and showering in Project Zomboid should feel meaningful.

This mod adds fully playable bath and shower mechanics, and gives them a real place in day-to-day survival.
Bathing is not just flavor. It can become part of how you stay comfortable, clean, and in good condition over time.

Is washing yourself in a sink, or even a toilet, really enough to feel clean?
You might survive without proper bathing, but it should not feel ideal.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nAzYwVj.png[/img]

[h2]Detailed feature notes are listed in the guide because of the Workshop character limit.[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3592172476/603044859897662340/]This Mod Guide[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Egqo3zB.png[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adds an invisible body dirt parameter called [b]Grime[/b].
[*]The Grime system can be disabled in the sandbox options.
[*]Bathtubs function as fluid containers.
[*]Includes a dedicated bathtub UI.
[*]Adds "Take Shower" options to white showers and wall-mounted showers.
[*]Adds a "Take Bath" option to white bathtubs.
[*][b]Bathing Benefits[/b]: bathing can help relieve various negative stats.
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Body Shampoo[/b]: an alternative to soap. (Currently shower-only.)
[*][b]Bath Salt[/b]: can be added to tub water. There are currently 6 types, each with different bathing benefits.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ioCny6n.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Xp5Ut1.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic Clothing Change:[/b] includes a wide range of options.
[*][b]Improved Plumbing:[/b] bathtubs and showers can calculate available water from the total amount stored in all water collectors in the 3x3 area above them.
[*][b]Advanced Prep Location Detection:[/b] the character can better detect where to prepare for bathing. Toilets, cabinets, and other awkward tiles are given lower priority even if they are technically usable or closer.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hZcWW67.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Bathtubs have four sprite variations: with shower (vanilla), cleaned with shower, without shower, and cleaned without shower.
[*]You can always climb over the edge of a bathtub.
[*]This can sometimes result in zombies ending up in the bathtub.
[*]Bathtubs and showers can be separated through the context menu. (Requires a pipe wrench.)
[*]Shower parts can be removed from bathtubs and deluxe showers.
[*]Removed shower parts can be packed, unpacked, and placed as wall-mounted showers.
[*]Deluxe showers can be crafted using shower parts and wall-mounted showers as materials.
[*]Separated bathtubs can have shower parts or wall-mounted showers attached again.
[*]Adds recipes for packing and unpacking shower parts and wall-mounted showers.
[*]Clean Tub variants are available for both attached-shower and separated-shower types.
[*]The improved Deluxe Shower can rotate in all four directions. The vanilla version only supports S and E.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aKZFTc9.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5AaAmhS.png[/img]
[h1]Recommended Mods[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3396446795]Moodle Framework[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3416208765]Bath Towels Overhaul[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3378285185]Starlit Library[/url]
[/list]
I intentionally did not make these required, but I strongly recommend them because they support important parts of this mod.

[h2]Compatible Mods[/h2]
[b]Included Patches[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Ra's Body Mod[/b] - dedicated compatibility patch included.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3403870858]Lifestyle: Hobbies[/url] - bath and shower interactions are replaced by this mod's versions, and bathing can also reduce `hygieneNeed`.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2893930681]Anthro Survivors[/url] - Although a patch is included, there is no guarantee that it will work correctly with the latest version.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3546314080]WaterPipes[/url] - bathtubs and showers can be connected to WaterPipes pipes.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3592172476/582805296104118134/]Companion Dogs[/url] - Your following companion dog will wait while you bathe or shower. Please see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3592172476/582805296104118134/]Here[/url] for details.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2879745353]Melos Tiles for Miles Tilepack[/url] - Various bathtubs and showers are available.
[/list]

[b]Add-on required[/b]
[list]
[*]Excrementum - Use this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3792822955]Compat Add-on[/url].
[/list]

[b]General Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic clothing change is designed to work with most body mods.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3429790870]Tomb's Player Body Overhaul[/url] - one of my personal favorites, and the one used in the screenshots.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3428146910]Wash or Rot[/url] - its grime system is similar but not identical, so the two mods can coexist and may work well together.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3413150945]More Damaged Objects[/url] - [b][Important] Please be sure to perform an Auto Sort.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]My mods are not compatible with mods that directly overwrite the base game's files or functions. Using them together may cause unexpected bugs.[/h3]

[h2]Incompatible Mods[/h2]
[list]
[*]A mod that [u]constantly control[/u] the character's state or animations.
[/list]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[list]
[*]I filled the bathtub with water, but I can't see the water.
[*]When I get into the bathtub, my lower body disappears.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LklrXQz.png[/img]
[*]A: Make sure "Take A Bath And Shower: DepthMap fix" is at the top of the mod list.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BLKGQdQ.png[/img]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]Uninstalling this mod while saving is not recommended, as it will leave a large amount of junk in the game.
[*]Some features may still behave oddly in split-screen mode.
[*]The bathtub and shower faucet menus are currently limited because the vanilla fluid menu is broken.
[*]If you speed up the game during the movement or clothing-change steps before or after showering, the action may stop midway.
[*]This happens because WalkAction and PathFindBehavior can be canceled at high game speeds.
[/list]

[h1]Translations[/h1]
[list]
[*]EN
[*]ES - thanks to Kasualidad.
[*]FR - thanks to Bukaroo_Fr.
[*]IT - thanks to [ITA] D4rk
[*]JP

[*]RU - thanks to phxntom1213.
[*]TR - thanks to xeotN.
[*]UA - thanks to SilentSalo.
[/list]
Please help support additional translations.

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]
[list]
[*]More balance adjustments.
[*]Additional polishing and expansion of bathing-related content.
[*]Metal barrel bathing.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NSyw3xg.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2NXzGF7.png[/img]

If you like my mod, please consider buying me a ko-fi. It helps support future modding work.
[url=https://ko-fi.com/sicafe_kofi][img]https://i.imgur.com/TXUirZn.png[/img][/url]

 The M163 VADS (Vulcan Air Defense System) is a self-propelled anti-aircraft weapon based on the M113 chassis. Equipped with the M61 Vulcan 20 mm Gatling gun, this vehicle is capable of unleashing devastating firepower

*Only for B42 SP and MP

[*] [b]Animated Tracks[/b]

[*] [b]Animated Addons[/b]

    The turret uses an advanced custom-coded ballistics system independent of the standard Project Zomboid mechanics, calculating the trajectory, kinetic energy, and penetration of each projectile individually. Damage is applied realistically to vehicles, walls, and bodies.
[/list]

[h1]Advantages[/h1]
[list][*][b]Firepower[/b] - The 20 mm M61 Vulcan is capable of firing up to 3,000 rounds per minute, shredding anything in its path.

3606009875.title: Immersive Reading [B42.15+][MP]
3606009875.description:
[h1]Description[/h1]
This mod slows down the process of reading books, magazines, and comics, making the experience more immersive. Instead of applying boredom, unhappiness, and stress relief only once at the end of reading, it spreads these effects evenly throughout the entire reading duration. This creates a more realistic and engaging experience, with gradual changes in the character's mood and mental state.

Works only for books, magazines, and comics - skill books are not affected.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
     [*][b]Longer reading[/b] - No more finishing Tom Sawyer in just 20 in-game minutes.

     [*][b]Reading progress saved[/b] - Your reading progress is saved, so you can pick up where you left off even after closing the game.

     [*][b]Excludes skill books[/b] - your character's skill progression books remain unchanged.

     [*][b]Gradual mood impact[/b] - boredom, unhappiness, and stress changes are applied proportionally to the reading progress.

     [*][b]Does not modify vanilla items[/b] - all original books and magazines remain untouched, ensuring maximum compatibility with other mods.

     [*][b]Supports tagged mod items[/b] - if a modded item uses tags like Magazine, Picturebook, NewspaperRead, Softcover, Hardcover, or FancyBook, it will automatically receive the correct reading duration.

     [*][b]Safe to add or remove anytime[/b] - fully compatible with existing saves, no risk of breaking progress.

     	[*][b]Multiplayer Support[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Note[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Slow/Fast Reader traits affects the reading speeds.

[*]You can no longer re-read a finished book immediately. This limitation prevents exploiting mood effects and lasts until the character eventually forgets the book's contents.
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list]
[*] Compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3342191739] Gyde's Trait Magazines[/url]
[*] Incompatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3607100086] Literature Reworked[/url]
[/list]

[h1] Translations [/h1]

🟪Silent Pines – Isolated Cabin Town Expansion

Hidden deep in the backwoods north of March Ridge, Silent Pines was once a quiet hunting settlement where trappers, loggers, and drifters lived far from the noise of the cities. A dozen crooked cabins, a rundown lodge, a forgotten gas stop, and a scattering of abandoned trailers were all that marked the town on any map.

When the Knox Event hit, Silent Pines went dark overnight.

Now the forest has reclaimed nearly everything. Pine needles blanket the roads, wildlife stalks the empty yards, and the only movement comes from what’s wandering between the trees. Supplies are sparse. Cell service is nonexistent. The cabins creak with every shift of wind, and no two nights ever sound the same.

Explore narrow dirt paths, collapsed hunting shacks, secret lookout towers, and remote lakeside camps. Navigate the dense underbrush where visibility can vanish in seconds. Every corner hides risk; every cabin feels like a final refuge that might not hold.

Perfect for players who crave solitude, atmosphere, and a brutal early-game survival challenge. Whether you’re searching for isolation, a lore-heavy backwoods sanctuary, or just a new area to die in creatively, Silent Pines offers a hauntingly quiet slice of the Knox woods.

3618557184.title: Here Goes the Sun [B42MP]
3618557184.description:
[h1]AREN'T YOU ABSOLUTELY, COMPLETELY TIRED OF LIVING THE SAME DAMN DAY OVER AND OVER? I KNOW I AM.[/h1]

If your survivor lived for years, they spent three-quarters of their entire life watching the exact same sunset, again and again and again (except during storms).
It's time to put an end to that.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Let me introduce my first mod: HERE GOES THE SUN[/h2]

[h3]Sunrises and sunsets redesigned with seasonal and weather-based transitions[/h3]
Spring and summer feel brighter and more alive; autumn comes with golden, brown and muted palettes; winter brings icy, grey or deep-blue tones. Golden hour? All yours.

[h3]Storms reshape the world into something bleak and suffocating[/h3]
Muted colors and dim daylight transform rain into a claustrophobic, cinematic experience that slowly wears the player down.

[h3]Fully dynamic and deterministic color system[/h3]
Every day the game picks a new variation based on season and probability, never random noise.

[h3]Compatible with other weather mods[/h3]
I aimed to avoid collisions with climate mods. Preferably load it last, just in case.

[h3]Made to capture beautiful screenshots[/h3]
Designed from the very beginning to create photographic, atmospheric moments in every season.

[h3]Includes SportXAI's god rays[/h3]
To keep compatibility high and revive his BRILLIANT idea, they are included.

[h3]Fully safe for old and new saves[/h3]
No new world required. Just enable and enjoy.


I'm open to all feedback and ideas. My coding skills are somewhat limited, but if inspiration strikes, I'm absolutely willing to experiment.
