3781225795.title: Project RV Cabin Climate Fix (Build 42.20)
3781225795.description:
Companion fix for [b][B42]PROJECT RV Interior[/b]. Weather leaks straight through the cabin walls - this stops that, while still respecting whether the RV's own AC/heater is actually on. More fixes planned; see the roadmap at the bottom.

[h1]The bug[/h1]
RV interiors are plain map tiles placed far outside the normal playable map, with no roof geometry for the engine's room/roof detection to find. That leaves every cabin permanently flagged "outdoors" by the engine itself, so full outdoor rain and temperature apply exactly as if you were standing in a field - worst during rain. (The base mod's own code even fills rain barrels placed inside the room from "rain" - the same bug, visible from the inside of the author's own logic.)

[h1]The fix[/h1]
The "outdoors" flag itself can't be changed from a mod, so this corrects its effects on you directly, about once a second, while you're inside any RV interior:
[list]
[*]Wetness (body and every worn item) is always driven back down, since the interior's rain simulation keeps re-wetting the room every tick. The cabin has a roof regardless of power - rain shouldn't reach you either way.
[*]Body temperature is corrected only if the RV actually has a real Heater part switched on with power available - the same part behind the vanilla driver-seat "Heater On/Off" radial toggle, which doubles as AC via a negative target temperature. No heater, heater off, or no battery charge means no correction at all: a desert-parked RV with the AC off still cooks you, a snowed-in one with no heater still freezes you.
[/list]

[h1]Reaching the heater/AC from inside[/h1]
The vanilla heater/AC toggle only works from the driver's seat, which you're not in once teleported into the interior. Adds a right-click option, "Toggle RV Heater/AC," while you're inside, so you don't have to walk back out to the cab to switch it on or off.

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer alike - the fix runs authoritatively on whichever process actually owns your character (the server on a dedicated server, your own game in singleplayer), never on a remote client.

An optional sandbox setting ("Respect vehicle Heater/AC for cabin temperature," default on) turns the whole temperature behaviour off server-wide, leaving only the wetness fix.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Safe to add or remove mid-save. No new items, recipes or save data.
[*]Requires [B42]PROJECT RV Interior. Load after it.
[/list]

Workshop ID: 3781225795
Mod ID: ProjectRVFix

3781319724.title: [B42.20+ MP] - Furniture Push & Pull
3781319724.description:
[h1]Furniture Push & Pull[/h1]
Ever wanted to move a chair, table or cabinet without picking it up first?
Furniture Push & Pull lets you physically push and pull furniture one tile at a time using your character's Strength.

[h2]Version 1.1.2[/h2]
[list]
[*]Plant Drying Racks are temporarily excluded from Push/Pull to prevent active drying items from disappearing
[/list]

[h2]Version 1.1[/h2]
[list]
[*]Filled containers can now be pushed and pulled without emptying them first
[*]Container contents are preserved when furniture is moved
[*]Filled-container visuals are refreshed after moving furniture
[*]Container contents are synchronized between players in multiplayer
[/list]

[h2]How to Use[/h2]
[b]Keyboard & Mouse[/b]
[list]
[*]Stand directly next to a supported piece of furniture
[*]Right-click the furniture
[*]Select [b]Push[/b] to move it one tile away from you
[*]Select [b]Pull[/b] to move it one tile toward you
[/list]

[b]Controller[/b]
[list]
[*]Stand directly next to a supported piece of furniture
[*]Open the standard world context menu
[*]Select [b]Push[/b] or [b]Pull[/b]
[/list]

When pulling furniture, your character automatically steps one tile backward before moving the furniture toward them.
The destination must have enough space for the entire piece of furniture.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Push furniture one tile away from your character
[*]Pull furniture one tile toward your character
[*]Supports single-tile furniture
[*]Supports multi-tile furniture such as large tables and cabinets
[*]Filled containers can be moved without removing their contents
[*]Container contents are preserved during movement
[*]Strength affects how quickly furniture can be moved
[*]Furniture weight affects movement time and stamina usage
[*]Moving furniture consumes stamina
[*]Checks walls, obstacles and the complete destination footprint
[*]Warns when ground loot is present on the destination tile
[*]Ground loot does not prevent furniture from being moved
[*]Uses vanilla-style push and pull animations
[*]Furniture movement creates sound and can attract nearby zombies
[*]Full controller support
[*]Multiplayer compatible and tested
[*]Furniture movement and container contents are synchronized between players
[/list]

[h2]Strength & Weight[/h2]
Your Strength level affects how much effort it takes to move furniture.
Characters with higher Strength can move furniture faster and with less stamina cost, while weaker characters take longer and use more stamina.

Furniture weight is also taken into account.
A lightweight chair is much easier to move than a large cabinet or heavy table.
Multi-tile furniture is treated as heavier than smaller single-tile furniture.

[h2]Filled Containers[/h2]
Furniture with items inside can be pushed and pulled without being emptied first.
The contents are preserved while the furniture is moved, including in multiplayer.

Some furniture uses decorative container overlays, such as visible books on a filled bookcase. These visuals are refreshed after the furniture is moved, so the exact decorative arrangement may change while the actual container contents remain unchanged.

[h2]Ground Loot[/h2]
Furniture can still be moved onto tiles containing loose items on the ground.
If loot is detected on the destination tile, the mod displays a red warning before you move the furniture.

The items remain on the ground, but due to Project Zomboid's rendering they may visually appear on top of the moved furniture.

[h2]Balanced & Vanilla-Friendly[/h2]
Furniture Push & Pull is designed to feel like a natural part of Project Zomboid rather than a replacement for the existing furniture system.

Furniture is only moved one tile at a time, movement costs stamina, heavier objects take more effort, and blocked destinations cannot be used.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
[b]Full controller support.[/b]
Controller players can access Push and Pull through the standard world context menu while standing next to supported furniture.
Controller support works in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
[b]Fully multiplayer compatible and tested.[/b]
Furniture movement is handled authoritatively by the server and synchronized between connected players.
Filled container contents are preserved and synchronized when furniture is moved.

Multiple players can take turns pushing or pulling the same furniture.
Keyboard, mouse and controller players can all use the mod together.

[h2]Supported Furniture[/h2]
The mod is intended for normal moveable floor furniture, including both single-tile and multi-tile objects.

Examples include:
[list]
[*]Chairs
[*]Tables
[*]Cabinets
[*]Shelving
[*]Other standard moveable furniture
[/list]

Some objects such as rugs, wall decorations, windows and floor tiles are intentionally not supported.
Plant Drying Racks are also temporarily excluded because Build 42.20 does not safely preserve active drying jobs when multi-tile furniture is moved.

[h2]Existing Saves[/h2]
[b]Safe to add to an existing save.[/b]
The mod does not add new world generation or require a fresh world.

[h2]Build Compatibility[/h2]
Made for Project Zomboid Build 42.20+.

3781716360.title: Wheelbarrow Multiplayer/Singleplayer - Carrinho de mão
3781716360.description:
[b]Also by me:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3782332412]AutoMark[/url] — marks looted buildings with an X and flags important items, automatically. Everyone does this by hand; now the mod does it for you.

[b]🇧🇷 Português no final.[/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MHHHhmrm/andando.gif[/img]

A construction wheelbarrow for the loads the game punishes you for carrying: logs, generators, anvils, corpses.

[b]It is deliberately useless for ordinary loot.[/b] This is not a bigger backpack.

[h1]The load[/h1]
[list]
[*]Items of [b]8 units and up[/b] are repacked — a fifth of the room, 95% off the weight.
[*]Lighter items get [b]nothing[/b], and fill up fast.
[*]About [b]21 logs[/b], or [b]6 planks[/b]. Full of heavy cargo it weighs ~13 on your back.
[*][b]Organized[/b] +30%, [b]Disorganized[/b] −30%.
[/list]

[h1]What it costs[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Both hands.[/b] No weapon while you hold it.
[*][b]No running.[/b] Loaded or empty.
[*][b]No fences, windows, sheet ropes or cars.[/b] Set it down first.
[*]Doors, gates and stairs are fine.
[/list]

[h1]Rush it and you lose everything[/h1]
Picking it up and setting it down are timed actions. Interrupt one and it [b]tips over[/b], dumping the load and itself on the ground.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/V6D5GV4R/deixarcair.gif[/img]

[h1]Using it[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]E[/b] picks it up and sets it down. Like a vehicle, it is never in your inventory.
[*][b]Load it:[/b] select items, right-click, [b]Load into Wheelbarrow[/b].
[*][b]A corpse:[/b] drag the body, then right-click by the wheelbarrow.
[*]Any action while holding it makes you [b]park it and pick it back up[/b] automatically.
[/list]

[h1]The game's own limit — read this if it will not fill[/h1]
The game caps the total weight of items lying on a single tile. Since loading always happens with the wheelbarrow on the ground, [b]anything else dumped on that tile counts against it[/b] — and the wheelbarrow stops accepting cargo early.
[b]Load it on a clear tile.[/b] If it will not take any more with room left on the bar, step away from your loot pile and try again.

[h1]Getting one[/h1]
[b]Crafting is the reliable way.[/b] [b]MetalWelding 4[/b], near any surface:
[list]
[*]2 Sheet Metal
[*]2 Metal Pipe
[*]1 Tire — [b]any[/b] of the game's nine car tires, flat ones included
[*]4 Screws
[*]1 Welding Rod
[*]Blow Torch and Welding Mask (tools — not consumed)
[/list]
[b]Or find one:[/b] construction sites, warehouses, garages, tool stores and roadworks — but only a [b]3% chance[/b] per location, rolled once per save. They are meant to be a lucky find, not a plan.

[h1]Also[/h1]
[b]Multiplayer supported[/b] — tested against a dedicated server. [b]11 Sandbox options[/b], [b]23 languages[/b], [b]no dependencies[/b]. Build 42.

[i]Removing the mod from a save that has wheelbarrows in it can cause load errors. Empty and destroy them first.[/i]

[h1]PORTUGUÊS[/h1]
[b]Também meu:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3782332412]AutoMark[/url] — marca com um X os prédios já saqueados e sinaliza itens importantes, automaticamente. Todo mundo faz isso na mão; agora o mod faz por você.

Um carrinho de mão para as cargas que o jogo pune você por carregar: troncos, geradores, bigornas, cadáveres.

[b]Ele é inútil de propósito para loot comum.[/b] Isto não é uma mochila maior.

[h2]A carga[/h2]
[list]
[*]Itens de [b]8 unidades para cima[/b] são reacondicionados — um quinto do espaço, 95% do peso a menos.
[*]Itens mais leves não ganham [b]nada[/b], e enchem rápido.
[*]Cerca de [b]21 troncos[/b], ou [b]6 tábuas[/b]. Cheio de carga pesada pesa ~13 nas suas costas.

[/list]

[h2]O que ele cobra[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]As duas mãos.[/b] Nenhuma arma enquanto você o segura.
[*][b]Nada de correr.[/b] Carregado ou vazio.
[*][b]Nada de cerca, janela, lençol ou carro.[/b] Largue antes.
[*]Portas, portões e escadas funcionam normalmente.
[/list]

[h2]Com pressa, você perde tudo[/h2]
Pegar e largar são ações com animação. Interrompa uma delas e o carrinho [b]tomba[/b], derrubando a carga e ele mesmo no chão.

[list]

[*][b]Carregar:[/b] selecione os itens, botão direito, [b]Carregar no Carrinho de mão[/b].
[*][b]Um cadáver:[/b] arraste o corpo, depois clique com o direito perto do carrinho.
[*]Qualquer ação com ele na mão faz você [b]largar e pegar de volta[/b] automaticamente.
[/list]

[h2]Um limite do próprio jogo — leia se ele não encher[/h2]
O jogo limita o peso total de itens jogados num mesmo bloco do chão. Como carregar sempre acontece com o carrinho no chão, [b]tudo o que estiver largado naquele bloco conta junto[/b] — e o carrinho para de aceitar carga antes da hora.
[b]Carregue num bloco limpo.[/b] Se ele não aceitar mais nada com a barra ainda mostrando espaço, afaste-se da pilha de loot e tente de novo.

[h2]Como conseguir um[/h2]
[b]Fabricar é o caminho confiável.[/b] [b]MetalWelding nível 4[/b], perto de qualquer superfície:
[list]
[*]2 Chapas de Metal
[*]2 Canos de Metal
[*]1 Pneu — [b]qualquer[/b] um dos nove pneus do jogo, inclusive murcho
[*]4 Parafusos
[*]1 Vareta de Solda
[*]Maçarico e Máscara de Solda (ferramentas — não são consumidas)
[/list]
[b]Ou encontrar:[/b] obras, galpões, garagens, lojas de ferramentas e obras de rua — mas só [b]3% de chance[/b] por lugar, sorteado uma vez por save. Ele é para ser um achado de sorte, não um plano.

[h2]Também[/h2]
[b]Multiplayer suportado[/b] — testado contra servidor dedicado. [b]11 opções de Sandbox[/b], [b]23 idiomas[/b], [b]sem dependências[/b]. Build 42.

[i]Remover o mod de um save que tem carrinhos pode gerar erro no carregamento. Esvazie e destrua eles antes.[/i]

3782033481.title: The Grate Escape
3782033481.description:
Pry open a road manhole with a crowbar and work your way through Knox Country's storm sewers to another manhole across the map. It is a journey, not a teleport - and it costs you.

[b]SINGLEPLAYER ONLY for now.[/b] In multiplayer the mod politely refuses to travel - proper server-validated movement is on the roadmap, and the travel system was built with that move in mind.

[h2]How it works[/h2]
[list]
[*] Manholes are the real covers already scattered across Knox Country's roads - all 446 of them, straight from the game's own map data. They show on the world map dimmed until you have been near them, and the map's own fog of war applies: covers in territory you have never explored (or read off a paper map) stay hidden until you uncover them. Prefer to earn every marker? An option limits travel to covers you have discovered in person.
[*] Right-click a manhole and pry it open. By default that needs a crowbar or pry bar - the same tools that pry off a barricade.
[*] Some covers have been rusted into their frames since before the outbreak. Getting a stubborn one up takes strength, fitness, a proper lever and legs that are not already spent - a crowbar beats a tire iron, and a tire iron beats bare hands. Nothing is ever permanently stuck: every failed heave shifts the lid a little further, and that progress is remembered. A cover you have worked open stays loose for about a month before it seizes back up.
[*] The map opens with every manhole marked. Hovering one prices the whole trip before you commit: the route lights up along the roads with every scheduled stop ringed, and the label shows the distance, how much food and water the trip needs against what you are carrying, what the hardest stretch takes out of your stamina, and a red warning if your supplies will not see you through. Click to set out, or close the map to stay put.
[*] The trip runs manhole to manhole. The screen goes dark and you surface at each cover along the way: press on, or climb out here. [b]There is no resting in the dark[/b] - every mile costs food, water and stamina, more if you are loaded down or limping, and none of it comes back until you are above ground. Your character eats and drinks from their own pack as they go.
[*] The stop screen keeps the bookkeeping honest: four bars - Food, Water, Rest, Stamina - that all drain the same way, so a low bar is always bad news. Hover any bar for exactly why: what the next stretch costs, what the rest of the trip costs, what your pack is worth, and anything making it worse. A progress strip shows the whole run to scale - start, stops, you, destination.
[*] Going badly? Bail out anywhere along the route, if you can get that cover open. And when the body runs out before the lid gives, desperation takes over: with your stamina gone every heave starts tearing at your arms and back, and with your strength and wind both spent the last heave always gets the cover up. You crawl out starving, dying of thirst, dead tired, aching in every muscle - but you crawl out. Nobody is ever sealed underground.
[*] The mod refuses outright to send you down a stretch that would finish you, warns when the trip ahead looks longer than your supplies, and tells you how many miles short of the destination your stamina will run out.
[/list]

[h2]No time skipping[/h2]
The clock runs normally the whole way. In the fiction the sewers are the fast way across the county - that is the point of using them - and skipping the clock breaks farming and weather in ways that are not worth it. A journey costs supplies, not hours. Quitting or crashing partway is safe: you climb out at the last cover you reached, having paid for the legs you finished and none of the one you did not.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
Press ESC, go to Options, and open the [b]Mods[/b] tab. Drop the tool requirement, switch off seized covers entirely, limit the map to covers you have discovered in person, turn travel back into a plain instant teleport, or scale what a mile underground costs from a quarter to four times the normal rate. Server admins get a matching sandbox page that can lock all of it to the server's values.

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
Next: multiplayer support, things that can go wrong down there, and eventually the sewers themselves - a generated run between entry and exit, in the dark, with company.

No new items, no map edits, no world changes - safe to add to an existing save. Works alongside Geo Compass (they share a map-drawing pedigree) but does not require it.

3783433804.title: [B42] Nellis Air Force Base
3783433804.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ilu5S1O.gif[/img]

[h1]Information[/h1]

Thank you for downloading my map! It's my first map and any feedback is appreciated. Nellis will continue to receive updates. I already plan to add a huge city under the AFB along Highway 31 and huge underground complexes.

Nellis is located under March Ridge.

The entire map is 4x5 cells, the AFB itself covers 4x3 cells. It is very huge, and I plan to add underground complexes next, along with an adjacent city.

Also, if you like the map please give this mod a star or like or whatever, it would mean a lot to me since I sunk a lot of man hours into this.

Cells Used: 35,47; 36,47; 37,47; 38,47; 35,48; 36,48; 37,48; 38,48; 35,49; 36,49; 37,49; 38,49; 35,50; 36,50; 37,50; 38,50; 35,51; 36,51; 37,51; 38,51

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]

While I listed it as required, VMZ is optional. However it is highly recommended you use Vehicle Military Zones so military vehicles spawn around the map at the motor pool, checkpoints, administrative building, and checkpoints.

KI5 and Filibuster's military vehicles are supported. Any vehicle that has a 'military' zone is supported.

You should probably start a new save if you download this map. If you want to add it mid save you need to do some weird chunk loading stuff that you can find online with a quick google.

It's compatible with any map mod that does not occupy any of the cells I listed.


Pharmacy's Guide:
For anyone wanting to add this mid save (WARNING: THIS ONLY WORKS IF YOU'VE BEEN NOWHERE NEAR NELLI'S BASE COORDINATES ON THE MAP!!!)

1. Backup your main save folder before doing any of this just in case.
2. Create a new save in Zomboid with Nelli's enabled, load into the game (preferably spawning in Nelli's Base as it's an option) wait until you spawn in, give the game a few seconds.
3. Once you've given it a few seconds, close PZ completely, go to where your PZ saves are located, something like: ]C:\Users\name\Zomboid\Saves\Sandbox\2026-08-21_20-46-42\
4. Within that folder, look for a file called map_ver.bin
5. Copy map_ver.bin from your temporary save to your main save folder, overwrite when prompted.
6. Enable Nelli's and all of it's requirements within your main save.
7. Load your main save, Nellis should now be where it needs to be.

[h1]Updates[/h1]

August 22nd - Increased zed distribution and spawns, should make the airbase a lot more dangerous and risky to balance out the high loot yields. Expect future updates for custom weaponry exclusive to the airbase. Such as RPGs, mounted machine guns, maybe even mortars. A new save isn't required for this update, it only touches zombie spawns. If you haven't loaded the chunks with Nellis yet, you will have the new distributions.

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]

This map has been tested in both local and dedicated multiplayer hosting. If the map is not loading, ensure your .ini is configured correctly, and you have no conflicting mods and are testing on a fresh save. This map is not compatible with Falcon Ridge or other maps below March Ridge.

Make sure the mod is listed in your mods= and workshopitems= and make sure the map is loaded before Muldraugh, KY

Example:
Map=Nellis Air Force Base;Muldraugh, KY
mods=YAPZLib;UnofficialMappersCommunityTilePack;melos_tiles_for_miles_pack;VMZNEW;NellisAFB;
WorkshopItems=3783433804;3628736763;2879745353;3436499337


[h1]Lore/Background[/h1]

Established during World War II, Nellis Air Force Base was constructed near Fort Knox as a strategic United States Air Force installation.

During the Cold War, the base became home to a number of highly classified programs and facilities, many of which remained unknown even to personnel stationed at Nellis.

Following the outbreak of the Knox Event, Nellis was repurposed into a major military evacuation and refugee processing center. As the crisis worsened, thousands of civilians were directed toward the installation under the protection of the U.S. military.

It didn't last.

The perimeter eventually collapsed. Sections of the installation were abandoned or quarantined one by one, forcing surviving military personnel and refugees toward the airfield as Nellis was overrun.

The base now sits abandoned. Rumor has it that the airbase is filled with enough weaponry, medical supplies and tools to start a new country.

[h1]Credits[/h1]

Caçador - Various military vehicles and props, vehicle interiors and teleportation script. (check their stuff out) https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199468186338/myworkshopfiles/

ALEXSI - Radar buildings and signal tower

Conan - Military housing template

Seven (7) - 2 military building templates

dirkiedirk - all his PZ mapping tutorial videos

PZ Mapping discord community - helping me troubleshoot stuff Also,

huge thanks to Kraz who made Fort Redstone, while I didn't talk to them or anything, their map served as a huge inspiration for this project and as a bit of a reference or whatever I used 2 of the same central buildings as him, albeit facelifted to work with B42.

Also, please credit me or ask me for permission if you plan to use this map for anything.

3784003967.title: Horse Utility Add-on
3784003967.description:
[h1]More ways to use your horse.[/h1]

[b]Horse Utility Add-on[/b] expands Horse Mod with practical features for everyday use. Set a horse as your personal mount, build a bond with it, call and track it, add weapon storage to the saddle, and use equipped reins for leading and hitching.

Additional DLC lets you customize and expand your experience with even more features.

The new features are integrated into the existing Horse Mod menus and equipment system.

[h2]Make a Horse Your Personal Mount[/h2]
[list]
[*]Set one horse as your personal mount
[*]Build a bond from 0 to 100 by riding, leading, feeding, and petting it
[*]View the current bond directly inside Horse Mod's Animal Information window
[*]Hover over the bond value for an explanation of the system
[/list]

[h2]Call and Track Your Horse[/h2]
[list]
[*]Set a keybind to call your personal mount under [b]Options > Mods > Horse Utility Add-on > Primary Mount > Call primary mount[/b]. The key is unbound by default
[*]Call range increases as the bond grows
[*]Track your horse on the world map and minimap
[*]See its last known location if you become separated
[/list]

[h2]Equip the Saddle[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add separate weapon storage slots to the left and right side of the saddle
[*]Use two of the same holder or combine the bag and scabbard
[*][b]Saddle Rifle Bag:[/b] capacity 9 and fully enclosed
[*][b]Saddle Rifle Scabbard:[/b] capacity 6, faster access, and a visible stored long gun
[*]Open scabbards appear as additional hotbar slots while mounted, allowing you to quickly draw or store a long gun
[*]Stored weapons retain their condition, ammunition, and attachments
[/list]

[h3]Finding and Crafting Saddle Weapon Storage[/h3]
Both finished saddle attachments can be found as uncommon loot wherever Horse Mod saddles can appear. Possible locations include jockey lockers, barns and farm storage, camping and hunting locations, survival gear containers, relevant supply crates, sports stores, and Wild West general stores.

Both attachments can also be crafted through the Tailoring crafting menu. The recipes are learned automatically at [b]Tailoring 3[/b].

[b]Saddle Rifle Bag crafting recipe[/b]
[list]
[*]1 Sewing Needle (tool, not consumed)
[*]1 pair of Scissors or 1 Sharp Knife (tool, not consumed)
[*]2 Heavy Thread
[*]2 Leather Strips
[*]2 Buckles
[*]1 empty Cloth Gun Case (rifle, shotgun, alternate, and camouflage variants are accepted)
[*]Hard rifle cases are not accepted
[/list]

Accepted vanilla item variants: Base.Bag_RifleCaseCloth, Base.Bag_RifleCaseCloth2, Base.Bag_ShotgunCaseCloth, Base.Bag_ShotgunCaseCloth2, and Base.Bag_RifleCaseClothCamo.

[b]Saddle Rifle Scabbard crafting recipe[/b]
[list]
[*]1 Sewing Needle (tool, not consumed)
[*]1 pair of Scissors or 1 Sharp Knife (tool, not consumed)
[*]1 Heavy Thread
[*]3 Leather Strips
[*]2 Buckles
[/list]

The vanilla Cloth Gun Case required for the closed bag can be found in its normal loot locations, including gun stores, hunting storage, pawn shops, garages, hunter or trapper loot, and some vehicle storage.

[h2]Lead and Hitch with Reins[/h2]
Give equipped reins a practical purpose by using them to lead and hitch your horse.

[list]
[*]Lead a horse using its equipped reins without carrying a separate rope
[*]Hitch it to suitable trees, fences, posts, and other appropriate world objects
[*]Select a hitching point while mounted. Your character automatically rides there, dismounts, and hitches the horse
[*]Uses matching icons and the existing Horse Mod context menus
[/list]

[h2]Additional DLC[/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3786752882][img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11425569789060323002/B0E396AB4550C6A9349AD71B74D8227480E31C92/[/img][/url]

You can finally shoot Zombies while riding your horse. You can also reload, rack your firearm, and clear weapon jams without dismounting. This Horse Utility Base mod is required.

[h2]More Features Planned[/h2]
More utility features, saddle expansions, and additional uses for the bond system are planned for future updates.

Feature requests and suggestions are welcome in the Workshop comments and discussions.

[h2]Languages[/h2]

3786332527.title: Cheat Menu: Rebuild
3786332527.description:
[h1]Cheat Menu: Rebuild[/h1]
A standalone cheat menu for Project Zomboid Build 42.20. You do not need Cheat Menu Reloaded or the B42.20 fix pack.

[h1]WHY THIS EXISTS[/h1]
Cheat Menu Reloaded is the classic menu, but on Build 42 it started falling apart — especially in multiplayer.

The item spawner got slower every time you opened it, and FPS often never recovered. God, Heal, Infinite Carry, and Creative Mode looked like they were on, but often did nothing. Instant Actions had been turned off. Some skills (like Tailoring) changed the wrong perk. Vehicles, weather, and a lot of admin tools did not sync on a server.

People ended up stacking Reloaded plus a separate "B42.20 fix" mod. That is messy, easy to break, and still left holes.

Rebuild is one mod that replaces both. Same kind of menu, rewritten for 42.20 — singleplayer, co-op, and dedicated servers.

[h1]HOW TO USE[/h1]
Right-click the ground → Cheat Menu: Rebuild. Works while the game is paused (heal / God before you unpause).
Dedicated servers: admin / GM / moderator only. The host must have the mod; friends only need it if the server checks Lua checksums.
Do not enable Cheat Menu Reloaded or B42.20 Cheat Menu Reloaded Fix at the same time.

[h1]WHAT'S BETTER[/h1]
[*] Item spawner stays smooth instead of killing FPS
[*] God, Heal, Infinite Carry, and Creative Mode actually work
[*] Instant Actions is back
[*] Skill XP goes to the skill you picked
[*] Animal spawner; furniture can be removed, not only doors and windows
[*] Multiplayer: items, vehicles, weather, skills, teleport, Vehicle God, vehicle color / rust

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[*] Heal, God, Ghost, Prevent Death, Health panel
[*] Works while paused — right-click to heal / toggle cheats before unpausing
[*] Creative Mode, Instant Actions, Infinite carry
[*] NoClip / Fly (PageUp / PageDown)
[*] Infinite ammo, refill, no shot delay, melee one-hit, infinite durability
[*] Item / animal spawn, skills, recipes, teleport, weather, time, nutrition
[*] Vehicle repair, Vehicle God, color / rust
[*] Fire: left-click a tile to ignite; Shift/Ctrl+click or middle-click to extinguish; right-click to disable. Barricade: click a door/window or hold Z
[*] Suicide (with or without zombification)

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]
[*] Singleplayer: full access
[*] Co-op (host): full access
[*] Dedicated server: visible and usable for admins, GMs, and moderators only

[h1]COMPATIBILITY[/h1]
[*] Build 42.13+ / 42.20 (not Build 41)
[*] Works with most other mods
[*] Safe to add to existing saves (backup first)

[h1]日本語[/h1]
Build 42.20 向けのスタンドアロンチートメニューです。Reloaded 本体や Fix パックは不要です。

[b]なぜ作ったか[/b]
Cheat Menu Reloaded は定番ですが、Build 42 では特にマルチで壊れやすくなっていました。

アイテムスポナーを開くたびに重くなり、FPS が戻らないことがありました。God / 回復 / 無限所持 / クリエイティブはオンに見えても効かないことが多く、インスタントアクションは無効のまま、スキル経験値（裁縫など）が別のスキルに入ることもありました。車両や天候などの管理機能もサーバーに同期しませんでした。

Reloaded と別の Fix パックを重ねる運用も、壊れやすく穴が残ります。Rebuild はその両方を置き換える 1 つの Mod です。

[b]使い方[/b]
地面を右クリック → Cheat Menu: Rebuild。ポーズ中でも使えます（解除する前に回復 / God が可能）。専用サーバーは管理者のみ。ホストは Mod 必須。Reloaded と B42.20 Cheat Menu Reloaded Fix は同時に入れないでください。

[b]改善点[/b]
[*] アイテムスポナーで FPS が落ちにくい
[*] God / 回復 / 無限所持 / クリエイティブが実際に効く
[*] インスタントアクションを復活
[*] 選んだスキルに経験値が入る
[*] 動物スポーン、家具の削除
[*] マルチでアイテム・車両・天候・テレポート・Vehicle God・塗装が同期

[b]操作[/b]
飛行は PageUp / PageDown。放火はタイルを左クリックで点火、Shift/Ctrl+クリックまたは中クリックで消火、右クリックで解除。バリケードはドア/窓をクリック、または Z 長押し。ポーズ中も地面を右クリックすればメニューが開きます。

3786534696.title: Kane the Merchant [SP ONLY] [Shop]
3786534696.description:
[h2]READ THIS FIRST: Kane isn’t an NPC; he’s a mannequin. Don’t expect any dialogues or any sort of reactions from him...he’s literally just decorative, it's a economy mod, not a game remake[/h2]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]A balanced, hand-tuned trading system for survivors who want a reason to hoard cash .....  not a cheat that hands you everything.[/h3]

That stack of Base.Money (and Money Bundles) you've been dumping in a drawer since day one... it's actually worth something now.

[h3]Kill zombies → loot jewelry → sell it to the merchant → get cash → buy stuff.[/h3]

Double-tap L near any of the 6 Merchant locations (or right-click Kane) to open the shop.
(Shop locations can be found in the images section.)
[b]( AND NOW SHOP LOCATIONS ARE CUSTOMIZABLE)[/b]
read this for more info: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3786534696/582806854239782532/
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Features:[/h1]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15420555143762886542/55F09A430225EB9D6C4940732281AB68BF6D5DCE/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[h3]🔄Daily Rotating Stock (customizable) [/h3]

Kane doesn't run an infinite vending machine.

His inventory refreshes every in-game day:

- Each category shows only a limited, randomized subset of its full item pool
- Every item that appears gets its own randomized daily stock count
- Once an item sells out, it's gone until the next daily refresh
- Ammo, medical supplies, vehicle parts, and other goods each have their own stock limits

[b]🔫 Guns Have Their Own System[/b]

Firearms are intentionally much rarer. Every day, Kane offers exactly:

- 1 Pistol (randomly picked from the Pistol class)
- 1 Revolver (randomly picked from the Revolver class)
- 1 Shotgun (randomly picked from the Shotgun class)
- 1 Rifle (randomly picked from the Rifle class)

Each firearm is capped at one unit per day. A good gun showing up in Kane's shop should feel like you found something valuable — not like you walked into a supermarket.

OR
[b]You can change that to a single random gun in sandbox settings.[/b]

[h2]The whole system is built to make Kane feel like a limited-supply trading post that stays useful across a long save, without turning the economy into an infinite source of gear.[/h2]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11149198648294532642/001F0FF1DE33F4150B8001021EFE3A49FB3C0C8C/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[h3]📈 Progression, Not Just Purchasing[/h3]

Kane's shop can be upgraded through investment:

- $5,000 for Level 2
- +$5,000 per additional level
- Unlock a new category at each level-up — [b]you[/b] choose which one

Possible categories: Tools, Materials, Gardening, Vehicle Parts, Vehicle.

Every investment also grants a permanent [b]2.5% loyalty discount[/b], stacking with each investment — a reason for long-term customers to keep coming back, without breaking the early-game economy.

Investing now always shows a clear confirmation with the exact amount before any money leaves your hands — no more surprise pocket-draining misclicks.

[h3]🔧 Gun Repair[/h3]

Bring damaged firearms to Kane instead of throwing them away.

Repairs are capped at 90% condition — Kane repairs weapons, he doesn't perform miracles. Cost scales with the weapon's value, its current condition, and how much damage needs fixing.

A scuffed starter pistol? Cheap. A heavily damaged high-value rifle? That's going to hurt the wallet.

[h3]💎 Turn Your Jewelry Into Real Value[/h3]
(Your main source of income)

All those watches (not all watches), rings, necklaces, and other valuables you've been hoarding finally have a purpose. Kane buys gold jewelry, silver jewelry, and gemstone pieces of either.

[h3]🚗 Vehicle Delivery[/h3]

Buy a vehicle and Kane handles the logistics — it arrives fueled, keyed, with a spare gas can, spawned near the shop. No second delivery trip required.

[h3]⚖️ Built Around Balance[/h3]

Kane the Merchant runs on one principle: [u]Money Should Feel Valuable.[/u]

The shop gives you a reason to save cash, explore for valuables, make real purchasing decisions, invest in progression, and keep coming back — without turning the game into an unlimited item dispenser.

[u]You're still surviving the apocalypse. Kane's just giving your money somewhere useful to go.[/u]

[h3]Later additions:[/h3]

[b]+Jewel/Money gathering Automation (check images section)[/b]


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Started as something just for me. Then I thought 'why not share it?' — so I cleaned it up and uploaded it. Still actively updated based on feedback, added features, and bug fixes — a passion project built in my free time.[/b]
[h2]Enjoying the mod? drop a like 👍[/h2]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11820670298719541919/065898E8920C013B89120CB1AE0FC316D093EB85/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Supported languages:
English 🇬🇧, Spanish 🇪🇸, Russian 🇷🇺, German 🇩🇪, French 🇫🇷, Italian 🇮🇹, Chinese 🇨🇳, Japanese 🇯🇵
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Supported Gun mods:
[b]Guns of Marz:[/b] 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3722134990
[b]ModernFirearmsSystem:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3633421539
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]Known Limitations[/h3]

[b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] The mod is [b]compatible with most other mods[/b]. The only ones that may cause issues are other gun mods, but support is growing over time.
Kane's Guns ships with support for the vanilla firearms by default. Support for other gun mods is being added as I go, based on what you're using and requesting.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]Q & A[/h3]
Q: Is it safe to add or remove from an existing save?
A: Yes.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[u]This is my first mod, guys — let me know what you think! Feedback, bug reports, and feature ideas are all welcome in the comments.[/u]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]Permissions[/h2]
[b]All rights reserved. This mod — code, artwork, and everything else in it — is not to be copied, reused, repackaged, reuploaded, forked, or redistributed in any form, in this mod or any other, without my explicit written permission first.
If you want to use anything from this mod, ask. Don't just take it.[/b]
Don't reupload this mod itself elsewhere, translated or not, without permission.

[h1]On the art (Important)[/h1]
[b]THIS MOD INCLUDES SOME AI INVOLVEMENT IN THE ARTWORK.[/b] Some visual assets started from AI-generated bases — I'm not claiming otherwise. But every piece in this mod went through real editing, cleanup, and iteration by me before it made it in. That's still my work and my time, and it's covered by the same permissions above.

[sry but I'm not gonna hire a painter just for 2 interaction buttons.]
[Yea, had a few run-ins with the 'it's AI' crowd, don't ask 😂]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]WHY NO MULTIPLAYER?[/h1]
read this: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3786534696/582806564883286097/

3786752882.title: Horse Utility: Mounted Firearms
3786752882.description:
[h1]DLC for Horse Utility Add-on[/h1]

[b]Horse Utility: Mounted Firearms[/b] is an optional gameplay DLC for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3784003967]Horse Utility Add-on[/url]. It adds stationary firearm combat on horseback while preserving Project Zomboid's standard firearm system.

Mount your horse, equip a supported firearm, then aim and fire using the controls you already know.

[b]Updated for Horse Mod 1.1 and Horse Utility Add-on 1.1.[/b]

[h2]Required Base Add-on[/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3784003967][img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17155379523315025566/05B561E9FAF64DCC2593E65DAED648C524E4A482/[/img][/url]

The required Horse Utility Add-on lets you set a horse as your personal mount, build a bond with it, call and track it, add weapon storage to the saddle, and use equipped reins to lead and hitch it.

[h2]What this DLC adds[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mounted aiming with Vanilla handguns, two-handed firearms, and compatible mod firearms
[*]Normal RMB aiming and LMB firing controls
[*]Seated rifle and handgun poses that follow the aiming reticle
[*]Stationary saddle combat within a controlled forward and side aiming sector
[*]Rear aiming is blocked to prevent invalid rider poses and saddle glitches
[*]The horse you are riding is protected from your own shots aka you cannot accidentally shoot it in the head
[*]Reloading, racking, and clearing weapon jams while mounted
[*]Supported ammunition boxes can be opened while mounted
[/list]

[h2]Standard firearm handling remains intact[/h2]
This DLC does not create replacement bullets, fake damage, or custom hit logic. Project Zomboid continues to manage:
[list]
[*]Ammunition and one-round consumption
[*]Magazines, chamber state, spent cases, and weapon jams
[*]Reloading, racking, and unloading
[*]Weapon condition and attachments
[*]Gunshot sounds, targeting, hits, and zombie damage
[/list]

[h2]Mod firearm compatibility[/h2]
Compatible mod firearms are supported when they use Project Zomboid's standard ranged HandWeapon firearm properties and normal attack path.

Tested successfully with Vanilla Firearms Expansion and Guns of Marz using Gunworks Framework. Compatibility with every firearm overhaul cannot be guaranteed.

[h2]How to use[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Mount your horse.
[*]Equip a supported firearm after mounting.
[*]Remain stationary and hold RMB to aim.
[*]Press LMB to fire.
[/olist]

[h2]Current scope[/h2]
[list]
[*]Project Zomboid Build 42.20 or newer
[*]Singleplayer
[*]Mouse and keyboard
[*]Stationary mounted aiming and firing only
[*]Vanilla firearms and compatible standard-system mod firearms
[/list]

Firing while walking, trotting, or galloping is not yet supported. Controller support, multiplayer, saddle quick draw, and horse bonding reactions are planned for future releases. Multiplayer is not supported by this release.

[h2]Required Mods[/h2]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3661336777]Horse Mod[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3784003967]Horse Utility Add-on[/url]
[/list]

Both required mods must be enabled. Horse Utility Add-on continues to work normally without this optional DLC.

3786918614.title: Hands: Stow, Equip, Place [B42]
3786918614.description:
[H1]YOU HAVE HANDS, USE THEM[/H1]

[H3]B42.20.4 MP Tested[/H3]

This exists because I just wanted to grab that duffel bag on the floor and throw it into the trunk of my van.

But in PZ, that's buried in lists, menus, and clicks. It's difficult to justify RP when it just makes more sense to absorb things into your [i]magic face pocket[/i] and spit them back out.

Mods like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3749026793]Carry Visible Items In Hands[/url] help you feel grounded in the world, but that immersion is lost as soon as your dude stands there for a couple of seconds thinking about the table, that baseball bat that's on it, how to hold it in their hand, then finally holding it in their hand.

[b]I just want to use my hands.[/b]

So this mod tries to remove some of the friction between thinking [i]"I want to do that"[/i] and actually doing it. Quickly pick things up. Put them down. Move them around. Throw them. Interact with the world without having to stop and fight the UI.

[i][b]NOTE:[/b] This is not a cheat mod, it doesn't bypass the vanilla interaction time and rules, only the menu slog.[/i]

[h2]Default Hotkeys[/h2]

[h3]Pick Things Up:[/h3]
[b]Alt+LMB[/b]: Equip Primary
[b]Alt+RMB[/b]: Equip Secondary
[b]Double-Click[/b]: Wear, else Equip in Both Hands, else Equip Primary

[i](Clicks cannot be rebound, but can be switched off to use rebindable keyboard hotkeys instead)[/i]

[h3]Put Them Down:[/h3]
[b]Stow:[/b] Alt+E [i](Rebindable)[/i]
Put your primary and secondary equips into the active container
[i](or the floor if no valid container is found)[/i].

[b]Place:[/b] Ctrl+E [i](Rebindable)[/i]
Vanilla "Place" behavior, secondary then primary.

[h2]Config[/h2]
Will update shortly.

Recommended to be paired with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3749026793]Carry Visible Items In Hands[/url]. Compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3395614151]Grab and Drop[/url].

3786993262.title: Total Weight Rebalance
3786993262.description:
[h1]Total Weight Rebalance (TWR)[/h1]
Handcrafted weight rebalance for [b]1,600+ items[/b], adjusted individually for realism and comfortable gameplay.

[h1]HAVING ISSUES? RESUBSCRIBE FIRST, READ THE DESCRIPTION AND CHECK THE SCREENSHOTS.[/h1]
Close the game, unsubscribe and subscribe again, then let Steam finish downloading the mod to ensure you have the latest version before reporting a problem.

Open settings with [b]F8[/b] in a loaded world. Rebind it in [b]Options -> Key Bindings -> Total Weight Rebalance[/b]. [b]No external configuration mod required.[/b]

[h1]Built-in presets[/h1]
[b]TWR[/b] rebalances everyday items, literature, fluid containers, crafting materials, medical supplies, electronics, tools, kitchenware and camping gear. Clothing and weapons remain mostly untouched to preserve balance.

[b]Vanilla[/b] restores the original game weights and container stats.

[h1]Preset system[/h1]
Choose a preset and apply it. Presets include item weights and container stats; save, rename, merge, import or export them independently of your world's settings.

TWR, Vanilla and Workshop presets are read-only. Use [b]Save Current as Preset[/b] to create an editable copy in [b]Zomboid/Lua/TWR_Presets[/b] and transfer it between worlds.

[b]Multiplayer:[/b] only admins can change weights and container stats. The server saves and synchronizes the active state.

[h1]Settings[/h1]
[list]

3787450672.title: LpB Container Signs
3787450672.description:
[h2]A crate's name, written on the crate.[/h2]

Any base ends up with twenty identical crates and cabinets, and finding the one with the ammunition means opening them one at a time. Build 42 can already name a container, but that name only lives in the loot window title. This mod puts it out in the world: a sign nailed, taped or painted onto the object, readable from across the room.

Single player and dedicated servers.

[h2]Writing[/h2]
- Right-click the crate, "Write a name on this", and your character takes the time to write it
- Three styles: a nailed board, a taped note, or painted straight onto the wood
- Needs a pen or a pencil; a paintbrush and a can of paint for the painted style
- The ink takes the colour of the tool: a red pen writes the same red it writes on a map, a can of blue paint paints the same blue as a wall
- Carrying more than one pen, or more than one can? A drop-down in the writing window offers the inks you are actually carrying, and remembers the one you picked for the next crate
- A four-colour pen counts as four: black, red, blue and green, each its own line in that list
- A can of paint loses a use, a pen does not, exactly as vanilla treats a pen used to annotate a map
- A name too long runs onto a second line, and a third, as soon as it outgrows the width of the furniture: the crate decides, not the sign
- Erasing needs no tool at all
- By default, only crates have a sign. A Sandbox option allows this to be extended to all containers, but the display on other types of containers [b]has not been tested[/b].

[h2]Several containers on one tile[/h2]
Each one gets its own entry, top to bottom: the menu reads the way the stack looks. Two stacked crates sharing a name are told apart, "on top" and "at the bottom", and hovering an entry outlines that crate in the world. You never guess which one you are writing on.

[h2]Choosing the side[/h2]
Right-click the crate, "Position" submenu: "Auto", "On the left", "On the right", with a tick against the one in force. On "Auto" the sign goes on the right-hand face and moves round on its own if a wall or another crate comes to block it. The other two nail it to the face you picked and there it stays, whatever happens around it. The choice is stored with the sign, so everyone sees the crate the same way in multiplayer. No tool needed, and the name does not change.

[h2]Works with the vanilla rename[/h2]
A container already renamed from the loot window grows a sign on its own, with nothing to rewrite. The other way round, writing on the crate updates the loot window title. The two never disagree. A sign also survives a move: a wardrobe picked up and put back down keeps its name.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
- Server (sandbox options): a master switch for writing, crates only or every container, whether a tool is required, whether it is spent, maximum length (28 at most), allowed styles, and a safehouse-members-only rule
- Player (native B42 mod options): show signs or not, display radius, opacity, hide while looting
- No key to hold: the sign is part of the scenery. It fades out over the last two tiles of the radius and comes back when you walk up again.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
The sign lives in the object's ModData, which is replicated, rather than in the vanilla container name, which is not. It shows up for other players without a reload. The server revalidates everything: distance, safehouse, tool, length.

[h2]Mod languages[/h2]
English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese

[i]If you’d like to help translate the mod, feel free to contact me. All contributions will be credited![/i]

[h2]Known limitations[/h2]
- Three lines are not always enough: a name at the maximum allowed length, all in capitals, asks for more than a crate face can carry. The sign then widens a little rather than lose letters.
- In multiplayer, a vanilla rename is only visible to the client that made it, until someone writes on it with this mod. A game limitation, not a mod one: right-clicking the crate fixes it.

3788232452.title: Accurate XP Multipliers [B42]
3788232452.description:
[h1][b]WHAT THIS MOD DOES[/b][/h1]
[b]Project Zomboid's vanilla XP Boost labels ("+75%", "+100%", "+125%") are pretty misleading. At level 0, any skill (except Sprinting, Strength and Fitness) only gets 25% of the XP it would at level 1. So what looks like a "+75%" boost isn't a 75% bonus — it's actually a full x4 multiplier, since it raises that base rate to 100%.

Actual XP multipliers:

No boost (level 0): x1 (baseline, 0.25 XP rate)
+75% (level 1): x4 (1.00 XP rate)
+100% (level 2): x5.32 (1.33 XP rate)
+125% (level 3): x6.64 (1.66 XP rate)

This mod corrects those labels into their real multipliers, and factors in Fast/Slow Learner, Crafty and Reluctant Fighter. It also accounts for Sprinting's own skill-specific XP multipliers of x1.25, x1.33 and x1.66 values. 

Works both on the Character Creation screen, Admin/Debug panel and the Skills Panel tooltip, including a new "XP Reduction" label when the combined multiplier drops below x1, localized into all 28 officially supported languages.[/b]

[h2][b]CREDITS[/b][/h2]

This started as an attempt to fix crashes from the [b]"Fix XP View" mod by star[/b], but I ended up fixing a few more issues, adding a couple of things based on my own experience with the game, and making it compatible with the "This Is Your Life" mod.

[b]All credits go to star for his original idea and code. Link (which should still work for B41):
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2341974040

If star ever updates the original mod to fix it, I've got no issue taking this down from the Workshop, just reach out and I'll pull it.[/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]FIXES[/b][/h2]

- Fixed crashes when opening the Skills Panel caused by the original mod.
- Fixed errors caused by the mod that occurred after closing a Skills Panel tooltip and then interacting with other UI-related mods.
- Fixed XP multipliers on the Character Creation screen not accounting for Fast/Slow Learner, Crafty and Reluctant Fighter.
- Fixed a vanilla bug where clicking "Reset Traits" on the Character Creation screen didn't refresh the Major Skills list until another trait was added.
- Fixed correct multipliers not applying to the Admin/Debug panel.

[h2][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]

- [b]Added Crafty trait support[/b] to the multiplier calculation (previously only Reluctant Fighter and Fast/Slow Learner were factored in).

- [b]Skills Panel tooltip now shows[/b] the Fast Learner / Crafty (x 1.3), Slow Learner (x 0.7) and Reluctant Fighter (x 0.75) [b]multiplier on all skills affected by each trait, including their combination[/b].

- [b]Added a new "XP Reduction" label on the Skills Panel tooltip[/b] when the XP multiplier is lower than x1 (e.g. Slow Learner alone at x0.7, or Fast Learner + Reluctant Fighter at x0.98), something neither vanilla nor the original mod do. [b]This is fully localized across all 28 languages the game supports[/b]; translations were done with AI assistance, so if you spot an error in your language, please report it in the comments.

- [b]Renamed the Admin/Debug vanilla menu labels[/b] from "Boost" to "XP Multiplier" and "Multiplier" to "Skill Book XP Multiplier", [b]localized into all officially supported languages[/b].

[h2][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/h2]

[b]✓[/b]  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3773911887][b]This Is Your Life:[/b][/url] Correct multipliers are shown on the Character Creation Screen, or the "Knox County Personnel Assessment" screen as the mod calls it. According to my testing, the origins' XP boosts are not currently working, so they are not accounted for in either the Character Creation screen or the Skills Panel tooltip.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/h1]
[h2]This mod only changes the way XP multipliers are displayed. It does not modify vanilla XP gain[/h2]

Mod ID: accurateXPmultipliers

3788502146.title: ZBPopFix - Fix Zombies Despawning
3788502146.description:
Fixes a bug that makes zombies despawn while pathfinding, you can [url=https://theindiestone.com/forums/topic/99681-42202-zombie-despawn-issue/]read more about it here.[/url]
This is a quick fix based on Dontas' findings, this patch just ignores the newly added clearChunkForReplace method that was added between 42.19.1 and 42.20.3

Made specifically for [b]version 42.20.3[/b] (although should work for any 42.20+). I'll try to keep it up to date until TIS fixes it.

Video showcasing the bug:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=snG9AcbOcjQ

[h1] Installation [/h1]
Subscribe and make sure you have ZombieBuddy installed properly.

[h1] Installation for dedicated server [/h1]
Disclaimer: I haven't tested it myself, this is based on ZombieBuddy's documentation.

1. Copy ZombieBuddy.jar to the root folder of your server, same folder where you have your .bat or .sh start script.
2. Add the java arguments (see below) to your server launch script (ends with a .bat or .sh usually, depending on your OS) or java arguments config.
3. Add ZombieBuddy's and this mod's WorkshopID and ModID to your server.ini file

For Windows servers, you'll need to copy the .dll that comes with ZombieBuddy together with the ZombieBuddy.jar file. Also, the java arguments becomes: -agentlib:zbNative=policy=allow-all,frontend=console --

For Linux servers you'd put "-javaagent:ZombieBuddy.jar=policy=allow-all,frontend=console" under the vmargs in the ProjectZomboid.json

[h1] Q/A [/h1]
[h2] Why ZombieBuddy is required? [/h2]
This is a Java mod and ZombieBuddy is a Java mod loader. What this mod does is not achievable in a standard mod, and while it is possible to make a Java mod by replacing the game's class files, such mods tend to conflict with each other and/or break even on minor game updates. The mod loader solves this problem by injecting code at runtime.
[h2] Can I verify what the mod does and build it myself? [/h2]
Yes, the source code is included with the workshop download.
[h2] Multiplayer support? [/h2]
No clue, but I can't see why it wouldn't work.
[h2] Is it safe to add to or remove from an existing save? [/h2]
Yes.

3790598654.title: TENT Interior

[i]It is heavily inspired by [b]RV Interior[/b]—huge respect to its creator for the original concept.[/i]

    [i]Important: Always make sure to clear out every item stored inside before moving or dismantling the tent.[/i]

    [b]°Alternative Lighting:[/b] If you don't have a generator, you can use propane or oil lamps. Note: This mod allows you to place them directly on the floor.
    [b]°Day/Night Lighting:[/b] Natural light filters in during the day, while nights get pretty dark (though the moon still provides a faint glow).
    [b]°Safety (with a catch):[/b] You're safe from the weather and out of sight, but keep in mind that generator noise or sounds made inside can still attract nearby zombies. So stay alert before stepping out!

I'm working on a fix for a future update, so please avoid combining those actions for now.[/strike] [b]Works fine now![/b]

3790656296.title: NeatUI Equipment [42.20]
3790656296.description:
[h1]🎒 NeatUI Equipment[/h1]
Your character in 3D, surrounded by everything they are wearing. One click on the bag beside your inventory. Built for Build 42 and styled to match NeatUI down to the last rounded corner. 🧡

[h2]👔 The Wardrobe[/h2]
Save an outfit once, put it back on whenever you like — even when the clothes are not on you any more.
[list]
[*] 🔎 It finds every piece: already on you, in your inventory, or in any container within reach
[*] 🎨 Colour and pattern are remembered, so a blue shirt comes back blue
[*] 🎯 An outfit is exact — what it contains goes on, what it does not comes off
[*] 🎒 Your bags are never taken off, and they can be left out of a saved outfit entirely
[*] 💬 Missing a piece? It tells you which one and puts the rest on anyway
[*] 💾 Stored as descriptions, not links — outfits survive a reload and the original garment being destroyed
[/list]

[h2]✨ The panel[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🧍 Your character in 3D, centred, turning as you dress and undress
[*] 🟧 Slots down both sides, the same rounded squares as your hotbar
[*] 👐 Both hands as round slots in the bottom corners
[*] 🧦 Layered clothing shows as small chips beside the slot — click to fold them out
[*] ⌨️ The hotbar below the doll, so you can see what is clipped where
[*] 🌍 Translated into all 26 languages the game ships with
[/list]

[h2]🎛️ Four buttons in the title bar[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🔗 [b]Chain[/b] — unhook the panel, move and resize it freely, click again to snap it back
[*] 👁️ [b]Eye[/b] — hide the equipped section in the inventory list
[*] 👕 [b]Shirt[/b] — strip everything in one press; press again and it all goes back on
[*] 🪝 [b]Hanger[/b] — open the Wardrobe
[/list]

[h2]🖱️ Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Click the bag[/b] beside your inventory to open and close the panel
[*] [b]Drag and drop[/b] to equip, unequip, swap hands or clip to the hotbar
[*] [b]Right-click[/b] any slot for the usual item menu
[*] [b]Drag the title bar[/b] to move the panel once unhooked, the [b]corner grip[/b] to resize it
[*] Assignable hotkey under [i][NeatUI Equipment][/i] in Options → Key Bindings
[*] 🎮 Controller supported — pick the button in Options → Mods
[/list]

[h2]📦 Requirements[/h2]
🔗 [b]NeatUI Framework[/b]

[h2]💾 Compatibility[/h2]
✅ [b]Made for CleanUI.[/b] The bag button lives on the edge of the CleanUI inventory, the panel hangs off it and follows it around, and the slots are Clean HotBar slots — one interface, not two mods sitting side by side.
📐 [b]It matches your inventory.[/b] Hooked on, the panel stretches down to meet the bottom of your inventory window, so resizing CleanUI resizes it too.
🖥️ Client-side code only, so there are no server checksum issues.
🤝 Designed to work alongside the other Neat mods.

3791294616.title: CD: Cats
3791294616.description:
[h1]CD: Cats[/h1]
Cats for Companion Dogs. An optional add-on, and the first one in the family that isn't a dog.

[b]REQUIRES the base mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3740052292]Companion Dogs[/url].[/b] Subscribe to both, enable both in the main-menu Mods list, then fully restart the game so the cat model loads.

[table]
[tr][th]Which version does it run on?[/th][td]Build 42.19 up[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]Do I need anything else?[/th][td]Yes, the base mod Companion Dogs, 0.7.0 or newer[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]Can I add it to a save or a server already running?[/th][td]Yes. Strays spawn in areas you have already explored[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]Does it work on servers?[/th][td]Yes, dedicated and co-op[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]Which languages?[/th][td]Fourteen, same as the base mod[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]How many breeds are there?[/th][td]Five coats here, listed below. Search the Workshop for [b]CD[/b] or [b]Companion Dogs[/b][/td][/tr]
[tr][th]Can my cat die?[/th][td]Only from hunger. The big vet care update will add death from illness and wounds, and it comes switched off by default in the sandbox[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]Can I have more than one animal following me?[/th][td]Not today. An update to improve this is on the roadmap[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h1]The cat[/h1]
A cat is a lookout. It won't attack a zombie, it won't work your livestock and it won't breed with a dog. What it does is notice the dead earlier than any dog in the mod. It is also the most stubborn animal here, and it will wander off after a rat in the middle of whatever you asked it to do.
[url=https://companiondogs.pet/docs/en/breeds.html#5-the-cat-the-first-other-species]>> The cat, in full, in the wiki <<[/url]

[h1]What it's good at[/h1]
[list]
[*]It spots zombies further out than any dog, 25 tiles untrained and 38 with Scent maxed.
[*]Its meow carries half as far as a dog's bark, so the warning doesn't hand out your position.
[*]It goes hunting while you sleep and leaves what it caught at your feet. Worms and crickets from a clumsy cat, mice and rats once it knows the job.
[*]Cat's Eyes, a moodle only the cat has. Pitch dark normally cuts your foraging down to 1.5 tiles, which is useless. A fed, bonded cat nearby puts the small hours back to roughly 60% of your daytime range.
[*]It takes rodents and rabbits, learns Hunting twice as fast and Scent half again as fast. Deer are dog work. Your own chickens and cows are never prey.
[*]Everything from the base mod that applies to it: follow and stay, alerts, needs and loyalty, skills and genes, breeding and kittens, saddlebags, tricks, the kennel, name tags.
[/list]

[h1]What it costs you[/h1]
[list]
[*]No fighting at all. No Combat skill, no Guard, no auto-protect, not even while you're being mauled in front of it. No herding either, so Tend livestock never shows up in its menu.
[*]The worst obedience in the mod, below the Husky. It does unlock all four tricks, just long after any dog would have.
[*]It hunts rodents on its own, whether you want it to or not. Not sure that counts as a cost, but you get no say in it :)
[*]Its loyalty fades half again as fast as a dog's if you neglect it, and it startles easily. A frightened cat stops watching and stops bringing anything home.
[*]Its saddlebag comes out at 2 slots however strong it's born.
[/list]

[h1]Five coats[/h1]
Black, white, orange, calico and tuxedo.
Strays turn up in houses, shops and pet stores. Shops, groceries and diners. Indoors or out. Cats have their own spawn multiplier in the sandbox options, so turning stray dogs down doesn't take the cats with them. Tame one the usual way, feed it until it trusts you.

[h3]Removing the add-on[/h3]
[b][url=https://companiondogs.pet/docs/en/features.html#23-removing-the-mod-from-a-save-read-this-first]>> How to remove the mod from a save <<[/url][/b]

[h1]Credits[/h1]
Animation help by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198351533061]Cerise[/url]. Cat sounds from BigSoundBank / Joseph Sardin. Coats and model work by the author.

[h1]Wiki and Discord[/h1]
Every feature, breed and sandbox option is written up in the wiki, so the answer is very likely already there:
[b][url=https://companiondogs.pet/docs/index.html]>> Companion Dogs Wiki <<[/url][/b]
Bugs, breed suggestions, or just showing off your cat:
[b][url=https://discord.gg/ndyTBFSuAT]>> Join the Discord <<[/url][/b]

[h1]Support[/h1]
If you enjoy the mod, you can buy me a coffee. Thank you!
[url=https://ko-fi.com/M8F72123UE][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/kofi6.png?v=6[/img][/url]

3791686284.title: Vehicle Fluid Logistics Library
3791686284.description:
Do you also like vehicles with water storage tanks?
Would you rather fill them with milk or whiskey?
Would you rather have your favorite PZ cocktail mix on tap?
Ever wanted to find a leftover trailer with some hairdye and mead?
Did you want propane to handle more intuitively - with similar interactions as fluids?
Or rather just drive the Elgin Street Sweeper that actually consumes water?

To keep track what your vehicles have stored in their storage tanks a Fluid Info panel is part of the radial menu and context menu to show and configure your fluid tanks per vehicle (NeatUI patch included) - including a visual fluid composition breakdown per tank.

All this and more you get with this library (and depending on which mods you use a few prepared patches).

[h1]Patches[/h1]
Ready-made patches that put existing vehicle mods on this library:
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3791686779]KI5 Vehicles Patch[/url] - tankers, fire trucks, mounted propane and the Elgin street sweeper
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3791686967]KI5 Campers Patch[/url] - a fresh-water tank per camper trailer, and their propane bottles
[*]Water Trailer Mod - the mod has its own integration and does at this point of time not require a patch.
[/list]

Almost all features of this mod can be configured and/or turned off in sandbox settings.

Library features for patches:
[list]
[*]easy registration of existing fluid tanks with one-line declarations (if you already run another mod that enables water tank mechanics those tanks will be automatically recognized and integrate into the VFluid system without compromising your save)
[*]designate fluid tanks as enforced single-fluid or keep them adaptable and allow mixed fluids as far as vanilla allows mixing fluids in handheld containers
[*]easily definable spawn-rules for fluid-spawn variation -> fire truck always spawns with water-only, no coffee in your firetrucks (unless you explicitly want coffee in your firetrucks)
[*]have a cocktail you always wanted to randomly run into... define it as one of the flavor options with a weight and you might just find a watertrailer (if you have a mod for such) that has a random amount of your favorite cocktail in it... or you are unlucky and find a trailer full of fuel and milk that can't be used and needs to be cleaned first
[/list]

Compatibility:
[list]
[*]compatible with most fluid-enabling mods
[/list]

Honest caveat: I can't draw, so the icons are mostly reused vanilla sprites - trying to find someone to work on some proper art.

[h1]Requirements[/h1]
None. Tanks come from your vehicle mods - anything declaring bulk fluid storage is picked up as it is; without any such vehicle the library simply idles. Removing it later is safe: fluid levels live in the game's own containers and survive, only the extra bookkeeping goes dormant.

Check out my other mod series enabling household appliances (fridges, freezers, ovens,...) and generators as fully functional vehicle parts and containers [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3787451639]HERE[/url].

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
Tested and designed for multiplayer.
Disclaimer: This was not tested with a lot of players around, feedback on potential issues is welcome!

The vehicles in the preview images are from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3776875714]Water Trailer[/url] and KI5's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2969343830]Elgin Street Sweeper[/url] - neither is required, they are just what the library is doing its work on.

No third-party assets.

[i]Created with LLM assistance.[/i]

Workshop ID: 3791686284
Mod ID: VFluidLibNeatUI
Mod ID: VFluidLib

3782613536.title: Zed's Better FPS - B42.20.2 Fix / 42.20.2 修复版
3782613536.description:
[h1]Zed's Better FPS - B42.20.2 Fix / 42.20.2 修复版[/h1]

[b]Fix maintainer / 修复版作者：老余[/b]

[h2]Until the ZombieBuddy author adds me to the local author list, this mod will temporarily disable Java signature verification to ensure that users experiencing network issues or unable to properly access the Steam Workshop can still enable and use the mod normally.[/h2]

[b]English[/b]

This is an [b]unofficial complete replacement[/b] for zed-0xff/ZBBetterFPS on Project Zomboid 42.20.2. Original mod and code by Zed, released under the included MIT License.
[list]
[*]Original Workshop: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3622986450]3622986450[/url]
[*]Original source: [url=https://github.com/zed-0xff/ZBBetterFPS]github.com/zed-0xff/ZBBetterFPS[/url]
[*]Required framework: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619862853]ZombieBuddy 2.3.2+ (3619862853)[/url]
[/list]

[h2]What this fixes[/h2]
The old Patch_IsoMovingObject directly accessed the removed IsoZombie.networkAi field and crashed on 42.20.2. This build uses the current getNetworkCharacterAI() API with a null guard. Streamlined Physics / Rewrite IsoMovingObject.separate is the code path fixed here.

[h2]Installation and conflicts[/h2]
[list=1]
[*]Install and enable ZombieBuddy 2.3.2 or newer.
[*][b]Disable or unsubscribe from the original ZBBetterFPS and BetterFPS_B42.[/b] This mod is a complete replacement, does not depend on the original, and cannot be enabled with either one.
[*]Enable only this 42.20.2 Fix.
[*]Approve the Java Mod when ZombieBuddy prompts you, then fully exit and restart Project Zomboid.
[/list]

[h2]Settings and risks[/h2]
Settings path: [b]Options → Mods → Zed's Better FPS - B42.20.2 Fix / 42.20.2 修复版[/b]. All optimization checkboxes are disabled by default. Enable one at a time and test.
[list]
[*][b]Render Distance:[/b] lower values reduce load but increase pop-in and may affect distant-entity mods; reload the save after changes.
[*][b]Uncapped FPS:[/b] forcing uncapped increases load, heat and power use; forcing capped may affect frame pacing.
[*][b]Optimize IndieGL State:[/b] skips redundant OpenGL state calls; unusual rendering mods may show artifacts.
[*][b]Optimize Sprite Batching:[/b] reduces draw calls; custom rendering/batching mods may conflict.
[*][b]Optimize RingBuffer:[/b] enlarges GPU buffers and batch pools, uses more memory, and [b]requires a full restart[/b] after changing.
[*][b]Optimize Chunk Shaders:[/b] caches shader state; custom terrain shaders may render incorrectly.
[*][b]Optimize 3D Models:[/b] caches model shader data; custom model/shader mods may conflict.
[*][b]Streamlined Physics / Rewrite IsoMovingObject.separate:[/b] rewrites collision/separation logic and is this fix's repaired code path; may alter pushing, bumping or collision behavior with gameplay mods.
[*][b]Instant Zoom:[/b] removes zoom animation and changes visual transitions.
[*][b]Lower CPU Use:[/b] yields CPU time; aggressive modes can reduce responsiveness or FPS.
[/list]

[h2]Scope, signature, and limitations[/h2]
Verified only on PZ 42.20.2 with ZombieBuddy 2.3.2. Use cautiously after future game updates. The JAR is signed by the uploader/user's Steam public author key. It is [b]not Zed's official signature[/b], is not an upstream release, and does not imply upstream endorsement.

[hr][/hr]

[b]中文[/b]

这是 zed-0xff/ZBBetterFPS 面向 Project Zomboid 42.20.2 的[b]非官方完整替代修复版[/b]。原模组与代码作者为 Zed，按随附 MIT License 发布。
[list]
[*]原 Workshop：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3622986450]3622986450[/url]
[*]原始源码：[url=https://github.com/zed-0xff/ZBBetterFPS]github.com/zed-0xff/ZBBetterFPS[/url]
[*]硬依赖：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619862853]ZombieBuddy 2.3.2+（3619862853）[/url]
[/list]

[h2]修复内容[/h2]
旧版 Patch_IsoMovingObject 直接访问已被删除的 IsoZombie.networkAi 字段，会在 42.20.2 崩溃。本版改用当前 getNetworkCharacterAI() API，并加入空值保护。Streamlined Physics / 重写 IsoMovingObject.separate 正是本次修复的代码路径。

[h2]安装与冲突[/h2]
[list=1]
[*]安装并启用 ZombieBuddy 2.3.2 或更高版本。
[*][b]禁用或取消订阅原版 ZBBetterFPS 与 BetterFPS_B42。[/b]本模组是完整替代版，不依赖原版，也不能与二者同时启用。
[*]只启用本 42.20.2 修复版。
[*]ZombieBuddy 首次提示时批准 Java Mod，然后完全退出并重新启动 Project Zomboid。
[/list]

[h2]设置与风险[/h2]
设置路径：[b]选项 → 模组 → Zed's Better FPS - B42.20.2 Fix / 42.20.2 修复版[/b]。所有优化复选项默认关闭，建议逐项启用并测试。
[list]
[*][b]渲染距离：[/b]降低数值可减少负载，但会增加物体突然出现，并可能影响远距离实体模组；修改后需重载存档。
[*][b]无上限 FPS：[/b]强制解除上限会增加负载、温度和功耗；强制限制可能影响帧时间表现。
[*][b]IndieGL 状态优化：[/b]跳过重复 OpenGL 状态调用；特殊渲染模组可能出现画面异常。
[*][b]Sprite Batching 优化：[/b]减少绘制调用；自定义渲染或批处理模组可能冲突。
[*][b]RingBuffer 优化：[/b]扩大 GPU 缓冲区与批次池，增加内存占用，修改后[b]必须完全重启游戏[/b]。
[*][b]区块着色器优化：[/b]缓存着色器状态；自定义地形着色器可能显示异常。
[*][b]3D 模型优化：[/b]缓存模型着色器数据；自定义模型或着色器模组可能冲突。
[*][b]Streamlined Physics / 重写 IsoMovingObject.separate：[/b]改写碰撞与分离逻辑，也是本次修复点；可能改变与其他玩法模组之间的推挤、碰撞或绊倒行为。
[*][b]即时缩放：[/b]移除缩放动画，改变视觉过渡效果。
[*][b]降低 CPU 使用：[/b]让出 CPU 时间；激进模式可能降低响应性或帧率。
[/list]

[h2]适用范围、签名与限制[/h2]
仅针对 PZ 42.20.2 与 ZombieBuddy 2.3.2 完成验证。游戏未来更新后请谨慎使用。JAR 使用上传者/用户自己的 Steam 公开作者密钥签名，[b]不是 Zed 官方签名[/b]，不是上游正式发布，也不代表上游背书。

[h2]署名与许可[/h2]
原作者：Zed / zed-0xff。完整 MIT License 与 Zed 版权已包含在模组 LICENSE 文件中。

[b]Important / 重要：[/b] Steam Required Items cannot be set by workshop.txt. After the first upload, manually add ZombieBuddy item 3619862853 as a Required Item on this item's Workshop page. / workshop.txt 无法设置 Required Items；首次上传后必须在页面手动将 ZombieBuddy 3619862853 添加为 Required Item。

2849467715.title: [42.20MP] Water Goes Bad
2849467715.description:
[h1]Water Goes Bad[/h1]
This mod makes the water still stored in sinks, baths, etc after the water shutoff become unsafe to drink after a customisable amount of time. Off-grid water containers, such as water dispensers, stored water containers, and player plumbed sinks are not affected.
This aims to make keeping track of water more engaging. In Vanilla, stored-up water leaves a near infinite supply of easy safe water even after the water shutoff, making keeping up with thirst trivial.
[h1]Water Drain[/h1]
This mod also features water draining from the taps over time to add further urgency to securing a water source.
[h1]Filters[/h1]
This also introduces the need to filter plumbed taps. You'll need to additionally craft and install a filter after plumbing a tap, unless the source has safe water (not rain).
[h1]Customisability[/h1]
Sandbox variables allow you to customise how many days after the water shutoff the water becomes tainted (including instantly). The filtering and water drain features can be turned off entirely, and the rate of drain can be changed.
