3777752751.title: [B42.20] Bandits Fix Plus - Loot, Radar, Companions and Stealth
3777752751.description:
A bugfix and stability patch for [b]Bandits[/b], written from the Build 42.20 source.

The community already had one of these - [b]BanditsFix[/b] by MCZGabriel - but it targets 42.13.x and has not been updated since February. This is a fresh implementation for 42.20, with the same goal and a few fixes it never had. Credit to MCZGabriel for the idea; none of that mod's code is used here.

Safe to add to a world already in progress, safe to remove. Every fix has its own switch in the in-game Mod Options panel.
[b]Dedicated servers:[/b] add it to the server's mod list as well, not only to the clients. Bandits are dressed and their corpse loot is decided on the server, so the clothing fix has to run there. Everything else is client side and works either way.

[h2]The warning arrow actually works[/h2]
Bandits aims the red "hostiles nearby" arrow exactly once, at the tile the group spawned on, and then never touches it again - it does not even turn as you walk around, and it hangs there for half an hour after you have killed everybody.
Now the arrow points at the nearest living bandit's [i]current[/i] position, and the warning disappears the moment there is nothing left alive to warn you about.

[h2]Corpses keep their clothes[/h2]
Bandits are zombies wearing a costume. They are dressed with item visuals - graphics with no real item behind them - and the code that was supposed to turn those into real clothing on the body is still sitting in Bandits itself, commented out. This puts it back.

It puts it back in the right place, which took two goes to get right. When the game builds a corpse it does not copy the clothing across: it hands the corpse the character's own worn-items list, and Bandits empties that list every tick to draw its NPCs. So anything added to the corpse's [i]inventory[/i] was lootable but invisible - the body still rendered bare, because a body draws what it is wearing, not what it is carrying. The corpse's clothing is now rebuilt from the graphics the bandit was actually drawn with: one garment per thing it wore, right slot, right colour, on the body and lootable off it.

Nothing is duplicated. Clothing the bandit is visibly wearing is no longer also added to the corpse's inventory, and the rebuild starts by clearing the list rather than appending to it.

[h2]Bandits on your map[/h2]
Hostile bandits show as red dots on the world map and the minimap, so a warning arrow is not the only thing you have to go on. Companions can show too, in blue.
All of it is optional and all of it is in Mod Options under [b]World map[/b]: turn the dots off entirely, or keep the world map and clear only the minimap. Server owners get the same four switches as sandbox options, each a three-state number - [b]-1[/b] leaves it to each player, [b]0[/b] forces it off for everyone, [b]1[/b] forces it on. [b]-1[/b] is the default and changes nothing.

[h2]Companions stop wrecking your base[/h2]
Most of the demolition code checks whether the NPC is hostile first. Three branches do not: a barricaded door, a locked double door, and any other locked door. That is why your own ally walks up to your front door and chops it down. Friendly NPCs now leave player-built walls, doors, windows and barricades alone, and you can tighten that to "never damage anything" or turn it off entirely.
Hostile raiders still break in. That is the whole point of them.

[h2]No more running on the spot[/h2]
A light watchdog measures whether an NPC on a move order is actually covering ground. If it has not moved for a few seconds its path is dropped and it picks a new goal. No teleporting, no forced pathfinding.

[h2]Soft guard posts[/h2]
A guard post is one exact tile, and pathfinding does not reliably land on one exact tile - so the companion is never quite "at" its post, goes back to following you, walks away, takes the post again, forever. Posts now have a tolerance of a tile or two, and a post somebody is already holding does not count as free. Nobody gets snapped into position.

[h2]Bandits do not know where you are[/h2]
You are supposed to have the advantage of knowing where they are. They should not have the same advantage over you.
Out of the box a Tracker hears you through walls from fifty-five tiles away, and in multiplayer the engine's own zombie AI keeps pathing bandits straight to players across the map.
Now they find you the way zombies do: line of sight, sound at close range, or getting shot. They also remember where they last saw you and search there for a while, instead of forgetting you the instant you step behind a wall - so breaking line of sight is worth doing, and firefights do not fall apart.
Gunshots and alarms still pull them in. Hearing a rifle three streets away and coming to look is fine; knowing which room you are standing in is not.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
[b]Bandits[/b] by Slayer (Workshop 3268487204) is required.
The way the corpse clothing is repaired - rebuilding it on the body after the game has created the corpse, instead of registering items in advance - was worked out by [b]Scarecrow the Spud King[/b] for [b][NBF] Naked Bandits Fix[/b]. No code from that mod is used here, but the idea is theirs and it is the right one. Run one or the other, not both: they repair the same thing.
Do not run this together with the old BanditsFix - they patch the same things.

[h2]Works with the companion mods[/h2]
[b]True Companions[/b] and [b]Bandits Creator[/b] are both supported, and were checked against line by line rather than assumed.
Nothing here overwrites a function either of them overwrites. The stealth rules apply only to NPCs that are actually hunting you - a companion following you, standing in a passive stance or knocked down is never treated as a threat, so orders and following keep working when you break line of sight. Bandits Creator is untouched: nothing in this mod hooks a context menu or sits anywhere in the debug spawn path.

Available in every language the game ships with. Corrections from native speakers are very welcome, drop them in the discussions and I will fold them in.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
Does not alter the base AI - every patch keeps a reference to the original function and calls it, so with a fix switched off the behaviour is bit for bit the base mod's.
Does not duplicate loot. Low performance impact: the heavy work runs a few times a second, not every frame.
When a bandit is infected and killed by a zombie, a temporary zombie can appear without clothes; killing it restores the real body with its loot. That is how Bandits works internally and it is not a bug.

Mod ID: BanditsFixPlus

3778201332.title: Hydrocraft Reinvented [B42]
3778201332.description:
[h1]⚙️ Hydrocraft. Reborn for Build 42.[/h1]

The legendary B41 mega-mod didn't survive the trip to Build 42 — so it was rebuilt from the ground up. Not a quick port: every recipe was translated to the native B42 craftRecipe system (input/output blocks, vanilla tool tags, B42 fluids, xpAward instead of Lua XP hooks), and every wearable item was migrated to the new B42 item class system. No legacy shims, no error spam, no black screens.

[b]📦 What's inside[/b]
[list]
[*] 5,196 items and 3,620 recipes — animals and dogs, MRE rations, electronics, mining, beekeeping, weaving, chemistry, hundreds of dishes and drinks
[*] 121 fixing schemes
[*] Full Russian localization: every item, recipe and crafting category
[/list]

[b]🧭 Port philosophy — complement, don't duplicate.[/b] Build 42 finally has proper smithing, pottery, masonry, glassmaking and butchering — so Hydrocraft steps aside there and adds everything vanilla still doesn't have. Built for the ZZZ Industrial Collection; plays nicely with Industrial Revolution and Factory Pieces.

[h1]⚙️ Hydrocraft. Возрождён для Build 42.[/h1]

Легендарный мега-мод B41 не пережил переезда на Build 42 — поэтому он был пересобран с нуля. Это не механический порт: каждый рецепт переведён на нативную систему craftRecipe (input/output-блоки, ванильные теги инструментов, жидкости B42, xpAward вместо Lua-хуков), а вся носибельная экипировка мигрирована на новую систему классов предметов B42. Без легаси-костылей, без простыней ошибок, без чёрных экранов.

[b]📦 Что внутри[/b]
[list]
[*] 5 196 предметов и 3 620 рецептов — животные и собаки, MRE-пайки, электроника, шахты, пасека, ткачество, химия, сотни блюд и напитков
[*] 121 схема починки
[*] Полная русская локализация: все предметы, рецепты и категории крафта
[/list]

[b]🧭 Философия порта — дополнить, не задублировать.[/b] В Build 42 наконец-то есть настоящее кузнечество, гончарство, кладка, стекло и разделка — там Hydrocraft уступает дорогу ванили и добавляет всё, чего в ней по-прежнему нет. Создан для сборки ZZZ Industrial Collection; дружит с Industrial Revolution и Factory Pieces.

Original mod by Hydromancerx, B41 maintenance by the Hydrocraft Continued team. B42 port by hombrehumor.

3778511497.title: Skully's Zombie Collision [B42.20+]
3778511497.description:
[h1]Please rate![/h1]

[h1][u]Skully's Zombie Collision[/u][/h1][h3]A mod that adds proper collision between zombies, preventing them from phasing through each other while chasing the player.[/h3]
[i]Internally tested and balanced. Reported by other players to work in multiplayer for extended sessions without issues (see comments for feedback).[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][u]The issue:[/u][/h2]
In vanilla, zombies usually go through one another when they are chasing you, especially if you hit or push the zombie at the front.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fZBidHh.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][u]The solution:[/u][/h2]
This mod aims to fix the lack of collision that zombies have when they are chasing the player in a way that [b][u]doesn't ruin your performance[/u][/b]. It only considers the zombies close to you and only a small amount, which is what matters. [b][u]Whether you have 10 zombies or 100 zombies around you, the additional performance strain remains roughly the same.[/u][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EGzIBNr.gif[/img]

3778709615.title: [B42.20.3] Simple Belt Flashlight+ (Better Flashlights Compatible)
3778709615.description:
[h1][B42.20] Simple Belt Flashlight+[/h1]
[b]Put your flashlight on your belt and keep both hands free.[/b]

[h2]Recent Update - 1.0.4[/h2]
Fixed an existing-save timing issue that could remove a flashlight from its hotbar slot while loading. Supported attached flashlights are now migrated before the vanilla hotbar validates them.

Legacy attachment models now move with one atomic attachment update instead of a temporary detach and reattach. This preserves the slot, battery and on or off state without custom network packets or per-tick synchronization.

All mod-owned Lua and script paths are now lowercase for B42.20.3 multiplayer checksum compatibility. ScriptManager item definitions are no longer rewritten during normal hotbar refreshes.

[h2]Important multiplayer upgrade cleanup[/h2]
The [code]SFoB_Attachments.txt[/code] black-screen error belongs to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3625933422]old Workshop item 3625933422[/url]. The old and new packages share the [code]FixedLightOnBeltAF[/code] Mod ID, so clients and servers must not keep both packages installed.

[list=1]
[*]Close Project Zomboid and stop the server completely.
[*]Unsubscribe from Workshop item [code]3625933422[/code] on every client and remove it from the server.
[*]Remove [code]3625933422[/code] from [code]WorkshopItems[/code] and keep this package, [code]3778709615[/code].
[*]Keep [code]Mods=FixedLightOnBeltAF[/code] unchanged.
[*]If Steam leaves it behind, delete only the stale [code]steamapps/workshop/content/108600/3625933422[/code] folder, then let Steam redownload the active mod list.
[/list]

Keep [code]DoLuaChecksum=true[/code]. Disabling checksum validation hides a mismatched installation instead of fixing it.

Added optional compatibility with Plysken Attachments Reborn 1.6.0. Flashlights using this mod's attachment types can now use Plysken backpack flashlight slots without either mod overwriting the other's item types or slot mappings. The integration is load-order independent and does nothing when Plysken is not installed.

Added optional, passive multiplayer diagnostic logging for investigating remote flashlight visibility. It is disabled by default and never sends extra network packets or changes item state.

This mod lets you attach supported flashlights to the left or right side of your belt. The flashlight stays on your belt while you turn it on and off with its normal hotbar slot key.

[b]Better Flashlights is supported.[/b] The mod is optional, so Simple Belt Flashlight+ also works without it. When Better Flashlights is installed, all 13 regular handheld flashlights gain proper left and right belt support.

[h2]How to use[/h2]
[list=1]
[*]Wear a belt with an available slot.
[*]Right-click a supported flashlight in your inventory.
[*]Choose Attach, then Belt Left or Belt Right.
[*]Press the number shown on its hotbar slot to turn the flashlight on or off.
[/list]

The flashlight stays attached while it is running. Battery drain, battery insertion and battery removal continue to work normally. Angled flashlights can also be attached to supported webbing slots.

[h2]Existing saves[/h2]
You do not need to start a new world.

This mod keeps the original [code]FixedLightOnBeltAF[/code] Mod ID. If your save already uses the old Simple Belt Flashlight mod, unsubscribe from or remove the old Workshop package first, then install this one.

Flashlights already stored in your inventory, bags inside other bags, containers or hotbar slots are updated automatically. Flashlights already attached to a belt keep their slot, battery and on or off state.

If the save has never used a belt flashlight mod before, enable this mod once from [b]Load > More > Choose Mods[/b].

Do not keep the old and new Workshop packages installed at the same time.

[h2]Better Flashlights support[/h2]
The following 13 regular Better Flashlights items are supported:

[list]
[*]BF_EgenerexLite, BF_OldFlashlight, BF_SpiffoLite
[*]HandTorch_Army1, HandTorch_Army2, HandTorch_CK_LED, HandTorch_ManLite
[*]Torch1, Torch2, Torch3, Torch4, Torch5, Torch6
[/list]

Torch7, TorchArmy1 and TorchArmy2 are weapon flashlights, so their weapon behavior is left unchanged. BF_HeadLight is a helmet light and is also left unchanged.

Better Flashlights can load before or after this mod.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*]Project Zomboid Build 42.20.3
[*]Vanilla flashlights
[*]Better Flashlights
[*]Authentic Z flashlight items
[*]Plysken Attachments Reborn 1.6.0
[*]Singleplayer
[*]Multiplayer
[*]Dedicated servers
[*]Existing saves
[/list]

[h2]Multiplayer note[/h2]
Belt attachment and flashlight activation use the normal game synchronization paths.

Remote flashlight visibility is being investigated after player reports of lights disappearing for other players over time. Build 42.20 also contains upstream changes to remote flashlight synchronization, and Better Flashlights projected beams may still disappear at long range. This update does not add speculative synchronization traffic.

[h2]Reporting a multiplayer light issue[/h2]
For a temporary diagnostic session, enable [code]Simple Belt Flashlight+ > Enable multiplayer diagnostic logging[/code] in the server sandbox options, restart the server and reproduce the issue. Disable it again after testing.

Please include:
[list]
[*][code]C:\Users\you\Zomboid\console.txt[/code] from both players
[*]The dedicated or host server console log
[*][code]C:\Users\you\Zomboid\mods\default.txt[/code]
[*]The exact Project Zomboid build and flashlight item name
[*]The exact steps and approximate time before the light disappeared
[/list]

Diagnostic lines start with [code][SBFPlus:diag][/code]. They contain numeric online and item IDs but no player names.

Server owners replacing the old mod can keep:

[code]Mods=FixedLightOnBeltAF[/code]

Replace the old numeric WorkshopItems entry with the Workshop ID shown on this page. If Better Flashlights is also installed, keep [code]BetterFlashlightsFixed[/code] and Workshop item [code]3420478458[/code] in the server configuration.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
Based on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3625933422]Simple Belt Flashlight[/url] by RazpyPineapple, with permission to edit and republish the source package.

Better Flashlights compatibility is made for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3420478458]Better Flashlights[/url] by Slobodskoy.

Compatibility work and packaging by ACE.

Better Flashlights models and textures are not included or redistributed.

Workshop ID: 3778709615
Mod ID: FixedLightOnBeltAF

3779211885.title: Tanks Have Propane - Unofficial Fixes (B42.20)
3779211885.description:
[h1]Lets you refill at Gas2Go stations, not just Fossoil[/h1]
I did not make Tanks Have Propane. All credit goes to [b]Azexor[/b]. This adds two missing lines.

Original mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3676347667]Tanks Have Propane (B42)[/url]

[h1]The problem[/h1]
Tanks Have Propane says it works at both Fossoil and Gas2Go stations. In practice only the red Fossoil tanks respond — right-click the big white Gas2Go tank and there is no refill option at all.

The mod recognises tanks by their artwork, and the Gas2Go tank uses a different set of artwork that was never added to its list. It is a simple oversight, not something the 42.20 update broke.

[h1]After installing[/h1]
The white Gas2Go tanks now work exactly like the red Fossoil ones. Walk up, right-click the tank, refill your propane tank or blowtorch. Nothing else changes.

[h1]Good to know[/h1]
[list]
[*]Subscribe alongside the original. It does nothing on its own.
[*]You do not need my other patch mods for this one to work.
[*]Unsubscribe once Azexor updates the original.
[*]Safe to add to a save already in progress, and safe to remove again.
[*]Nothing from the original mod is copied or replaced — this only adds to it, so all of Azexor's own updates keep working normally.
[/list]

[h1]For the author[/h1]
The two names to add to PropaneTankSprites are [b]location_shop_gas2go_01_66[/b] and [b]location_shop_gas2go_01_67[/b]. Happy to take this down whenever you add them.

3780683663.title: Cye's Push Doors! [SP/MP]
3780683663.description:
[h1][B42] Cye's Push Doors![/h1]
[h3]Turn ordinary doors into situational survival tools.[/h3]

Cye's Push Doors! adds physical consequences to opening and closing doors when living zombies or players are directly behind them.

Impacts can damage, stagger or knock targets down according to Strength, Fitness, arm strain, door type, material, durability and the number of targets. The mechanic complements vanilla combat without replacing normal door interaction.

[h1]Mod Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Physical door impacts:[/b] opening or closing a door can damage, stagger or knock down valid targets behind it.
[*][b]Character-based power:[/b] Strength controls damage, target capacity and knockdown potential, while Fitness controls arm strain gain.
[*][b]Progressive Muscle Strain:[/b] they apply from 5, 12, and 20 points of muscle tension in both arms and delay repeated impacts. Level 20 blocks the effects of the hits.
[*][b]Door-specific behavior:[/b] standard, glass, reinforced, resistant, scrap, double, garage and sliding doors use different damage, resistance and wear rules.
[*][b]Meaningful durability:[/b] impacts wear doors according to Strength, material, structure and affected targets. Garage doors can also suffer structural failure.
[*][b]Multiple target support:[/b] eligible impacts can affect several standing or crawling zombies according to Strength and door type.
[*][b]Player interactions:[/b] damage and knockdown against other players can be configured independently by the host.
[*][b]Optional feedback:[/b] local impact sounds and visual reactions, global server control and automatic Combat Text support when available.
[*][b]17 Sandbox controls[/b] for damage, targets, knockdown, door wear, garage behavior, arm strain, player impacts and feedback.
[*]Supports [b]single-player, co-op and multiplayer[/b] with no mandatory dependencies.
[/list]

[i]Doors continue to open and close normally. Recovery only controls when another modified impact may occur.[/i]

[h2]v1.0.X – Release[/h2]
[list]
[*]Introduced the complete door-impact framework for single-player and server-authoritative multiplayer.
[*]Added validation for living zombies and players directly behind a moving door, preventing unrelated entities from receiving impact effects.
[*]Added dedicated handling for standard doors, door materials, double doors, garage doors, sliding glass doors and crawling zombies.
[*]Added Strength and Fitness scaling for damage, knockdown, affected targets, door wear and Muscle Strain.
[*]Added progressive strain penalties and recovery between successful impacts to limit repeated attacks without restricting vanilla door use.
[*]Added configurable player damage, player knockdown and synchronized server Sandbox rules.
[*]Added optional impact feedback, Combat Text integration and English, Spanish and Spanish (Mexico) localization.
[/list]

[b]Enjoying the mod?[/b] [i]If Push Doors! improved your experience, leave a positive rating or add it to your favorites to help other players find it. [b]Thanks for the support![/b][/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r2Hwk6e.gif[/img]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]

- Designed exclusively for [b]Project Zomboid Build 42.20+[/b]; not compatible with Build 41.
- Combat Text support is optional and does not become a required dependency.
- May conflict with mods that replace door interaction, door state, durability, zombie reactions or related combat systems.
- A full game or server restart is recommended after changing the mod list.

[b]Multiplayer and existing saves[/b]

- Safe to add to or remove from existing saves; the mod adds no persistent world data.
- Supports single-player, co-op and dedicated multiplayer servers.
- Gameplay balance and player-impact rules come from the active world or server Sandbox profile.
- Impact feedback remains a local player option unless the host hides individual controls and enforces the global setting.

Report issues in [b]Discussions → Bug Reports & Issues[/b]. Include your game version, Push Doors! Sandbox settings, steps to reproduce, other active mods and [i]console.txt[/i] whenever possible.

3780938346.title: Under the Hood [B42] [BETA]
3780938346.description:
[h1]🔧 UNDER THE HOOD[/h1]
[h2]A Complete Vehicle Maintenance Overhaul for Project Zomboid Build 42[/h2]

[b]Your car is more than an Engine Condition bar.[/b]

Under the Hood turns Project Zomboid's vehicles into machines that need [b]maintaining, diagnosing and repairing[/b].

Fluids degrade. Filters clog. Belts wear out. Hoses burst. Brakes lose pressure. Cooling systems leak. Ignition parts fail. Problems develop gradually — and the better your Mechanics skill, the more you understand them.

[b]Maintain it. Diagnose it. Repair it. Or keep driving and deal with the consequences.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]⚙️ SANDBOX SETTINGS[/h1]

Three settings on an [b]Under the Hood[/b] page, set at world creation:

[list]
[*] [b]Maintenance Wear Rate[/b] — how fast oil, filters, belts and fluids wear out. 0.25x to 2x.
[*] [b]Found Vehicle Condition[/b] — how worn abandoned cars are when you first find them.
[*] [b]Breakdown Frequency[/b] — how often hoses burst, belts snap and brake lines leak.
[/list]

Defaults are today's balance; an existing save keeps what it started with.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🔧 WHAT IT ADDS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Engine oil, viscosity grades, formulations, condition, contamination, filters and oil pressure
[*] Coolant level and condition, Radiator, Water Pump, Thermostat, Radiator Cap
[*] Upper and Lower Radiator Hoses that wear, leak and burst
[*] Head Gasket faults and internal coolant loss
[*] Brake Fluid, hydraulic pressure, trapped air, leaks and Master Cylinder service
[*] Drive Belt wear, slipping, squealing and snapping
[*] Starter, Alternator, Battery and charging-system diagnostics
[*] Heater Core, Blower Motor, Cabin Filter, cabin air quality, A/C Compressor, Condenser, Refrigerant and leaks
[*] Spark Plugs, Ignition Coil, Distributor and Engine Air Filter
[*] Fuel Filter, Fuel Pump, Carburetor and Fuel Injection
[*] Automatic Transmission, Manual Gearbox, Clutch and Power Steering
[*] Recoverable fluids and salvageable donor parts that keep their condition
[*] Per-cylinder compression diagnostics
[*] VDA-93 Diagnostic Reader with fault codes and Live Data
[*] Persistent vehicle Service History
[*] Full localization framework for community translations
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🛠️ A REAL MAINTENANCE SYSTEM[/h1]

Under the Hood isn't built around one giant hidden "vehicle condition" number. Different systems fail for different reasons.

A vehicle can have perfect engine condition but badly worn piston rings. Healthy coolant but a failing Water Pump. A full brake reservoir with air in the lines. Good compression overall with one or two weak cylinders.

The goal is to make maintaining a vehicle feel like [b]actually owning a machine[/b], not repairing one condition bar.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🔍 MECHANICS SKILL ACTUALLY MATTERS[/h1]

The mod does not hand you every exact number up front.

An inexperienced survivor might only notice [i]"something doesn't seem right."[/i] An experienced mechanic reads exact fluid levels and condition, failed components, leak severity and source, cooling, brake and ignition faults, weak cylinders, and the cause of poor engine health.

[b]Your Mechanics skill changes what your character actually understands about the vehicle.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🧪 PER-CYLINDER COMPRESSION TESTING[/h1]

On supported vehicles, compression is derived from real mechanical faults — Piston Ring wear, Head Gasket failure and overheat damage — rather than one engine-wide percentage.

[b]Mechanics 0–2[/b] — general impressions only, no cylinder diagnosis and no PSI.
[b]Mechanics 3–6[/b] — identify weak cylinders and uneven compression, exact PSI hidden.
[b]Mechanics 7+[/b] — read individual cylinder PSI and reach stronger conclusions.

Vehicles with no known cylinder layout fall back to an engine-wide report rather than inventing information.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]📟 VDA-93 DIAGNOSTIC READER[/h1]

The [b]VDA-93 Vehicle Diagnostic Analyzer[/b] gives skilled survivors another way to read the car:

[list]
[*] [b]CODES[/b] — current detected faults
[*] [b]STORED[/b] — previously recorded problems
[*] [b]LIVE DATA[/b] — live vehicle and engine information
[/list]

It does not replace Mechanics skill: low-skill characters get limited information, experienced mechanics read more specific faults. It also works from the driver's seat for supported scans.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🛑 BRAKES, COOLING & LUBRICATION[/h1]

[b]Brakes[/b] are their own hydraulic system: fluid level and condition, trapped air, leaks, Master Cylinder condition, bleeding, draining, refilling, inspections and warnings. Neglected brakes are not just a warning row — [b]they change how well the vehicle stops[/b].

[b]Cooling[/b] models leaks, pressure, hoses that degrade and burst, Head Gasket problems and overheating. Pressure testing helps a skilled mechanic locate the loss.

[b]Lubrication[/b] models oil level and condition, viscosity grades, Conventional / Synthetic Blend / Full Synthetic, wrong-viscosity penalties, mixing, filter clogging, pressure and contamination.

Using the wrong oil may not immediately kill the engine. But over time, the engine remembers how you treated it.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]⚡ DRIVE BELT & ELECTRICAL[/h1]

Battery condition and charge, Starter, Alternator, and full charging and starting diagnosis.

The Drive Belt is a real service component that can wear, squeal, slip and snap. Removed belts retain their actual mechanical state.

[b]Taking a snapped belt off and reinstalling it does not magically repair it.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🔩 SALVAGE & RECOVERY[/h1]

Recover usable Engine Oil, Coolant and Power Steering Fluid. Recovered fluid keeps its condition rather than becoming new, and mixing blends condition honestly.

Components can be pulled from donor vehicles and reused, keeping their condition and fault state. A wreck might never drive again, [b]but its Radiator, Starter, Alternator or Water Pump might keep yours going.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]📋 SERVICE WINDOW & HISTORY[/h1]

Inspect and service through a dedicated Service Window with tabs for Overview, Lubrication, Cooling, Electrical, HVAC, Tune-Up, Fuel System, Brakes and Service History.

Major maintenance is recorded on the vehicle itself, so Service History survives reloads, other players working on it, and the vehicle changing owners.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🌍 TRANSLATION SUPPORT[/h1]

Under the Hood includes a complete Build 42 translation framework covering the Service Window, diagnostics, scanner, items, fluids, menus, reports and warnings.

Community translators can add languages through [b]media/lua/shared/Translate/[/b]. The included English files are the template, and missing entries safely fall back to English.

[b]If you'd like to translate Under the Hood into your language, you're very welcome to contribute.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]💾 SAVES, MULTIPLAYER & COMPATIBILITY[/h1]

[b]Existing saves are supported.[/b] New state is added; the mod does not reroll established vehicle state because it updated.

Service actions validate their requirements authoritatively, including skill and working position.

[list]
[*] Single Player — ✅
[*] Hosted Multiplayer — ✅
[*] Dedicated Multiplayer — ✅ Supported / actively tested
[/list]

Designed for broad vehicle-mod compatibility, falling back safely where reliable vehicle data is unavailable. Invasive overhauls of the same systems may conflict.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]⚗️ BETA — ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT[/h1]

Development continues, focused less on new systems and more on making the existing ones feel physical.

Found something weird? Please use the Workshop bug-report discussion, and say what you were doing, the topology (Singleplayer / Hosted / Dedicated), the vehicle, and any console.txt error.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🔧 MAINTAIN • DIAGNOSE • REPAIR • SURVIVE[/h1]

[b]Your vehicle isn't just transportation anymore.

It's another machine keeping you alive.[/b]

Workshop ID: 3780938346
Mod ID: RealisticVehicleMechanics

3782014758.title: Gunworks Fix
3782014758.description:
[h1]Gunworks Fix[/h1]

An unofficial multiplayer patch for the [b]Gunworks[/b] weapon framework, the mod that MarzGuns and other weapon packs are built on.

It contains no files from Gunworks. It is a small standalone mod that loads afterwards and corrects a handful of Lua functions. Because the problems are in the framework, fixing it here fixes every pack that uses it.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]What it fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Ammo counts that never update[/b]
Unload a magazine and the number does not move. Reload a firearm and it still reads the old count.

[*][b]The wrong ammunition going into a firearm[/b]
On guns that take loose rounds — shotguns, revolvers, lever actions — choosing a special round applies its statistics but chambers the default round instead. If you do not carry that default round, nothing loads at all.

[*][b]Loading that stops before it starts[/b]
With your ammunition in a backpack rather than your main inventory, loading a chosen round finished immediately without loading anything.

[*][b]Magazines piling up in your inventory[/b]
Every reload animation could leave a spare magazine behind.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Installing[/h1]

[b]Required on the server and on every player.[/b] Most of the affected code runs client-side, so installing it only on the server will not fix anything.

List it after the framework:

[code]Mods=...;SWMG;...;MarzGuns;GunworksFix[/code]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Gunworks (SWMG) is required.[/b] On its own this mod does nothing.
[*]Save-safe. Remove it at any time and stock behaviour returns.
[*]No weapon statistics, recipes or balance are changed.
[*]Nothing runs on a timer. The performance cost is effectively zero.
[*]A magazine already showing a wrong count corrects itself next time you load or unload it.
[*]Spare magazines already in your inventory are [b]not[/b] removed. There is no reliable way to tell a leftover apart from a real magazine, so deleting them automatically would be dangerous. Drop them by hand.
[*]Each fix can be switched off individually in [i]shared/GunworksFix/Core.lua[/i].
[/list]

[b]One compatibility preference[/b] ships with the fixes. Packs often add their own round for a calibre vanilla already has — MarzGuns does for eight, under the same item name — so menus show two identical rows and your ammunition splits across two item types. The vanilla round is now listed first and used by automatic reloads, so less is lost if you remove the pack later. Rounds with no vanilla equivalent (armour piercing, hollow point, subsonic) are untouched; nothing is renamed or removed. Toggle: [i]PREFER_VANILLA_AMMO[/i].

[b]Known limitation:[/b] the radial menu keeps its handlers as file-local functions, which no other mod can replace. The firearm case is still covered — the chosen round is remembered on the weapon and used as the default — but indirectly.

Should the framework fix these itself, this mod becomes unnecessary. Thanks to the Gunworks-gang for the framework, and to everyone building on it. This patch exists because it is worth keeping.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Gunworks Fix[/h1]

MarzGuns など多くの銃 MOD の土台になっている武器フレームワーク [b]Gunworks[/b] の、マルチプレイでの不具合を修正する非公式パッチです。

Gunworks 本体のファイルは含みません。読み込み後にいくつかの Lua 関数を修正する独立した MOD です。問題はフレームワーク側にあるため、Gunworks を使う銃 MOD すべてに効果があります。

[hr][/hr]

[h1]直る不具合[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]弾数の表示が更新されない[/b]
マガジンから弾を抜いても数字が変わらない。銃をリロードしても古い数のまま。

[*][b]銃に違う弾が装填される[/b]
弾を1発ずつ込める銃（ショットガン、リボルバー、レバーアクションなど）で特殊弾を選ぶと、性能だけその弾になり、実際に装填されるのは既定の弾です。既定の弾を持っていないと何も装填されません。

[*][b]装填が始まる前に終わる[/b]
弾をバックパックに入れていると、選んだ弾の装填が何もせず即座に完了扱いになっていました。

[*][b]マガジンがインベントリに溜まる[/b]
リロードのたびに余分なマガジンが残ることがありました。
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]導入方法[/h1]

[b]サーバーと参加者全員の両方に必要です。[/b] 問題のあるコードの大部分はクライアント側で動くため、サーバーだけでは直りません。

フレームワークより後ろに並べてください。

[code]Mods=...;SWMG;...;MarzGuns;GunworksFix[/code]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]注意事項[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Gunworks (SWMG) が必須です。[/b] 単体では何もしません。
[*]セーブデータを壊しません。いつでも外せます。
[*]武器性能・レシピ・バランスは変更していません。
[*]常時動く処理はありません。負荷はほぼゼロです。
[*]既に表示がおかしいマガジンは、次に装填か排出をした時点で直ります。
[*]既にインベントリにある余分なマガジンは[b]削除しません[/b]。残骸と本物を確実に見分ける方法がなく、自動削除は危険なためです。手で処分してください。
[*]各修正は [i]shared/GunworksFix/Core.lua[/i] で個別に無効化できます。
[/list]

[b]互換性のための設定[/b]も同梱しています。銃 MOD はバニラにある口径の弾を独自に追加しがちで、MarzGuns では8口径がバニラ弾と同じ表示名です。そのためメニューに同じ行が2つ並び、弾が2種類に分散します。バニラ弾を先に表示し、自動リロードでも優先するようにしました。MOD を外したときの影響も減ります。バニラに対応がない独自弾（徹甲弾・ホローポイントなど）は変更していません。改名も削除もしません。[i]PREFER_VANILLA_AMMO[/i] で無効化できます。

[b]既知の制限:[/b] ラジアルメニューは処理をファイルローカル関数として持つため差し替えられません。銃の弾種は、選んだ弾を武器に記憶させて既定値に使う形で対応しています。

Gunworks 側で修正されればこの MOD は不要になります。素晴らしいフレームワークを公開されている Gunworks-gang 氏と、その上に銃 MOD を作られている皆様に感謝します。

3782193024.title: Antibodies B42.20 Community
3782193024.description:
Antibodies B42.20 Community Update

------------------------------------------------------------
NEW MOD - ADVERSE DRIVING CONDITIONS: DYNAMIC TRACTION!
------------------------------------------------------------

Looking for more dangerous and realistic driving in Build 42?

Check out Adverse Driving Conditions - Dynamic Traction, which introduces dynamic traction loss, understeer, oversteer and spin events during rain, snow and poor road conditions.

Dynamic Traction Workshop:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3786400622

------------------------------------------------------------
ANTIBODIES B42.20 COMMUNITY
------------------------------------------------------------

A community-maintained update of the Antibodies mod for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.

Antibodies enhances the vanilla zombification mechanic by introducing an antibody system inspired by real-life immune responses.

Instead of zombification being an automatic death sentence, your character's immune system can fight the Knox infection. Your condition, wounds, hygiene and other factors influence how effectively your antibodies develop.

Features:

- Antibody development against Knox infection
- Infection progression and recovery stages
- Recovery can occur if antibodies overcome the infection
- Health, fitness, fatigue, hunger, thirst and other conditions influence immune response
- Wounds, infections and hygiene affect antibody development
- Treatment and wound care can influence recovery
- Medical information and antibody/hygiene tracking
- Updated for Project Zomboid Build 42.20

POST-INFECTION RECOVERY

Surviving the Knox infection no longer means immediately returning to full health. Your character now goes through a recovery period after successfully overcoming the infection.

- Post-infection fatigue - survivors can remain unusually tired while recovering
- Physical weakness - endurance drains faster during the recovery period
- Activity-based exhaustion - running and sprinting place greater strain on a recovering survivor
- Lingering sickness - mild sickness can persist after the Knox infection has been defeated
- Gradual recovery - fatigue, weakness and sickness effects diminish as recovery progresses
- Variable recovery - recovery duration and severity can differ depending on how severe the infection was

The aim is to make surviving Knox feel like a significant event. Your immune system may have won the fight, but your character still needs time to recover from it.

------------------------------------------------------------
v0.3.0 - REPEAT INFECTION & IMMUNITY REBALANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

Repeat Knox infections have been substantially reworked.

Surviving Knox infection no longer means future infections become trivial. Repeat infections now become progressively more severe, while the survivor's condition and how well they are cared for can make the difference between recovery and death.

Changes:

- Reworked repeat Knox infection behaviour
- Repeat infections now progressively increase in severity
- Repeat infection severity scales up to a maximum of 1.60x
- Survivor condition and care have a greater influence on recovery
- Poor condition can result in higher infection progression and a much more dangerous fever
- Good care can meaningfully improve the chance of recovery
- Repeat infections can cause severe health loss even when antibodies eventually overcome the infection
- Added recovery handling to prevent survivors becoming effectively immune after repeatedly beating Knox infection
- Improved post-infection recovery behaviour
- Rebalanced sickness progression during repeat infections
- Various fixes and internal changes to the infection and recovery systems

Balance goal:

Previous survival gives your character an advantage, not immunity. A well-cared-for survivor may overcome Knox infection repeatedly, but poor health, negative traits and neglect can still turn a later infection fatal.

------------------------------------------------------------
ABOUT THIS VERSION
------------------------------------------------------------

This is a community-maintained compatibility update for Build 42.20, with additional fixes and features to keep Antibodies working with current Build 42 systems.

Original Antibodies mod:
https://github.com/lonegamedev/pz_mod_antibodies

Community update by Shazzi2k.

3783535220.title: Neat Lockpicking
3783535220.description:
[h1]Neat Lockpicking[/h1]

Break into locked doors, windows, and vehicles with three minigames. UI built on [b]NeatUI Framework[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Lockpicking[/b] - pin minigame on doors and vehicle doors.
[*] [b]Crowbar[/b] - skill-check on doors, garages, windows, and car doors.
[*] [b]Hotwire[/b] - wire minigame from the driver seat. Replaces vanilla hotwire.
[*] Skill books [b]Lockpicking I-V[/b] and a magazine spawn in the world.
[/list]

[h1]Lockpicking[/h1]

Who can lockpick: the [b]Burglar[/b] profession/trait, [b]or[/b] anyone who has read [i]Lockpicking Basics[/i].

[list]
[*] [b]1.[/b] Have a lockpick.
[*] [b]2.[/b] Right-click a locked door, or stand at a locked car door and press [b]V[/b].
[*] [b]3.[/b] Choose Lockpicking.
[*] [b]4.[/b] Move the pick under a pin and push it up from below.
[*] [b]5.[/b] Pins must go in a hidden order. The right pin stays; a wrong pin can snap the pick.
[*] [b]6.[/b] Set every pin to unlock.
[/list]

Handmade picks have 50% to snap. Store lockpicks last several uses. Higher Lockpicking skill = lower snap chance. Burglars get a Lockpicking XP boost.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qJZUkLW.gif[/img]

[h1]Crowbar[/h1]

Anyone with a crowbar can try. No magazine or profession required.

[list]
[*] [b]1.[/b] Right-click a locked door/window, or press [b]V[/b] on a car door.
[*] [b]2.[/b] Choose Crowbar.
[*] [b]3.[/b] Watch the moving marker.
[*] [b]4.[/b] Press [b]SPACE[/b] while it is in the yellow or green zone. Green fills more of the bar.
[*] [b]5.[/b] Repeat until the bar is full. Missing the zone fails the attempt.
[/list]

Strength makes the zones larger. Fitness and stamina decide the cost. You cannot start while exhausted. Security doors are harder (faster marker, less progress,reversed arrow).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nLldmm7.gif[/img]

[h1]Hotwire[/h1]

Sit in the driver's seat of a vehicle. You need a [b]screwdriver[/b] to unscrew the cover ([b]Burglar[/b] no needs tools).

[list]
[*] [b]1.[/b] Open Hotwire from the [b]V[/b] radial or the context menu.
[*] [b]2.[/b] Unscrew both screws.
[*] [b]3.[/b] Cut the wires.
[*] [b]4.[/b] Join the two [b]same-color battery[/b] wires. Nothing else works until this pair is joined.
[*] [b]5.[/b] Optional: [b]Test wires[/b] to see what each remaining cable is. Each test drains the car battery.
[*] 1 spark = alarm
[*] 2 sparks = starter
[*] 3 sparks = shock
[*] [b]6.[/b] Touch the [b]starter[/b] to the joined battery pair to start the engine.
[/list]

Shock hurts you. Alarm wires set off the car. Do not join those to the battery.

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Lockpicking Basics[/b] - magazine. Unlocks lockpicking and both recipes.
[*] [b]Lockpick[/b] - several uses.
[*] [b]Handmade Lockpick[/b] - breaks on a snap.
[*] [b]Lockpicking I-V[/b] - skill books, same rules as vanilla books.
[/list]

[h1]Recipes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Handmade Lockpick[/b] - 1 paperclip + screwdriver. In-hand craft. Learned from the magazine or Burglar.
[*] [b]Lockpick[/b] - 1 Iron Bar Quarter + charcoal, primitive forge, Blacksmith 3. Ball-peen hammer and metalworking pliers. Learned from the magazine, or auto at Blacksmith 4 and Lockpicking 3.
[/list]

[h1]Spawn Locations[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Magazine[/b] - bookstores, libraries, university libraries, magazine crates, post offices / mailboxes, mechanic book shelves, living-room shelves (rare), postal and mobile-library trucks.
[*] [b]Skill books I-V[/b] - bookstores, libraries, university libraries, book crates, post offices, mechanic shelves, living-room / rec-room shelves (rare), postal and mobile-library trucks. Vol. I is most common, Vol. V is rarest.
[*] [b]Lockpick[/b] - bathroom cabinets and counters, salon counters, tool stores, mechanic shelves, garages, tool crates.
[/list]

[h1]Requirements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]NeatUI Framework[/b] - load [u]before[/u] this mod.
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list]
[*] Build 42
[*] Singleplayer and multiplayer
[/list]

[h1]Translations[/h1]
EN / PL / PT-BR / RU / ES / ES-AR / FR / UA / CH / IT

[h1]Author: Repsak[/h1]

3783807916.title: Clothing and Shoe Sizes B42.20
3783807916.description:
[h2]You can somehow squeeze into every pair of trousers, hoodie and pair of shoes you find? [b]NOT ANYMORE[/b][/h2]

[h1] How this mod works [/h1]

The player is assigned a size between XS and XXL and shoe size between 4 and 13.
This can be changed in the new 'Size' tab on the Info panel (H by default)


[h2]The search for the perfect fit [/h2]
Players should be looking for clothing which fits them, obviously. When a player finds an item of clothing or shoes which are the perfect fit they can wear it - their character will even say "A perfect fit!".

[list]
[*][b]Same size[/b] → ✓ Fits perfectly
[*][b]One size smaller[/b] → ⚠ A bit tight
[*][b]One size larger[/b] → ⚠ A bit loose
[*][b]Two+ sizes smaller[/b] → ✗ Doesn't fit
[*][b]Two+ sizes larger[/b] → ✗ Doesn't fit
[/list]

Clothing or shoes which are one size bigger or smaller than the character's size [u]can[/u] be worn but will incur a slight movement penalty. There's even a handy section in the Size tab which keeps track of whether or not you're wearing anything which isn't quite right.

Clothing or shoes which are 2 sizes more or less than the player's character are impossible to wear.

[h2]A tailor as old as time [/h2]

Players with Tailoring level 7+ will be able to make adjustments to the size of clothes, changing their size up or down by one. However, this can only be done once per item and cannot be done with shoes at all.

Crafting your own clothes and shoes will always make them in the correct size for the player - so if you're in need of a new pair of XXL trousers and there aren't any XXL zombies to take them off of, you'd best crack out your needle and thread!

Items crafted by players with Tailoring 7+ should not have the 'one size larger or smaller' restriction mentioned above - effectively allowing you to resize it once to any size of your choosing.

[b]Any feedback is hugely appreciated as this is my first PZ mod.[/b]

[h2]Don't forget to rate the mod and leave any bugs or suggestions down in the comments![/h2]

3784993266.title: Diesel Fuel
3784993266.description:
Adds diesel fuel for cargo vehicles, such as trucks and vans. It also adds diesel to fuel station pumps.

Cargo vehicles (pickups, vans, box trucks) run on diesel only -- putting the wrong fuel in the tank is blocked. Most vehicles still run on gasoline.

Includes a Diesel Can item and a curated list of real-life diesel vehicles, covering vanilla, KI5, Agrotsar and Papa_Chad vehicles, plus a custom option for your own.

Translated to English, Portuguese (BR), Spanish (ES/MX/CL), French, German, Italian and Japanese.

[h2]Sandbox options[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Which vehicles need diesel[/b] -- the curated list (default), every heavy-duty vehicle, or none.
[*] [b]Extra diesel vehicles[/b] -- add vehicle IDs from any mod, separated by commas.
[*] [b]Chance a pump has diesel[/b] -- 0.0 to 1.0, default 0.6. Lower it and diesel becomes something you plan around.
[/list]

[h2]Mod compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Rick's MLC Pay & Pump[/b] -- diesel is billed at the diesel price instead of the gasoline one.
[*] [b]Gasoline goes bad[/b] -- diesel ages and spoils exactly like gasoline, cans included.
[/list]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Does it work with KI5 and other vehicle mods?[/b]
Yes. The built-in list already covers KI5, Agrotsar and Papa_Chad vehicles, and more are to come. Anything it misses, you add yourself in the sandbox options.

[b]How do I find a vehicle's ID?[/b]
Look at the vehicle and open the Mechanics screen. The "Vehicle Script" line reads Base.XXXXX -- XXXXX is the ID. Partial names work, so one entry covers every variant.

[b]Why isn't my truck on diesel?[/b]
By default only vehicles that were really diesel need it. Guessing from the game's Heavy-Duty flag would strand you in a gasoline pickup you can't refuel, so the mod errs the other way. Set "Which vehicles need diesel" to every heavy-duty vehicle if you want the wider rule.

[b]This station has no diesel. Is it broken?[/b]
No. By default about 60% of pumps sell diesel, and whether a given station has it is fixed by its position -- the same station always answers the same way, for every player on a server. Set "Chance a pump has diesel" to 1.0 if you want every pump to carry it.

[b]The pump says "No Container for Fuel" while I'm holding a diesel can.[/b]
That line comes from the base game and refers to gasoline: a can with diesel in it can't take gasoline on top. If the pump sells diesel, Take Fuel (Diesel) appears right above it. Nothing is broken.

[b]Can I put gasoline in a Diesel Can?[/b]
Yes -- what matters is what's inside the can, not the can. A Diesel Can full of gasoline won't fuel a truck, and an empty Gas Can takes diesel at the pump.

[b]Do diesel vehicles use less fuel?[/b]
In the versions prior to 1.1.7, gasoline and diesel were identical. From 1.1.7 and beyond, diesel are 20% more efficient than gasoline, but you can customize this ammount in the Sandbox Menu from 0 to 0.2 (the higher the more efficient diesel will be compared to gas)

[b]Is it safe to add to an existing save?[/b]
Yes. Removing it mid-save is safe too -- fuel tanks only ever store litres, so nothing is lost.

[b]Does it work in multiplayer?[/b]
It should -- the logic lives in shared/ and uses the game's own network actions. Run it as a required mod on the server: the restriction is applied in the menus, so a client without the mod wouldn't be subject to it. Not tested at scale yet.

[b]Build 41?[/b]
No. It uses the Build 42 fluid system.

[u]Reminder: this mod is a [b]WIP[/b]. Bug reports and vehicle IDs I missed are welcome in the comments.[/u]

3787062830.title: Skill Book Library
3787062830.description:
[h1]Skill Book Library[/h1]

Stop digging through a pile of skill books to work out what you have.

Skill Book Library turns three ordinary vanilla bookcases into a proper reference library for all 120 vanilla skill books. Every volume has a known place. Missing books are visibly missing. Any readable books are obvious at a glance.

There are no new items, furniture, textures or magic storage. Your books remain real physical books in real bookcases. This mod simply gives the collection a clear home and a clean way to browse it.

[h2]What you get[/h2]
[list]
[*]Organise all 120 vanilla skill books: 24 skills, five volumes each.
[*]Designate supported vanilla bookcases as Shelf A, B or C.
[*]Browse the whole nearby collection from one window.
[*]See present books as labelled spines and missing books as dark labelled spaces.
[*]Know whether a volume is done, in progress, or the next useful book for your character.
[*]Keep every book physically stored, lootable and movable as normal.
[/list]

[h2]How it works[/h2]

Right-click a vanilla bookcase and designate it as Shelf A, B or C. Each shelf holds the 40 books for eight skills, arranged alphabetically:
[list]
[*]Shelf A: Agriculture to Cooking
[*]Shelf B: Electrical to Maintenance
[*]Shelf C: Masonry to Welding
[/list]

Right-click any designated bookcase and choose [i]Browse the collection[/i]. If the other designated shelves are within four tiles, The Library window shows all three together.

Put books into the relevant bookcase normally. The panel only displays what is physically there; it never creates, moves or consumes books. One copy of each volume is allowed per shelf. If a duplicate is added, a warning text is displayed on the panel.

[h2]Reading status[/h2]
[list]
[*]Green: you have read the volume, or your skill level has already passed it and you no longer need it.
[*]Blue: this is an unread volume you can benefit from reading now.
[*]Amber: you have started reading this book but have not finished it.
[*]No accent: the book is not currently useful yet, or it is missing from the shelf.
[/list]

Right-click a present, ready book in the library to read it using the normal game action; it is returned to its bookcase afterwards.

[h1]Check out my other mods![/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781912830 - VHS Queue
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3780567359 - Reading Nook

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Do I need three bookcases?[/b]
No. One designated bookcase works fine. Three nearby shelves give you the complete library view.

[b]Does this add books, furniture or storage space?[/b]
No. It uses the vanilla books and vanilla bookcases already in your world.

[b]Can I move the bookcase?[/b]
Yes. Its Shelf A/B/C designation moves with it because it belongs to that individual bookcase.

[b]Why is a book green when I have read 0 pages?[/b]
Your character's skill is already above the levels covered by that volume, so reading it would give no benefit. It is green so the shelf answers the useful question: do you still need this book?

[b]Does it work in multiplayer?[/b]
Yes. Shelf designations are server-authoritative, so everyone sees the same collection. Reading status is personal to each player.

[b]Will it conflict with other reading mods?[/b]
Skill Book Library only records a shelf letter on supported vanilla bookcases and reads their real contents. It does not alter books or vanilla reading mechanics.

3789366983.title: KI5 General Fixes
3789366983.description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/rK8yVgJz/Steam-Workshop-Description-Seperator.png[/img]

A collection of fixes for bugs affecting KI5's vehicles, from engine level gaps that hit every car to problems on one specific vehicle.

[b]Build 42.20+. Singleplayer and multiplayer. Safe on an existing save. Load order does not matter.[/b]

I wrote this for my own game and a friend's server. It is published in case it is useful to anyone else, not as a supported mod. I may read bug reports and I may fix things, but I am not promising to.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/xtVSd8Kn/Steam-Workshop-Contents-Seperator.png[/img]

[b]What it fixes, in full:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Stutter as a vehicle loads in[/b], and the [i]cannot get ID for container[/i] spam behind it. Affects every KI5 vehicle.
[*][b]The '80 MAN KAT1 sinking into the ground[/b] and not coming back up. That vehicle only.
[/list]

That is the whole list. If a bug is not named above, this mod does not touch it. In particular it does [b]not[/b] fix missing wheels or other model problems, engine or fuel drain behaviour, or vanilla cars appearing where a KI5 one was expected. It adds no vehicles and replaces none.


[b]Stutter as a vehicle loads in[/b]

The engine only knows nine vehicle container names, hardcoded, and they are all vanilla's own. Every trunk, roofrack and seat a modded vehicle adds fails that lookup, and the game writes to two log files each time, once per container on every loot roll. That is the stutter, and the [i]cannot get ID for container[/i] lines in your console are the same thing.

It also means no loot table can target those containers at all. This registers every one it can find, getting on for four hundred. Nothing spawns or changes as a result.

An engine gap rather than a KI5 one, so it covers any vehicle mod that hits it.

If you see [i]KI5 General Fixes: vehicle container 'X' is not registered[/i], that is a car I do not own, so its ids were never collected. Post the message and I can add it.


[b]'80 MAN KAT1 sinking into the ground[/b]

Loaded, the truck bottoms out its suspension, drops through the terrain and has no travel left to climb back out, so it stays sunk. This raises the suspension travel, which is what lets it come back up, along with the rest length, stiffness and damping so the extra travel does not just turn into a bounce.

Credit for the numbers goes to a player who worked them out by driving it from Ekron to West Point fully loaded. They make the truck usable, not correct: wheel size and spacing are still off and only KI5 can fix those.

Nothing of KI5's is edited or replaced. The change is applied to the script the game has already loaded, and it stands down on its own if KI5 ever touches the suspension themselves.

[b]This one is off by default.[/b] Turn on [b]Fix the '80 MAN KAT1 sinking[/b] in the sandbox options, under KI5 General Fixes. It changes how a vehicle handles on one player's tuning rather than fixing something outright broken, and that is not a thing to do to your game uninvited. It is a server setting rather than a client one, because two people on the same server driving the same truck to different physics would be worse than either answer.

The container id fix has no setting and is always on. It changes nothing you can see and there is no reason to want it off.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/2wC3Ykd/Steam-Workshop-Compatibility-Seperator.png[/img]

　✓ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3171167894]that DAMN Library[/url] (required, every KI5 vehicle needs it already)
　✓ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3740300378]KI5 Mini-fixes[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3457132019]Specific Loot (KI5)[/url]
　✓ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3423424077]Vanilla Vehicles Replacer (KI5)[/url]
　✓ Any KI5 vehicle, trailer or camper

No files from any other mod are bundled here.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/d4CjJYgB/Steam-Workshop-Issues-Bugs-Seperator.png[/img]

Restart the game after enabling, reloading the save is not enough.

If you do report something, say which vehicle, singleplayer or multiplayer, and include the console error. [url=https://github.com/aspctt/KI5GeneralFixes]GitHub[/url] or here. The mod id is [b]KI5GeneralFixes[/b].


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Z63wG3cw/Steam-Workshop-Credits-Seperator.png[/img]

The vehicles are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198030597952/myworkshopfiles/?appid=108600]KI5's[/url], and that DAMN Library with them. This mod would have nothing to do without them.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3740300378]KI5 Mini-fixes[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3457132019]Specific Loot (KI5)[/url] by Пупсич cover neighbouring ground and are worth running alongside this.

3777663603.title: Even More Traits [42.20]
3777663603.description:
Over 30 traits, good and bad. Juggernaut, Berserker, Plot Armor, Spartan, Second Wind, Night Walker and Quicksilver if you have points to spend. Insanity, PTSD, Addict, Anorexic, ADHD, Codependant and friends if you need some back.

Singleplayer and multiplayer. Nothing else to install.

This is Lazolo's Even More Traits brought up to 42.20. The traits, the effects and the writing are all theirs: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2855320431]the original is here[/url]. Go rate it.

[b]To Lazolo[/b]
If you want this taken down, message me and it is gone. If you would rather update the original yourself, say so and I will send you every change and the fixed files.

[b]What was broken[/b]
Build 42 changed how mods create traits, so none of them turned up in character creation. Then it changed how stats are read and written, so anything that did turn up could not actually do anything.

That same change killed Stat Tweaks Lib, which the original depends on. It cannot work on 42.20 no matter what you subscribe to. If your character ever announced "Even More Traits requires Stat Tweaks Library", that was this.

[b]What I changed[/b]
- Traits are built on the current system again, with their costs, descriptions, icons, skill bonuses and exclusions.
- Rewrote every stat call in the mod, 82 of them, so the effects run.
- The stat engine is part of the mod now. Stat Tweaks Lib is not needed.
- Starting items get handed out properly in multiplayer, and only once per character.
- Sandbox toggles work. They were read wrongly, so anything you switched off stayed on.
- Translations load again, all nine languages.
- Split screen players no longer share one set of stat tracking between them.

[b]Multiplayer and load order[/b]
Build 42 sets up modded traits in one pass over your mod list, and it does not cope with one of them failing. A single broken trait mod takes down every trait mod after it, on whichever side it broke, and then your server and your client disagree about which traits exist. That is the load order shuffling people end up doing to get trait mods working on a server.

This one sets itself up on its own, after that pass, on both sides. Where it sits in your list does not matter, and it will not drag anything else down either. If you already run a general fix for this, no conflict there.

[b]Notes[/b]
- Do not run this and the original together.
- Trait ids changed, so an old character will not keep them. Start a new one.
- MoodleFramework is optional. Install it for the extra moodles or skip it.
- Fine alongside More Traits, same as before. Traits that should not stack still do not.
- Already have Stat Tweaks Lib for something else? Leave it. This keeps its own data and will not touch it.
- On load the console says how many traits it set up. If that is ever zero, something stopped it and I want to know.

[b]My other Build 42 mods[/b]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3774243294]Sound Direction Indicator[/url], for playing without sound.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3774789651]Long Term Preservation[/url], curing and jarring so food keeps without power.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3775816001]Adjustable Unhappiness[/url], a slider for how fast unhappiness climbs.

3790123686.title: Generator Hose
3790123686.description:
[h1]Generator Hose — Build 42[/h1]
Connect nearby fluid containers to generators using a vanilla Rubber Hose, or a craftable Long Hose for longer/cross-floor runs.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Connect nearby B42 fluid containers to a generator through the Generator context submenu.
[*]A regular Rubber Hose reaches 1 tile away on the same floor.
[*]Craft a Long Hose (2 Rubber Hoses + Duct Tape or Scotch Tape) to reach 2 tiles on the same floor, or a source one floor above. A Long Hose can also be split back into 2 Rubber Hoses.
[*]Connecting also requires Duct Tape to seal the joint (configurable) - crafting and connecting only use a single charge from the roll, never the whole thing.
[*]The connect option always shows up, even when it can't be used yet - greyed out with a tooltip explaining why (no hose, or nothing in range).
[*]Hover a connection option to highlight the exact container in the world.
[*]Fuel transfers gradually while the generator tank has free capacity.
[*]If the external container runs dry, the generator simply falls back to its own fuel tank.
[*]Empty containers are harmless.
[*]Connecting a running generator to the wrong non-empty liquid, or starting it while connected to the wrong liquid, shuts it down and damages condition by 5-30%.
[*]Timed connect/disconnect actions with animation and progress bar.
[*]Sandbox options for connection radii, floor-above access, the tape requirement, and the fuel transfer rate.
[*]Full English, Ukrainian and Russian localization.
[*]Designed for Build 42.20+ and multiplayer/dedicated servers.
[/list]

[h2]Usage[/h2]
Keep a hose (and, by default, some Duct Tape) in your inventory. Right-click a generator, open the Generator submenu, choose Connect fuel hose to, then select a nearby compatible container.

[h2]Compatibility
Useful barrels - approved compatibility. Should support any modded object using vanilla FluidContainer.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
Default transfer rate: 0.10 generator fuel units per in-game minute (sandbox configurable).
Mod ID: GeneratorHose

3793911582.title: Zomboid Unified Engine Tweaks (Z-UET) - B42.20.04
3793911582.description:
Zomboid Unified Engine Tweaks (Z-UET) - B42.20.04
Build 42.20.04 compatible only.
Unified async tick + alloy cache + smooth input for zombie-heavy late game.
Based on ZombieBuddy runtime patching.

---

How do I install and use this mod ?

- Subscribe and enable in mod list (requires ZombieBuddy 2.3.2+)
- Place at bottom of load order if using other patch mods
- Start game, approve ZUET.jar in ZombieBuddy dialog (SHA-256)
- Open Options -> Mods -> Z-UET to configure
- Safe to add/remove mid-save (no save data)

Do not use with other mods that patch MovingObjectUpdateScheduler / IsoCell.getGridSquare at the same time (e.g. ZBBetterFPS's optimizeIsoMovingObject).

---

Features

- Async tick: MovingObjectUpdateScheduler zone-partitioned parallel (player-near 5 tiles stay sync)
- Alloy cache: IsoCell / IsoChunk getGridSquare + IsoGridSquare isBlockedTo
- Smooth input: Windows glfwPollEvents decoupling
- JVM tuning: ZGC, JIT thresholds verified via JFR (Deopt -11% vs vanilla in steady state)

---

Mod Options (Options -> Mods -> Z-UET)

- Enable Parallel Ticks (default: ON) - Parallelizes zombie ticks. OFF keeps fully synchronous behavior
- Auto-tune Worker Count (default: ON) - Automatically tuned for CPU (2C=1, 4C=2, 6C=4, 12C=6). OFF uses manual value
- Worker Count (default: 6, 1-16) - Only used when Auto-tune is OFF. Restart required
- Allow Concurrent World Ticks (default: OFF, experimental) - Parallelizes world ticks. May improve TPS but raises race risks. Do not enable for normal play as this is a development-stage feature. Restart required
- Enable Alloy Cache (default: ON) - isBlockedTo / getGridSquare cache. OFF reverts to vanilla. Restart required
- Enable Performance Metrics (default: OFF, debug) - Currently not wired. No console output. Reserved for future BATCH dt / thread distribution logging. Leave OFF
- Enable Smooth Input (default: ON) - Reduces input latency. Most effective on Windows; smaller benefit on Linux/Mac
- Aggressive Window Caching (default: OFF) - Caches glfwGetWindowSize. Small FPS gain but may cause size drift on Alt-Tab. Restart required

Note: OS: %1 | Recommended workers: %2 is auto-detected. Worker Count / Alloy Cache / Aggressive Caching require restart. Windows benefits most from RawInput; Linux/Mac gains are smaller.

---

Requirements

- Project Zomboid B42.20.04 (Java 25 bundled)
- ZombieBuddy 2.3.2+

---

Credits

- zed-0xff - ZombieBuddy framework
- Gson - bundled under Apache-2.0

---

Bugs

If you encounter any issue, post in BUGS discussion with logs (console.txt + ZUET.jfr if possible). Check for patch conflicts first.
Known issue: chunk reload may leave stale cache - restart fixes.

Mod ID: ZUET

3037854728.title: [B42.2/B41] Tikitown & Powerplant
3037854728.description:
[h1]Welcome to Tikitown![/h1]

Tikitown sits between Riverside and West Point, near Fallas Lake. Use it as a long-term base, a supply run, or just another place you clear out and move on from. Walk the old main street, pick through the downtown shops and offices, or move into one of the custom houses and rebuild it however you want.

It mixes familiar Kentucky sprawl with a lot of new ground to fight over and fortify. Some of it's comfortable. Some of it isn't. A few spots are better left alone.

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/scl/fi/81fskkau8cr0io4nrf4a5/B42-info.png?rlkey=98cvywlrq7z1gjqfpqopc1j6z&st=g749wu5i[/img]

[h2]Tikitown's Own Powerplant[/h2]

[h3]We're BACK! The Powerplant has been tested on Single and Multiplayer and works on both now[/h3]

The power plant is the biggest addition to Tikitown. It's a separate add-on mod you enable on its own, but it ships bundled with this workshop item, so there's nothing extra to download. The user guide is still being written and the current version is already a little behind thanks to some last-minute changes, but it's here:
[url=https://gist.github.com/drazion/9eed8b69a9c47bdca722c2d4942a7523]Tikitown Power Plant User Guide[/url]

Give it a run and leave feedback. Wear rates are in the mod options so you can tune them to your playstyle, and I'll keep making small changes as I go, including a fueling requirement down the line.

[h3]What's new in Tikitown[/h3]
Tikitown has picked up hundreds of new locations for Build 42, with over 250 new buildings since launch. If you knew the B41 version, a lot of the town is different now.

• [b]Downtown rebuild:[/b] A reworked business core with new landmarks, side streets, and trouble spots.
• [b]Rail and docks:[/b] A commuter rail line plus a large warehouse, railyard, and docklands for late-game looting and base builds.
• [b]Blackshields Sheriff's Office:[/b] A large police station themed around the Blackshields.
• [b]FBI field office:[/b] A small federal site with security, offices, and higher-end loot if you can clear it.
• [b]Tikitown University:[/b] A full campus with lecture halls, dorms, and a to-scale baseball and football field.
• [b]Mansion Row expanded:[/b] More big houses on the hill if you like gated compounds and long driveways.
• [b]New underground spaces:[/b] Tunnels, garages, and service corridors that link parts of town and give you more ways to move around or disappear.
• [b]Industrial sector overhaul:[/b] Factories, depots, and yards built out as a proper industrial belt on the edge of town.
• [b]Tikitown Power Plant add-on:[/b] A fully mapped power station behind the hospital, with repairable equipment, custom loot, and an optional system to bring the town's grid back online for a while.
• [b]Expanded docks:[/b] A built-out Port Authority and northside docks, with more warehouses, offices, and room to stash a boat or a safehouse.

[h3]Will you claim Tikitown as your own, or will it just be another place you passed through?[/h3]

[img]https://www.dl.dropboxusercontent.com/scl/fi/zpy1wal5l3sika0zs872r/B41-sub-banner-Source.png?rlkey=5vs5q4dr4pvzm2zs48m5bxvqk&st=1djwurrj[/img]

[h1]ONLY B42[/h1]

[h1]PLEASE READ BEFORE USE[/h1]

Hello everyone, for all the people who already played SecretZ and SecretZ Pandemic in B41, well you already know what it is, for all the new ones, this a map pack, adding several military checkpoints, bunkers, and some reworked vanilla places into military bases and refugee camps.

In this case, for everyone who already played it, you will notice there's a lot left behind at B41, B42 still under development and official modding tools are not released yet, so this was done thanks to our skillful modding community effort and support which is trying to keep the rythm with all the new changes and so i am.

Said that, still a lot of work to do, probably i was only able to get back 40% of my B41 maps, some of them are lost forever so i'll need to remake them once the stable version get's released.

Tilepacks are not available yet for B42 officially, so you'll probably find that some places are somehow "empty", not at all but it will be easy to notice there are some tiles which should be there and aren't, so this is "normal" for the moment.

I will keep this separated from my B41 versions, because i'll need to update this one with some frequency and still under development so, in advance take that into account, if everything goes well maybe for B42 stable release i'll be able to drop a full version updating my B41 mods and deleting this one, this is important, is just a temporary version, keep that in mind.



[h1]WHAT WE HAVE HERE[/h1]

As you can guess, everything reworked from vanilla Louisville is lost, so main part of the maps are checkpoints around Muldraugh, the reworked Valley Station Mall, and some more checkpoints past Rosewood, plus the Military Complex of Louisville. In resume, you'll get several Military Checkpoints around the map, some reworked places as the Mall like military checkpoint/base, and some hidden underground military bunkers.

Any error/bug you find, post it, so i can take a loot and try to fix it while i keep working on bring back all i can from my B41 maps.

Use it with caution, i wouldn't recommend to use it on an already made world, so just in a new one.

3685508479.title: [B42]Xixi's Serene Cottage
3685508479.description:
In the earliest days of the apocalypse, Xixi and her friends built this safehouse.
Here, she learned to fall asleep to the steady hum of the generator, to create varied flavors with limited ingredients, and to read a worn book by the faint glow of a lamp on silent nights.
But Xixi knew the world was vast—they couldn't stay in one place forever.
When she had gathered enough courage and resolve, she embarked on a new journey with her friends to see if there were other possibilities beyond this wasteland.
This house, along with all the kindness and blessings she left behind, was reserved for the next person who might need it.
If it can help you, Xixi and her friends will be happy for you!

This safehouse is located east of Fallas Lake Town, suitable for 2–3 people, with complete facilities and containing brand-new exclusive furniture, unique items, and specialized backpacks.
The estate is surrounded by lakes and features a basement, forge, garage, small parking area, livestock zone, and agricultural planting area.
Separated from Fallas Lake Town by a forest, you can try visiting the town if you stay here.

3781991849.title: Riverside Mansion
3781991849.description:
[h1]Riverside Mansion[/h1]
A luxurious mansion east of Riverside with everything you need to survive an apocalypse.

Update: Now you can choose from three versions of the mansion when you start your game.

[list]
[*] [h3]Riverside Mansion[/h3] (fully furnished and with the loot you have configured in your game).
[*] [h3]Riverside Mansion - No Loot[/h3] (fully furnished, but every container inside the mansion spawns empty).
[*] [h3]Riverside Mansion - Empty[/h3] (completely unfurnished: no furniture and no containers at all, just the empty building).
[/list]

Cell 28,20

As far as I know, does not cause conflict with any other map mods.

If you like the mod you would make me very happy by giving me a👍

[hr][/hr]

[h1]MULTIPLAYER SERVER SETUP[/h1]

These lines go in your server .ini. Pick ONE of the three Mods= lines.
[code]WorkshopItems=3781991849
Map=riversidemansion;Muldraugh, KY[/code]

1) Normal mansion - furnished, with loot:
[code]Mods=RiversideMansionMod42[/code]

2) No Loot - furnished, but every container spawns empty:
[code]Mods=RiversideMansionMod42;RiversideMansionMod42NoLoot[/code]

3) Empty - no furniture and no containers at all:
[code]Mods=RiversideMansionMod42;RiversideMansionMod42Empty[/code]

- [b]Map=[/b] Place riversidemansion before "Muldraugh, KY"

- [b]Mods=[/b] It always needs the base ID RiversideMansionMod42. The No Loot and Empty mods declare it as a dependency.

- Never enable No Loot and Empty together. They are marked as incompatible.

- If you want the mansion to be selectable as a spawn point, add this line to <servername>_spawnregions.lua:
[code]{ name = "riversidemansion", file = "media/maps/riversidemansion/spawnpoints.lua" },[/code]

2463499011.title: Grapeseed [B42 Unstable Remake]
2463499011.description:
[h2] Disclaimer: This is an unstable release. For Grapeseed-related issues, please use the bug report section do not contact Indie Stone.

A big thank you to Indie Stone for reigniting our passion for mapping, 
Build 42 is truly incredible![/h2]

[h2] Grapeseed is a map mod located North West of Rosewood.[/h2]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/x8W752B/New-Project.png[/img]

[h3]The Build 42 Update:[/h3]
[b]Expanded Cells:[/b]
From just 1 cell originally to 12 cells.
[b]Increased Buildings:[/b]
Grew from 60+ buildings to over 200.
[b]Authenticity[/b]:
Transitioned from a meme-heavy, anachronistic design to a time-period-appropriate setting.
[b]Complete Overhaul[/b]:
Entirely rebuilt from scratch, ensuring a fresh and improved experience.
[b]New Assets[/b]:
None of the previous buildings have been reused every structure is brand new.
[b]Returning Brands[/b]:
Familiar favorites like Royale With Cheese and Tristan's Tools make a comeback.
[b]Custom Tiles[/b]:
Thoughtfully designed custom tiles to avoid bloating your game or server performance.
[b]No Additional Tile Packs[/b]:
Eliminated the need for extra tile packs, simplifying installation.
[b]Balanced Zombie Spawns[/b]:
Carefully tuned zombie spawns for a more immersive experience, no overwhelming hordes.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]

Grapeseed doesn’t display correctly on the start location map.
Foraging system needs adjustments.
Basements are not yet implemented.
Occasional tree clipping near fences.
Big Boulders spawning in farm / residential zones.
In-game map clips further than the space it occupies.
Note: These issues will be resolved once the official Build 42 mapping tools are released.

3733167464.title: [B42] SecretZ Pandemic [MODULAR]
3733167464.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BrQUXVd.png[/img]

[h1]LINK FOR B41 VERSION[/h1]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3017588820



[h1]ONLY B42[/h1]

[h1]MODULAR VERSION[/h1]

This version was made specially for those who play singleplayer and want's more control over which maps would like to load or not, so every map is separated in different modules for make it easier to enable or not. Please, don't mix the mods, if you are using the modular version just unsubscribe the other one or make sure you enable the correct mod in game, even if shouldn't be problems having both versions is better to keep it clean.

[h1]PLEASE READ BEFORE USE[/h1]

Hello everyone, for all the people who already played SecretZ and SecretZ Pandemic in B41, well you already know what it is, for all the new ones, this a map pack, adding several military checkpoints, bunkers, and some reworked vanilla places into military bases and refugee camps.

In this case, for everyone who already played it, you will notice there's a lot left behind at B41, B42 still under development and official modding tools are not released yet, so this was done thanks to our skillful modding community effort and support which is trying to keep the rythm with all the new changes and so i am.

Said that, still a lot of work to do, probably i was only able to get back 40% of my B41 maps, some of them are lost forever so i'll need to remake them once the stable version get's released.

Tilepacks are not available yet for B42 officially, so you'll probably find that some places are somehow "empty", not at all but it will be easy to notice there are some tiles which should be there and aren't, so this is "normal" for the moment.

I will keep this separated from my B41 versions, because i'll need to update this one with some frequency and still under development so, in advance take that into account, if everything goes well maybe for B42 stable release i'll be able to drop a full version updating my B41 mods and deleting this one, this is important, is just a temporary version, keep that in mind.



[h1]WHAT WE HAVE HERE[/h1]

As you can guess, everything reworked from vanilla Louisville is lost, so main part of the maps are checkpoints around Muldraugh, the reworked Valley Station Mall, and some more checkpoints past Rosewood, plus the Military Complex of Louisville. In resume, you'll get several Military Checkpoints around the map, some reworked places as the Mall like military checkpoint/base, and some hidden underground military bunkers.

Any error/bug you find, post it, so i can take a loot and try to fix it while i keep working on bring back all i can from my B41 maps.

Use it with caution, i wouldn't recommend to use it on an already made world, so just in a new one.

* North-East Muldraugh Checkpoint
* South-East Muldraugh Checkpoint
* North-West Rosewood Checkpoint
* North-West Checkpoint
* Deerhead Lake Military Camp
* Muldraugh EVAC Point Train Depot
* Military Blockade at Rosewood-Muldraught crossing
* Military checkpoint at Marchridge entrance, and a research complex
* Valley Station Mall as Military base


[h1]RECOMMENDATIONS TO USE WITH[/h1]

[h1]THEY KNEW B42[/h1]

Lore friendly with the theme of SecretZ, adding more special items related.

[url= https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3387110070 ][img]https://i.imgur.com/6alTPPv.png[/img][/url]

In case of conflicts, just be sure to overwrite the prefered map by changing the load order.
